name: Dirfys Trail Run 2026
description: The Dirfys Trail Run is a challenging mountain-running event held in the area of Steni, Evia. It features four different routes of varying lengths and difficulty, offering a unique experience for runners of all levels. The course crosses beautiful trails in the mountainous natural landscape of Dirfys, with impressive scenery and varied terrain. The race is organized by the Evia Runners Athletic and Cultural Association and is an important sporting event in the area.
course_highlights: Routes along the mountain trails of Dirfys
Impressive natural scenery and varied terrain
Four different routes of varying lengths and difficulty
additional: The race includes results recording with the ITRA - UTMB Index. Participant lists and photos from previous years are available. The organizers provide technical information and race regulations for each route.

name: Вещица рън
location: Игрището, поляна над с. Извос, Белоградчик, Bulgaria
description: “Witch Run” is a themed recreational run in the Belogradchik area, organized by BG Events & Guiding. In a previous edition, participants covered a 15-kilometer route, part of which was dedicated to the witch theme and flying on broomsticks. The event combines outdoor activity with a festive atmosphere and themed surprises.
course_highlights: A 15-kilometer route in the Belogradchik area, according to information about a previous edition
A themed 2-kilometer section dedicated to flying on broomsticks
Starting location in a previous edition: the meadow above the village of Izvos, known as “The Playing Field”
additional: The available information refers to previous editions and does not confirm details about the race on 29.11.2026.

name: Babe Trail 2026
location: Osnovna škola Cana Marjanović, Stojnik, Serbia

name: Zapad Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a competitive and recreational sporting event held on Fruška Gora, known for its historic trails and new challenges. The event features various courses, including an ultra-extreme marathon, an ultra marathon, and medium and short courses suited to runners of different abilities. It brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience amid the beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora. The organizers aim to provide good organization and support for participants throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra Extreme Marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern Marathon with 3 ITRA points
Apprentice Southern Marathon with 1 ITRA point
additional: Transport to the marathon start from Novi Sad is organized for Saturday from 6:00. On-site registration for the FUN courses is available at Popovica on Saturday. Race packets are collected before the race. The races are scored under the ITRA system across different courses. Participants can expect various race categories, including ultra, medium, and beginner courses, with online registration available. The event is part of a wider festival promoting sport and nature on Fruška Gora.

description: The International Olympia Marathon is a historic road race held in Ancient Olympia, the birthplace of Olympism. Runners have the opportunity to run along the historic “Sacred Way,” following a route rich in cultural memory and sporting ideals. The event includes a Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km, Family Run, and children’s race, offering a unique sporting experience for everyone. The start and finish are at the Town Hall Square in Ancient Olympia, with full support and services for participants.
course_highlights: Route along the historic “Sacred Way” of Ancient Olympia
8 support stations with water, isotonic drinks, energy gels, and medical assistance
Kilometre markers every 5 km and electronic timing
additional: Runner benefits: race bib with electronic timing chip, commemorative medal and T-shirt, and water, isotonic drink, energy drink, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. There are 8 support stations with water, isotonic drink, and energy gels. A medical check is mandatory to participate. Doping control is conducted by the Hellenic Anti-Doping Organization. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the Ancient Olympia Town Hall, as well as portable toilets along the course. Runners must keep to the right side of the road. The event welcomes participants from around the world and features celebrations and awards, with an emphasis on cultural heritage and the spirit of the Olympic Games.

name: 7ο Γόριτσα Trail
description: The 7th Goritsa Trail is a mountain race organized by the Volos Health Runners’ Club in cooperation with the Region of Thessaly and under the auspices of the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultra-Running Clubs. The race takes place on Volos’s beloved hill, offering a unique mountain-running experience amid beautiful scenery and natural beauty. The start and finish are at the foot of Goritsa Hill, next to the EAK Volos Stadium. The event is affiliated with the International Trail Running Association (I.T.R.A.) and is fully covered by the National Center for Emergency Care (EKAB) to ensure runners’ safety.
course_highlights: 24 km course with an ITRA difficulty rating of 1
8 km course starting at 09:45
Start and finish at the foot of Goritsa Hill, next to the EAK Volos Stadium
additional: EKAB provides full safety coverage for runners, with a staffed motorcycle for rapid response. The event is supported by the Special Forces Association of Magnesia. There are also 5 km (1 hour and 30 minutes) and 15 km (4 hours and 30 minutes) courses, starting from Goritsa Church and the chapel of Katichori, respectively. Aid stations and safety coverage by EKAB are provided. Register at https://bit.ly/goritsa26.

name: Παλαμήδειος Άθλος
location: Entrance to Palamidi Castle, 25is Martiou Street, Nafplio, Greece
description: The Municipality of Nafplio organizes the Palamidi Challenge, a race honoring the anniversary of the fall of Palamidi. Participants climb the historic Palamidi Castle via its 999 steps and descend toward the city. The program includes 4.2 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, as well as a 500 m children’s race.
course_highlights: Climb to Palamidi Castle via its 999 steps.
Descend from the historic castle toward the city.
Option to cover the 4.2 km course twice in the Athlos Double Challenge, for a total of 8.4 km.
additional: The routes start and finish in the area in front of the Castle entrance, on 25th March Street. The Palamidi Challenge is described as a race with special requirements.

name: Spata Run 5
location: Municipal Stadium of Spata “D. Dimitriou”, Spata, Greece
description: Spata Run 5 is an established road race held in Spata, offering 5 km and 10 km races, as well as free children’s races of 200 and 1,000 meters. The event takes place at the Spata Municipal Stadium “D. Dimitriou” and includes electronic timing, commemorative medals, and awards by age category. It attracts runners of all ages and abilities, with strict adherence to fair-play rules and respect for participants and organizers.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses on a predetermined, marked route along public roads
Electronic timing with two timing stations on each course
Water stations: two for the 5,000 meters and four for the 10,000 meters
additional: Race bib and race materials pickup: Thursday 26/11, 18:00-21:00; Friday 27/11, 18:00-21:00; Saturday 28/11, 11:00-14:00; Sunday 29/11, 07:00-08:00. The timing chip and T-shirt can be collected from the office behind the stadium stands. The maximum number of participants in the 5 km and 10 km races is 500. A bag drop area is available. Teams/clubs may run in a shirt of their choice. Time limits: 50 minutes for the 5,000 meters and 100 minutes for the 10,000 meters. Runners aged 15 and older may participate in the 5 km race. Runners receive a commemorative medal and event T-shirt, and can use the bag drop area.

description: The 3rd No Discrimination Race is organized by the Runners of Hope Association and takes place at the Olympic Stadium (OAKA). The race aims to promote equality and combat all forms of discrimination, with an emphasis on social inclusion and supporting children with disabilities. The start and finish are at the Stoa of the Agora, offering a lovely atmosphere in a historic setting. The event includes a 5-kilometer race and a 1,000-meter children’s race. All proceeds will support the purchase of a wheelchair for children with disabilities.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Stoa of the Agora at OAKA
5 km route with water stations at 2.5 km and at the finish
Children’s race and 1,000 m race for people with disabilities
additional: Race-pack collection is available from the Registration Desk at the OAKA VIP entrance (Gate A) from 8:00 to 9:45 a.m. Voluntary medical coverage is provided by a race doctor and an EKAB ambulance. Registration is online only and is confirmed by emailing proof of bank deposit to the organizer. Proceeds will go toward purchasing a wheelchair for the association.

name: Eco Trail Ultra
description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the race offers a variety of routes, including the 50 km ultramarathon, team races, a half marathon, a cross race, and children’s races. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions while enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and refreshment stations. The event also includes a live broadcast, modern facilities, and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and sweets
The final 12 km are predominantly downhill, with just one climb of more than 100 m
additional: The race kit includes a race bib with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a finisher’s medal, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory products, still and sparkling water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruit. Time limits are 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also includes Play&Run children’s races and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Race distances include Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children’s races; events take place from 28 November to 1 December 2026, with exhibitions, race-kit distribution, and awards ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The 1 December Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, open to runners of all levels. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with well-organized courses and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can receive race kits and attentive organizational support, helping ensure a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, bringing the community together for a worthy purpose.
course_highlights: Course held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Race kits handed directly to participants or to a representative with the required documents
Race kit collection available over the three days before the race
additional: Race kits can be collected over the three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (69 Unirii Boulevard) and ParkLake Shopping Center. Kits are handed only to the registered and validated participant, upon presentation of an identity document. Another person may collect a kit only with a signed copy of the participant’s identity document. For the teenagers’ race, the kit is handed only to the minor, accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who want to support a good cause through sport. The event offers an enjoyable running experience in a friendly setting, promoting the local running community and social engagement. This is the first edition of the race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km course in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Sfântul Nectarie' Palliative Care Center for seriously ill children
Race options: 2 km (family, non-competitive) and 6 km (competitive)
additional: The event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: 4 Run 4 Fun 2026 – Etapa 4 (Alergarea de Moș Nicolae)
XL kmrun - Северен парк
description: XL kmrun - North Park is a race on the 5kmrun calendar, held in North Park, Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—6 km, 12 km, and 18 km—suitable for different levels of fitness. The event offers the opportunity to run in a natural setting on varied terrain and is part of the XLkmrun series of races held at various locations around Sofia. It is a traditional winter race that attracts runners from the city and the surrounding region.
course_highlights: Three distances: 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km
Terrain with alternating climbs and descents
Held in North Park, Sofia
additional: The distances allow participants to choose according to their abilities and preferred level of exertion. The race is part of the XLkmrun winter calendar and takes place in conditions suitable for winter running.

name: Gučevo winter trail 2026
location: Planinarski dom PK Gučevo, Mount Gučevo, Serbia
description: Gučevo Winter Trail 2026 is a mountain race held on Mount Gučevo, starting near the PK Gučevo Mountain Lodge. The race is challenging, with 700 metres of total elevation gain and 700 metres of descent over a 13 km course. Participants can enjoy the natural scenery and demanding terrain, which tests endurance and running technique. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the organizers emphasize the importance of following the rules and staying safe during the race.
course_highlights: 13 km course with 700 m of total elevation gain and 700 m of descent
Mountain terrain on Mount Gučevo
Checkpoints at 6 km and at the finish at 13 km
additional: Registration requires confirmation that participants have read and understood the race regulations and risks, as well as permission to use photos and videos from the race. Registration includes consent to participate at one’s own risk and acceptance of the regulations and rules of conduct.

description: The Vojvodina Trekking League (VTL) is a series of trekking races held on attractive trails in Vojvodina, open to all interested runners and nature lovers. The league’s eighth round, Vetrenjača Trail, takes place in Debeljača and offers two routes of different lengths and difficulty levels, suited to varying levels of fitness. The race is organized in the spirit of hiking ethics and sportsmanship, with the aim of promoting an active lifestyle and enjoyment of the region’s natural beauty. Participants register via an online form, and the entry fee is paid on site.
course_highlights: Small Route: 10.9 km with 22 m of elevation gain; time limit 3.5 hours
Big Route: 20.6 km with 45 m of elevation gain; time limit 6 hours
The routes pass through the natural surroundings of Debeljača and have marked checkpoints
additional: Participant check-in is from 08:00 to 09:50, and awards are presented from 13:00 to 15:00. Participants run at their own risk and must respect hiking ethics and the organizers’ instructions. The time limit is 3.5 hours for the Small Route and 6 hours for the Big Route. Participation is at the participants’ own risk.

name: 3ος Χαριτήσιος Δρόμος
location: Κεντρική Πλατεία Ορχομενού, Ορχομενός, Βοιωτία, Greece
description: The 3rd Charitiseios Road Race is a road race on paved roads, held in the central square of Orchomenos, Boeotia. It features three distances: 15 km, 5.5 km, and 1.3 km, all starting and finishing in the central square. The routes are marked with yellow and red arrows and are supported by a sweeper carrying fluids and medical supplies. The race is open to men, women, and children aged 8 and over, offering an enjoyable and well-organized sporting experience.
course_highlights: Three paved routes of 15 km, 5.5 km, and 1.3 km.
Shared start and finish in Orchomenos central square.
Routes marked with yellow and red arrows, with a sweeper carrying fluids and medical supplies.
additional: All three races start and finish in the central square of Orchomenos. The routes are color-coded: a yellow arrow marks the 15 km route and a red arrow marks the 5.5 km route. A sweeper carrying fluids and medical supplies follows the last runner. Men and women aged 18 and over, as well as primary and secondary school children, are eligible to participate. The races start and finish in the central square of Orchomenos. Start times: 10:30 for the 15 km, 11:00 for the 5.5 km, and 12:30 for the 1.3 km. Online registration is available through Chronolog.

name: 9ο Artemisio Mountain Running
organizer: Πολιτιστικός και Εξωραϊστικός Σύλλογος των Απανταχού Καρυωτών και φίλων της Καρυάς «Το Αρτεμίσιο»
description: The Artemisio Mountain Running race, held in the central square of Karia in Argolis, is a mountain race that attracts runners who love nature and the challenge of the mountains. The event offers a unique running experience in a mountainous landscape, ideal for those who want to combine sport and natural beauty. It has become an important event for the local community and mountain-running enthusiasts. The atmosphere is friendly and supportive of all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain routes on Mount Artemisio.
Options of 26, 12, and 5 km, as well as a 1.5 km children’s race.
Shared start and finish in Karia’s central square.
additional: The 26 km route is technical, particularly near the summit, and is intended for experienced mountain runners. Athlete support includes a rescue team, mountain rescuers, nurses, a race doctor, an AED, and a rapid geolocation system.

description: The 18th “Michalis Kousis” Half Marathon is a fast, flat road race held by Lake Trichonida and in the city of Agrinio. The new AIMS-certified course starts in Dογρή and finishes at Dimokratias Square, offering a unique experience for runners of all levels. Alongside the half marathon, there are 5 km races and a 1 km student race, with free entry and a range of services for runners. The event includes free transport, bag storage, a race pack with a technical T-shirt and medal, and cash prizes for the top finishers in the half marathon.
course_highlights: A 100% flat, certified 21.0975 km course from Lake Trichonida to the heart of Agrinio
The University uphill section has been removed for a faster, more enjoyable course
Four hydration stations and a recovery zone with water, isotonic drinks, bananas, and snacks at the finish
additional: Free return buses from Athens, Ioannina, and Patras (Antirrio); free buses to the start in Dογρή; personal bag storage (Drop-off Bags), with bags handed in at the start and collected at the finish; official electronic timing; a technical T-shirt and commemorative medal for all participants; and cash prizes totaling €4,000 for the top three finishers in the half marathon. Free buses from Athens, Ioannina, and Patras via Antirrio, as well as transport to the start in Dογρή, are provided.

name: 26ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Εμμανουήλ Παππά
organizer: ΕΑΣ ΣΕΓΑΣ Ανατολικής Μακεδονίας και Θράκης και Δήμος Εμμανουήλ Παππά
description: The 26th Emmanouil Pappas Road Race is organized by the East Macedonia & Thrace Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS), in cooperation with the Municipality of Emmanouil Pappas, in honor of the 1821 hero of the same name. The race includes a 17,000-meter road course, as well as accompanying races of 1,200 meters for middle school students and 600 meters for elementary school students. The start and finish are at Eleftherias Square in Serres and the Community of Emmanouil Pappas, respectively. The event combines sport with historical memory and the local community.
course_highlights: A 17,000-meter road course
Accompanying races of 1,200 meters for middle school students and 600 meters for elementary school students
Start at Eleftherias Square in Serres and finish at the Community of Emmanouil Pappas
additional: There is an accompanying 1,200-meter race for middle school students and a 600-meter race for elementary school students, starting at 11:00 a.m. The 17,000-meter main race starts at 10:45 a.m. from Eleftherias Square in Serres. The finish is at the Community of Emmanouil Pappas. The person responsible for the accompanying race is Ms. Stella Spanoudaki (tel. 6974900229). The 17 km race starts at 10:45. Registrations for the main course are accepted on race day, from 08:30 to 10:00, at Eleftherias Square.

name: Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on 11-12 December 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with 9,250 m of elevation gain, rated difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 m of elevation gain, rated intermediate. The race is known for its demanding mountain terrain and Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking a top-level endurance competition. Participants can track their performance on a personalized results dashboard.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with 4,600 m and 9,250 m of elevation gain, respectively
Mountain terrain rated intermediate and difficult
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event has a personalized dashboard for tracking participants’ results. No entry-fee details or start times are provided. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Nikulden Trail Run
location: Sports Hall Nikola Petrov, Gorna Oryahovitsa, Bulgaria
description: Nikuldен Trail Run 2026 is a traditional trail-running race held in the town of Gorna Oryahovitsa, starting from the Nikola Petrov Sports Hall. Organized by SC Brown Team and SCO Kamaka, the race offers two main distances—11 km with 350 meters of elevation gain and 19 km with 750 meters of elevation gain—as well as a 2 km children’s race. The courses pass through technical terrain including Kamaka, the Rahovets Fortress, and the Chuypetel rock formation. Some sections are also used for the long courses of Tarnovo Ultra. The event is suitable for runners experienced in mountain running and offers participation across different age categories.
course_highlights: Technical terrain at Kamaka, the Rahovets Fortress, and the Chuypetel rock formation
Two main distances: 11 km (350 m elevation gain) and 19 km (750 m elevation gain)
A 2 km children’s race with 75 meters of elevation gain
additional: On-site registration is available for a limited number of participants. Trail shoes with aggressive tread are mandatory due to the technical sections and the possibility of snow. A long-sleeved top is recommended when temperatures are below 10 degrees. Bib pickup is from 09:00 to 10:45 in the conference hall at Lokomotiv Stadium; race briefing is at 10:55 in front of the sports hall. The awards ceremony and closing will take place by 14:30 at the start/finish area. The start and finish are at the Nikola Petrov Sports Hall. Trail shoes with aggressive tread are mandatory. The children’s race is for age groups up to 8, up to 10, and up to 12 years.

name: 22ος Αγώνας Δρόμου 100 χλμ.
location: Kafe Paradise, Psatha Beach, Mandra-Eidyllia, Greece
price_range: 60€ για τα 100, 110 και 120 χλμ.· 40€ για τα 50 χλμ.
description: The 22nd 100 km Road Race in memory of Takis Skoulis, together with the 17th 50 km Race in memory of Alexandros Theofanidis, will take place at Psatha Beach. The 6th 120 km race will also be held for athletes seeking possible qualification for the Spartathlon. The courses are circular and flat, with no elevation gain, and measure 3,333.40 metres per lap. They have been officially measured by the IAAF. All races start at 06:30 from Kafe Paradise at Psatha Beach. The event is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultradistance Clubs and follows IAAF and IAU regulations.
course_highlights: Course at Psatha Beach, flat with no elevation gain
Circular course measuring 3,333.40 metres per lap
Officially measured by IAAF measurer Mr. Giorgos Dousis
additional: The time limit is 12 hours 30 minutes for the 120 km, 110 km and 100 km races, and 6 hours for the 50 km race. A central aid station provides runners with water, isotonic drinks, sweet and savoury foods, fruit, honey, juices and soft drinks. The 100 km, 110 km and 120 km races start at 06:30 from Kafe Paradise. A central aid station, electronic timing and medical coverage are provided. Registration: https://raceid.com/el/races/15467/about.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The “Pe Argeș în Jos” Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The courses start in Ștrand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a distinctive natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children’s races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is vibrant, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ștrand Park, near the Summer Theatre
Course through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks
Run along the Argeș River promenade, with picturesque views
additional: Race kit collection is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theatre for participants from outside Pitești. The half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races start at 10:00 in Ștrand Park. The children’s race starts at 12:30, and the awards ceremony is at 13:00. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal representative when registering and collecting their race kit. The event includes online registration, race kit collection on 12.12.2026, and access to results and photos after the event.

name: ULTRA ZĂRAND SERIES
description: Ultra Zărand Series is an ultra-trail race held in the Zarand Mountains, near the village of Cășoaia in Arad County, Romania. The event takes place from 11 to 13 December 2026 and offers long-distance routes through scenic landscapes, promoting local tourism and the region’s natural and cultural heritage. Participants can choose from various distances, including an ultramarathon, and enjoy a trail-running experience amid mountain nature. The organizers, ACS ULTRA PANA LA CAPAT, invite experienced runners to discover the beauty of the Zarand area at this special event.
course_highlights: Scenic mountain routes in the Zarand Mountains
Various distances, including an ultramarathon
Promotes the region’s natural and cultural heritage
additional: Available distances: Ultra; The routes cross the Zarand Mountains, a scenic region for winter trail running.

name: Găsește-l pe Moș Crăciun în inima naturii, Codrul 2026
Deliblatska Peščara 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Za prijavu je potrebna uplata akontacije u iznosu od 1000 din.

description: Deliblatska Peščara 2026 is a one-day hiking event organized by PSK Pobeda, held in the beautiful surroundings of Deliblatska Peščara near Čardak. Participants can choose between two hiking groups, with routes ranging from 8 to 16 kilometers through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland. The route is easy, with negligible elevation gain, and is suitable for people with light to moderate fitness levels. After the hike, participants can take a break and enjoy an organized lunch with hot soup and refreshments. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and spend time together in the spirit of mountaineering.
course_highlights: Routes through rolling landscapes of sand dunes and woodland
Two hiking groups: 15–16 km or 8–10 km
Easy route with negligible elevation gain
additional: Departure is at 7:30 from Nebojšina Street, by the Church of Saint Sava. Recommended gear includes protection from wind, rain, and cold; sturdy hiking boots; layered clothing; a thermos or water bottle (minimum 1 liter); a flashlight; and hiking poles. Advance notice and registration with the guide are required for the organized lunch. Return to Belgrade is planned between 18:30 and 19:00. Participants must bring their hiking membership card, health insurance card, and ID card. The guide assigns bus seats in the order participants register and pay. Hiking through Deliblatska Peščara requires appropriate gear, registration with fee, and participant responsibility.

name: 20ός Χειμωνιάτικος Ενιπέας & 11α Ολύμπια Μονοπάτια
location: Municipal Park of Litochoro, Litochoro, Pieria, Greece
description: The 20th Winter Enippeas and the 11th Olympian Trails are mountain running races held in Litochoro, Pieria, offering a unique experience amid the magic of Mount Olympus. The Winter Enippeas passes through the imposing Enippeas Gorge, with waterfalls, wooden bridges and dense forest, while participants face challenging winter conditions. The atmosphere at the finish is warm and festive, with volunteers’ support and the running community creating a special experience. The races honor the history and nature of Mount Olympus, combining an athletic challenge with cultural heritage.
course_highlights: Route through Enippeas Gorge, with waterfalls and wooden bridges
Challenging winter weather conditions and demanding terrain
Warm, festive atmosphere at the finish in Litochoro
additional: The race includes live weather data for key elevations, volunteer support, an athlete’s package with gifts, a pasta party, and strict participation rules. There are numerous food and water stations along the route. The organizers emphasize safety and environmental protection on Mount Olympus. The Winter Enippeas is 25 km with 1,740 m of elevation gain and a time limit of 5 hours and 30 minutes. The Olympian Trails is 11 km with 540 m of elevation gain and a time limit of 3 hours. Entry to the longer race requires having previously finished a mountain race that meets the criteria in the event regulations.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου «Ολοι διαφορετικοί, όλοι ίσοι, όλοι τρέχουμε μαζί»
Πεντελικόν Μάραθων
description: The Pentelikon Marathon is a 12-kilometer mountain race, organized for the fourth consecutive year by the Telmissos Nea Makri Marathon Runners’ Association in collaboration with the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association. The route follows forest trails, starting at Agia Marina in Nea Makri. The race aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service to the community. Despite recent fire damage, Mount Pentelikon retains its remarkable beauty and historical significance, and the race contributes to efforts to restore the mountains.
course_highlights: A 12 km mountain route on forest trails
Start at Agia Marina in Nea Makri
An area of great historical significance and natural beauty
additional: The race is organized with the support of the Municipality of Marathon and under the auspices of EOSLMA-Y. The start is at 10:00 a.m. The event aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service. The route passes by S.E.D.M. (Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association) and follows a trail through a forest that suffered a fire in August 2024. The event includes competitive and volunteer participation, with an emphasis on enjoying nature and promoting mountain running.

name: GTH MOUNTAIN FESTIVAL
location: Central Square of Paiania, Paiania, Greece
organizer: Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Μη Κερδοσκοπικός Σύλλογος «Αυθεντικός Φειδιππίδειος Δρόμος»
description: GTH Mountain Festival 2026 is a three-day mountain running festival held on the eastern side of Mount Hymettus, with the start and finish at Paiania Central Square. It features four races of varying difficulty and distance, honoring the area’s historical heritage with courses that connect sport with history. The races are for runners over 18, with the Antenna Vertical Run serving as an introductory course for beginners in mountain running. The event is supported by the Municipality of Paiania and the Hymettus Protection and Development Association, with an emphasis on protecting the natural environment.
course_highlights: GTH 100+ with 100+ km and 5,500 m of elevation gain
Kallias Trail: 37 km with 2,180 m of elevation gain, honoring the ancient athlete Kallias
Demosthenes Trail: 22 km with 1,400 m of elevation gain, dedicated to the orator Demosthenes
additional: The four races have been evaluated and scored by ITRA, with corresponding ITRA Points. The event is organized by the Authentic Pheidippides Road Athletic and Cultural Non-Profit Association, with the Municipality of Paiania as co-organizer and the Hymettus Protection and Development Association as strategic partner. The races are for people over 18. The Municipality of Paiania is a co-organizer and main supporter, with SPAY as strategic partner.

name: Коледно бягане I 2026
description: Christmas Run I 2026 in Tulbe Park, Kazanlak, is a festive, friendly event bringing together runners and enthusiasts for an easy, enjoyable 6 km route with no elevation gain. The event is non-competitive and untimed. Its main goal is to get moving before the holidays, share smiles, and enjoy a cheerful atmosphere. Participation is free with advance registration, and the festive dress code and prize raffle add to the occasion. It’s an ideal place for families and runners of all levels to enjoy exercise and the holiday spirit.
course_highlights: Easy, enjoyable 6 km route with no elevation gain
Mostly asphalt and dirt road
Route suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: The event is completely free, but advance registration is required. It is non-competitive and untimed, and participants take part at their own risk. A festive dress code is planned, with Christmas hats, reindeer antlers, and other accessories. A raffle will be held, with prizes including vouchers for other races in 2027. Participants are advised to arrive 15–20 minutes before the start for warm-up and photos. Advance registration is required.

name: ПОЛУМАРАТОН НЕСЕБЪР
description: The Nessebar Half Marathon is your epic finale to the year’s races, held during the magical Christmas season in Nessebar. The course is one of the fastest and most scenic in Bulgaria, combining the beauty of the blue sea with the majestic Balkan Mountains. The cobbled streets of centuries-old Nessebar create a unique atmosphere, while nature brings different surprises each year, making the race one of a kind. It is the last race of the year, with excellent organization and a wonderful experience for all participants.
course_highlights: A fast, scenic course combining the sea and mountains
A magical atmosphere in Nessebar’s cobbled streets
A Christmas-season race with unique surprises from nature
additional: Children up to 14 years old can participate in any distance free of charge. Race packs are distributed on 19.12 from 10:00 to 18:00 and on 20.12 from 07:00 to 09:00. On 19.12, there is a guided walk organized by the Ancient Nessebar Museum from 14:00 to 15:00. The race starts at 10:00. On 19 December, race-pack distribution and a guided walk organized by the Ancient Nessebar Museum are scheduled. Packs are also distributed on race day from 07:00 to 09:00.

name: GTH Mountain Festival
location: Central Square of Paiania, Paiania, Greece
organizer: Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Μη Κερδοσκοπικός Σύλλογος «Αυθεντικός Φειδιππίδειος Δρόμος»
description: GTH Mountain Festival 2026 is a three-day mountain running festival held on the eastern side of Mount Hymettus, with the start and finish at Paiania Central Square. It features four races of varying difficulty and distance, honoring the area’s historical heritage through the Kallias Trail and Demosthenes Trail routes. The event is for runners over 18 and combines sport with the protection of Mount Hymettus’s natural environment.
course_highlights: GTH 100+: 100+ km with 5,500 m of positive elevation gain
Kallias Trail: 37 km with 2,180 m of positive elevation gain
Demosthenes Trail: 22 km with 1,400 m of positive elevation gain
additional: The races have been assessed by ITRA and awarded corresponding points. The Antenna Vertical Run, at 11+ km, is an introductory route suitable for beginners in mountain running. The event is organized by the Authentic Pheidippidean Road Athletic Cultural Non-Profit Association, with the Municipality of Paiania as co-organizer and the Hymettus Protection and Development Association (SPAY) as strategic partner. The four races are for runners over 18. The Municipality of Paiania is co-organizer and principal supporter, while the Hymettus Protection and Development Association (SPAY) is the strategic partner.

name: 7. Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a traditional sports, competitive, and recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The race features a variety of courses, from ultra-extreme to beginner, with challenging climbs and beautiful natural surroundings. Participants can enjoy the challenges and beauty of the mountain terrain while competing in a unique atmosphere. The event brings together runners of all levels and promotes a healthy lifestyle and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Varied courses with 1 to 5 ITRA points
Mountain terrain with significant climbs and descents
Beautiful landscapes and natural surroundings of Fruška Gora
additional: Races are scored under the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories (1 to 5 ITRA points). The event includes ultra-extreme, ultra, medium, short, and beginner marathons. The beginner Southern Marathon is 22 km long, with 898 m of ascent and descent. Group and fun registration options are also available for the shorter courses. The event takes place in April, and the 7th Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is held in December. Participation includes courses of various lengths, and the event is part of a series of races on Fruška Gora, focused on trail and mountain sports. Registration details are not available.

name: Winter Trail Race Fruška gora 2026
description: Winter Trail Race Fruška gora is the final race of the year on Fruška gora, intended for fans of trail running, hiking, and Nordic walking. Participants can choose between two courses, a shorter one of 10 km and a longer one of 17 km, which pass through the winter scenery and nature of Fruška gora. The start is at Iriški venac, and after the race there is a social gathering with mulled wine and tea. This event offers a chance to end the year actively, in pleasant company and surrounded by nature, whatever the weather.
course_highlights: Trails through the nature of Fruška gora with a wintry atmosphere
Two courses: 10 km for a dynamic outing and 17 km for a greater challenge
Start and finish at Iriški venac, followed by a post-race gathering
additional: All participants receive a medal at the finish as a reminder of the challenge they conquered. Recommended gear includes trail shoes with studs for secure footing on uneven terrain, hydration and supplements, and a headlamp for better visibility. The race is suitable for runners of all ages and fitness levels, as well as hikers and families with children.

name: 3. NOVOGODIŠNJI MRAZATON
description: The New Year’s Santa Run is a festive race for Santas in Belgrade, held on the Sava Promenade and open to recreational runners and athletes in a holiday atmosphere. Participants run in red Santa and Mrs. Claus outfits provided in their race packs, creating a unique and cheerful atmosphere. The event has a charitable and environmental focus, with initiatives to collect gift packages for children and raise awareness about protecting the environment. The race is limited to 700 participants and is one of Serbia’s largest winter sporting events.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the Sava Promenade, one of Belgrade’s most beautiful places for recreation
Two adult races: 5 km and 10 km
All participants run in authentic Santa and Mrs. Claus costumes provided in their race packs
additional: All participants receive red Santa and Mrs. Claus outfits in their race packs. The number of participants is limited to 700. The organizer highlights the race’s charitable focus through the “Sweets for Sweets” initiative and its environmental awareness. More than 1,000 visitors, including spectators and volunteers, are expected. Participants receive a Santa outfit in their race pack; Mrs. Claus costumes are also mentioned. The “Sweets for Sweets” charity initiative has been announced, and medical support will be available on the course and at the finish.

name: BBKT 2027
description: The Christmas Hill Cross-Country Race (BBKT) takes place on January 10, 2027, in Smederevska Palanka. This race challenges all fans of hill running and cross-country, offering a unique opportunity to test endurance and speed on a demanding course. Organizer Agencija Izazov invites all runners to join this traditional event and enjoy the sporting spirit and sense of community.
course_highlights: Hill and cross-country course with natural obstacles
Location in Smederevska Palanka, surrounded by beautiful natural scenery
Winter race conditions in January
additional: Organizer contact: aeg.events@gmail.com.

name: 27ος Αγώνας Αλσους Δαφνίου
description: The 27th Daphni Grove Race is a traditional 10-kilometer road race held in Daphni Grove. The course starts on Athens Avenue and passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite, offering a route away from the city noise with beautiful views of the Thriasian Gulf. The race is dedicated to the memory of Babis Georgats zonas and is a celebration for runners, with traditional hospitality and electronic timing. Participants are asked to arrive early to collect their race numbers, and there is a place to store their belongings.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course in Daphni Grove
Passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite
Views of the Thriasian Gulf, away from the city noise
additional: The start is on Athens Avenue, near Daphni Hospital. Athletes must arrive at least one hour before the start to collect their race numbers from the registration desk. Electronic timing and baggage storage are available. It is recommended that participants leave their cars at the end of Iera Odos, near Daphni Monastery, to avoid congestion. Electronic timing and baggage storage are provided. Race-number pickup takes place before the start; arriving at least one hour early is recommended.

location: Parcul Ion C. Brătianu, Oradea, Romania
organizer: Asociaţia Clubul Sportiv Xterra Sport Bihor
description: Oradea City Trail is a running competition held in Ion C. Brătianu Park in Oradea, offering three routes: half marathon, cross, and mini. The event is for runners of all ages, with clearly defined age categories, and emphasizes sportsmanship and the outdoor experience. Participants receive personalized race kits and finisher medals, while the top finishers are awarded prizes by category. The race starts in the morning, and the routes are clearly marked, with refreshment points along the way.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon route with a time limit of 3.5 hours
10.5 km cross route with a time limit of 2 hours
Start and finish in Ion C. Brătianu Park, Oradea
additional: Race confirmation and race-pack pickup take place on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 in IC Brătianu Park. The technical briefing is at 09:30, before the start. The half-marathon route has three refreshment points, while the cross/mini route has one. Participants must wear their race number visibly on their clothing. Trail-running shoes are recommended. Minors must have parental consent.

name: 7ος Βυζαντινός Αγώνας
organizer: Δήμος Μεγαρέων και Αντιδημαρχία Αθλητισμού & Νέας Γενιάς, σε συνεργασία με τους Αθηναίους Δρομείς, τον Απόλλωνα Δυτικής Αττικής και τους Δρομείς Μεγάρων «Ο Όρσιππος»
description: The 7th Byzantine 50-Kilometer Road Race is an ultradistance race held in Megara, starting and finishing at Vasilissa Frederikis Square. The route is entirely paved and passes through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, wooded sections, and the Alepochori–Dourakou beach, offering a unique experience of the area’s natural landscape. The race has a charitable purpose and is intended for runners with marathon experience. The event honors the memory of Georgios Panos and promotes running and ultradistance racing.
course_highlights: A 49,600-meter route that is entirely paved
Passes through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, and forests
Approximately 5 kilometers along Alepochori–Dourakou beach
additional: Race-day registration opens at 07:00 and closes at 08:30. The race has a time limit of 7 hours and 30 minutes. Aid stations are available every 5 km, along with medical support. Timing is carried out using an electronic RFID chip. Participants may donate non-perishable food for charity before the start. The announcement for the 7th edition specifies aid stations every 5 km, medical support, electronic timing with an RFID chip, and a time limit of 7 hours and 30 minutes.

location: Aigio Seafront near the Old Port, Aigio, Aigialeia, Greece
description: The 14th Aigialeia Half Marathon is organized by the Aigio Athletic Club “Athenodoros of Aigion,” with the support of the Municipality of Aigialeia’s Deputy Mayor for Culture and Sports. The race takes place on the Aigio seafront, near the old port, on a nearly entirely paved and flat course with minimal elevation change. The course starts at the seafront and heads towards the community of Nikolaika, continuing through local communities and coastal villages along the old railway line to the area of Stafidala, before finishing back at the Aigio seafront.
course_highlights: Nearly entirely paved course
Flat course with minimal elevation change
Passes through local communities and coastal villages along the old railway line
additional: Parallel 5 km and 1.5 km races follow similarly flat, paved courses. The finish is on the Aigio seafront, near the 12 Fountains and the historic plane tree of Pausanias. The available information concerns the 2026 event and also mentions 5 km and 1,500 m races.

Nevrokopiou, in cooperation with local organizations.

Lakeside trail and natural scenery of Kato Nevrokopi
Gentle elevation changes in the 2026 edition

description: The Gerar Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Romania, held on the campus of the Polytechnic University of Bucharest. The competition promotes outdoor running and team spirit, welcoming both individual runners and teams of three. The course is an approximately 3.6 km loop, completed multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The event takes place on the last weekend of January and attracts more than 850 active participants.
course_highlights: A 3.6 km loop on the Polytechnic University campus
Start/finish in front of the Faculty of Transport
The half marathon covers 6 loops for a distance of 21.8 km
additional: Race kits can be collected at the Rectorate building – AN wing, on the campus of the Polytechnic University of Bucharest, on Friday, January 29, 2027, from 17:00 to 20:00, and on Saturday, January 30, 2027, at different times for each race. Car access to campus is prohibited on race day. The half marathon is limited to 200 teams, and the half marathon fee is paid collectively for all team members. Car access to campus is prohibited on race day; information is available about public transport and nearby parking.

name: 2ο Γιαννούλα Vertical Run
description: The Giannoula Vertical Run is a vertical running race in Thessaloniki, featuring an uphill section and, this year, a downhill section as well. The event combines a demanding test of strength with a charitable purpose, supporting the “O Sotir” Center for People with Disabilities.
course_highlights: Uphill and downhill running
Distance: 4,250 m, according to the event listing
additional: Event proceeds support the charitable work of the “O Sotir” Center for People with Disabilities.

name: Kalikantzaros Trail Run
location: Summer Cinema, Valley of Agion Anargiron, Serres, Greece
organizer: Организационният комитет на KALIKANTZAROS TRAIL, Асоциацията на маратонците в Серес и община Серес
description: Kalikantzaros Trail Run offers an authentic experience on the mountain trails of Serres, Greece. The race features two routes of different lengths and difficulty levels, suitable for runners of all abilities. The 21 km half marathon follows technical trails and requires physical endurance, while the 8 km route is easier and suitable for beginners. The race takes place in the picturesque Agion Anargiron Valley and offers unique views and outdoor challenges.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon with technical trails and +350 m elevation gain
8 km route with 85% trails, 5% asphalt and 10% forest road
Three hydration points on the half-marathon route
additional: Race bibs can be collected the day before the race (10:00–14:00) and on race day (08:00–10:30). On-site last-minute registration is also available. The half marathon has a 4-hour time limit, while the 8 km route has a 2-hour limit. Prizes are awarded to the top runners overall and in each category. For the 22 km distance, a 4-hour time limit and mandatory gear apply; the 8 km limit is 3 hours. Support stations are provided along the routes.

name: 15ος Ημιμαραθώνιος «Ιωάννης Καποδίστριας»
distance_verbose: Ημιμαραθώνιος, 10 km, 3000 μέτρα, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.2 km

description: The 15th “Ioannis Kapodistrias” Half Marathon in Aegina is a historic road race honoring the first governor of modern Greece. The event includes a 21.1-kilometer race, a 10,000-meter race, a 3,000-meter walk, and children’s races, offering a celebration for runners of all ages and abilities. Held in the center of Aegina, the event combines sport with cultural heritage and attracts a large number of participants each year. The longer-distance races start in the morning, while the shorter races start earlier, creating a festive sporting atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: A 21.1-kilometer half marathon in the center of Aegina
Children’s races of 200 m, 500 m, and 1,000 m for all ages
A 3,000 m walk and a 10,000 m road race
additional: Awards ceremonies take place at 11:00 for the children’s races and at 13:45 for the other races. The half marathon and 10,000-meter race have age categories of 18–39, 40–59, and 60+ years. Participants must be at least 18 years old for the half marathon and 16 years old for the 10,000-meter race. Middle- and high-school students may also participate in the 3,000 m race, under their parents’ responsibility. All participants receive finisher medals, and trophies are awarded to the top three in each category. For the 2026 event, water stations every 2,500 m and isotonic drinks along the half-marathon course are listed.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a popular series of winter trail races in the mountains of Attica, offering runners of all levels the chance to enjoy mountain running and nature. The event includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha, with two courses at each race: a longer, more technical course and a shorter one for beginners. The series has become an established fixture in the running community and offers incentives through awards, prize draws and individual and team rankings. MyRace is responsible for organizing the event, with support from Salomon, which invites runners of all ages to take part in this celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha
Two courses at each race: a long course (10–12 km) and a short course (4–7 km), both with significant elevation gain
Natural scenery and technical trails, with elevation gains ranging from +170 m to +660 m
additional: At each race, the top three men and women in each distance receive awards. Age categories are available only for the long distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. Four pairs of Salomon shoes are drawn at each race. There are individual and team rankings for the long distance. Teams consist of 3 people, and the top three teams receive awards. In a recent edition, the race in Penteli started from Semelis Square. The event provided a race number with a timing chip, water stations, snacks at the finish, a commemorative certificate and medical coverage.

name: FAGET WINTER TRAIL Padurea Faget.
description: Faget Winter Race is a mountain running event held in Faget Forest, Cluj-Napoca, now in its 12th edition. The competition offers three distances: 7 km, 15 km, and a half marathon, on marked routes featuring climbs and descents along forest trails and tourist paths. Participants can use refreshment and aid stations along the course, access medical assistance, and compete for category prizes. The event is open to runners over 18, with minors permitted to participate with special approvals.
course_highlights: Marked mountain routes with elevation gains of 243 m (7 km) and 688 m (15 km)
Refreshment and aid stations at key points along the course
The route passes through forest, open clearings, and marked tourist trails
additional: The start is at Unirea Sports Base; the half marathon starts at 10:00, the 15 km race at 10:30, and the 7 km race at 11:00. Race kits must be collected in person and include a race number that must be worn visibly, an electronic certificate, and product/voucher prizes. Mandatory equipment includes trail running shoes, protective clothing, and a reusable bottle/cup. Participation is limited to 500 competitors, and registration is online only.

name: KTJ trejl štafeta 2027
location: Planinarski dom Jedinstvo, Iriški venac, Fruška gora, Serbia
description: The 3rd KTJ Trail Relay is a winter relay race held on Fruška Gora, starting at the “Jedinstvo” Mountain Lodge. The race consists of two 5 km legs, and participants compete in men’s, women’s, and mixed categories. Each team must have a unique name, which both members enter when registering. This race offers an opportunity for team strategy and great energy in the winter setting of Fruška Gora.
course_highlights: A 2 × 5 km course on Fruška Gora
A winter race in relay format
Start and finish at the “Jedinstvo” Mountain Lodge
additional: The entry fee applies to each individual participant. Teams compete in men’s, women’s, and mixed categories. Each team must have a unique name, which both members enter in the “club” field when registering.

name: 2ο Tsiggla Trail Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Η ατομική συμμετοχή στο ημερήσιο εκδρομικό κόστος είναι 5€.

description: The TSIGGLA Trail Run takes place in Tsigla Forest near Didymoteicho, offering a unique running experience in a natural setting on the borders of Europe. The event includes an 8-kilometre training route through the forest, suitable for runners of all levels. It coincides with the annual vasilopita-cutting gathering of Thrace’s runners, creating a friendly, sociable atmosphere. The race is an alternative sporting get-together with a strong local character and tradition.
course_highlights: 8 km training route in Tsigla Forest
Natural setting near the Greece–Turkey border
Recreation area and forest trail
additional: The event includes the annual vasilopita-cutting gathering of Thrace’s runners and is an excursion-style meeting for athletes. The route is intended for training and takes place in the recreation area of Tsigla Forest. The race is held in early February and also includes related events and activities in the Didymoteicho area.

name: 49ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Υγείας Αθήνας 21 χλμ.
location: Ολυμπιακό Κωπηλατοδρόμιο Σχοινιά, Μαραθώνας, Αττική, Greece
description: The 49th Athens Health Run 21 km is organized by the Athens Health Runners Association and takes place at the Schinias Olympic Rowing and Canoeing Centre. Since 1978, the race has promoted popular mass participation in sport and running, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The course is paved, completely flat, and loops around the rowing course, offering an enjoyable and fast experience. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, with technical support provided by MyRace.
course_highlights: Paved and completely flat course
Four laps around the water course at the Schinias Olympic Rowing and Canoeing Centre
Water stations along the course and at the finish
additional: Participants receive a race bib with a timing chip and safety pins. Medical support is available, along with the option to print a commemorative certificate showing the participant’s name and result. Race packs can be collected on race day from 07:30 to 09:00. The race has a 3-hour time limit. The top three men and women overall and the winners of the age categories receive awards. Supporters provide energy gels, natural mineral water, and bananas at the finish. 21.1 km course, 600-participant limit, online registration, race pack with chip and medal, water stations, live results, medical support

name: Национален крос "По стъпките на Васил Левски" 2026
location: Garden next to National School of Applied Arts “Prof. Venko Kolev”, Troyan, Bulgaria
description: The National Cross-Country Race “In the Footsteps of Vasil Levski” is an annual event honoring the memory of the Apostle, with participants covering part of the route he travelled. The race takes place in Troyan, starting near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts. Several distances with varying difficulty and elevation gain are offered for different age and gender groups. The event combines sporting spirit with historical remembrance and is open to anyone wishing to honor Vasil Levski’s legacy.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 8 km, and 12 km, with elevation gains ranging from 10 m to 375 m
The course follows paths travelled by Vasil Levski
The start is near the garden by the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan
additional: Members of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation submit entries at https://orienteering.bg, while unregistered participants can send entries by email or phone. Race numbers can be collected from the secretariat until 11:00, and on-site registration is available until 10:30 if race numbers remain. The youngest participants (3 km) are transported by minibus to the start and run along red markings. The masters’ start (12 km) is at 11:20, following yellow markings. For the 2026 edition, the start is listed at 11:00 from the garden near the Prof. Venko Kolev National School of Applied Arts in Troyan; entries are accepted in advance, and on-site registration is available if race numbers remain. The date listed in the sources for 2026 is 14 February, not 20 February 2027.

name: Făget Winter Race
description: Făget Winter Race is a mountain running event held in Făget Forest in Cluj-Napoca, now in its 12th edition. On January 23, 2027, participants can choose from three events: 7 km, 15 km, and a half marathon. The varied routes feature significant elevation changes, offering a challenging and scenic experience in nature. The event is open to runners over 18, as well as minors with special approval. The organizers provide aid stations and medical assistance along the course.
course_highlights: Marked mountain routes with elevation gains of 243 m (7 km) and 688 m (15 km)
Aid stations at key points along the route (3.4 km, 6.4 km, 9.3 km)
The route passes through forest, open clearings, and marked hiking trails
additional: The participant limit is 500. Race kits must be collected in person and include a race bib that must be worn visibly, an electronic diploma, and prizes in the form of products/vouchers. Mandatory equipment includes trail running shoes, a rain/wind jacket or long-sleeved top, and a water bottle or reusable cup. Energy bars or gels and a charged mobile phone are also recommended. Running with pets is prohibited. The routes follow forest trails and are marked. Hydration points are provided along the route and at the finish for the 15 km and 8 km events.

name: SKV Vertical Race
description: SKV Vertical Race is a winter mountain-running competition held in the Brașov area, with courses starting in the Tâmpa area. The 21 km half marathon includes a climb up Tâmpa’s switchbacks, followed by descents and sections on trails marked with different symbols, offering an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both amateurs and professionals and takes place in winter conditions, requiring mountain experience and adequate physical preparation. The organizers provide safety measures and course markings, and participants receive personalized kits.
course_highlights: 21 km half-marathon course with 1,128 m of elevation gain
Climb up Tâmpa’s switchbacks and descents on marked trails (Blue Stripe, Yellow Stripe, Blue Triangle, Blue Cross)
Run in winter conditions, with natural obstacles and varied mountain terrain
additional: A personalized race kit is guaranteed for registrations during the Early Bird and Special Promo periods. The event also includes a night mountain-running race (Night Run), starting at 17:30 on the day before the half marathon. Kits can be collected in the Promenada Tâmpa area, either the day before or on race day. The awards ceremonies take place after the races finish.

name: 7ο Atlas Trail Running
description: Experience mountain running at the Atlas Trail Running race in the Malakasa area of Attica. The race offers four routes: 34Km, 24Km, 11Km and 6Km, featuring a variety of technical sections, forest roads and trails through scenic, lush green landscapes. During the race, you will pass two chapels: Prophet Elias and Saint Mercurius. Some mountain-race experience is required, and suitable shoes and a hydration vessel are mandatory.
course_highlights: 60% forest roads and 40% trails
The scenic, lush green landscape of Malakasa
Two chapels along the route (Prophet Elias, Saint Mercurius)
additional: All participants receive timing by 'AGON Race Timing' and a unique medal. Carefully planned refreshment stations ensure sufficient calories and electrolytes. Sponsors RUN N TRAIL - BETTER PEOPLE provide a 500ml water flask. The largest team is awarded. The announcement for the previous event recommends experience in mountain races and requires suitable mountain shoes and a hydration vessel. It included timing, a medal and a 500 ml flask.

name: 2ος Αγώνας για την Πανελλήνια Ημέρα Φιλάθλου
description: The 2nd road race for Panhellenic Sports Fans Day, “In the Name of Alkis,” is organized by the February 1, 2022 Foundation, a nonprofit organization run by volunteers. The race aims to honor the memory of Alkis Kampanos and promote the message that sports unite and do not kill. Participants run in the jerseys and colors they love along a route passing through central Thessaloniki, giving the whole community the opportunity to take part. The race includes 5 km and 1 km routes for younger runners.

name: 5ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αγάπης
description: The 5th Love Half Marathon in Mytilene will take place over the weekend, offering a rich program of sporting and cultural events. On Saturday, races begin in the Tsamakia area, with distances of 1,000 m, 2,500 m, Family Running 2,500 m, and 5,000 m for various age categories. On Sunday, athletes gather in the city center for the 10-kilometer race and the 21-kilometer half marathon. This event has become an important occasion for the city of Mytilene.

name: 8ος Αγώνας Trail Φανερωμένης Χιλιομοδίου
location: FREELAND ADVENTURE CAMP, Chiliomodi, Corinthia, Greece
description: The Faneromeni Chiliomodiu Trail Race is a mountain running event starting and finishing at FREELAND ADVENTURE CAMP. Runners can choose from three distances: 23, 10.5, and 6 kilometers. The routes combine trails, forest roads, and paved roads, offering a varied trail-running experience in the area’s natural landscape.
course_highlights: Three distance options: 23, 10.5, and 6 kilometers.
Routes combining trails, forest roads, and paved roads.
Shared start and finish at FREELAND ADVENTURE CAMP.

name: 10ο MaskaRun
description: The sporting extravaganza in Orchomenos, Boeotia, brings together the 10th-anniversary MaskaRun, the 1st “Asopichos” 5 km Road Race, and events celebrating Panhellenic Sports Fans Day. The event is a major celebration of sport, remembrance, and humanity, with free participation for everyone. Orchomenos Central Square will be the hub of the events, which also include a handball demonstration and prize draws for children. MaskaRun has become an established event with mass participation, and this year a certified “Asopichos” 5 km race course with official timing is being added.

name: 11ο Lycabettus Run
description: The 11th Lycabettus Run is a unique road race held on the lush Lycabettus Hill in Athens. The courses include paved and dirt roads, offering a one-of-a-kind running experience surrounded by nature and overlooking the city. The race includes individual and team categories, with morning starts and full support for runners. The event offers medals, cups, digital certificates, medical coverage, and aid stations.

name: 26ος Μπιζάνιος Δρόμος
organizer: Δήμος Ιωαννιτών, ΕΑΣ ΣΕΓΑΣ Ηπείρου και αθλητικά σωματεία των Ιωαννίνων
description: The Bizanios Road Race is an 11.5-kilometer race in Ioannina, dedicated to the anniversary of the city’s liberation. The event connects running with local history and invites runners to take part in a race with a strong local character. It is co-organized by the Municipality of Ioannina, the SEGAS Epirus Athletics Association, and the city’s sports clubs.

name: Προπονητική Ημερίδα Νίκης Βύρωνα
description: The Niki Vyronas Training Meet is organized by the Niki Vyronas Gymnastics Club, based at the Vyronas Municipal Stadium. Founded in 2005, the club offers specialized guidance from coaches with experience and high athletic achievements. The meet aims to promote track and field and improve quality of life through exercise. It offers athletes and sports enthusiasts an opportunity to discover the joy of athletics in a friendly, well-organized setting.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup 2026 is a popular winter trail-race series in the mountains of Attica, offering new racing experiences for runners of all levels. It includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus, and Parnitha, with two courses at each race: a longer, technical, and challenging course, and a shorter one for beginners or training. The event aims to connect runners with nature and showcase the beauty of mountain running in Attica. MyRace is responsible for organizing the series, with Salomon supporting it as title sponsor.

location: Βαρυμπόμπη, Δάσος Βαρυμπόμπης, Βαρυμπόμπη, Αττική, Ελλάδα

description: The 5th Friendship and Solidarity Memorial Run is a special sporting event held in the former forest of Varympompi. The event includes two routes, 14.5 km and 6.3 km, on forest and paved roads, fully marked. Participation is free, with registration accompanied by a €10 deposit, which is refunded on race day. The amount collected from runners who do not show up will be donated to an orphanage. The race has no electronic timing or prizes, as all participants are considered winners and receive a cup as a memento.
course_highlights: Two routes, 14.5 km and 6.3 km, on forest and paved roads
Fully marked routes and water stations along the course
Held in the natural setting of the former Varympompi forest (Tatoi Estate)
additional: There is no electronic timing or prize-giving. Each participant receives a cup, possibly featuring a personal photograph. Water stations are available along the course. The 14.5 km and 6.3 km routes follow forest and paved roads. Participation requires a €10 deposit; the prize is a cup featuring a personal photograph, and funds support an orphanage.

name: 10ος Δρόμος Αξιών
location: Ιερός Ναός Ζωοδόχου Πηγής, Κεφαλάρι Αργολίδας, Αργολίδα, Greece
description: The 10th Road of Values, organized by the 1st Argos Scout Group, is a running race dedicated to the universal values of life. The race is held on February 22, on the occasion of Scout Thinking Day, and honors the memory of the great Greek marathon runner Stelios Kyriakides. The start and finish are at Kefalari, Argos, at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi, offering a special experience for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km road race starting and finishing at Kefalari, Argos
650-meter children's race at the same location
Special tribute to Stelios Kyriakides and universal values
additional: The event includes two simultaneous starts at 10:30 a.m. for the main 10 km race and the 650-meter children's race. The event has a long tradition and is associated with Scout Thinking Day. The race is dedicated to universal values and takes place in a natural setting, starting and finishing at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi. Participation is free and includes a 650-meter children's race.

name: Γεντίκι Trail 9
description: The Gentiki Trail is a mountain race held in the Gentiki area of Larissa. The 21-kilometer course follows marked trails, with a positive elevation gain of +1370 meters, offering a demanding and exciting experience for mountain runners. There is also a shorter 5.1-kilometer course with a positive elevation gain of +250 meters, ideal for those looking for a shorter challenge. The race serves as a qualifying event for participation in the Olympus Marathon, attracting runners seeking a high level of competition and natural beauty.

description: Șiria Winter Trail is a mountain running competition for both amateur and professional runners, promoting short- and middle-distance running in the Zărand Mountains, Arad County. The event combines sport and tourism, following routes that include historical and natural landmarks such as Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, and Feredeu Hermitage. The competition features three easy- and moderate-difficulty races on varied, marked routes, with the start and finish at the “Ioan Slavici” House of Culture in Șiria. It is a challenge suited to trained, experienced runners with appropriate equipment.
course_highlights: Mountain routes featuring historical landmarks: Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, and Feredeu Hermitage
Routes consist of marked hiking trails, forest roads, and paved roads
Elevation gains ranging from 365 m to 1070 m across distances of 6 km, 10 km, and 21 km
additional: The race kit includes a sweatshirt, a hat, and gloves; these must be reserved when registering. There are hydration and fueling stations along the routes. The mandatory equipment includes a race bib. Recommended equipment includes trekking poles, energy gels, gloves, a water bottle, and clothing suitable for winter conditions. The routes are marked with tape and arrows, and participants must pass through all checkpoints to avoid disqualification. The start and finish are at the “Ioan Slavici” House of Culture in Șiria. The routes include hiking and local trails, forest roads, and paved sections; participants must provide their own food and hydration.

name: Team-Up and Run 2027
location: Iulius Town, Piața Consiliul Europei 2, Timișoara, Romania

name: 5ο Koumaria Trail Series
description: The Koumaria Trail Series is a major mountain running event held at the historic Achaia Clauss winery in Patras. The event offers routes of various distances, including an ultra-distance race, through beautiful trails and natural landscapes. It combines an athletic challenge with social responsibility, as part of the proceeds goes to charitable causes. Race registration and the start are located at the winery, offering participants a unique experience.
course_highlights: Trail routes through areas of outstanding natural beauty, with varied elevation
Start and finish at the historic Achaia Clauss winery
A route through cobbled lanes, stone towers, and historic cellars
additional: Participants receive electronic timing, aid stations, a commemorative medal, and gifts. Special routes are available for children, along with charitable initiatives such as support for the Floga Patras Association and the Ark of Love. Race registration operates from 26 to 28 February 2027 at the winery. Available distances include the Back To Back Challenge 60 (20+40 km, 4,000 m of positive elevation gain), the Koumaria Marathon 40.5 km (2,550 m of positive elevation gain), the Koumaria Trail Race 22 km (1,300 m of positive elevation gain), and a 4 km race. There is also a 1,000 m children’s race.

name: ДЛШ КОЛОКРОС, КУПА ДОЛЧИНИ
description: Bulgarian Cyclocross Championship, Dolcini Cup is a cyclocross race held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. The event is part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship and offers participation opportunities for various rider categories. The race starts at 09:30, and detailed information and regulations are available on the federation’s official website. Registration is online via a special link provided by the organizers.
course_highlights: Race in Borisova Gradina, Sofia
Part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship
Various participant categories

name: Vlădeasa Winter Trail
description: Vlădeasa Winter Trail is a mountain running race held in the Rogojel area, in the heart of the Vlădeasa Mountains. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and challenging courses, which offer runners an authentic winter experience in nature. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and event organization dedicated to trail running enthusiasts. The competition attracts both experienced runners and amateurs eager to discover the beauty of mountain running in the cold season.
course_highlights: Mountain courses in the Vlădeasa Mountains with winter scenery
Varied difficulty, suitable for runners of all levels
Friendly atmosphere and organization dedicated to trail running enthusiasts

description: Scorilo Winter Trail is a mountain running competition held in Poiana Mărului, Caraș-Severin, offering varied courses for runners of all levels. The event includes races with significant elevation gain and spectacular scenery, such as the Scorila rock formations and the mountain peaks of the Țarcu area. Participants can choose from several distances, from a mountain marathon to races for children and families, all organized to internationally recognized standards. It is an experience that combines athletic challenge with natural beauty and community spirit.
course_highlights: Mountain course with up to 2,653 m of elevation gain at Țarcu Marathon
Passing the Scorila rock formation, which is associated with a Dacian legend
Running over the Brusturu and Căleanu peaks, with alpine sections and technical terrain
additional: Race kits can be collected at Pine Hill cabin in the Start/Finish area. Each race has time limits (cutoffs), and participants who exceed them are stopped. The event provides official T-shirts and medals for participants. There are races for children and families, as well as races with significant elevation gain for experienced runners.

name: 2ο Τρέχω Στον Μαραθώνα
description: The “MARATHON - I Run in Marathon” road race is a flat 6.8-kilometer race held in Nea Makri, by the sea, along the Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade. It is aimed at experienced runners and athletes over the age of 15, offering an enjoyable route without difficulties. The start and finish are at the central small harbor of Nea Makri, with the race starting at 16:30. The event provides hydration and snack stations along the route and at the finish, ensuring a complete experience for participants.
course_highlights: Flat 6.8 km route by the sea
Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade
Start and finish at the central small harbor of Nea Makri
additional: The entry package includes hydration and snacks along the route and at the finish. Stations provide bottled water, soft drinks, juices, bananas, sweet snacks, and savory snacks. Participation is open to people over the age of 15, with parental consent required for minors under 18. Runners participate at their own risk and must have recent medical examinations. Routes of approximately 8.2 km, participation open to all ages, online registration, finish at the port of Nea Makri, with water and snacks provided during and after the race.

name: 18ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Καθαράς Δευτέρας
location: Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Saviour, Alepochori, Attica, Greece
description: The 18th Clean Monday Road Race is a traditional 10,000-meter race held in Alepochori, Attica, starting and finishing at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior. The course is rugged, unpaved, and marked, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. There is also a 300-meter children’s race and a fancy-dress and dance contest. After the race, a celebration with music, wine, and traditional Lenten treats creates a festive atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Rugged, unpaved course
Start and finish at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior
Marked course and water provided
additional: The 10,000-meter race is limited to 250 athletes. Registration is by telephone only. A bus is available for €10, departing from Metaxourgeio (Karaiskaki Square) at 8:00. After the race, participants receive a handmade commemorative medal; trophies and prizes are awarded for the children’s race and costume contest. The post-race celebration includes DJ music, dancing, wine, and a picnic with traditional Lenten treats. For the 18th edition, a limit of 250 participants in the 10 km race and telephone registration are specified. A bus from Athens is available for a €10 ticket.
