description: Road Races Plovdiv 2027 will take place on March 6 and 7 at the Rowing Canal in Plovdiv. The event offers three distances—1 mile, 5 km, and 10 km—suitable for runners of different levels. Organized by SC ACTIVE 2013, the race includes electronic timing, aid stations, medical assistance, and awards for the overall standings. Participants receive a unique medal, a race pack with lots of gifts, and the chance to enter a raffle for prizes. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with a host, photographers, and volunteers helping ensure everyone enjoys the event and that it runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The course is at the Rowing Canal in Plovdiv, with a flat, fast profile
Aid stations and a medical team along the course
Chip-based electronic timing and official individual results
additional: The race pack includes a race bib with an electronic timing chip, a unique designer medal, insurance, entry in a raffle with more than 32 prizes, gifts from partners, water and refreshments at the finish, and an electronic certificate of completion. Late registration is possible if places are available and closes before the relevant start. The organizers have removed the mandatory declarations from the website and provide them pre-filled when participants collect their race packs. Payment is by bank transfer.

description: Team Up & Run is a dynamic team running competition combining speed, endurance, and athletic skill challenges, including stair climbing. The event emphasizes coordination and mutual support among team members, making it ideal for friends, colleagues, or family. Participants form teams of three and can enjoy an energetic, challenging team-building experience. Everyone who finishes the race receives a medal, and the winning teams are awarded trophies.
course_highlights: Course consisting of three sections
Includes climbing and descending stairs, slopes, and ramps
The event combines running with fitness and athletic skill challenges
additional: The maximum number of teams is limited to 60, divided equally between the two races. Registration is exclusively online, and payment can be made by card or bank transfer. The minimum age for participation is 16. Medals are awarded to all participants who finish the race. Participants must be at least 16 years old. The “Together” and “Relay” races are mentioned.

name: RUBICON - CURSA EROILOR Ultramaraton: Bucuresti - Chisinau
description: Rubicon is a unique ultramarathon held along the Bucharest–Chișinău route, divided into 46 stages crossing Romania’s counties and the regions of the Republic of Moldova. Participants can choose how many stages to complete and create their own race strategy, with no restrictions on the number of stages. For each stage completed in a county, runners receive a medal bearing that county’s coat of arms, and the winner receives a special shield for the badges collected. The event promotes the sport, culture, and history of the regions along the route and is open to both amateurs and professionals.
course_highlights: The route is divided into 46 stages, with each county having between 1 and 10 stages
Medals bearing each county’s coat of arms are awarded for every stage completed
The route crosses regions of Romania and the Republic of Moldova, promoting local culture and history
additional: The official race start is in Bucharest, and participants can request transport by special bus from the “Arcul de Triumf” Stadium. The race follows the eastern route through Romania and the Republic of Moldova. The organizer is A.O. Clubul sportiv "Sporter". To receive a region’s medal, participants must complete at least one stage in that region.

name: Crosul Divelor
location: Platoul Sălii Sporturilor Horia Demian, Cluj-Napoca, Romania
description: Crosul Divelor powered by 8x8 is the first running race in Cluj-Napoca dedicated exclusively to women and girls. The event offers a friendly, fun atmosphere, inviting participants to run and enjoy being active in a special setting. It takes place at the Horia Demian Sports Hall Esplanade and is part of the Runners Club event series, known for organizing a variety of appealing races. The race also supports a charitable cause, adding extra meaning to taking part.
course_highlights: A race dedicated exclusively to women
Central location: Horia Demian Sports Hall Esplanade
Friendly, fun atmosphere
additional: A registration kit is provided to participants. The event supports a charitable cause, Run for Alex Mâță. The organizer offers free group training sessions for the local running community. The event is charitable; the announced cause is “Run for Alex Mâță!”.

name: 1ο All Terrain Ultra Race Ioannina
location: Panepirotic Athletic Center of Ioannina (PEAKI), Anatoli, Ioannina, Greece
description: The 1st All Terrain Ultra Race Ioannina brings runners to the Panepirotic Sports Center of Ioannina for an event offering both ultra-distance and shorter races. The announcement for the inaugural event included 3- and 6-hour races, as well as 5 km and 10 km races and a 1 km children’s race. The event takes place in the Anatoli area of Ioannina and is organized by Epirus Athletic Events.
course_highlights: 3- and 6-hour ultra-distance races
5 km and 10 km routes
1 km children’s race at the Panepirotic Sports Center of Ioannina
additional: The announcement for the inaugural event lists the Panepirotic Sports Center of Ioannina (PEAKI), in Anatoli, as the venue.

price_range: 15-25 € για τους αγώνες 10 και 26 χλμ.· δωρεάν charity fun run

description: The 2nd Spetses Mountain Run “Sotirios Anargyros” is a mountain race held on Spetses, aiming to promote sport and fair play and showcase the trails of the pine-covered mountain overlooking the sea. The race includes 26 km and 10 km routes, as well as a children’s walk, offering a unique experience for athletes and visitors. The event is supported by the Municipality of Spetses and the AKSS Foundation, with an emphasis on environmental awareness and promoting local products.
course_highlights: Trails on a pine-covered mountain overlooking the sea
26 km and 10 km routes in a natural setting
Children’s walk on the grounds of the AKSS Foundation
additional: The race office opens at 10:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. on the previous day at the TITANIA cinema, where the technical briefing and athletes’ meal also take place. On race day, the race office is open from 08:30 to 09:45 a.m. After the race, awards are presented at 3:00 p.m., followed by a farewell celebration featuring local delicacies.

name: Alerg pentru mama
description: The “I Run for Mom” charity run is an accessible, friendly race for children, adults, and families, opening the running season in Suceava County. The event promotes solidarity and community involvement, supporting the Casa ADRA project. It brings together both beginner runners and people who want to combine exercise with a socially meaningful gesture.
course_highlights: An accessible race for all ages and experience levels
A charity event supporting Casa ADRA
A friendly, welcoming atmosphere for families and the community

name: TIMISOARA 21K Povestea aleargă mai departe.
description: TIMIȘOARA 21k is the first stage in the 21k.ro series, a series of road races connecting cities and communities across Romania. The event offers a unique experience, with an energetic and welcoming vibe that reflects Timișoara’s cultural and European spirit. Runners are invited to take on a course that grows in intensity and challenge from one stage to the next, with a gamification system that encourages progress and participation. Organized by Yolo Events, this race is more than a competition: it’s a revolution in road running that keeps you coming back and pushing your limits.
course_highlights: The 21k series begins in Timișoara, the cultural capital
An urban course with the city’s characteristic energy and welcoming spirit
Part of a gamification system with levels and goals for runners
additional: The 21k series includes several stages in different cities, culminating in a grand finale in Bucharest. The event is organized by Yolo Events, known for thoughtfully designed sporting experiences and real communities. Participants can earn a special 21k bracelet that reflects their level and progress in the series. The race is also presented under the name “Timișoara 21k by SportGuru”.

name: 2ο Ελάτεια Historic Trail
organizer: Ορειβατικός, Φυσιολατρικός Σύλλογος Ελάτειας και ο Σύλλογος Νεολαίας Ελάτειας
description: The 2nd Historic Trail Elateia is a mountain race offering three routes of varying distances and difficulty, set in a beautiful natural and historic environment. The route starts from Elateia’s central square and follows trails and forest roads, passing archaeological sites and offering unique views of the Maliakos Gulf and the surrounding mountains. The race is also suitable for runners with limited experience in mountain running, with full course marking and aid stations. The event is renowned for its excellent organization, support from volunteers, and participation by the local community.
course_highlights: Start from Elateia’s central square at an elevation of 180 m
Pass by archaeological sites and the chapel of Saint Athanasios
Views of the Maliakos Gulf and the mountains of Kallidromos, Parnassos, Giona, Oiti, and Vardousia
additional: The race starts from Elateia’s central square. There are three routes: 21.2 km, 12.6 km, and 6.2 km. Electronic timing is provided by CHRONOLOG. There are three aid stations. All finishers receive a medal. Payments are accepted by card only. Refunds are available up to 10 days before the race, subject to a small fee. The cutoff time for the middle-distance route is 2 hours and 30 minutes.

name: 14ος Χορτιάτης Trail Run
description: The 14th Hortiatis Trail Run is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners Association and takes place on Mount Hortiatis in Thessaloniki. The race aims to introduce runners to Hortiatis’s mountain environment, familiarize them with the challenges of trail running, and promote the protection of the natural environment. The event is supported by the Municipality of Pylaia–Chortiatis and promotes exercise, sports education, and social responsibility. It is a mountain race that combines natural beauty with an athletic challenge, ideal for runners who love the mountains and nature.

name: Ολοι Μαζί Μπορούμε
description: The Όλοι Μαζί Μπορούμε road races are taking place for the third consecutive year in Parnitha, Attica, with the aim of reforestation and environmental protection. Participants can choose from three courses, making it possible for everyone to take part regardless of age or fitness level. The entry fee for adults is 10 euros, while children up to 12 years old can participate for free. All runners receive individual timing and a commemorative T-shirt. The event brings participants together to help create a sustainable environment.

name: Πανελλήνιοι Αγώνες Βετεράνων Στίβου
description: The Panhellenic Masters Track and Field Championships are held under the auspices of the Hellenic Masters Athletics Federation (OEVAS) at the Spiantza Grove in Elis. The events include cross-country races and a 10 km race walk, and are open to masters and independent athletes. The event is supported by the Region of Western Greece and the Municipality of Pyrgos, offering a high-level sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting. The races begin in the morning, with the first start at 08:30.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a popular series of winter trail races in the mountains of Attica, offering every runner the chance to enjoy mountain running and the area’s natural beauty. The event features three races in Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha, with two routes at each race: a longer, technical and challenging route, and a shorter one for beginners or training. The series has become an established event in the running community and offers incentives through awards, prize draws and rankings for individual and team performances. The event is organized by MyRace and supported by Salomon, inviting runners of all ages to take part in this celebration of mountain running.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αθήνας
description: The 14th Athens Half Marathon is one of the most popular road races in Greece, held in the historic center of Athens. The 21-kilometer course offers a unique experience through the city, with support stations and full event organization. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over and is a celebration of sport and participation. Races over 5 kilometers, a Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities are also organized. The event prioritizes participants’ safety and comfort, with support along the course and an expo area before the race.
course_highlights: A 21-kilometer course through the historic center of Athens
Support stations with water, energy gels, isotonic drinks, and sponges
Start at 08:00, with the finish open until 11:30
additional: Race materials can be collected at the Runner Service Center & ERGO Half Marathon Expo at the Palaio Faliro Indoor Arena - Taekwondo Venue. Full hydration and energy support is provided along the course. Participants compete at their own exclusive responsibility, with no medical certificates required. Races over 5 km, a Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities are also organized. The event includes the Family Run, the Special Olympics Hellas race, and activities such as the ERGO HALF MARATHON EXPO, with notable courses and activities for everyone.

name: Στα Βήματα του Ζορμπά
description: The “In the Footsteps of Zorba” race is held in Kolindros, Pieria, and features 13 km and 4 km courses, as well as a 500-metre children’s race. The event highlights the area’s historical and cultural heritage, offering participants a unique experience amid beautiful natural surroundings, with panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pierian Mountains. The race is open to athletes aged 12 and over, with special requirements for minors. It is organized by the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros and SMF SPORTS, which is responsible for organizing and supporting the event.
course_highlights: 13 km and 4 km courses in Kolindros, Pieria
Panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pierian Mountains
500-metre children’s race for younger athletes
additional: Athletes aged 15 and over may enter the 13 km race, while athletes aged 12 and over may enter the 4 km race when accompanied by an adult. The event also includes a 500-metre children’s race. SMF SPORTS provides event organization, electronic timing, and sportswear sales services. Technical courses, online registration, medical support, commemorative medals and participant gifts, cultural events, and local traditions.

description: Kavala Trail Run is an annual mountain running celebration organized by the Kavala Greek Mountaineering Club 1933 in Kavala’s unique suburban forest. It offers three different races, united by nature, challenge, and stunning views. The event is for runners seeking outdoor experiences with a variety of distances and difficulty levels.
course_highlights: Three races at different distances: 27 km, 13 km, and 5.5 km
Routes through Kavala’s suburban forest
Natural surroundings with stunning views and varied terrain
additional: The races are organized by the Kavala Greek Mountaineering Club 1933. Three different race distances offer participants a range of experiences. The event has institutional supporters and provides information about the weather and getting around the Kavala area.

name: Primavera Trail Race
description: Ave Romania Primavera Trail Race is a mountain running competition organized by AS Xterra Sport Bihor, held in the village of Șuncuiuș, at the entrance to the Crișului Gorge. The routes follow forest roads and marked hiking trails, passing some of the most beautiful attractions of the Pădurea Craiului Mountains. The race is technical and difficult, with significant elevation changes, offering a serious challenge for endurance runners. Three routes are available: Marathon (42.8 km, +2120 m elevation gain), Cross (16.2 km, +990 m) and Wild (10.2 km, +460 m).
course_highlights: Routes on forest roads and marked hiking trails
Significant elevation changes; technical and difficult course
Scenery and natural attractions in the Pădurea Craiului Mountains and Crișului Gorge
additional: Participants must be at least 16 years old and fit for endurance running. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent/guardian and copies of their ID cards. Organizers may withdraw competitors who are intoxicated, under the influence of substances, or lack appropriate equipment. All participants must follow the marked route and the officials’ instructions. Prizes are awarded only in categories with at least 5 competitors. Registration is exclusively through the webshop, with secure payment. The Marathon has a time limit of 9 hours, and the Cross race has a time limit of 4 hours. Finishers who meet the time limits receive personalized medals.

name: Crosul pentru viață
location: Parcul Alexandru Ioan Cuza (IOR), Bucharest, Romania
organizer: Centrele ROUA, în colaborare cu Pegas Triatlon Club
description: Crosul pentru Viață is an annual charity sporting event held in Alexandru Ioan Cuza Park (IOR) in Bucharest, supporting social causes related to the protection of life. Participants can choose between two adult races: 11 km (three laps of the lake) and 3 km (one lap of the lake), while children aged 3 to 14 run distances adapted to their age groups. The event promotes outdoor activity and solidarity, and the funds raised go to the ROUA Centers, which support pregnant women and mothers with babies. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with prizes and participation medals for all runners.
course_highlights: The course runs through Alexandru Ioan Cuza Park, along the path around the lake
The 11 km race consists of three laps of the lake, while the 3 km race consists of one lap
The children’s race has distances from 200 m to 1,000 m, depending on age group
additional: Race-kit pickup takes place between 08:00 and 09:00 at the wooden gazebo near the stage. The 11 km and 3 km races start at 09:30, and the Children’s Race starts at 11:30, with starts organized by age group. All participants receive a participation medal made of Horezu pottery, access to hydration points along the course and at the finish, medical assistance, and prizes. Participants receive a 30% discount on Cozia Mountain Run 2026 with code CPV26. Registration is not available on race day.

description: Alba Iulia City Race is an annual athletic event held in the historic heart of Alba Iulia, offering participants a unique running experience through the Alba Carolina Citadel and its surroundings. The event includes several races, including a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km cross-country race, a fun run, and the Kids Race, all designed to attract runners of every level. The courses combine paved roads with forest roads and trails, offering spectacular scenery and a glimpse into the history and nature of the area. The atmosphere is festive, with socializing, prizes, and raffles, making the event a celebration of running and the local community.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon with 700 meters of elevation gain
Mixed course: 50% paved roads and 50% forest roads and trails
Support stations with hydration and refreshments along the course
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup take place the day before the event, from 14:00 to 22:00, at the Race Center inside Gate IV of the Alba Carolina Citadel. The half marathon and cross-country race share a 10:00 start from Alba Carolina Citadel Square, while the fun run starts at 10:15. The Kids Race starts at 12:00. The race kit includes a personalized bib, a technical T-shirt for the main races and a cotton T-shirt for the Kids Race, as well as other promotional materials. Timing is electronic with a chip, and finisher medals and prizes are awarded at the finish. The organizers provide an ambulance and photography along the course and at the finish. After the races, an anniversary raffle and a get-together with the team are held at Zocco Cafee. The event includes chip timing, water stations, and a finisher medal. On race day, the citadel is closed to car traffic.

name: Avala trail race
description: Avala Trail Race is a mountain race held on Avala near Belgrade. Organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club, the event brings together runners who enjoy nature and the challenges of mountain terrain. The race is known for its demanding yet beautiful route through wooded areas, offering an opportunity for both a sporting challenge and camaraderie. The fifth edition of the race is scheduled for March 13, 2027.
course_highlights: Mountain trail on Avala
Wooded areas and natural surroundings
Challenging terrain with climbs
additional: The fifteenth edition of the race is organized by the "Avala" Mountaineering Club from Belgrade. Around 70 participants have registered for 2027 so far. Photographer Nemanja Jovanović is covering the event. Participants can expect medals, T-shirts, and professional timing. The race is part of an annual tradition of events on Avala.

name: DRC x URC Run
description: DRC X URC run is a friendly running event held in the center of Athens, offering an opportunity for a light run and socializing with other runners. The route offers 5- and 8-kilometer options, with different paces to suit each participant. The run starts at the Karaiskakis Statue in the Zappeion, creating a lovely atmosphere for a running morning. Participation is free and limited to 200 spots, encouraging runners to sign up quickly.
course_highlights: 5- and 8-kilometer routes in the center of Athens
Starting point: the Karaiskakis Statue in the Zappeion
An opportunity for a light run at different paces (5 km @ 6:30 pace, 8 km @ 6:00 pace)
additional: Participants can choose the pace that suits them and run with other runners in the center of Athens. The event also includes an open light run and activities in the center of Athens, and is part of a series of running events organized by DRC and URC.

name: SportGuru Timișoara 21k
description: SportGuru Timișoara 21k is an international half marathon held in the heart of Timișoara, offering a premium experience for both elite runners and passionate amateurs. The event features a wonderful route full of energy and fun, passing through important areas of the city. It brings the running community together and promotes the spirit of sport with the slogan “Start Running Purple.”
course_highlights: Urban route through Piața Libertății and central areas of Timișoara
International event with broad participation from amateur and professional runners
Vibrant atmosphere and community support throughout the race
additional: The start and finish area is in Piața Libertății, Timișoara. Several races are available: 21k, 10k, 5k, and 2.5k Kids Run. Registration is online via the form on the website. The event also includes training programs and charitable activities. No details have been published about start times or registration fees for the 2027 edition. Sport Expo and race kit pickup take place at Iulius Town Timișoara.

name: Crosul Primăverii
location: Stadionul Viorel Mateianu, Baia Mare, Romania
description: Crosul Primăverii is a running competition that opens the official running season in Baia Mare, for people over 15 years old. The event offers two main races, one 3 km and one 6 km, as well as a combo option for both distances. It is a race about motivation, community, and the joy of running beneath the clear spring sky, carefully organized to provide all participants with an enjoyable and competitive experience.
course_highlights: 3 km Popular Race with a 30-minute time limit
6 km Cross-Country Race with age categories and a 60-minute time limit
Combo option for both races with one race T-shirt
additional: On-site registration is available only for the 3 km Popular Race, with no guarantee of a race kit. Separate prizes for the OPEN podium and age categories. Bank transfer is available for paying the participation fee. The event is for participants over 15 years old.

name: 10ο Women’s Run
description: The 10th Women's Run is a non-competitive 5-kilometer race organized by the Chios Health Athletes Association in collaboration with the Municipality of Chios, with the aim of honoring women. The course is flat and runs through the center of Chios, starting and finishing at the Central Square (Chios Town Hall). The race offers an enjoyable experience for all participants, with amenities including a T-shirt, medal, and commemorative certificate. The race starts at 11:30 a.m. Participation is open to women over 18, and minors may participate with parental consent.

description: The 39th “Kalogreza Blockade” Road Races are a traditional running event held in Nea Ionia, Attica. This sporting event honors historical memory and promotes sports and community participation. It gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in a route through the city, combining athletic activity and culture. The event is organized by the Municipality of Nea Ionia to strengthen the local sporting culture.

name: OPPENING SEASON Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling 2027
location: Meadow above the Rakia Still, Metropolitan Methodius Kusev Park (Ayazmoto), Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб по колоездене и туризъм „Сърнена гора“ – Стара Загора
description: OPENING SEASON Ultra Trail Run & XCM Cycling 2027 is a signature sporting event that opens the sports season in Stara Zagora. Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event offers a range of disciplines—ultra trail running and cross-country cycling. The start and finish are at the clearing above the rakia still in Mitropolit Metodiy Kusev Park (Ayazmoto). Participants can choose from several distances of varying difficulty and marking, suitable for both beginners and advanced athletes.
course_highlights: A dynamic 5 km course within the park, marked in white
A moderately challenging 11 km distance with yellow markings and moderate elevation gain
The royal 42 km distance, marked in orange, featuring the challenges of Sarnena Gora
additional: Registration opens at 06:30 and continues until 08:30, with collection of race packs and bibs with timing chips. The technical briefing is from 08:30 to 08:50. The cycling start (XCM and E-Bike) is at 09:00, and the running start is at 09:30. The main awards ceremony is at 17:00. The distances are marked with colored ribbons and include both running and cycling. There are special categories for electric bikes and age groups. Helmets are mandatory for cyclists.

name: 7ο Via Egnatia Run
description: The VIA EGNATIA RUN is a sporting event organized by the Evros Regional Unit and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace. It is an innovative initiative that connects the history and culture of the ancient Via Egnatia with sport, offering runners a unique experience. The race route follows the ancient Via Egnatia, which once linked Constantinople with Rome, and aims to bring people together through sport and culture. The event includes certified half-marathon and 5-kilometer routes, offering options for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: 21.0975-meter route (half-marathon) certified by AIMS
5,000-meter route certified by AIMS
Route following the ancient Via Egnatia, a historic and cultural trail

name: 17ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Καλαμπάκα – Τρίκαλα
description: The 17th Kalambaka–Trikala “Thanasis Stamopoulos” Half Marathon is one of the fastest half marathons in Greece and Europe, with a gently downhill course starting in historic Kalambaka and finishing in the heart of Trikala. The event honors the memory of Thanasis Stamopoulos, a founding member of the Trikala Runners’ Club, and attracts thousands of runners from across Greece and abroad. Alongside the classic half marathon, the event offers 5K, 5K for people with disabilities, and a 1K children’s race, making it a celebration for all ages and abilities. The course features beautiful scenery and a blend of historic and modern sights, while the atmosphere is filled with excitement and support from spectators.

name: Piraeus Port Run
description: Piraeus Port Run is an iconic road race held in Piraeus in memory of Piraeus-born runner Christos Vartzákis. The race offers 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children, with an emphasis on a safe, high-quality running experience that showcases the city’s waterfront. It is a fixture in Piraeus’s sporting calendar and is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Piraeus and the Piraeus Runners’ Club. The event places particular importance on supporting runners and providing medical care during the race.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.piraeusportrun.gr/race-info.html): 2027-03-21 — "Παρασκευή 13/03 14:00 – 19:00 και" (was estimated 2027-03-21)

name: 1ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ηγουμενίτσας
description: The 1st Igoumenitsa City Run is a road race organized by the Igoumenitsa Runners’ Club in collaboration with the sports company Epirus Athletic Events and the Municipality of Igoumenitsa. The race includes 10,000 m and 5,000 m courses, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race for elementary school students. The start and finish are at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center, offering a unique experience on a scenic urban course. The race is dedicated to the memory of young friend Maximos Lamprousis, honoring his memory and smile.
course_highlights: 10,000 m and 5,000 m courses in the city of Igoumenitsa
1,000 m children’s race for elementary school students
Start and finish at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:35 a.m. The event takes place in the coastal area, welcomes participants of all ages and abilities, and features a celebration and surprises in the city.

name: 4ος Καλλιγώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος
description: The Kalligonios Half Marathon in Lefkada is an annual road race offering events for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon. The race combines an athletic challenge with the beauty of Lefkada’s scenery, attracting runners of all ages and abilities. The event is friendly and offers all participants an enjoyable experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km and 9 km routes featuring natural scenery and historical monuments
1,000 m race for Special Olympics participants and children
Discounts on accommodation and transport for participants
additional: An event focused on cultural and athletic experiences, with entries in various categories and preparation for other races. Registration for 2027 appears to be opening soon.

name: Τρέχω για την άνοιξη ζωής
organizer: Πανελλήνια Ένωση Γονέων και Κηδεμόνων Ατόμων Παιδιών Νοητικά Υστερούντων (ΠΕΓΚΑΠ - ΝΥ)
description: The “I Run for the Spring of Life” road race is held under the auspices of the Attica Region and with the support of the Friends’ Association of P.E.G.K.A.P.-N.Y. It is a sporting event featuring 10 km and 4 km races, as well as a 500 m race for people with disabilities. The races start and finish on Drosias Avenue in Stamata. The courses are looped and pass by notable landmarks in the Municipality of Dionysos, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. The event is open to runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes, with categories by age and gender.
course_highlights: Looped 10 km course (2 × 5 km), starting and finishing on Drosias Avenue in Stamata
4 km course for middle-school boys and girls and adults
500 m race open to people with disabilities
additional: The races take place on Sunday, March 28, 2027, in the Municipality of Dionysos. There are age categories for men and women, with age limits and veterans’ categories. Runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes are eligible to participate. The start and finish are at the corner of Drosias–Stamata Avenue and Solomou Street, with designated turnarounds on the 2.5 km and 2 km courses. All participation supports charitable causes, with an emphasis on strengthening social cohesion and raising awareness about people with disabilities.

name: Voio Race – Νεάπολη
description: The Voio Race in Neapoli is organized by the Municipality of Voio and includes 10,000 m and 5,000 m races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race. The start and finish are on Neapoli’s pedestrian street, and the course runs along the old Tsotyli–Neapoli national road. The race is open to runners aged 12 and over, offering a pleasant experience on a public road with support from the local traffic police. The event uses wave starts and provides electronic timing for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course on a public road, starting from the Tsotyli Health Center
5 km course, starting from the junction in the village of Peristera
1 km children’s race, starting from the kiosk at the entrance to Neapoli
additional: Participants collect a race number with an integrated timing chip and race materials from the registration center on race day. The 22 km race has a maximum finish time of 4 hours and uses wave starts, with runners assigned to start blocks based on their times. After the time limit, runners who have not finished continue at their own risk on the sidewalk. The event includes courses on public roads and pedestrian streets, with support from volunteers and awards for the winners. The event takes place on 28 March 2027.

name: OPENING SEASON-награден фонд 3 000 € Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
location: Clearing above the Rakiya Kazan, Ayazmoto Park (Metropolitan Methodius Kusev Park), Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб по колоездене и туризъм „Сърнена гора“
description: OPENING SEASON 2027 is the fourth anniversary edition of the iconic race in Stara Zagora, opening the sports season with a record prize pool of €5,000. Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event features Ultra Trail Run and XCM Cycling disciplines. The race offers a variety of distances with different difficulty levels and course markings, following scenic routes through Mitropolit Metodiy Kusev Park (Ayazmoto).
course_highlights: Dynamic 5 km course within the park, marked in white
Moderately challenging 11 km distance with yellow markings and moderate elevation gain
The royal 42 km distance, marked in orange and featuring the challenges of the Sarnena Gora
additional: Registration and collection of race packs and numbers with timing chips from 06:30 to 08:30. Technical briefing before the start. Cycling (XCM & E-Bike) starts at 09:00; running races at various distances (5, 11, 21, 34, 42 km) start at 09:30. Grand awards ceremony at 17:00. Routes are marked with different colors for each distance. The start and finish are on the meadow above the rakia still. According to the published schedule, registration is from 06:30 to 08:30, cycling starts at 09:00, and running starts at 09:30.

name: Danube 24h Run 2026
description: Danube 24h Run is an ultramarathon held in the city of Ruse at the City Stadium. Participants can choose between the 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour events, or a 3 x 2-hour relay. The event offers an endurance challenge and is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness.
course_highlights: Ruse City Stadium is the start and finish venue
Individual running and relay options
Events of different durations: 24 hours, 12 hours, 6 hours and a relay
additional: For the 2026 edition, the 24-hour and 6-hour runs are scheduled to start on March 28 at 11:00, the 12-hour run at 23:00, and the relay on March 29 at 06:00. The race date listed in the metadata differs from the dates on the edition pages.

name: Uphill Running Championship
location: Bencecu de Jos, Pișchia, Timiș County, Romania
distance_verbose: Semimaraton, 10.5 km, 5.6 km, 2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Woodland Series
location: Săldăbagiu de Munte, Paleu, Bihor County, Romania
description: Woodland Series Trail Run is a nature running event held in the village of Săldăbagiu de Munte, Paleu commune, Bihor County, offering an experience for the whole family. The event includes two trail races of 5 km and 10 km, as well as children’s races of 500 m and 1,500 m. The routes cross forests and hills on trails and dirt roads, offering hilly terrain with climbs and descents that require runners to stay attentive. Woodland Series is suitable both for beginner runners and for those looking for a challenge on natural terrain in a rural setting near Oradea.
course_highlights: Routes on trails and dirt roads in the Săldăbagiu forest
Hilly terrain with successive climbs and descents
Approximately 300 m of elevation gain on the 10 km route
additional: The event includes children’s races of 500 m and 1,500 m, intended for the youngest participants. The routes are marked, and GPX maps are available for the 5 km and 10 km races. The meeting point is set up near the village of Săldăbagiu de Munte, at Kovács Ranch. The children’s races are free and non-competitive; each child may choose one distance.

name: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA ~ 2027
location: Sat Roșu, Chiajna, Ilfov County, Romania

name: Gârboavele Trail Run
location: Pădurea Gârboavele, Tulucești, Galați County, Romania

name: 4ο Serres Circuit Run
description: The 4th Serres Circuit Run is a major running event returning to Serres, offering a unique experience for runners of all levels. The race takes place at the Serres Autodrome, a specially designed venue that combines safety with an exciting course. The event is supported by the Municipality of Serres, with the aim of promoting sports and the local community. It brings runners and spectators together in a friendly, vibrant atmosphere.

name: 9ο “Το Δεκάρι του Πάρκου”
description: The 9th Charity Road Race “The Park 10K” is being held for the ninth consecutive year on the beautiful trails of Tritsis Park. This is a cross-country race with 5- and 10-kilometer courses, supported by the Metropolitan Park Management Agency and organized for charity, benefiting MDA Hellas. The race attracts runners of all ages and abilities who enjoy running in nature and supporting their community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at the Antonis Tritsis Environmental Awareness Park
5- and 10-kilometer courses through a natural setting
Access through five main entrances, with Entrance A recommended as it is near the start
additional: Tritsis Park can be accessed through five entrances; Entrance A, near the start, is recommended. The race is supported by the Park Management Agency and benefits MDA Hellas. It promotes social awareness, the protection of Tritsis Park, and support for MDA Hellas, while offering people of all ages the chance to enjoy sports in a natural setting.

name: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo
organizer: Спортен клуб по планинско бягане и туризъм „Пловдив и Родопа“
description: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo is a mountain running race held in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains around the village of Markovo, Plovdiv Province. The race offers four distances—8, 12, 22, and 44 km—as well as a 700-meter children’s course. Participants can enjoy well-marked and secured courses with aid stations providing water, food, and drinks. Race services include timing, electronic results tracking, medical assistance, and special race packs with gifts. The event is held under the auspices of Markovo Town Hall and organized by the Plovdiv and Rhodopa Mountain Running and Tourism Sports Clubs.

name: Legal Half-Marathon
description: Legal Half-Marathon is a competition open to members of the legal professions and the general public, organized to promote outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in Bucharest, on Unirii Boulevard, and includes half-marathon and cross-country races, with courses officially certified by World Athletics. Participants can also support social causes through the involvement of the local community. It is an excellent opportunity for amateur and professional athletes to enjoy an urban race starting and finishing in front of the Bucharest Tribunal.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is a 5.27 km loop, completed 4 times
The 10 km cross-country course combines a 4.73 km lap and a 5.27 km lap
The start and finish are located in front of the Bucharest Tribunal
additional: Race kits can be collected in the days leading up to the event at Sport Guru Unirii, 69 Unirii Boulevard, Bucharest. There are separate categories for members of the legal professions and the general public, with distinct age groups. The courses are measured and officially certified by World Athletics. Kit collection is scheduled at Sport Guru Unirii, 69 Unirii Boulevard.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Σπερχειού
description: The 9th Spercheios Half Marathon “Athanasios Akridas” is held in Spercheiada, in the regional unit of Phthiotis, with the support of the Municipality of Makrakomi and the Spercheiada Municipal Community. This road race celebrates the area’s traditions and natural beauty, offering a unique experience for runners who love running and nature. The event is a celebration of sport and social responsibility, aiming to promote sport for all and encourage volunteering.

name: 44ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Δήμου Φιλοθέης – Ψυχικού
description: The 44th Filothei-Psychiko Municipality Road Race is an annual sporting event held in the Filothei and Psychiko area of Athens. The race offers runners of all ages an opportunity to take part in a route through a beautiful suburb with sports and cultural facilities. The event is supported by the Municipality of Filothei-Psychiko and promotes physical activity and social solidarity in the local community. The city is counting down to Sunday, March 22, race day.

name: 2ο DUTH Campus Half Marathon
organizer: Δημοκρίτειο Πανεπιστήμιο Θράκης και Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Ροδόπης
description: The DUTH Campus Half Marathon is being held for the third consecutive year at the Democritus University of Thrace campus in Komotini. It features two distances, 7,000 meters and 21,000 meters, on a smooth, flat dirt course within the university campus. Participation is free, and electronic timing is provided, along with a commemorative medal for all finishers. The top three finishers in each distance and age category are also awarded trophies. The race starts at 10:30 a.m., with the start and finish at the Department of Physical Education and Sport Science (DPESS) of DUTH.
course_highlights: Smooth, flat dirt course within the DUTH campus
Two distances: 7,000 m and 21,000 m
Start and finish at the DUTH DPESS
additional: Electronic timing and overall and individual results are provided. All finishers receive a commemorative collectible medal. A medical examination is required for all athletes and for the parents or guardians of minor athletes. The event is held with the support of the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science, with commemorative medals, trophies, and family events. The course is flat and suitable for all runners.

name: 2ο Vertical Challenge
description: The 2nd Vertical Challenge is an international “vertical kilometer” mountain running race held in Gerakas, Xanthi, organized by the Xanthi Mountaineering Club in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi. Athletes start in the village of Gerakas and follow a 3.5 km uphill route with 1,000 m of elevation gain, finishing at an altitude of 1,415 m. The Gerakas Trail and Gerakas Path races are also held, featuring circular routes of varying difficulty and distance. The event welcomes runners aged 12 and over, with special requirements for younger participants. Registration is individual and takes place online through the club’s website.
course_highlights: Vertical Challenge: 3.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain on trails, finishing at an altitude of 1,415 m
Gerakas Trail: circular 8.5 km route with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Gerakas Path: easy circular 5 km route with 240 m of elevation gain
additional: Maximum number of participants in the 2nd Vertical Challenge: 80. ITRA score must be provided if available. Individual registrations only. Open to participants aged 12 and over, with special requirements for ages 16–18. Organized in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi, with limited places and registration through the website.

name: 3ος Παράκτιος Ημιμαραθώνιος Θερμαϊκού Αντώνης Ματζάρης
description: The Thermaikos Coastal Half Marathon “Antonis Mantzaris” is a distinctive running event in eastern Thessaloniki, offering unique routes along the coastline of the Municipality of Thermaikos. Held on a regular date and attracting a large number of runners, the race combines sport with social action, drawing families and runners of all levels. The event aims to establish itself as an important sporting occasion, known for its quality and beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: A coastal route of unique beauty
Routes suitable for the whole family
Impressive performances and runner participation
additional: The race includes side events and volunteer opportunities. The event follows the standards of major international races and is held on a regular date. It is supported by local clubs and organizations, with an emphasis on environmental awareness and community participation, and includes starts and finishes at the Wellness Santa Hotel.

name: 5ος Μυρμιδόνων Αθλος
description: The 5th Myrmidons Athlos is a challenging mountain running race organized by the Municipality of Farsala in collaboration with the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultrarunning Clubs, the Larissa Prefecture Marathon Runners Club, and Running Team Farsala. The race covers 21 kilometers, with approximately 1,000 meters of both elevation gain and loss, offering an exciting experience in a natural mountain setting. The 2nd Myrmidons Mini Trail is also organized alongside it, covering a shorter distance for runners seeking a shorter route. The event aims to promote sports and connection with nature in the Farsala area.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer distance with +1,000 m of elevation gain and loss
Mountain running in a natural setting around Farsala
A shorter mini-trail race is held alongside the main event
additional: The race features highly challenging routes, with an emphasis on showcasing the area's natural and cultural wealth, and welcomes participants from various age categories.

name: 5ο Pravi Trail Run
description: The EleftheroupoliRunners Sports and Cultural Association of the Municipality of Pangaio organizes the 5th Pravi Trail Run mountain race in Eleftheroupoli. The event includes three distances—21.5 km, 12 km, and 5 km—all starting and finishing in Eleftheroupoli. The 21.5 km course is of moderate difficulty and includes trails, forest roads, and asphalt, while the 12 km course is also of moderate difficulty. The 5 km course is easy and suitable for beginners, offering a first introduction to mountain running.
course_highlights: 21.5 km course with 16 km of trails, 2.5 km of forest roads, and 2.5 km of asphalt
12 km course with 8 km of trails, 1.5 km of forest roads, and 2.5 km of asphalt
Easy 5 km circular course for beginners in mountain running
additional: Maximum entries: 300 for 21.5 km, 200 for 12 km, and 200 for 5 km. Finish time limit: 5 hours. Minimum age: 15, with parental consent for participants aged 15–18. Start and finish at the Eleftheroupoli farmers’ market venue. Registration includes a commemorative gift. Terrain includes trails, forest roads, and asphalt; maximum participants: 300 (21.5 km), 200 (12 km), 200 (5 km); age 15+; time limit 5 hours

name: 8ος Δρόμος 21 Μαθητών
description: The Makrochori Cultural Association of Imathia “PSIFIDOTO,” in collaboration with the Sports Department of the Municipality of Veria and the Local Folklore Association of Makrochori and Surrounding Areas, is organizing the popular memorial race “8th Race of the 21 Students.” The event includes races for adults and children: a 10,700-meter main race, a 2,500-meter health walk, and races for primary and secondary school students. The course is on paved roads, with no significant elevation changes, and takes place in Makrochori, Imathia. The event has a charitable purpose and honors the memory of the 21 students.
course_highlights: 10,700-meter paved course with no significant elevation changes
2,500-meter health walk for adults
1,000-meter and 1,500-meter races for primary and secondary school students
additional: Online registration has closed for all categories. Late registrations are accepted only if race numbers are available, on Saturday or Sunday morning at the Makrochori Cultural Association office. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:15. Courses are on paved roads; participants take part at their own risk. Registration is through the website, with categories separated by age and race distance.

name: 10ος Αραφήνειος Δρόμος
location: Δημοτικό Κολυμβητήριο Ραφήνας, Ραφήνα, Ανατολική Αττική, Ελλάδα
description: The 10th Araphineios Road Race is a major celebration of sport in the Municipality of Rafina-Pikermi, which has become an established event with strong community and athletic participation. The event brings people and organizations together, showcasing the city as a vibrant center of sport and culture. Rafina’s central square is transformed into a hub of activity and entertainment, with sports activities, music, and events for all ages.
course_highlights: Event held in Rafina’s central square
Sports activities and fitness activities by PROTYPO FITNESS CLUB
Cheerleading performance and music by the Rafina-Pikermi Municipal Philharmonic
additional: Race bibs and athlete kits can be collected from 09:00 to 19:00. Activities, refreshments, and event sponsors are present throughout the day. The event includes music and sports demonstrations. The event features races on certified courses, with participants aged 6 and over, and is held with the support of the police and volunteers. Participation is free or requires a small fee, and the event is accompanied by cultural and community activities.

name: 10ος Μαραθώνιος Ναυπλίου
description: The Nafplio Marathon is a special road race that combines sport, history, and natural beauty in the beautiful city of Nafplio. Runners of all levels have the opportunity to enjoy courses passing through historic and natural landscapes while taking part in a friendly, well-organized event. The event offers a range of benefits and gives participants the opportunity to visit archaeological sites in Argolis free of charge. The Marathon is a celebration for the city and its runners, with a strong cultural character and social dimension.
course_highlights: Courses combining sport, history, and natural beauty
Free admission to the archaeological sites of Argolis for participants
Showcasing monuments and archaeological sites in Nafplio, Palamidi, Tiryns, Mycenae, and Epidaurus
additional: Participants receive a race number (BIB), electronic timing, a technical T-shirt, printed informational materials, a participation certificate, race photos, a finisher’s medal, and a bag. Registration fees can be paid only by card or IRIS. Unpaid registrations are automatically canceled. Volunteers are an important part of the event. Runners receive free admission to the archaeological sites of Argolis on race day and the following day. The event includes accompanying cultural, educational, and social activities, races for the marathon, half marathon, 5 km, and a 1 km race for students, as well as cultural programs and trips.

name: 10ος Εύκλειος Αγώνας Βουνού & 6ο Υμηττός Marathon
description: The 10th Efkleios Mountain Race and the 6th Hymettus Marathon are organized by the South Athens Runners Association “EFKLIS” and offer a unique mountain-running experience on Mount Hymettus. The routes include a variety of distances and elevation profiles, with certified courses and water stations. The event is supported by volunteer groups and local organizations, and provides electronic timing, medals, and refreshments for participants. The start is in Argyroupoli, and the atmosphere is friendly and safe for all runners.
course_highlights: 18 km course with electronic timing and live location tracking
47 km Hymettus Marathon with +2,150 m elevation gain and 2 ITRA points
Water stations at key points along the course
additional: Electronic timing uses a chip, and runners’ locations are displayed in real time. The race office distributes race packs from 07:00, strictly for athletes from outside Attica. Payment is by card online only and must be made within five days of registration. Volunteers receive an event T-shirt, a backpack, snacks, water, juice, and a medal. Mountain races and marathons, routes on Mount Hymettus, road and mountain race entries, technical T-shirts and equipment, electronic timing.

name: 14ος Βαλλιάνειος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 14th Vallianeios Popular Road Race in Argostoli is one of Kefalonia’s most important and beloved sporting events, with a continuous presence for 14 years. The main 10-kilometer race follows a beautiful, accessible route along the waterfront, combining sea views with the natural landscape. Children’s races and a dedicated route for people with disabilities are also organized, reinforcing the event’s inclusive character. The event is accompanied by music, dance, and sporting activities, offering a complete celebration of sport for everyone.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the waterfront promenade lined with palm trees
Turnaround near the “Oscar” restaurant and return to the Central Square
Dedicated route for people with disabilities and children’s races ranging from 50 to 100+ meters
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal, and winners in each category are honored with special awards. The event is co-organized with the Municipality of Argostoli and held under the auspices of the Vallianeios Bequest. Last-minute registration is available for a limited number of runners only, on a first-come, first-served basis. Various routes and age categories, volunteer participation, and events for the public. Includes 10 km and children’s routes.

name: Ολοι Μαζί Μπορούμε
description: The “All Together We Can” road races on Mount Hymettus combine sport with support for reforestation and environmental protection. Participation helps raise money to buy trees to be planted in the area. With routes for different ages and abilities, it’s an opportunity to run and give back together.
course_highlights: Route on Mount Hymettus
Race with an environmental purpose
Route options for different ages and abilities
additional: Individual timing and a commemorative T-shirt are mentioned.

name: PepsiCo Gives Back – Kifissia
location: Πλατεία Ηρώων Πολυτεχνείου, Κάτω Κηφισιά, Greece
description: The PepsiCo Gives Back - Kifissia event is a charity road race held in Kato Kifisia, starting and finishing at Heroes of Polytechnic Square. It features timed 5 km and 10 km races, as well as untimed 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races for students and people with disabilities. The event is open to runners of all ages, and proceeds go to charitable causes. RUNAWAY provides technical support, making this an enjoyable and socially beneficial sporting experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the circular road around Heroes of Polytechnic Square
Timed 5 km and 10 km races
Untimed 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races for students and people with disabilities
additional: The 5 km and 10 km races are timed. The 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races are untimed. Companions of people with disabilities and parents may participate without a race bib, starting at the back of the course. The event is charitable, with proceeds going to charitable causes. Registration is available through an online form, with various categories and age groups and a participation fee. The event takes place in Kato Kifisia, starting at Heroes of Polytechnic Square.

name: Велинград Ултра
description: Velingrad Ultra is the inaugural edition of an ultramarathon offering three challenging courses in Velingrad, the spa capital of the Balkans. Participants can choose between 11 km, 27 km, and 43 km mountain courses with varying elevation gain, passing through picturesque natural landscapes. The event includes professional organization, marked courses, aid stations, and medals for all finishers. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the magic of the mountains and enjoy sport and nature together.

name: Панагюрище ултра
description: Panagyurishte Ultra is a mountain running and cycling race held in the heart of Sredna Gora near Panagyurishte. The event brings together people who love being active and seek challenges on forest and dirt roads, with varying distances and elevation gains. Participants can choose from several distances, offering unique views and the chance to connect with nature and test their own abilities. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and community spirit, and offers support along the course as well as prizes for finishers.
course_highlights: After the first kilometer of paved road, the routes follow forest and dirt roads exclusively
Distances of varying lengths and elevation gains, from 12 km to 61 km
A combination of mountain running and cycling, with beautiful views and challenges
additional: The entry fee includes an event T-shirt, a race number with a chip, electronic timing and results, medical support, course markings, water and food at aid stations, a finisher's medal, and gifts from sponsors. Participants must be at least 14 years old, and those aged 14 to 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. Competitors must arrive at the race-number and chip collection point at least 30 minutes before the start. The event includes trail running and mountain biking disciplines.

organizer: Universitatea de Științe Agronomice și Medicină Veterinară din București

tiers.description: Taxa de participare CURSA 500 m – Categorie U12 – 2027

description: The USAMV Cross-Country Run is an annual sporting event organized by the University of Agronomic Sciences and Veterinary Medicine of Bucharest, open to everyone who enjoys exercising outdoors, from children to adults. The event takes place on the Agronomie-Herăstrău Campus, a pleasant green area of Bucharest that offers an ideal setting for running and promoting a healthy lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a green course and fresh spring air. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each age and gender category. The event is limited to 1,000 participants and offers a friendly, motivating atmosphere for all ages.
course_highlights: A green course on the Agronomie-Herăstrău Campus, an area of 38 hectares with green spaces and horticultural landscaping
An academic and historic setting, with exotic plant species and fruit orchards nearby
An event for all ages, with races ranging from 500 m to 10 km
additional: Race kits can be picked up from March 31 to April 2, 2027, between 9:00 and 16:00, in the Expo Area on the Agronomie-Herăstrău Campus. On race day, April 3, kits can be collected in the start/finish area according to a schedule that varies by race. The maximum number of participants is 1,000. The event offers 84 prizes across all categories, awarding the top three places in the girls’ and boys’ categories. Categories include children, USAMV students, and adults.
