name: Bistrița Trail Running
description: Bistrița Trail Running is a mountain running race held in the Bistrița area, with courses that take participants through natural landscapes. Marathon and half-marathon events are announced, suited to runners who want to test their limits on varied terrain. The event invites runners to discover the forests and surroundings of the city.
course_highlights: Courses through the Ghinzii and Codrișor forests
Varied terrain, with forests, clearings, and pastures
Marathon and half-marathon events

name: Reșița Stairs Challenge
location: Dealul Golului, Reșița, Caraș-Severin County, Romania
description: Reșița Stairs Challenge is an annual race on concrete stairs, trails, and paths, held on Dealul Golului in Reșița. The event is open to both professional and amateur runners and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and increase the area’s appeal. Participants can enjoy an intense vertical competition, with cash and product prizes, in a unique natural and urban setting. Runners start individually, at 30-second intervals, and the courses are clearly marked and vary in difficulty.
course_highlights: A course running almost entirely on stairs through the forest, finishing on Dealul Golului at the La Stemă viewpoint
Events of varying lengths and difficulty: short race (400 m, +110 m elevation), half race (7 km, +650 m elevation, 5 laps), long race (14.5 km, +1250 m elevation, 10 laps)
The start is at the bottom of the stairs, opposite Lidl, approximately 300 m from the center of Reșița
additional: Runners start individually, 30 seconds apart, in order of previous performances. Check-in and race-kit pickup take place from 9:00 to 9:45 in the designated area beside the Lidl parking lot. The time limit is 30 minutes for the short race and 3 hours for the long race (10 laps). The courses can be downloaded in .gpx format from Google Drive. The event is open to both amateur and professional runners; cash and product prizes are offered.

name: Kablar Skyrace 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held on the slopes of Kablar in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge. The race is 22.4 km long, with 1,600 meters of cumulative elevation gain, and is worth 1 ITRA point. The course combines fast forest sections, technically challenging rocky segments, and climbs to two of Kablar’s peaks, offering beautiful views of the West Morava River and the surrounding mountains. The race is intended both for beginners in mountain running and for experienced runners who want to enjoy the nature of western Serbia. It is organized by the Kablar Mountaineering Society of Čačak and held under the auspices of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia.
course_highlights: 22.4 km with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging rocky sections and two Kablar peaks (889 and 885 m)
Views of the West Morava River, Ovčar, Jelica, and Debela Gora
additional: The race has a 4-hour time limit for competitors in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia national series. The course is certified and is worth 1 ITRA point. The start and finish are at the Natural History Center in Ovčar Banja. The organizer provides good organization, clear course markings, and safety during the race. The 2026 edition started and finished at the Natural History Center in Ovčar Banja; certification worth 1 ITRA point is listed.

name: Helicon Mountain Race
description: The Helicon Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race held at the Krya Springs in Livadeia. It offers routes of various distances, from 5.6 km to 38 km, through a stunning natural environment with rugged terrain and lush vegetation. The race is certified by the International Skyrunning Federation and offers nature and adventure enthusiasts a unique opportunity to enjoy an unforgettable mountain-running experience. A free yoga session is also organized to help participants unwind and relax.

name: 3ο Kefalonia Backyard Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Η εγγραφή πραγματοποιείται μέσω της εφαρμογής RaceID και θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μετά την καταβολή του παραβόλου συμμετοχής, το οποίο είναι 40 ευρώ.

description: The Kefalonia Backyard Ultra is a backyard ultra-distance race held in Argostoli, Kefalonia. Runners are invited to run a 6,706-meter loop, completing one lap every hour until only one runner remains. The course combines asphalt, trails, and dirt roads, with a distinctive climb up Agios Athanasios Hill, offering beautiful panoramic views of the sea and the island. The race encourages participants to push their limits and enjoy nature and the company of other runners.
course_highlights: 6,706-meter loop with a climb up Agios Athanasios Hill
Mixed terrain: 10% asphalt, 45% trails, 45% dirt roads
Panoramic views of the sea and the port of Argostoli
additional: At night, the course is modified for safety, keeping its 6,706-meter length but with a different proportion of asphalt and trails. Each lap takes between 42 and 53 minutes to complete, depending on the athlete’s fitness.

name: 78ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Ιέρας Πόλης Μεσολογγίου
location: Holy Monastery of Saint Symeon, Mesolongi, Greece
description: The 78th Sacrifice Road Race of the Sacred City of Messolonghi is a historic road race held as part of the celebrations marking the anniversary of the historic Exodus. The race honors the people of Messolonghi who sacrificed themselves for the ideals of freedom and is the oldest road race in the country. The course starts at the Holy Monastery of Saint Symeon, where the Free Besieged sought refuge after the Exodus, and finishes in the city’s Garden of Heroes.
course_highlights: Start at the Holy Monastery of Saint Symeon, a historic refuge for the Free Besieged
Finish in the Garden of Heroes in the city of Messolonghi
Total course distance: 9,800 meters
additional: The course has historical significance and is connected with the heroic Exodus of the Free Besieged. Approximately 2,500 fighters, women, and children who sacrificed themselves take part. The event also includes a children’s race.

name: Evia Ultra Trail
description: The Evia Ultra Trail is a challenging mountain race that crosses the beautiful region of Steni, Evia. It offers a unique experience on scenic trails, combining technical routes with impressive landscapes. The race is organized by the Evia Runners Athletic and Mountaineering Club and is an important event for mountain running enthusiasts in Greece. The organizers emphasize safety and support for runners throughout the course.
course_highlights: Trails with natural beauty and varied terrain
Impressive landscapes in the Steni, Evia region
Technically challenging sections with changes in elevation
additional: The race includes aid stations with water and refreshments, and strict safety regulations are enforced. The organizers provide a technical briefing and race rules before the event. Participation in the EVUT 100 Relay is available. The central aid station is located in Kymi.

name: Run Greece Syros
location: Town Hall of Ermoupoli, Eleftheriou Venizelou Street, Ermoupoli, Syros, Greece

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Η συμμετοχή στους Αγώνες 5χλμ & 10χλμ έχει συνδρομή 15,00€.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Η συνδρομή συμμετοχής για μαθητές/φοιτητές 12-18 ετών σε ομαδική εγγραφή είναι 5,00€.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ο Παιδικός Αγώνας και το Family Run είναι Δωρεάν.

description: Run Greece Syros is an annual road race that attracts runners from across Greece and abroad, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy Syros’s rich cultural heritage and natural beauty. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races, a race walk, a family race, and a children’s race, making it ideal for all ages and levels of runners. The start is in front of Ermoupoli Town Hall, on a course that combines urban and seaside scenery. The event provides for participants’ safety and comfort with electronic timing and full medical coverage.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km courses through the town of Ermoupoli
Start in front of Ermoupoli Town Hall on Eleftheriou Venizelou Street
Family and children’s races open to participants of all ages
additional: Race numbers and race materials can be collected at the former “Pantheon,” Miaouli Square, on Friday, May 15, from 17:00 to 20:00 and Saturday, May 16, from 10:00 to 20:00. Timing is provided by a chip embedded in the race number. Full medical coverage and volunteer rescuers are available during the race.

name: Kaylaka Trail Run 2026
description: Kaylaka Trail Run 2026 is the fourth edition of a mountain race in Kaylaka Nature Park in Pleven. The event offers four distances—7 km, 16 km, 21 km, and 30 km—on scenic forest trails, steep hills, and rocky sections with panoramic views of the valley of the Tuchenishka River. The event combines sport, nature, and a cause, with part of the funds raised donated to improve the park’s infrastructure. Every finisher receives a specially made medal, a symbol of perseverance and the strength that comes from the forest.
course_highlights: Scenic forest trails and rocky sections with panoramic views of the valley of the Tuchenishka River
Routes with challenging climbs and descents, suitable for beginners and experienced trail runners alike
Water and food stations at various points along the routes
additional: Distances: 7 km (also suitable for walkers and children), 16 km, 21 km, and 30 km. The terrain includes asphalt, forest roads, and hiking nature trails. Water and food stations are located at key points along the routes. Every participant receives a special medal. The event supports improvements to the infrastructure in Kaylaka Park. The event is dedicated to caring for nature and Kaylaka Park.

name: МАДАРА TRAIL 2026
description: Madara Trail 2026 is a mountain running event held in the village of Madara, Shumen Municipality. The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, suitable for both recreational runners and experienced trail runners. Participants must wear trail shoes, and those running the 30 km distance must carry containers for water and food. The event is organized by Shumen Early Runners, and participants must complete informed consent forms.
course_highlights: Trail running in the natural surroundings of the village of Madara
Three distances: 13 km, 21 km, and 30 km
Trail shoes and equipment are required
additional: Mandatory equipment for all participants: trail running shoes. Participants in the 30 km race must carry water containers with a capacity of at least 500 ml and food. Completing informed consent forms is mandatory. For the 30 km distance, participants must carry a water container with a capacity of at least 500 ml and food. Trail running shoes are mandatory.

name: Кайлъка трейл рън '27
location: Totlebenov Val Reservoir, Kaylaka Park, Pleven, Bulgaria
organizer: Сдружение „Да бягаш“ в партньорство с Община Плевен
description: Kaylaka Trail Run is a mountain race in Kaylaka Nature Park, Pleven, combining sport, nature, and a cause. The race offers four distances—7 km, 16 km, 21 km, and 30 km—along scenic forest trails, steep hills, and rocky sections with panoramic views of the valley of the Tuchenishka River. The courses are suitable for beginners as well as experienced trail runners. The event supports improvements to the park’s infrastructure and promotes a connection between people and nature. Everyone who finishes receives a specially made medal, a symbol of perseverance and the strength of the forest.
course_highlights: Scenic forest trails and steep hills
Rocky sections with panoramic views of the valley of the Tuchenishka River
Varied surfaces—pavement, forest roads, and hiking eco-trails
additional: Water and food stations are located along the courses. The 7 km course is suitable for runners, walkers, and children. The 30 km course starts at the Totlebenov Val Reservoir and passes historical and natural landmarks such as the Storgozia Fortress and the Dead Valley. The surface is about 6% pavement, with the rest consisting of forest roads and eco-trails. In the previous edition, the start and finish were at the Totlebenov Val Reservoir.

name: Wizz Air Cluj-Napoca Marathon
distance_verbose: Maraton, Semimaraton, 10.5 km, 10 km, 4 km, 1.6 km
description: The Wizz Air Cluj-Napoca Marathon is an annual running event offering several races for runners of all levels, including a full marathon, half marathon, cross-country races, and relays. The event takes place in the city of Cluj-Napoca and is known for its vibrant atmosphere and professional organization. Participants can experience varied courses that pass through important areas of the city, promoting sport and the local community. It is an excellent opportunity for runners to enjoy a well-organized competition and discover the beauty of Cluj and Transylvania.
course_highlights: Varied courses through the center and key areas of Cluj-Napoca
Multiple events: marathon, half marathon, cross-country races, and relays
A vibrant event with community support and a competitive atmosphere
additional: The event also includes wheelchair races and a Family Run. Relays are held over distances of 4×1.6 km and 4×10.5 km. Road restrictions and recommendations for participants and spectators apply. Registration is online and must be validated before the event. The 4×1.6 km corporate relay and Family Run are scheduled for the day before the main events.

name: ULTRAMARATON GALAȚI
organizer: Asociația Profesională a Polițiștilor Locali Galați (GALPOL)
description: UltraRace 24h Galați is an endurance running competition held in Gârboavele Forest and organized by the Professional Association of Local Police Officers of Galați. The event includes a variety of races, from short cross-country runs to individual and team ultramarathons, on a 3.25 km course with a mixed dirt and asphalt surface and 20 m of elevation gain. Participants receive services such as a race bib with a chip, a finisher’s medal, hydration points, and medical assistance. Winners are determined by the distance covered or the time recorded, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: A 3.25 km course, with 1.85 km on dirt and 1.4 km on asphalt
20 metres of elevation gain on a marked and illuminated circuit
A variety of races, from cross-country runs to individual and team ultramarathons
additional: Participants can run, walk, take breaks, or sleep throughout the 24-hour period. Special events include a team relay and races for children. Equipment storage and emergency medical services are available. The event also includes team events, a relay, and races for children; the race for wheelchair users has no participation fee. It also has a charitable component.

name: 1ος Μαραθώνιος Ηπείρου «Βασιλιάς Πύρρος»
description: The Epirus “King Pyrrhus” Marathon is a historic, fast marathon held in the city of Arta, on a course certified by World Athletics. The route is flat and runs along the Arachthos River, offering ideal weather conditions for runners seeking personal records. The race honors King Pyrrhus, an important ancient leader of Epirus, and combines sport with the region’s history and culture. The event includes a marathon, 10K, and 5K, and welcomes runners of all levels.

name: 2ο Amanitis Trail
organizer: Podilates Chiou – Cycling and Triathlon Club
description: Amanitis Trail 2027 offers a unique mountain-running experience in central Chios, starting from the picturesque semi-mountainous village of Avgonima, overlooking the Aegean Sea. The 40-kilometer route passes through historic and natural landscapes, including the medieval village of Anavatos and the secluded Agios Sideros, with a mix of trails, dirt roads, and panoramic views. The finish is back in Avgonima, completing an authentic adventure through the island’s nature and history. Shorter 7- and 21-kilometer routes are also available, suitable for beginners and more experienced runners, respectively.

name: 10ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Βόλου
description: The 10th Volos Half Marathon is a festive sporting event held under the auspices of the Thessaly Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS) and EOSLMA-Y. The event includes the half marathon, a 5 km city race, a 2 km Family Run, and a 500 m Kids Run, attracting thousands of participants every year. It is co-organized by the Volos Health Runners’ Club, the Municipality of Volos, the Region of Thessaly, the Magnesia Chamber of Commerce, and the University of Thessaly. Registration is exclusively online, with payment by card, and the participation package includes a commemorative T-shirt for the anniversary race. The start and accompanying races offer a unique running experience in the city of Volos.

name: 3ος Γιτάνειος Δρόμος
location: Igoumenitsa Cycling Path, Igoumenitsa, Thesprotia, Greece
organizer: Πολιτιστικοί Σύλλογοι Φιλιατών, Ραγίου, Ασπροκκλησίου, Σαγιάδας και Κεστρίνης
description: The 3rd Gitaneios Run is an important sporting and cultural event that combines athletics with the promotion of Thesprotia’s historical heritage. It includes 21 km and 5 km road races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race for children aged 6 and over. The course is paved and finishes at the archaeological site of Gitana, at the iconic Ancient Theatre of Gitana, offering a unique experience amid landscapes of natural and historical interest. The event aims to become an institution that connects sport with the culture of the region.
course_highlights: 21 km route from the Igoumenitsa cycling path to the archaeological site of Gitana
Finish at the iconic Ancient Theatre of Gitana
Passes along the waterfront, through the plain of Ragio–Kestrini, and by the Kalamas River
additional: Participation is free. Buses will be provided from the Pantheon in Igoumenitsa to the Archaeological Site of Gitana (08:00–08:30 a.m.), with return transport after the awards ceremony. For safety reasons, before the start of the 5 km race and the children’s race, vehicle traffic will be stopped in and around the Ancient Theatre of Gitana. The co-organizers are the Municipality of Filiates, the Municipality of Igoumenitsa, the Thesprotia Regional Unit, and the Ephorate of Antiquities of Thesprotia. The routes are paved, and buses are planned from the Pantheon in Igoumenitsa to the archaeological site of Gitana.

name: 3ο Γρεβενά City Run
description: The 3rd Grevena City Run is a road race held in the city of Grevena with the central message “Sport for All.” The route passes through the city’s main streets, climbs steps, and winds through picturesque alleys, offering beautiful views of the Grevenitis River and showcasing the city’s distinctive corners. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 1,000-meter race for children, and a 1,000-meter walk for people with disabilities and parents with strollers. The race is dedicated to BPAN Heroes, aiming to inform and raise awareness about the disease and promote scientific research.
course_highlights: Route through the city’s main streets and picturesque alleys
Climb up steps with views of the Grevenitis River
Showcases Grevena’s hospitality and the city’s distinctive corners
additional: Race-day registration is not available for the children’s race. A 1,000-meter walk is included for people with disabilities and parents with strollers. Children must register in advance; registration for the children’s race is not available on the day of the event.

name: 4α Γεωργάντεια
location: Κεντρική Πλατεία Κωνσταντίνου Μπάκαλα, Στενό, Arcadia, Greece
organizer: Αστική Μη Κερδοσκοπική Εταιρεία «Ποσειδώνας Τρίπολης», Δήμος Τρίπολης και Δημοτική Κοινότητα Στενού
description: The 4th Georganteia road race takes place at Konstantinos Bakalas Central Square in Steno, Arcadia. All routes start and finish in front of the central square of the community of Steno. This sporting event offers 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer routes, as well as a shorter 1-kilometer route suitable for all participants. The organizers provide amenities for athletes, including parking and security support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Steno Central Square
10 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes
Routes through the community of Steno, Arcadia
additional: Race registration opens at 09:00 a.m. on the day of the event. Parking is available in the grounds of the former Steno Primary School, with security provided to help keep vehicles safe. Participants must be at the starting point by 10:00 a.m.

name: 5ο Race For Autism Gr
organizer: Δήμος Βάρης Βούλας Βουλιαγμένης και ΑμΚΕ Race for Autism Gr
description: The 5th Race For Autism Gr takes place in the Kavouri area of Vouliagmeni, aiming to raise awareness of autism and promote the equal participation of neurodivergent people in sports. The event is supported by local government and includes amateur sporting activities that foster social inclusion. The race promotes awareness and acceptance of diversity, with athletes of all ages and abilities taking part. It is an important initiative for social cohesion and raising awareness about autism.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route in the Vouliagmeni area
Amateur race with a social purpose
Promotes the equal participation of neurodivergent people
additional: The event is supported by the Municipality of Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni and includes awareness-raising and social inclusion activities. In the past, a swimming event, “I Swim for Autism,” was also held at the Kallithea Swimming Pool, with athletes of all ages and abilities taking part. Participation is open to children over the age of 12.

name: 10ος Ορεινός Αγώνας Γερανείων
location: Παραλιακό Πάρκο Λουτρακίου, Λουτράκι, Κορινθία, Greece
description: The Geraneia Mountain Race is an annual trail-running event held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Geraneia Mountains, starting from Loutraki Seaside Park. The race celebrates its 10th edition, honoring the challenges runners face on mountain terrain. The route offers unique experiences in a landscape that combines natural beauty with athletic challenge. The event is for runners who love the mountains and adventure, and the Loutraki community actively supports it.
course_highlights: Mountain route in the Geraneia Mountains
Natural scenery with unique views
A challenge at every kilometer of the route
additional: The event is supported by the Municipality of Loutraki and the Loutraki Mountaineering Club. The start is at Loutraki Seaside Park. The event celebrates its 10th edition, highlighting the tradition and community of trail runners in the area. The routes are 22 and 10 km, with 92% of the route running along trails.

name: 12ος Φιλανθρωπικός Αγώνας Βουνού Αυτισμός – Ελπίδα 2026
location: Κεντρική είσοδος Μονάδας ΕΛΠΙΔΑ, οδός Στεφανίδη, Oreokastro, Greece
organizer: Σύλλογος Φίλων Αυτιστικού Ατόμου της Μονάδας «ΕΛΠΙΔΑ» και Δήμος Ωραιοκάστρου
description: The 12th “Autism - ELPIDA” Charity Mountain Race takes place in the peri-urban forest of the Municipality of Oreokastro, with 1 km, 5+ km and 15 km routes. The 15 km route features significant elevation changes, with a total elevation difference of 500 metres, offering runners a challenging and beautiful experience. The race aims to raise awareness about children with autism and support the “ELPIDA” Autism Unit. Registration includes a personal race number, electronic timing for the longer routes, medical support, a medal, a snack and commemorative items. The race starts in front of the main gate of the “ELPIDA” Unit.
course_highlights: 15 km route with a total elevation difference of 500 metres
A mix of paved, forest and dirt terrain
Passes beside the dam without crossing it
additional: There are toilets and a clothing storage area at the start and finish. Gifts are awarded to the three youngest participants in the 1 km route. A medal and snack are provided at the finish. Electronic timing is available for the 5+ km and 15 km routes. Participants run at their own risk, and a recent medical check-up is recommended. The 5+ km and 15 km routes include electronic timing. Participation includes a race number, medical support, a commemorative certificate, a medal and a snack.

name: 13ο Poikilo Rocky Mountain
description: Poikilo Rocky Mountain is a mountain running race with an authentic trail character, on the trails of Mount Poikilo in Petroupoli. It includes routes of 29, 18, 10 and 4 kilometers, as well as a 1-kilometer children’s race, for runners of different experience levels. The start and finish are at March 8 Square. The event is coordinated by P.D.S. Odysseas and the Municipality of Petroupoli.
course_highlights: The routes follow the trails of Mount Poikilo.
There are four distance options: 4, 10, 18 and 29 kilometers.
A 1-kilometer children’s race is included.
additional: A water bottle or flask is required for the 18- and 29-kilometer routes.

name: Tarnovo Ultra 2026
location: Parking at Boris Denev Art Gallery, Assenevtsi Monument, Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 55 km, 51 km, 35 km, 32 km, 25 km, 14 km
description: Tarnovo Ultra 2026 offers a unique race in the heart of Veliko Tarnovo, with 10 disciplines including mountain biking, trail running and duathlon. The routes pass along beautiful trails and offer breathtaking views, including a passage through two medieval fortresses. The finish is at the Asenevtsi Monument, overlooking the historic part of the city, making this the only race in Bulgaria to finish in the centre of a regional city. The event is organised by Brown Team Sports Club, which guarantees a high standard of organisation and a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: The routes pass through two medieval fortresses
Breathtaking views and trails with varied terrain
The finish is in the centre of Veliko Tarnovo, at the Asenevtsi Monument
additional: The race offers 10 disciplines: three MTB distances (24, 35 and 55 km) on 10 April, four trail distances (14, 25, 32 and 51 km) on 11 April, and three duathlons combining MTB and trail distances. The routes have varied terrain and a challenging profile, with excellent course marking. The organiser is Brown Team Sports Club, a member of the Bulgarian Orienteering Federation. The programme also includes MTB distances of 24, 35 and 55 km, as well as a short and a long duathlon and a children's duathlon.

name: Kom Epic в града
description: KOM EPIC in the City is a mass urban race in the center of Berkovitsa and around the city stadium. The event offers three distances—3.5 km, 7 km, and a 1 km children’s race—with a shared start and finish in the city center. The course includes a red route of about 3.5 km, with a loop around the stadium that serves as a special speed segment, and a blue route for the children’s race in the city center. The event is suitable for both professionals and amateurs, who start together in a mass start.
course_highlights: A red route of about 3.5 km with a loop around the city stadium
A 1 km speed segment around the stadium for recording the fastest kilometer
A 1 km children’s race in the city center on a blue route
additional: The cutoff time is 45 minutes for 3.5 km and 1 hour and 20 minutes for 7 km. Payments can be made by bank transfer or through Easypay, providing a reference number to link the payment to the registration. Cutoff times of 45 minutes for 3.5 km and 1 hour and 20 minutes for 7 km apply. The event is held in partnership with Berkovitsa Municipality.

name: Semimaraton Brașov
description: Semimaraton Brașov is an annual running event held in Piața Unirii in Brașov, offering participants a unique experience on scenic and challenging routes. The main 21 km half-marathon course passes through the city’s most visited and spectacular areas, including sustained climbs and descents on forest trails. The event also includes cross-country races accessible to all ages, such as the Benchmark Cross and the High School Students’ Cross, promoting running for everyone. The atmosphere is friendly and supports social causes, and participants benefit from comprehensive services, from race kits to post-race massages.
course_highlights: A 21 km route with sustained climbs and descents on forest trails
Highest point at the quarry in Poiana Brașov (km 8.5)
Passes through scenic areas such as Poiana Stehil and Șaua Tâmpei
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday and Saturday before the race, with the waiver signed digitally. The race kit includes a metal medal, beer, a MyKinetik massage, hydration and refreshment stations, and a pasta party with tuna salad. Course cut-off times are 1h30min to reach the quarry in Poiana Brașov and 3h30min to reach the finish; exceeding these limits results in disqualification. The event has a social component and supports causes in the community.

name: Ultrarace 24H Galați
organizer: Asociația Profesională a Polițiștilor Locali Galați (GALPOL)
description: UltraRace 24h Galați is an endurance running competition held in Gârboavele Forest, featuring individual and team 24-hour events alongside shorter-distance races. Participants can choose between the marathon, half marathon, and cross-country race, and the event also includes a relay, a race for wheelchair users, and children’s races. It is an opportunity to run in nature in a competition with options for different ability levels and ages.
course_highlights: The course is a 3.25 km loop, with approximately 1.85 km on dirt and 1.4 km on asphalt.
The loop has an elevation gain of approximately 20 m.
Available events: 24 hours individually or in teams, a 42.25 km marathon, a 19.5 km half marathon, and a 9.75 km cross-country race.
additional: The 24-hour relay consists of four members, each running for one hour. Children’s races are also held, with distances ranging from 200 to 1,000 m.

name: Baneasa Forest Run
description: Will it be the challenge of 21 kilometers? The adrenaline of 11 kilometers? A fast 6-kilometer run? Or a fun run in the forest with your family, over a distance of 3 km? Whatever event you choose, don’t forget to enjoy such a beautiful race! Because, after all, that’s what Baneasa Forest Run is all about: the joy of running through the forest!
course_highlights: 100% trail routes in Băneasa Forest, with paths, dirt roads, and asphalt
A range of distances: half marathon 21 km, cross-country race 11 km, sprint 6 km, and Family Run 3 km
Aid stations at the start, km 3.3, km 5, km 9, and the finish, with water, isotonic drinks, and food
additional: The routes may include uneven ground, roots, and vegetation; rain may bring puddles and mud. Group training sessions are organized at different paces, with coordinators. Aid stations offer water, isotonic drinks, and food at several points along the routes.

images.alt_text: Doi alergători pe un traseu forestier în pădurea Băneasa, într-o zi luminoasă de primăvară.

description: The Leuctra Popular Cross-Country Race is a traditional road race held in Leuctra, Boeotia, and organized by the Leuctra Cultural and Educational Association. The event includes races for children and adults, starting and finishing in Leuctra’s central square. It offers an enjoyable sporting experience with a nominal entry fee, promoting local sports culture and community participation. Participants are asked to arrive early to collect their timing chip.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Leuctra’s central square
1.5 km course for children, and 3.5 km and 10 km courses for adults
Traditional cross-country race with a local character
additional: Participants must arrive at least one hour before the race starts to collect their timing chip. Courses through mountainous and urban areas; collection of the timing chip is required one hour beforehand.

name: Hydra’s Trail Event
location: Hydra, Hydra Regional Unit, Attica, Greece
description: Hydra’s Trail Event is an annual trail-running race held on the island of Hydra. It offers a variety of routes for runners of all levels, from a marathon to shorter, fun runs. The event combines the challenge of nature with the beauty of the landscape, attracting large numbers of participants and volunteers. It has a long tradition and a reputation for excellent organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes with a strong mountain character and natural beauty
A variety of races, from a marathon to routes for beginners and children
Routes crossing the picturesque island of Hydra
additional: Race T-shirts and medals are offered to participants. Volunteers can help support the athletes. The schedule includes multiple start times for different routes, with the first start at 07:00. The event includes medals, T-shirts, volunteer opportunities, and entries in various categories, with an emphasis on natural beauty and community.

name: 9ος Αγώνας Πεδίου Αρεως «Στις Γειτονιές της Αθήνας»
location: Pedion tou Areos, near the Statue of Athena, Athens, Greece
description: The 9th Pedion Areos Race “In the Neighborhoods of Athens” is organized by the “Athenians Runners” Athletic and Cultural Association to promote Pedion Areos Park and raise awareness of environmental issues. It includes 5- and 10-kilometer races and a 1.3-kilometer children’s race, starting and finishing inside the park and passing through Athens’s neighborhoods. The event promotes fair play, culture, and ecological awareness, with an emphasis on sustainability and waste reduction. It is held under the auspices of prominent sports and social organizations.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Statue of Athena inside Pedion Areos Park
5- and 10-kilometer routes through the neighborhoods around the park
A 1.3-kilometer children’s race with one loop inside the park
additional: The race is “green,” with an environmental-awareness program and a commitment to responsible waste management. The 10-kilometer race has a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes. After that, runners must run on the sidewalk at their own risk. The 10-kilometer route is listed as 10,160 m; electronic timing and water stations are provided.

name: Ямбол Рън / Yambol Run
description: Yambol Run is a sporting event that brings together athletes and sports enthusiasts in the city of Yambol. The competition includes different age groups and activities for children, with the aim of encouraging an active lifestyle and sports culture in the community. The event is held under the auspices of Yambol Municipality and offers everyone interested the opportunity to take part.

name: 15ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Δόλιχος «Δελφοί-Ολυμπία»
description: The Dolichos Delphi–Olympia Road Race is a challenging 255-kilometer ultramarathon with a 48-hour duration. It starts in Delphi and finishes in Ancient Olympia. The course combines 60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails with 40% paved roads, crossing central Greece and the Peloponnese via the Rio–Antirrio Bridge. The mountainous route reaches an altitude of up to 1,100 meters, with significant elevation gain and loss. The race is organized by the OLYMPIOI sports club and invites runners to test their endurance in a pioneering Greek race.
course_highlights: A 255-kilometer route with a 48-hour duration
60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails; 40% paved roads
A mountainous route reaching up to 1,100 meters, with 5,420 meters of total elevation gain
additional: Included are transfers from Athens to Delphi and from Olympia to Athens; accommodation and meals in Ancient Olympia after the race; supplies and medical support during the race; transport in the event of withdrawal; a medal and commemorative certificate for finishers; and a guided tour of the archaeological site and museum of Ancient Olympia the following day. The race offers multiple distances (255 km, 144 km, and 111 km), with scenic surroundings and a challenging course, and takes place over three days in April. Support points and electronic tracking are available.

description: Plovdiv Marathon Weekend brings together a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and corporate relay, with the start and finish at Plovdiv Rowing Canal. The courses are internationally certified to World Athletics and AIMS standards, passing along the Maritsa River and through the city center. The event offers opportunities for both experienced runners and beginners, with a range of distances and a friendly atmosphere. Participants receive race kits with a medal, T-shirt and travel vouchers. The three-day program includes races and entertainment for all ages.
course_highlights: Internationally certified courses to World Athletics and AIMS standards
The marathon consists of two laps of the half-marathon course, which passes along the Maritsa River and through central Plovdiv
The 5 km and corporate relay take place on a flat course near the Rowing Canal
additional: Race kits are distributed on Friday and Saturday. The race kit includes a chip-timed bib, medal, T-shirt (for the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon), water, isotonic drinks and fruit along the course, medical assistance and insurance for race day, as well as food and drinks at the finish. Each participant receives travel vouchers worth €300. The corporate relay is for four participants, each running a 1.25 km leg. The race kit includes a chip-timed bib, and finishers receive a medal; drinks, fruit, medical assistance and insurance for race day are provided.

name: Plovdiv Run
location: Plovdiv Rowing Canal (Гребна база), Plovdiv, Bulgaria
price_range: Корпоративна щафета: €40 на човек; таксите за останалите дистанции не са посочени.
description: Plovdiv Run is an event featuring a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and corporate relay, with the start and finish at Plovdiv Rowing Canal. The courses are internationally certified according to World Athletics and AIMS standards, passing along the Maritsa River and through the center of Plovdiv, offering a unique combination of sport and culture. Participants can enjoy a variety of distances suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, with the opportunity to take part in races throughout the weekend. The organizers provide race packs with medals, T-shirts, food and drinks, as well as medical assistance and insurance.
course_highlights: Internationally certified courses according to World Athletics and AIMS standards
Two laps for the marathon and one for the half marathon, along the Maritsa River and through the center of Plovdiv
Start and finish at Plovdiv Rowing Canal, with flat and scenic courses
additional: Race packs are distributed on Friday and Saturday. The race pack includes a race bib with chip, medal, T-shirt (for the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon), water, isotonic drinks and fruit along the course, medical assistance and insurance for race day, as well as food and drinks at the finish. Every participant receives travel vouchers worth €300 from Equator BG. Race packs are collected on Friday and Saturday. The corporate relay is for four participants, with each person running 1.25 km. The entry fee includes a race bib with chip, a finisher’s medal, drinks, food at the finish and medical assistance. Every registered participant receives travel vouchers worth a total of €300.

name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition held in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Nature Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross-country race with 680 m of elevation gain and a 23 km half marathon with 1,300 m of elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes featuring dramatic scenery and mountain trails. Participants can experience running beneath limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and climbing to impressive panoramic viewpoints. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular scenery featuring limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb to Crucea Sănduleștilor with 360° views of the Apuseni Mountains
additional: The start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Mountain Rescue Base. The race kit includes a customized fabric drawstring bag and a finisher medal; the technical T-shirt or singlet is purchased separately. There are aid and hydration stations along the route with water, cola, isotonic drink, fruit, and snacks. Race kits can be collected on Friday, April 17, between 16:00 and 20:00 in Cluj-Napoca (Iulius Mall), and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00 and 21:00, with collection also available on race morning. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

name: BRAȘOV 21K Run the City. Feel the Mountains.
distance_verbose: Semimaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km, 0.6 km
description: Brașov 21k is a running event that combines an urban challenge with the beauty of the mountains surrounding Brașov. Every runner, whether elite or amateur, can find a race suited to their level in a city full of energy and history. The event is part of the 21K Romania Running Series by YoloEvents.ro and offers a unique way to discover Brașov by running. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with varied courses for all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Varied courses in the city of Brașov and the surrounding mountains
Races for all levels: 21k, 10k, 5k, 2.5k and Kids Run
Discover Brașov in an energetic and friendly setting
additional: The event includes several races: 21k, 10k, 5k, 2.5k and Kids Run, for both elite runners and amateurs. The participation fee must be paid within 3 days of online registration; otherwise, the registration will be canceled. The event is organized by Yolo Events and is part of the 21K Romania Running Series. The half marathon is run over two laps, with a time limit of 3 hours and aid stations at 5.5 km, 11 km, 16.5 km and the finish. Kids Run includes distances of 600 m and 1000 m.

name: Maratonul Argonauților
description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in Cheile Dobrogei, offering a unique experience amid the natural scenery of the area’s geological and birdlife reserves. The marathon course has 1,600 meters of positive elevation gain, challenging runners to discover the beauty and demands of the terrain. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and includes several races for participants of all categories, promoting both sport and local tourism. Participants are invited to explore Cheile and Gura Dobrogei in a competitive and friendly setting.
course_highlights: Marathon course with 1,600 meters of positive elevation gain
Spectacular scenery in the Cheile and Gura Dobrogei Geological and Birdlife Reserves
Mountain course that tests runners’ endurance and technique
additional: Several races are available: Marathon, Chifu Ioan Half Marathon, Cross-Country Race, Family Race, and Cheile Circuit. Entry fees are fixed for each race, with no explicit mention of pricing periods or additional fees. The courses are promoted as part of local tourism and include protected nature reserves.

name: La Petrovaselo în vie
description: Petrovaselo in the Vineyard is a sporting event dedicated to running in nature, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage more people to take up outdoor running. Organized by Clubul Sportiv Asociația Alergotura in partnership with Petro Vaselo Winery, the event offers three races of varying distances along scenic routes in the Petro Vaselo vineyard area. Participants can enjoy an outdoor sporting experience with well-marked routes and refreshment stations in a friendly, well-organized setting. After the race, participants are invited to relax with goulash and wine, provided upon presentation of their race number.

description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, aiming to promote mountain running and the local natural and historical heritage. The routes cross the Zărand Mountains, linking two important medieval fortresses, Șoimoș and Șiria, and offering participants a unique experience amid nature and a medieval atmosphere. The event is open to both amateurs and professionals, with three moderately difficult races: a 9 km cross-country race, a 22 km half marathon, and a 44 km marathon. Participants can enjoy spring scenery and careful organization, with checkpoints, hydration, and medical assistance.
course_highlights: Routes run mainly along hiking trails, forest roads, and paved roads
Pass by historical sites: Șoimoș Fortress, Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, and Feredeu Hermitage
Significant elevation gains: 445 m (9 km), 1,026 m (22 km), 2,075 m (44 km)
additional: The start and finish for the cross-country race and half marathon are on the plateau behind Șiria Fortress; the marathon starts in Șoimoș and finishes on the plateau at Șiria Fortress. Participant kits are guaranteed for registrations made by April 12. Hydration and food stations are available along the routes. On-site registration is possible only for the cross-country race and half marathon, subject to availability, with no kit guaranteed.

name: Rtanj Vertikal 2026
description: Rtanj Vertical is a mountain race held on Mount Rtanj, starting in the settlement of Rtanj and finishing at the summit of Šiljak at 1,565 m above sea level. The race is a 4.6 km vertical kilometer with 950 m of elevation gain, following the southeastern Rtanj ridge. This challenge is part of the PSS National Mountain Running Series and is ITRA-certified. Competitors can enjoy fantastic views from the summit and are required to have a medical examination and a PSS competition booklet.
course_highlights: Course length: 4.6 km with 950 m of elevation gain
The route follows the southeastern Rtanj ridge to the summit of Šiljak (1,565 m above sea level)
Return along the marked trail on the southern side toward the village of Rtanj
additional: The start is in the settlement of Rtanj on the southern side. The only aid station is at the finish. The time limit for completing the race is 2 hours. A PSS competition booklet and a medical examination are required. The organizer is PK Šiljak Boljevac.

description: The 10th Kouri Forest Public Road Race is organized by the Friends of Kouri Forest Association in collaboration with the Region of Thessaly, the Municipality of Almyros, and the Volos Health Runners Association “Centaur.” The race includes 5,000- and 10,000-meter courses for adults, as well as 1,500- and 500-meter student races for middle and elementary school students, respectively, with a separate 500-meter course for people with disabilities. The race has a charitable purpose, collecting food to support the social grocery store and the Galini community meal centers of the Municipality of Almyros. Participation is free for children and costs 5 euros for adults. The race starts on Saturday afternoon.
course_highlights: 5,000- and 10,000-meter courses for adults
1,500- and 500-meter student races
Charitable event collecting food
additional: Opening and closing ceremonies, participation in a natural setting, and races for all ages and needs

description: The Indoor Ultramarathon Races at the National Stadium of Megara Olympians offer a unique endurance challenge, with 6-, 12- and 24-hour races on a flat course. Ideal for runners looking to test their limits in a controlled and safe environment, these races combine the athletic experience with the atmosphere of a stadium. The event is suitable for runners of all levels who want to improve their ultramarathon performance.
course_highlights: Flat course inside a stadium
6-, 12- and 24-hour races
Ideal for endurance runners and high-performance athletes
additional: The races take place on a flat, safe and controlled track inside a stadium, offering ideal conditions for testing endurance. No specific start times or registration prices are mentioned in the information provided. The event includes electronic timing and aid stations.

description: The Ypsilanteios Road Race in Nea Trapezounta, Pieria, is a sporting event offering three routes for everyone: a 10-kilometer race, a 1.1 km children’s race, and a 5.3 km walking route. The 10 km course is challenging, with elevation changes and beautiful views of Mount Olympus. It starts and finishes in the central square of Nea Trapezounta. The children’s race and walking route offer opportunities for younger participants and non-competitive runners. The event provides participants with medals, a light meal, and juice, while timing is overseen by the organizing committee. With medical coverage and a Pontian celebration after the race, it is a festival for the local community and runners.
course_highlights: 10 km route with +155 meters of elevation gain
Views of Mount Olympus along the route
Water stations at 3.2 and 7.7 km
additional: Registration is available exclusively on race day, up to 15 minutes before the start, in the central square. Timing is not electronic; it is overseen by the organizing committee. Medical coverage is provided by the Samaritans and Rescuers Volunteer Corps of the Hellenic Red Cross. A parent or guardian’s declaration of consent is required for minors participating in the children’s race. The awards ceremony begins at 19:00, followed by awards and a Pontian celebration. Three routes: 10 km, children’s race 1.1 km, and walking route 5.3 km. The race has +155 meters of elevation gain and a challenging course. Registration is on race day. Medal, meal, juice, manual timing, and medical coverage.

name: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Великденски Маратон 2026
organizer: СНЦ Клуб за колоездене и туризъм „Зарата“
price_range: от €14 до €31, в зависимост от категорията и датата на регистрация
description: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Easter Marathon 2026 is a sporting event in Stara Zagora featuring trail running and mountain biking. Organized by the Zaratа Cycling and Tourism Club Association, with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality and TD Sarnena Gora, the competition offers various running and cycling distances in Ayazmoto Park. Participants must have valid insurance and sign a liability waiver. The event begins with registration and briefing from 07:00 to 08:00, and the awards ceremony is at 17:00.
course_highlights: Trail running and mountain biking in Ayazmoto Park
Running distances: 5 km, 11 km, 21 km, 32 km and 38 km (ultra)
eBike MTB cycling at up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra course
additional: Registration and race-number pickup from 07:00 to 08:00. Cyclists must wear helmets. Payment is accepted only by bank transfer or at an EasyPay counter after online registration. Participants must have valid accident insurance for the day of the event (except UCI card holders). Awards ceremony at 17:00 for both disciplines. The cycling courses will include an approximately 32 km hobby course and a 42 km ultra course; online registration, payment by bank transfer; valid insurance and helmets are required for cyclists.

name: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge
description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge is a mountain running competition held in the village of Dălhăuți, Vrancea County. The event is organized by the Velopower Sports Association and promotes running on varied terrain, including forest trails and forestry roads. Participants can enjoy a well-marked course with checkpoints and a friendly atmosphere, rounded off with an awards ceremony and a traditional lunch. The start is scheduled for 10:00, following a technical briefing and a coffee-fueled warm-up. The event emphasizes socializing and promoting outdoor physical activity.

name: Brăila 10K
description: Brăila 10K is a running race held in Monument Park in Brăila, offering an energetic and welcoming experience for runners of all ages. The event includes 10.5 km, 7 km, and 3.5 km races, children’s races, and a 1.5 km Family Fun Run, making it ideal for setting a personal best on a fast, well-marked course. The festival atmosphere, music, prizes, and activities for the whole family make Brăila 10K a celebration of outdoor movement and health. The organizers emphasize safety and the smooth running of the competition, with volunteers and referees along the course.

name: 1ο Amphipolis Ahepa Run
description: The 1st Amphipolis Ahepa Run is a new series of road races combining Greece’s history, culture, and sport. The routes pass along ancient paths and through the natural landscapes of Amphipolis, offering a unique running experience that honors the area’s rich cultural heritage. The event is open to runners of all levels, from children to experienced athletes, with accompanying activities and support throughout the event.

name: 1ο Kotylaion Run
description: The 1st Kotylaion Run will take place in the village of Koutselio, Ioannina. The event is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Ioannina and with the support of the Ioannina Runners’ Club, offering a unique mountain-running experience in the area. My Adventure, with many years of experience organizing sporting events in Epirus, supports the event, bringing together the region’s natural environment and mountainous terrain. The race is for runners who want to enjoy nature and an athletic challenge amid beautiful mountain scenery.

name: 3ο Kastra Mountain Trail
description: The 3rd Kastra Mountain Trail in Servia, Kozani, is a major sporting event that attracts runners who love the mountains and nature. The course crosses the impressive natural landscape of the Pierian Mountains, offering unique mountain-running experiences. The Municipality of Servia actively supports the event and invites volunteers to contribute to its success. The event combines sport with the area’s natural beauty, creating a celebration for mountain-running enthusiasts.

name: 5ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Ιστίμπεη
description: The 5th Istibei Sacrifice Run is a 14-kilometer mountain race with 600 meters of elevation gain, held at Istibei Fort, near Neo Petritsi, Serres. The race is organized by the Friends of Istibei Fort Association in collaboration with the Municipality of Sintiki, as part of the 85th anniversary of the Battle of the Forts. The event aims to preserve historical memory through sport and showcase the area’s natural wealth. The route passes over the surface of the forts of the Metaxas Line, where defenders confronted the German war machine in 1941.

name: Lake Plastiras Trail
description: Lake Plastiras Trail is a celebratory mountain running race held in the beautiful area of Lake Plastiras in Karditsa, Greece. The race routes cross the historic Agrafa mountain range, offering unique natural scenery, varied terrain, and significant elevation gains. The race starts at the Botanical Garden of the Municipality of Lake Plastiras, beside the lake, and participants can enjoy routes combining trails, dirt roads, and asphalt. The race promotes sport, recreation, and the appreciation of the region’s nature and local history.

name: Bara Reva Trail 2026
description: Bara Reva Trail is a trail race in the natural area of Bara Reva in Belgrade. The course runs through a marshland area on the left bank of the Danube, offering runners the chance to discover one of the city’s green spaces. The race is intended for nature-running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The natural surroundings of Bara Reva
Location on the left bank of the Danube
Marshland in Belgrade’s Palilula municipality

name: 10ο No Finish Line Athens
description: No Finish Line Athens is the largest charity running event in Greece, combining sport, recreation, and social contribution. Participants run or walk freely for 100 hours, recording kilometres that are converted into funds to support children’s programmes through the “Together for Children” Association. The event takes place at Pedion tou Areos and is a leading social and sporting event, attracting many participants and making a significant contribution to society.
course_highlights: Held at Pedion tou Areos
100-hour duration, with participants free to choose when and how far they take part
Charitable event where kilometres are converted into financial support
additional: The event lasts 100 hours, and participants can run or walk whenever they wish, with no time or distance limit. It is supported by the international organisation No Finish Line International and the “Together for Children” Association. It has had a strong social impact, with more than 50,000 participants since 2017 and significant funding for children’s programmes. The event includes various races, with the goal of recording more than 100,000 kilometres, and takes place at Pedion tou Areos, emphasising collective effort and social contribution.

name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The Tsvetanka Khristova Tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria’s greatest track and field athletes. The competition is being held for the 17th time and includes the second round of the “A1 Athletics for Youth” series for young athletics talents. The tournament takes place at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and brings together athletes of various ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors Tsvetanka Khristova’s legacy and encourages the development of young talent.

name: Антеа рън
description: Antea Run is a unique race combining 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles in the scenic area around Sozopol. It’s not just a marathon, but a challenge for anyone who wants to push their limits and enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The event attracts running and adventure enthusiasts looking for something more than an ordinary race.
course_highlights: 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles
Scenic area around Sozopol
A combination of running and overcoming challenges

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Hills is a race and festival that combines sport and outdoor fun in Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event includes mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, allowing participants and guests to enjoy the region’s nature and attractions. Organized by the Asenovgrad Hills Association, the race offers various distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and fitness levels. Participation requires good physical fitness and appropriate equipment. The event is aimed at people who love sport and nature.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National 10,000m Track Championships in Hisarya is a prestigious competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The championship brings together Bulgaria’s best athletes to compete over the classic 10-kilometer distance on the track. The event is part of the federation’s 2026 sports calendar and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that connects sport with a social cause, supporting youth sports and cage-free shelters. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances of varying difficulty, from 1 km to a half marathon of 21 km. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while enjoying music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social connections.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom is Romania’s first charity mountain biking race, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in Urlați, Prahova County, among the area’s hills, vineyards, and wineries. Participants can choose from several routes suited to their ability, from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateurs and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The children’s races (4 and 8 km) start at 09:00, the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and the Family ride at 10:45. Race packs can be collected in Bucharest and at the venue during specified time slots. Family Ride participants do not receive a race kit and can go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, and the cut-off time is 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, as well as support for social and educational causes, promoting wine culture and local tourism.

name: Alergăraș în Făgăraș
description: Alergăraș în Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The courses offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular scenery, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes grassroots sport and respect for nature, offering a memorable day of running and socializing amid mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and descents through spectacular scenery
Start and finish in the area of Făgăraș Fortress
Well-stocked hydration points and excellent course marking
additional: Premium finisher medal, cash prizes for podium finishers, ITRA points and a UTMB Index for the Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal and Belvedere races, a voucher for a hot meal after the race, medical support with an ambulance, a massage tent, food and hydration points along the course and at the finish, and the option to purchase a technical running shirt. Multiple race categories, including marathon, trail, cross-country, and relays; the event includes cultural and tourist activities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the natural beauty of the Făgăraș area.

name: MusaiSpectaculos
location: Cetatea Făgăraș, Făgăraș, Brașov County, Romania
distance_verbose: 47 km, 45.8 km, 20.5 km, 19 km, 14 km, 3000 metri, 1500 metri, 0.3 km
description: Musai Spectaculos is an annual sporting event held at Făgăraș Fortress, combining running and MTB cycling to offer a unique experience amid the spectacular landscapes of the Făgăraș region. The event includes trail and urban cross-country races, as well as free races for children and seniors, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The routes showcase the historic center and the surrounding countryside, with steep climbs, technical descents, and impressive views of the Făgăraș Mountains. The atmosphere is warm and friendly, thanks to enthusiastic volunteers and a community passionate about sport.
course_highlights: Routes featuring steep climbs and technical descents through spectacular landscapes
Start and finish at Făgăraș Fortress, one of the best-preserved fortresses in Europe
Routes crossing the Olt floodplain and hills with National Geographic views
additional: Race kits can be collected in Republicii Square, at “Santa Claus’s Little House.” Official warm-up sessions and technical briefings are held before the start. The event includes both competitive races and popular free races for children and seniors. Participants can pay exclusively by bank card. The official T-shirt is available while stocks last, with the option of later delivery for an additional fee. The program also includes children’s races and the Generations Race; the popular events are free.

name: RotaRun 2026
description: RotaRun for Charity is a sporting and charity event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support children with cancer. The event aims to complete the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the “Prof. Dr. Ion Chiricuță” Oncology Institute in Cluj-Napoca. Participants can choose from several races, ranging from a 3 km run to a 2-hour race. All races take place along the Someș Promenade, starting and finishing near the “Horia Demian” Sports Hall. All funds raised from registration fees go directly to the charity project.

name: Maratonul Codrului
location: Popasul Codrenilor, Oțeloaia, Homoroade, Satu Mare County, Romania
description: Codrului Marathon is an MTB and trail running event organized by Pro Racers Sports Club and the Romanian Cycling Federation, for both amateurs and professionals. The spectacular routes cross forests and offer challenges for all fitness levels, with new and more appealing options for the MTB and trail running events. The event also includes races for children, race packs, hydration stations, medical assistance, timing, and a finisher medal for all participants. It is an event for the community and families, with a friendly atmosphere and comprehensive support for runners.
course_highlights: New, more challenging MTB routes, excluding the road section from the last 5 km
Varied trail running routes, with 6 km and 13 km hobby options
Significant climbs on routes with elevation gains ranging from 250 m to 1,150 m
additional: The event offers race packs with a race number and sponsor products (limited to 250 packs), photos from the course, hydration stations along the course and at the finish, medical assistance and Mountain Rescue, timing, a pasta party, and finisher medals. Official SPORT HG technical tops, model 2026, are available as an optional purchase. The schedule includes multiple category starts and a children’s race, with the awards ceremony at 14:30.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run București is an untimed 5-kilometer race, known as the “Happiest 5k on the Planet,” celebrating health, joy, and originality through a colorful, energetic experience. Participants run, dance, and enjoy a festival atmosphere, getting covered in powder at every kilometer. The event ends with a vibrant party, where all runners are covered in colors and receive medals and temporary tattoos. It is a celebration of movement and community, open to all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km, untimed course
Powder color stations at every kilometer
Post-race party with a cloud of colored powder and music
additional: The event has several consecutive start waves, five minutes apart. Entry to the event area requires a race number and the T-shirt from the race kit. The participation kit includes a T-shirt, race number, temporary tattoos, bandana, medal, and colored powder. There is no baggage storage area. Children aged 0–6 can enter for free with a race number, medal, and powder, but without a T-shirt.

name: Forest Race Marghita
location: Forest near Marghita, Bihor County, Romania
description: Forest Race Marghita is a trail-running race of moderate difficulty, held in the deciduous forest near the town of Marghita. The event is organized by Run For Freedom Sports Club together with XTERRA Sport Bihor Sports Club and offers four routes suited to different levels of runners: Half Marathon (21.6 km), Cross (10.8 km), Speedy (5.4 km), and Mini (1 km). The start and finish are at Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are appropriately marked for participants’ safety. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes on marked forest roads in the deciduous forest of Marghita
Moderate elevation gain: +460 m for the half marathon, +230 m for the cross, +20 m for the mini
Start and finish at Freedom Adventure Park
additional: The official T-shirt is not included in the price and cannot be ordered through the race. Participants under 18 must provide a medical certificate and written consent from a parent or guardian. The organizers may exclude participants who are intoxicated or do not have appropriate equipment. Registration is exclusively through the official webshop.

name: Fruškogorski maraton
distance_verbose: 134 km, 108 km, 59 km, Maraton, Polumaraton, 10 km
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a sporting competition and recreational event with a long tradition. It takes place in the hilly, forested area of Fruška Gora, near Novi Sad. The routes pass through natural beauty spots and numerous medieval Serbian monasteries, as well as historical and cultural landmarks. The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. In addition to the competitive courses, there are nine recreational routes that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.
course_highlights: The routes pass through 97% forested terrain on Fruška Gora
Pass through medieval Serbian monasteries such as Grgeteg, Staro Hopovo, Novo Hopovo, Jazak, and Bešenovo
Climb Fruška Gora’s highest peak (539 m) and descend past the Dombovački Stream waterfall
additional: The competitive courses are ITRA-certified and serve as qualifiers for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc. There are 14 different routes of varying distances and elevation gains, ranging from an ultra-extreme 134 km marathon to recreational routes. The routes include natural and cultural landmarks, as well as historical sites. The organizer also has a Viber group for registrations and communication. 14 routes of varying distances, ITRA-certified, including ultra and recreational distances, passing medieval monasteries and natural and cultural landmarks.

name: 49th Fruška Gora Trail
location: Planinarski dom Železničar, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: Fruška Gora Trail is a traditional sporting and competitive event held on Fruška Gora, known for its old trails and new challenges. The race features a variety of courses and categories, from ultra-extreme to recreational, suited to different levels of runners. The event brings together nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience through beautiful landscapes and demanding terrain. The organizers strive to provide quality logistics, including organized transport to the start and extensive support during the race.
course_highlights: A variety of trails with ITRA points ranging from 1 to 5
Courses ranging from mini distances to ultra-extreme marathons
Beautiful natural landscapes of Fruška Gora, with challenging climbs and descents
additional: The race includes courses with different ITRA point values, from 1 to 5, and distances suited to runners of all levels. The event includes multiple race categories, online registration, organized transport from Novi Sad, and a variety of courses for runners of all levels.

name: Šumadija Trejl Staza Snage (Gledićke Planine)
description: Šumadija Trail Strength Course is a challenging race through the unspoiled nature of the Gledić Mountains, with two courses that test runners’ strength and endurance. The longer course, Prkos, is 17.5 km long with 1,000 meters of elevation gain, while the shorter course, Zamah, is 8 km long with 450 meters of elevation gain. The race combines steep climbs and technical descents, offering a unique challenge and an opportunity to enjoy Šumadija hospitality. The start and finish are at Adžine Livade, and runners receive a generous race pack and a surprise lunch.

name: 4. Jablanik Trail
description: Jablanik Trail is a UTMB Index race held in Valjevo, Serbia. The race is 34 kilometers long with a total elevation gain of 1,837 meters, offering runners challenging and attractive terrain. The course provides a unique opportunity to experience the natural beauty of western Serbia through its mountainous landscapes. The race brings together experienced runners and trail-running enthusiasts, creating a competitive and friendly atmosphere.

name: Η Μάχη στο Λεβίδι 14-04-1821 «Αναγνώστης Δημήτριος Στριφτόμπολας»
organizer: Δήμος Τρίπολης, Γυμναστικός Σύλλογος Αρκαδίας, Σύνδεσμος Σωματικής Αγωγής
description: The Municipality of Tripoli, in cooperation with the SEGAS Regional Association of the Peloponnese, the Arcadia Gymnastics Club, and the “Orchomenos” Physical Education Association, is organizing road races and a power-walking event under the name “The Battle of Levidi 14-04-1821 (Anagnostis Dimitrios Striftompolas).” The races are dedicated to the first victorious battle against the Turkish occupiers, which took place in Levidi 205 years ago. The event includes 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m routes and takes place in Levidi’s central square. The event honors the historic victory and offers a celebration of sport and remembrance for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m routes in Levidi’s central square
Dedicated to the first victorious battle against the Turks in 1821
A historic and sporting event with a strong local and cultural character
additional: Race schedule: 16:00 registration opens and race packs are distributed; 18:00 start of the 10 km; 18:10 start of the 5 km; 19:20 start of the 1,000 m; 19:45 finish line closes; 19:50 awards ceremony; 20:15 event concludes with a celebration and recognition of the historic battle. Routes through a historic area, entries in various age categories, start and finish in Levidi, with commemorative gifts and cultural activities.

name: МЕЧИ ЧАЛ ТРЕЙЛ 2027
description: Mechi Chal Trail 2027 is a mountain race offering varied routes through the beautiful Rhodope Mountains, with an authentic Rhodope atmosphere. The race takes place on 25 April 2027 in Chepelare, with the start and finish at Olympic Square. Participants can choose from four distances of varying lengths and difficulty, featuring mountain routes and forest trails. The event is organized by SK AKTIV 2013, which provides full event organization, support, and prize money for all distances. The event also features a raffle with numerous prizes, a special hat, and many surprises for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Four distances: 8 km, 16.5 km, 25 km, and 38.3 km
Start and finish at Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Race packets are also distributed on the day before the race (24.04.27). The event includes aid stations, a medical team, photographers, an event host, volunteers, and special course marking. Every participant receives a medal, a race bib with an electronic timing chip, a unique special hat, and entry into a raffle with more than 35 prizes. The registration fee includes insurance and numerous gifts from partners. The fee includes a medal, a race bib with an electronic timing chip, insurance, aid stations, and a medical team.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is the largest spring mountain running event in Bulgaria, held near Pancharevo Lake. The race offers three distances: a 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain, a 21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain, and a 10 km route suitable for beginners, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The routes pass through the scenic Lozen Mountain, with views of Vitosha, Stara Planina, Rila, and Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by the Begach sports club and attracts more participants every year.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race on the XLkmrun calendar, held in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is shaped like a figure eight, starting on the northern outskirts of the town of Bankya and heading toward Ostrа Chuka Peak. Participants can choose between two distances: 6.4 km with 217 m of elevation gain, or 12.8 km. The course offers challenges for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes a variety of courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a scenic and challenging race that starts in the village of Bistritsa, which is accessible by public transport. The route crosses varied terrain with gradual but demanding climbs, reaching the Kikish area, which offers panoramic views of Sofia. The course continues to Kamen Del Hut, where participants can refuel with food and drinks. This race is an excellent strength and endurance workout, suitable for preparing for long distances and running in mountain conditions.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Uphill Championship for men, women, under-20 boys and under-20 girls is held in the village of Bistritsa, Sofia. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging uphill mountain run suitable for different age groups. The organizers provide official registration and support for competitors, with communication handled directly with them. The event is a traditional one and attracts athletes seeking a competitive experience on mountain terrain.

name: Semimaraton Iași
organizer: Rotary Club Iași Copou, Salvați Copiii Iași, Primăria Municipiului Iași
description: Iași Half Marathon is the largest running event in northeastern Romania, held annually in the Palace of Culture Square. The half-marathon course consists of two loops that pass through the start area, giving runners a unique experience on the city’s main streets, with road traffic stopped and refreshment points along the way. The event has a strong charitable component, supporting children from disadvantaged backgrounds through educational and social projects. Taking part in the half-marathon, cross-country races and fun runs is an opportunity to do good and join a community committed to positive change.
course_highlights: Route along main streets with road traffic stopped
Passes in front of the Palace of Culture
Refreshment points for hydration and medical assistance
additional: Participants in the half-marathon, 10 km cross-country and 5 km cross-country races receive a disposable timing chip and a technical event T-shirt. Registration is available online until the deadline; after that, subject to availability, participants can register in person at the Iași Half Marathon kiosk in Palas Mall. Registration is not available on race day. The event provides an ambulance for medical assistance and plenty of photos at the finish and along the course. Participation includes hydration points, medical assistance, a race kit, and the option to participate online or in person. The event is charitable, supporting projects for disadvantaged children.

name: Bucharest International Half Marathon
description: Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță brings runners to the streets of Bucharest in a race initiated by Olympic marathon champion Constantina Diță. The event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race, open to both competitive and amateur runners. The course is flat and fast, suitable for those aiming for a good result or wanting to enjoy a run in the capital.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Running on the streets of Bucharest
Half marathon and 10 km races
additional: Individual, family, and friends registrations are mentioned, as well as the Team 3 Challenge.

name: URME PE PLAY
description: Urme pe Play is a mountain running competition held in the commune of Rășinari, at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru Mountains. The routes are marked and include natural trails, forest roads, and paved roads, offering an authentic foothill experience. The event is open to both adults and children, with races for each age group. Participants can enjoy picturesque scenery and the friendly atmosphere of the local community at an event that combines sport with local culture and tradition.

name: Takovski grm
description: Takovski Grm is a 13.5 km road race starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac.
