Participants can choose between two loop courses: a longer 21 km red course with 1,400 meters of elevation gain for seniors, and a shorter 10 km blue course with 500 meters of elevation gain for juniors. The routes pass through Zlatibor’s unspoiled nature and over the peaks of Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering scenic, wild landscapes. The race brings together competitors from across Serbia and abroad. Scoring in the National Series follows the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association.

name: 5ο Run Πύργου
location: Κεντρική Πλατεία Πύργου, Πύργος, Ηλεία, Greece

description: The 5th “5ο RUN PYRGOU” road race in Pyrgos, Elis, offers a celebration of sport for all ages, with 5 km, 2 km, 1 km and 500 m routes. The start and finish are at Pyrgos Central Square, with categories for adults and children, as well as special categories for people with disabilities. The race is co-organized by Pirgos AthleticEvents and the Municipality of Pyrgos, with the aim of promoting exercise and participation by the local community. The event awards medals and cups to category winners, creating a friendly and encouraging atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km, 2 km, 1 km and 500 m routes at Pyrgos Central Square
Categories for all ages, from toddlers to adults, as well as people with disabilities
Start and finish at the central square, in an urban setting
additional: Medals are awarded to the first three finishers in each category, and cups to the overall category winners. Minors aged 15–18 may participate with parental consent. All routes start at Pyrgos Central Square at different times between 18:30 and 20:30. The race is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Pyrgos and includes various routes and categories for all ages and athletic levels. Participation promotes health and well-being, while electronic timing and results make it easier to track runners’ performance.

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κάστρου Διδυμοτείχου «Κώστας Γκατσιούδης»
description: The 8th Didymoteicho Castle Road Race “Kostas Gatsioudis” is an annual road race held in Didymoteicho. It includes 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races, a race for people with disabilities, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. The race began in 2016 on the initiative of military personnel, with the support of the Municipality of Didymoteicho and the Division. It is an important sporting and cultural event for the area, honoring the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay
Includes a race for people with disabilities
Takes place at the historic Didymoteicho Castle
additional: The event honors the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis and General Charalambos Lalousis, and includes celebratory events. The course passes through the city’s historic castle, and participation is open to everyone, with registration via Google Form.

name: Ποσειδώνια
organizer: Δήμος Πόρου, Γυμναστική Ένωση Πόρου Τροιζηνίας

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Poseidonia races in Poros are a popular running event that attracts more than 900 runners from across Greece and abroad. They are organized by the Municipality of Poros and the Gymnastics Association of Poros Troizinia, offering races over different distances on the picturesque island of Poros. The event includes courses ranging from 300 meters to 10 kilometers, with electronic timing and free participation in all events. After the races, participants are treated to a free Pasta Party, creating a friendly and festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Courses from 300 m to 10,000 m on a picturesque island
Electronic timing for athletes in the 5 km and 10 km races
Free Pasta Party after the races
additional: Registration includes a race T-shirt, a bottle of water, a banana, electronic timing, and a commemorative medal. Athletes traveling from Piraeus and Aegina receive a 50% discount on ferry tickets. The race office is open on Friday afternoon and Saturday morning for collecting race bibs, bags, and T-shirts. Travel to Poros is available by road and ferry. The event includes road races and mountain running, children’s races and family activities, with electronic timing and events for everyone.

name: Goulinas Trail
description: The Goulinas Trail mountain running race is held in the area of Spercheiada, Phthiotis, with the aim of showcasing the region through sport and a love of nature. It includes three routes of different lengths and elevation gains, offering an unforgettable experience to all participants. The start and finish are in Spercheiada’s central square, and the race emphasizes protecting the natural environment and sustainability. The event promotes fair play, cooperation, and a healthy lifestyle through sport.
course_highlights: Three routes: 6 km, 12 km, and 30 km, with elevation gains of 220 m, 700 m, and 2,000 m, respectively
Start and finish in Spercheiada’s Central Square
A nature-sensitive setting, with an emphasis on protection and a low environmental footprint
additional: All routes start and finish in Spercheiada’s Central Square. The 30 km race has a 7-hour finish time limit and an intermediate cutoff at 12.5 km, at 2 hours and 45 minutes. The race is environmentally friendly, with measures to reduce its impact on the natural environment. It includes different routes focused on nature and adventure, and offers information about accommodation and registration.

name: ApriltsiRun
location: ул. „Цанко Дюстабанов“ 12, квартал Острец, Априлци, Bulgaria
description: ApriltsiRun – In the Footsteps of the Heroes is a charity mountain race in Apriltsi, inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race offers various distances suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beautiful Balkan landscapes and historic sites in the Central Balkan region. The funds raised support health initiatives, cultural heritage preservation, and local healthcare. Participants become part of a community that combines the sporting challenge with care for people and the region’s history.
course_highlights: Panoramic routes and forest trails in the natural surroundings of the Central Balkan region
Views of Maragidik and Mount Botev
Inspired by the Novosel Uprising and the April Uprising
additional: Distances: 3 km (75 m elevation gain), 8 km (182 m elevation gain), 13 km (340 m elevation gain), 28 km (1,580 m elevation gain). Children aged 7 to 16 and people with disabilities may participate in the 3 km distance free of charge. Mandatory equipment for the longer distances includes a waterproof jacket in poor weather conditions. The use of trekking poles is permitted.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the maritime capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and picturesque views of the sea. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon is a test of endurance and strength of spirit that inspires participants to achieve new personal goals.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Friendship Marathon Pleven is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The race includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and the Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. Organizers provide aid stations, medical services, and a full program for race day.

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon event held at the foot of the Stara Planina Mountains near Kazanlak. The event offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginner and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event combines sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.

name: Timotion
price_range: Participație între 75 RON și 1.200 RON, în funcție de cursă

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Target minim donații Participă Target 1.200 RON

description: Timotion is the largest charitable sporting event in western Romania, bringing together thousands of participants, volunteers, and supporters each year to run, cycle, and do good for the community. The event offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels, from cycling and a half marathon to children’s races and fun races on wheels. By taking part, runners and cyclists support community projects and help foster solidarity and hope in the region. Timotion is a movement of hearts united for good, with a tradition spanning more than 10 years and a continuously growing community.
course_highlights: The timed 15 km SMW cycling race is for experienced participants
A 21 km half marathon and 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km fun runs for various age categories
Special races for children and fun races on wheels, also accessible to people with reduced mobility
additional: Races are timed and have specific time limits; children’s races require a legal guardian to accompany participants; the cycling race is for non-electric bicycles; accessible races are available for people with reduced mobility; races take place on Bd. Ion C. Brătianu; races start in waves between 08:00 and 17:30. Multiple races on May 10, including cycling, a half marathon, and recreational races; fundraising component; volunteering opportunities

name: SEMIMARATONUL SIRETULUI In memoriam Ilie Roșu
location: Adjudu Vechi, Adjud, Vrancea County, Romania
description: The Siret Half Marathon – In Memoriam Ilie Roșu is a running race held in Adjudu Vechi, Vrancea County, in memory of marathon runner Ilie Roșu. The half marathon invites runners to take part in a competition dedicated to running and remembrance. The start is announced at the church in Adjudu Vechi.
course_highlights: Start near the church in Adjudu Vechi.
Half marathon held in the Adjud area, in Vrancea County.
Race held in memory of marathon runner Ilie Roșu.
additional: The start is scheduled for 9:00.

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge is an intense competition testing strength, speed, agility, and skills, held in Iuliu Hațieganu University Sports Park in Cluj-Napoca. The second edition challenges participants to push their limits on an obstacle course. The event offers two distances, 6 km and 12 km, to suit both experienced runners and those looking for a shorter challenge.

name: MARATONUL NISIPULUI Run&Fun
description: The Maratonul Nisipului Run & Fun, held at Zoom Beach in Constanța, is a sporting event that combines competition with fun and promotes a healthy lifestyle. The event offers six different races, from the 42 km marathon to recreational runs for the whole family, held on the sands of the Romanian coast. Participants can enjoy spectacular routes with the sea breeze, in an energetic, welcoming community atmosphere. The marathon is a celebration of movement, nature, and adventure, welcoming both professional and amateur runners.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is Romania’s largest cross-country cycling marathon, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, covering approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no major elevation changes. The event brings together cycling enthusiasts from across the country, creating an energetic and welcoming atmosphere—ideal for kicking off the MTB marathon season.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: The Sombor Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Sombor, with a new course passing through beautiful parts of the city. The event brings together a large number of runners from Serbia and abroad, promoting a healthy lifestyle and recreational running. The organizers strive to make the race well organized and enjoyable for all participants, with particular attention to the atmosphere and socializing. The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has nurtured Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.

name: 6ο City Trail Αγρίνιο
description: The 6th Agrinio City Trail is a 16.4 km race organized by the Agrinio Health Runners Association in collaboration with the Municipality of Agrinio. The race is held as part of the events celebrating the city’s patron saint, Saint Christopher, and starts and finishes at the city’s central Democracy Square. Races of 6 km and 1 km for younger runners are also held on the same day.
course_highlights: The route includes trails and dirt roads in the Saint Christopher grove and Papastrateio Municipal Park.
The course is marked to ensure participants’ safety.

name: 13ο Paggaio Trail Run
description: The 13th Paggaio Trail Run is organized by the Kavala Mountaineering Club and offers two mountain races: a challenging 27-kilometer race for experienced runners and a 10-kilometer race for less experienced runners. Both routes start and finish in the village of Domatia, at the foot of Mount Paggaio, and cross trails, forest roads, and a few meters of asphalt. Mount Paggaio offers unique natural scenery and an unforgettable experience for mountain-running enthusiasts. The event welcomes both experienced and new runners to discover the area’s beauty through the race.

name: 1ο «Το Καλωσόρισμα των Πελαργών»
description: The 1st “Welcoming the Storks” road race in Aiginio, Pieria, is a spring sports celebration held under the auspices of the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros. The event includes 11-kilometer and 5-kilometer races, as well as a 1,000-meter children’s race, offering athletes and visitors an opportunity to take part. The welcoming town of the Storks welcomes runners on a route that combines natural beauty and sporting spirit, promoting mass participation in sports and helping participants discover the region.
course_highlights: 11-kilometer race: Kolindros–Katachas–Aiginio route
5-kilometer race: circular route in Aiginio
1,000-meter children’s race: circular route in Aiginio
additional: The event takes place as part of the 1st Stork Festival and includes sports activities aimed at promoting mass participation in sports and helping participants discover the region. The event is supported by local clubs and organizations. Races for different levels and age groups; event on May 23, 2027; accompanying activities and environmental awareness.

name: 4ος Axios Running Festival
description: The Axios Running Festival is a multi-day sporting and cultural celebration held in the Axios Valley, offering a unique experience for runners of all ages and abilities. The event includes 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 1-mile road races, with certified courses and accompanying social, cultural, and environmental events. The race combines sport, tourism, and history, showcasing the region and supporting the local community. The event is held under the auspices of the Region of Central Macedonia and follows World Athletics regulations.
course_highlights: Half marathon starting at the Koufalia Town Hall and finishing at the Balkan Wars Military Museum
Courses that cross the Axios Valley, the Axios Dam, and the old Thessaloniki–Evzoni National Road
Courses certified in accordance with World Athletics regulations
additional: The race is held on the first Sunday of April each year (in this case, May 23, 2027) and forms part of a two-day, wide-ranging experience featuring environmental, cultural, and social events. Participation certificates can be printed for all distances. The event provides high-quality safety and support services for runners of all ages and abilities. It includes road races, health activities, and a walk, with an emphasis on environmental awareness.

name: 5ο Belles Historic Trail
description: The Belles Historic Trail is a distinctive mountain-running event that combines the natural beauty and historical memory of the Neou Petritsi area in Serres. The routes cross trails rich in natural vegetation, historic forts, and offer magnificent panoramic views, providing a unique experience for runners of all levels. The event includes races of different distances, from 1 km for children to 22.66 km for experienced athletes, with a welcoming atmosphere and local delicacies at the finish. Belles Historic Trail is a celebration of sport, culture, and nature that brings the community and visitors together.
course_highlights: Routes on trails with abundant natural vegetation and waterfalls
Historic forts and trails of the Battle of the Forts (1941)
Panoramic views of Lake Kerkini and Mount Belles
additional: Electronic timing with prompt, reliable results. Refreshment stations along the routes. Commemorative gifts for all athletes (windbreaker jacket, buff, socks). Medical coverage throughout the races. Traditional local delicacies at the finish. Children’s races on Sunday at 11:30. Race office and packet pickup on race day from 10:00 to 14:00 and 16:00 to 17:30. The event includes trail and on-road races for children and athletes of different levels, and offers medals and local cuisine to participants.

name: 5ο Godzilla Xanthi Trail
location: Xanthi, East Macedonia and Thrace, Greece
description: The 5th Godzilla Xanthi Trail is a challenging mountain race held in Xanthi, offering three different routes of 30 km, 14 km, and 7 km. The 30 km route features technical trails and significant elevation gain, while the shorter routes suit runners with different experience levels, with the 7 km route serving as an ideal introduction to mountain running. The race is organized by the Xanthi Runners Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Xanthi and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, offering a unique sporting experience amid the area's natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 30 km route with 28 km of trails and 1,850 m of elevation gain
14 km route with 12 km of trails and 600 m of elevation gain
Easy, circular 7 km route, ideal as an introduction to mountain running
additional: The start and finish are at Thilia. Awards ceremonies take place at 11:30 for the 7 km race and at 14:30 for the 30 km and 14 km races. A volunteer follows the last runners to provide support. Bib pickup is at Xanthi's central square on the Saturday before the race and from early morning on race day at the start area. Group registration is available for clubs and groups of runners. There are three routes of varying difficulty, with the start and finish in the Ilia area, full refreshments, and awards. The 30 km route is particularly challenging and technical, suitable for experienced runners.

name: 6ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Φαλανναίων
description: The 6th Falannai Road Race is a sporting event held in Falani, Larissa, offering an opportunity to take part in a road race that promotes mass participation in sports and a healthy lifestyle. The race is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association, an organization with a long tradition of supporting runners, mountaineers, and cyclists. The event emphasizes social responsibility, solidarity, and a love of nature, fostering sportsmanship and a community of sports enthusiasts. The race is a celebration for runners and sports enthusiasts in the area.
course_highlights: 21.1 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities
In collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations
Focus on social cohesion and volunteerism
additional: An event featuring 21.1 km and 5 km routes, as well as a 1 km route for children and people with disabilities, in collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ειρήνης «Γρηγόρης Λαμπράκης»
description: The 8th Grigoris Lambrakis Peace Run is a 23-kilometer road race organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee in honor of Grigoris Lambrakis, a peace activist and martyr. The race takes place in Tripoli and follows routes connecting the city with areas such as Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista. Participation is free, and the race is part of the Arcadia Peace Committee’s annual sporting events. It is an event with historical and social significance that honors the memory and work of Grigoris Lambrakis.
course_highlights: A 23-kilometer route from Tripoli to Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista, and back to Tripoli
Areas of historical and natural interest in Arcadia
A race centered on the birthplace of Grigoris Lambrakis
additional: Participation in the race is free. It is organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee and is part of the committee’s annual sporting events. The 2026 race was scheduled for Sunday, May 17, at 18:00 in Tripoli. Routes through various parts of Tripoli, participation by the Arcadia Peace Committee, a historical and social context, and references to previous editions.

name: 13ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμους «Γεώργιος Αποστολάκης»
description: The 13th Popular Road Race “Georgios Apostolakis” is held in Nea Chalkidona in honor of the late Mayor Giorgos Apostolakis, who left an indelible mark on the local community. The race attracts many participants and is a celebration of sport and local tradition. The event honors his contribution and love of sport, while promoting social cohesion and health through physical activity.
course_highlights: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes in an urban setting
Organized by GEORGIOS APOSTOLAKIS PARK
Includes road races and gymnastics for all ages
additional: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes, age categories, road races and gymnastics, date: 23/05/2027

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας
description: The 22nd Sacrifice Road Race in Naousa is a running event honoring the historic heroic city and its unique traditions. The course gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural surroundings of Mount Vermio and the area’s rich cultural heritage. With its beautiful trails and welcoming atmosphere, Naousa is an ideal destination for runners of all ages and abilities. The race combines athletic challenge with historical remembrance and local hospitality.
course_highlights: A course at the foothills of Mount Vermio
Passing by Naousa’s historic and cultural landmarks
Natural surroundings with fresh air and beautiful trails
additional: Naousa offers welcoming accommodation and local cuisine featuring Xinomavro wine and traditional dishes. The area is accessible by road from Thessaloniki, 90 km away, and is suitable for family excursions and adventures in nature. The event emphasizes historical remembrance, with online and in-person registration, and medals and commemorative gifts for all runners.

name: Dental Run
organizer: Athens Dental Students' Association, Greek Pharmaceutical Students' Federation, Δήμος Ζωγράφου
description: Dental Run 2026 is an inclusive road race taking place at Goudi Park on May 17. Runners of all levels are invited to take part in a 5-kilometer race, a relaxed walk, or a children’s race. The event aims to promote health and smiles, and also offers non-athletes the opportunity to participate as volunteers. The start is scheduled for 09:00 in the morning, and the event is open to everyone, with support from well-known dental care product companies.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route at Goudi Park
Option of a relaxed walk or a children’s race
Inclusive event open to runners and volunteers
additional: Those who do not wish to run can participate as volunteers. The event is supported by companies including Sensodyne, Corega, Parodontax, Elmex-Colgate, Curaprox, and Dole. It is organized to raise awareness about health, with participation options including a 5-kilometer race, a walk, and a children’s race, as well as opportunities to volunteer.

name: 5 ος Αγώνας Ολοι Μαζί Ολοι Ισοι
description: The 5th “All Together—All Equal” road race is organized by the Region of Central Greece with the assistance of the “Gefyra” (Bridge) support structure and the support of the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association “Trachina.” The race takes place at Lamia Castle and aims to raise awareness about people with disabilities. It features three routes of 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km. These are non-competitive routes, and there is no timing. Participation is free for people with disabilities and their companions.
course_highlights: 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km routes at Lamia Castle
Start and finish at the same location at the Castle
Routes suitable for people with disabilities and their companions; non-competitive
additional: The 2.5 km and 5 km routes are open to people with disabilities and companions aged over 12. The 800 m route is for people with disabilities of any age and primary school children (ages 6–12). There is no timing, and the race is symbolic in nature. The schedule includes registration opening at 10:00, the 800 m start at 11:00, and the 2.5 km and 5 km starts at 11:30, with the event ending at 12:30. The event has a social purpose and includes children and adults, awareness-raising and cultural activities, and support from the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalandzha Marathon is an annual event held in the village of Sinemorets, in the heart of Strandzha Nature Park. The trail-running and mountain-biking routes offer scenic trails through the wilderness of southeastern Bulgaria, with distances from 3 to 42 km for runners and cyclists. The event combines sport, nature, and adventure, attracting participants of different ages and fitness levels. The marathon takes place over two days and includes running and mountain-biking races, as well as special children’s distances. Organizers provide support along the course with isotonic drinks and fresh fruit, and the event concludes with an awards ceremony and a party.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in Strandzha Nature Park
Loop courses starting and finishing at Veleka Beach
Aid stations with fresh fruit and isotonic drinks
additional: The running races start at 09:00, with different distances and cut-off times. Mountain biking takes place the following day, with distances of 21 and 43 km. Electric bikes are prohibited. Participants must carry a water container; refills are available along the course. For environmental reasons, the organizers do not provide plastic bottles. There is a special 3 km distance for children. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a raffle, followed by a party at Koraba Bar.

name: Международен турнир "Пловдив"
description: The “Plovdiv” International Tournament is an athletics competition organized by the Botev Plovdiv Athletics Club with the support of Plovdiv Municipality. The competition aims to promote athletics in the region and attracts competitors from Bulgaria and abroad. The program includes a variety of events, such as sprint races, jumps, and pole vault, held at Plovdiv Stadium. The tournament is a traditional event that brings athletes and sports fans together in a dynamic and friendly spirit.
course_highlights: Competitions at Plovdiv Stadium, with modern facilities
Events include 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, long jump, high jump, triple jump, and pole vault
A maximum of 2 heats for track events, with priority given to foreign athletes and the organizing club
additional: Technical events are limited to 8 competitors, selected according to their personal bests for 2023/24. Track events are limited to a maximum of 2 heats, with up to 16 competitors. Contact: Stoyko Tsonov, phone 0876117789.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The courses are challenging, with significant elevation changes and a variety of obstacles designed to test participants’ physical endurance and willpower. The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own difficulties and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and determination, and after the race, participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1,060 m of elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m of elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m of elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: The courses feature a variety of obstacles, including small fences, log jumps, rings, sandbags, a log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, a mud trench, a wall crossing, and a surprise obstacle. There are age- and gender-based prize categories, with cash prizes for the top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a difficult OCR. The event includes different distance categories and courses and is open to both recreational and advanced runners.

name: Bârlad Hills Challenge ~ 2027
location: Cotu Negru, Bârlad, Vaslui County, Romania

name: Jidvei Weinland Trails - Running Edition ~ 2027
location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba County, Romania

name: JIDVEI WINELAND TRAILS
location: Bethlen-Haller Castle, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba County, Romania
description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the Bethlen-Haller Castle estate, in the heart of Transylvania. The competition combines running and cycling on spectacular routes through vineyards and ancient forests, offering participants an authentic experience in Wine Country. The event includes races for all fitness levels, activities for children, and food and wine experiences, creating a memorable day for athletes and their companions alike. It is a celebration of sport, nature, and local culture, with a strong community spirit and support for cultural projects.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes through the vineyards and forests of the Bethlen-Haller Castle estate
Stunning scenery in the heart of Transylvania, with varied routes for all fitness levels
The event includes trail races, MTB/XCM marathons, and children’s races, all set amid nature and local culture
additional: The event includes special activities for children, with games and creative workshops in a safe setting. Food and wine experiences and tours of Bethlen-Haller Castle and the Jidvei Winery are available for an additional fee. The MTB race offers family-team options and non-competitive E-BIKE races. Special prizes are awarded to the youngest runners in the 1 km and 2 km races.

name: Obciniada Night Run
description: Obciniada Night Run is a night-running competition in Bucovina, offering spectacular routes and a festival atmosphere under the stars. Participants can choose from several races, from a half marathon to children’s races, all held on mountain trails with impressive scenery. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and local community involvement, and is organized to support the education of disadvantaged children. Participants benefit from chip timing, cash prizes, access to hydration stations, and a hot meal at the finish.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with significant elevation gain (up to 1050m for the half marathon)
Checkpoints and aid stations along the route, including at Vârful Toaca
Festival atmosphere with general admission and related activities
additional: Online registration closes Thursday at 18:00, and on-site registration is available until Saturday at 20:00. Participants are required to carry specific equipment. Live rankings and an electronic certificate are provided. Cash prizes will be announced at the beginning of 2027. Participants receive a wristband granting access to the festival area and a hot meal at the finish.

name: Tour de Tur
location: Complex Mujdeni, Lacul Mujdeni, Orașu Nou, Satu Mare County, Romania
description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the area of Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers varied courses for all fitness levels, from short, recreational races to more demanding endurance events. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and a friendly atmosphere, and are warmly invited to take part in the competition’s 20th edition. The organizers emphasize safety and compliance with the rules specific to each event. Tour de Tur is an excellent opportunity for nature and sports enthusiasts to meet and compete in a remarkable natural setting.
course_highlights: Varied mountain bike courses: Fun Ride (13 km, 385 m elevation gain), Race (34 km, 930 m elevation gain), Marathon (44 km, 1,180 m elevation gain)
Trail running courses: Fun Run (6 km, 184 m elevation gain), Cross (12 km, 390 m elevation gain), Half Marathon (25 km, 990 m elevation gain)
The event takes place at Lake Mujdeni, providing a picturesque natural setting for the competition
additional: The event includes several categories and distances for both mountain biking and trail running, with varying elevation gains. The organizer is the Transylvanian Carpathian Society - Satu Mare. The exact location is Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. Contact phone: +40-743-419443.

name: 1. Tibužde Trail
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in Tibužde, Vranje. Runners can choose between two course distances, 27 km and 7 km, offering challenging terrain and beautiful scenery. The event starts in the morning and lasts all day, giving participants a unique trail-running experience.
course_highlights: A 27 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
A shorter 7 km course with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
Natural terrain around Tibužde
additional: The event runs from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Terrain: mountainous; registration open; several categories, including a children’s race; shared lunch after the race.

name: Dragutin Tomašević
description: The Dragutin Tomašević Memorial Athletics Race is held in the village of Bistrica near Petrovac na Mlavi in memory of the first Serbian Olympian. This anniversary 21st race brings together runners of all ages and categories, offering opportunities to compete in men’s and women’s divisions as well as by age group. Participants receive chip-timed race bibs and “Joma” Dry Fit shirts, while the organizer provides transportation and a formal dinner. The race is known for its tradition and support from the local community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Ivanjica Trail
description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia, bringing together runners of different fitness levels across several courses of varying lengths and difficulty. The races take place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests, and streams, offering an unforgettable running experience in nature. Special highlights include the Golija PREMIUM race, which starts at the summit of Golija, and the ULTRA 66K, a two-day stage race connecting three mountains and offering a challenge for experienced runners. The organizers provide race packs, refreshments, lunch, transport, and accommodation for participants, creating a friendly and supportive atmosphere.

name: ONERUN 2026
description: One Run is an international race taking place for the eighth consecutive year, simultaneously across multiple countries and continents. The event is known for being entered into the Guinness World Records twice as the world’s largest half marathon with a synchronized start. The race is open to everyone, with four distances available, and promotes health, accessibility, and togetherness through sport and outdoor activities. This year, we’re running in Veliko Gradište, Serbia, on May 23, aiming to become part of a new attempt at a Guinness World Record for the first time in Serbia.

name: ONERUN 2027
description: One Run is an international running event that has been held for eight years, bringing together runners from several countries and continents on the same day. The race is known for being entered twice in the Guinness World Records as the world's largest half marathon with a synchronized start. This year, the race is taking place in Serbia as well as several other countries, and participants can choose from four distances: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The event is open to everyone, whether they run or walk, and promotes health, accessibility, and community through sport.
course_highlights: Four distances available: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Synchronized start in several countries on the same day
Event entered twice in the Guinness World Records
additional: The start and registration are at Žitni trg in Veliko Gradište. Registration is open from 08:00 to 11:30. The warm-up for the 1 km race begins at 12:45, and the 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races start at 13:30. The award ceremony and presentation of prizes follow the race at 15:30. The race packet includes a bib with a chip, sponsor gifts, and a medal.

name: 8ο Life Run
location: Julius and Alexander N. Diomedes Botanical Garden, Haidari, Greece
organizer: Σύλλογος Ιδιοκτητών Γυμναστηρίων Αττικής, μαζί με τον Σύλλογο Ελλήνων Ολυμπιονικών, την Πανελλήνια Ένωση Πτυχιούχων Φυσικής Αγωγής και τον Πανελλήνιο Σύνδεσμο Γυμναστηρίων
description: Life Run is an afternoon road race held at the «Ioulia & Alexandros N. Diomidis» Botanical Garden. The event features 4- and 8-kilometer courses and is connected with promoting the donation of organs, tissues, and cells for transplantation. Join the run on one of Athens’ greenest routes.
course_highlights: Route through the Diomidis Botanical Garden
Choice of 4- or 8-kilometer distance
Green natural surroundings in Haidari
additional: The race is dedicated to the donation of organs, tissues, and cells for transplantation.

name: 13ος Πράσινος Ημιμαραθώνιος Λευκάδας
description: The 13th Green Lefkada Half Marathon is a night race organized by the Lefkada «Filandros» Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Lefkada and the Region of the Ionian Islands. The event includes 21.1 km and 8 km races, as well as a 1 km children’s race for ages 6–12. The start and finish are at the Lefkada Cultural Center, and the course runs around the lagoon, offering a unique running experience with sunset views. The race is held under the auspices of the EAS SEGAS Epirus and EOSLMA-Y.
course_highlights: Night race starting at 19:45
Course around the Lefkada lagoon
Start and finish at the Lefkada Cultural Center
additional: Schedule of events includes bib and chip collection, a pasta party, and awards. Children’s races have separate start times. The 8 km race starts at 17:45 and the 1 km children’s race at 16:30. Distances: 21.097 m and 8 km; races for children ages 6–12; parallel activities; courses in a protected NATURA area.

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας «Αγγελής Γοβιός»
location: Κεντρική πλατεία Ψαχνών, Ψαχνά, Ευβοίας, Greece
description: The “Angelis Govios” Road of Sacrifice is a historic road race being held for the 22nd year in Psachna, Evia, organized by the Psachna Runners and Walkers Association under the auspices of the Municipality of Dirfys-Messapia. The race includes 15 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities, honoring the memory of the great Evian revolutionary military leader Angelis Govios and the late Mayor Giorgos Psathas. The race starts in Psachna’s central square, and entry is free, with ample refreshments provided. The 15 km route is 50% unpaved, with a total elevation gain of +131 meters, while the 5 km and 1 km routes are entirely on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
course_highlights: 15 km route with 50% unpaved terrain and +131 m elevation gain.
5 km and 1 km routes on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
Start in Psachna’s central square.
additional: Registration takes place on race day at the start area and is free. Registration opens at 15:00. Ample refreshments are provided for runners. The event takes place on 29 May 2027, with the race starting at 17:00. It includes routes for all ages and levels, promoting sport and historical remembrance.

name: Run For Stroke
location: Μητροπολιτικό Πάρκο «Αντώνης Τρίτσης», Αγίοι Ανάργυροι, Αττική, Greece
description: The Run For Stroke road race is organized by Stroke Hope, a Civil Non-Profit Company, in collaboration with NeuroLife IKE, with the aim of raising awareness about prevention and supporting people affected by stroke. The event takes place at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park and includes a 5 km race for runners and a 1 km race for children and people with disabilities. The race began in 2024, with a vision of connecting physical activity with health and social awareness. Technical direction is provided by WeRun, with support from RUNAWAY.
course_highlights: Routes within Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park
5 km dirt route consisting of two 2.5 km laps
1 km route for children and people with disabilities
additional: Eligibility: 5 km for people over 12 years old with a medical certificate confirming fitness to participate. 1 km for children aged 6–12, people with disabilities, and patients. The event includes runners and walkers. Technical direction by WeRun, supported by RUNAWAY. The terrain includes park trails and promotes health and social awareness.

name: Ursa Trail
description: The Ursa Trail in Metsovo is a challenging mountain race offering distances for all runners, from the 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain to shorter distances of 40 km, 21 km, and 11 km, as well as the 4.6 km Katara Vertical race. The course crosses beautiful trails and mountains in the area, offering unique natural scenery and technical challenges. The race is ITRA-certified and is an important event for mountain-running enthusiasts in Greece. The organizers provide for athletes’ safety and support, with aid stations and technical assistance along the course.
course_highlights: 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain
40 km, 21 km, and 11 km races, plus a 4.6 km vertical race
Beautiful mountain trails in Metsovo with technical challenges
additional: Races start at different times depending on the distance. Aid stations and technical support are available along the courses. The race is ITRA-certified and awards UTMB points for the 100 km ultramarathon. Information about accommodation and transport in the area is also provided. Ursa Trail also includes children’s races and special challenges, such as the 65.6 km URSA CHALLENGE with 4,810 m of elevation gain. The event combines racing and hiking, with an overnight stay in Metsovo and the involvement of volunteers and local organizations.

name: Semimaraton Casa Bună Sânpetru
description: Casa Bună Sânpetru Half Marathon is a charity sporting event that gives participants the opportunity to run on varied and scenic routes in the Sânpetru area of Brașov. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, flawless organization, and support for disadvantaged families through Casa Bună Sânpetru. The routes offer different levels of difficulty, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with beautiful scenery and sporting challenges. Taking part in this half marathon means not only enjoying a sporting experience, but also supporting a noble cause.

name: Semimaraton Galați
distance_verbose: Semimaraton, 10.5 km, 3000 metri, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.4 km
description: Semimaraton Galați is a philanthropic sporting event that combines athletic performance with social responsibility, bringing together professional and amateur runners, families, and volunteers. For more than 12 editions, the event has supported local community causes through entry fees and donations, funding projects focused on education, health, and social inclusion. The varied courses and community atmosphere make Semimaraton Galați a unique experience that brings sport closer to the community and promotes solidarity. The 2026 edition continues this tradition, offering races for all ages and fitness levels.

name: Crosul Copiilor
description: Crosul Copiilor 2026 is a competition for children aged 0 to 14, held in Central Park in Baia Mare. The event offers races tailored to different age groups, from the Baby Run for children under 4 to timed competitive races for the older groups. It’s a race full of energy and joy, with parents cheering on the children. Every child is encouraged to take part and enjoy running. The organizers limit the number of participants to ensure a pleasant and safe experience for everyone.

name: Trail trka Tibuzde 2026
location: село Тибужде, 5 км од града Врање
description: 1. Tibužde Trail is a trail race held in the village of Tibužde, near Vranje. The race offers two different distances, 27 km and 7 km, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain and the beauty of nature. The race starts at 7 a.m., and the event runs until 5 p.m., creating a great atmosphere for all running and nature enthusiasts.

name: 2ο Go Αμύνταιο
location: Κτήμα Κυρ-Γιάννη, Άγιος Παντελεήμονας, Δήμος Αμυνταίου, Greece
description: The 2nd GO - AMYNTAIO Half Marathon is a unique running experience organized by the Municipality of Amyntaio and GOevents. The 21-kilometer course starts at the enchanting Lake Zazari and passes through four villages, offering authentic Macedonian scenery and an energetic pace. There is also a 6-kilometer race called “The Wine Road” and a 1-kilometer children’s race. The event features music, local flavors, and a post-race party, creating a complete sporting and cultural experience.
course_highlights: 21 km course from Lake Zazari, passing through 4 villages
6 km “The Wine Road” course, starting and finishing at Kir-Yianni Estate
Full kilometer-by-kilometer course marking and aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, and snacks
additional: Medical support is available, including an ambulance and first aid. All participants receive medals. Aid stations along the half-marathon course provide bottled water, isotonic drinks, and bananas. After the race, a GO PARTY is held with live music and local flavors prepared by award-winning chef Angelos Naoumidis. Participants can access myathlete performance testing at a preferential rate. The program includes a 21 km half marathon, a 6 km race, and a 1 km children’s race.

name: 4α Λίμνηα
location: Central Square, Limni, Tripoli, Arcadia, Greece
description: The Agrotourism Cultural Association of Limni “To Agali,” in collaboration with the Peloponnese Region and the Municipality of Tripoli, is organizing the “Limni” road race in Limni, Arcadia. Certified by the SEGAS Peloponnese Regional Association, the event features 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m races on public roads in the area. The start and finish are at Limni’s central square, offering a pleasant sporting experience in a picturesque village in Arcadia. The race has become an important local sporting event with a friendly, family-oriented character.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m routes on public roads in Limni, Arcadia
Start and finish at Limni’s central square
Certified by the SEGAS Peloponnese Regional Association
additional: Race schedule: 09:00 registration desk opens for race-pack collection (bib number, timing chip, T-shirt). 11:00 start of the 1,000 m race; 11:15 start of the 5 km race; 11:30 start of the 10 km race. Registered participants receive a race pack and a commemorative medal.

name: 9ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Λίμνη Μαραθώνα
organizer: Σύλλογος Μαραθωνοδρόμων ΤΕΛΜΗΣΣΟΣ Ν. Μάκρης - Μαραθώνος
description: The Marathon Lake Road Race is a 10-kilometer race organized by the TELMESSOS N. Makris–Marathon Runners’ Club. The race starts at the unique stone dam of Marathon Lake, which is made of Pentelic marble—the same material as the Parthenon. The route circles the lake and its facilities, offering a distinctive natural setting with a mix of paved and dirt roads. The finish is within the lake facilities, where athletes receive a commemorative medal, a bag with offers, hydration, and refreshments.
course_highlights: 10 km route around Marathon Lake
Unique stone dam made of Pentelic marble
Paved and dirt roads with gentle inclines
additional: The race starts at the lake’s stone dam and finishes within the EYDAP facilities. Electronic timing, a commemorative medal, a bag with sponsor offers, hydration and snacks during the race, and a buffet at the finish are provided.

name: 10ο Thessaloniki Monuments Run
description: The Thessaloniki Monuments Road Race is a unique race that passes eight of the city’s historic monuments, six of which are part of UNESCO’s cultural heritage. The race is part of the Thessaloniki International Monuments Festival and combines sport with showcasing the history and beauty of Thessaloniki. The start and finish are in the grounds of Heptapyrgion, offering all participants a cultural and sporting experience.
course_highlights: Route passing eight historic monuments in Thessaloniki
Six monuments are part of UNESCO’s cultural heritage
Start and finish in the grounds of Heptapyrgion
additional: Warm-up led by specialists from the Department of Physical Education and Sport Science before the start. The race is followed by an awards ceremony and cultural events. An open guided tour is available for runners, spectators, and volunteers before the start.

name: Epidavrios Dromos Theater 2 Theater
location: Little Theatre of Ancient Epidaurus, Ancient Epidaurus, Greece
description: The Epidaurus Run is a road race held at the Little Theatre of Ancient Epidaurus, offering a unique experience in a historic and archaeological setting. The routes include 21-kilometer and 5-kilometer races, as well as children’s races, across varied terrain such as dirt paths, cobblestones, and asphalt. The race starts at the Little Theatre and passes through the port of Epidaurus, the village, and Ligourio, offering beautiful natural and cultural scenery. The event is professionally organized and welcoming, with an emphasis on safety and athlete support.
course_highlights: A 21-kilometer route with 479 meters of elevation gain
A 2.5-kilometer trail section on an uphill dirt path
Passes archaeological sites and the port of Epidaurus
additional: Participation is limited to 500 athletes per race. Time limits for the 21 km race: the first half must be completed in 2:15 and the full distance in 4:30. Water stations are located at specific kilometer points. Registration has separate opening hours before the start at each start location. The awards ceremony takes place after the races. The event includes a 5 km race and a 1.5 km children’s race.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in the Carpathian Mountains of Romania, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km through mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra runners. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as the Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognized, offers iTRA points and has been voted one of the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route through mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green meadows and the authentic sounds of bells and flowing water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: The event awards 3 iTRA points to finishers. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including barbecue with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, offers iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRAKIA UTRA is a mountain running event that recreates the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances suitable for beginners, advanced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with stunning views and challenges. It is an event that combines sporting spirit, history, and a love of nature, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Thrace in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The “Yordanka Arizanova” Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of the legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who developed hundreds of accomplished athletes. The tournament is held at Plovdiv Stadium and includes events such as the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, in which the coach achieved her greatest successes. The competition brings together both young and established athletes to honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultra-marathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognized as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity, and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have previous mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridges
Start and finish in the Bran Castle area
additional: Participation limits apply, and previous experience is mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for the winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

name: Maratonul Internațional Sibiu
location: Piața Mare, Sibiu, Sibiu County, Romania
description: The Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their registration fee. The event includes multiple races for all ages and levels, from a full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Piața Mare and surrounding areas. It is a movement that brings communities together and inspires them, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Piața Mare, Sibiu
Philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Registration fees are considered donations to support community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay race.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

name: TRANSYLVANIA 100K
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain ultramarathon event held in the wilderness of the Bucegi Mountains, crossing high-altitude trails. The event includes five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, all starting and finishing near Bran Castle, known as Dracula’s Castle. The routes offer a mix of narrow paths, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, providing a unique experience for runners passionate about the mountains. The races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special souvenirs for those who finish within the time limits.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.transylvania100k.com/): 2027-05-29 — "Transylvania 100 - 12th edition - May 29th 2027." (was estimated 2027-05-30)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Transylvania 100 - 12th edition - May 29th 2027.

name: Crosul Teiușului
description: Crosul Teiușului is a sporting event dedicated to promoting outdoor activity, mountain running, and a healthy lifestyle, for all ages and fitness levels. The event offers a variety of routes, from children’s races to a half marathon, in the authentic natural setting of Teiuș, Alba. It promotes inclusion, fair play, and active community participation, with free entry for all participants. A growing local tradition, it brings athletes and supporters together for a memorable experience.

name: Giarmata În Mișcare
description: Giarmata on the Move is an annual sporting event that brings together the communities of Giarmata and Cerneteaz to support social and educational causes and animal protection. In 2026, the event will take place on May 30 and will offer running races and cycling tours for all ages, from children to adults. Participants can choose from a half marathon, races of various distances, cycling tours, and children’s races, all helping to support local community projects. The event is organized by LOGS together with local partners and supported by major sponsors.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon for adults (ages 16+)
10.5 km and 5 km races for adults and young people
Races and tours for children aged 4 to 12
additional: The event includes races for all ages, from young children (400 m) to the half marathon. Participation supports community projects for children with disabilities, education, and animal protection. Donations can also be made separately by bank transfer or PayPal to the LOGS Association. The organizers provide support and information by email for payment confirmations and registration questions. The event includes donations and social projects, is supported by several local partners, and aims to promote health and civic engagement.

name: Thermal Trail Race
location: Băile 1 Mai, Sânmartin, Bihor County, Romania
description: Thermal Trail Race is an outdoor running race that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The event takes place in Băile 1 Mai, with the start and finish in the parking lot at Avenul Betfia (Crater). Two races are available: the 14 km Cross and the 7 km Mini, offering a trail-running experience amid the natural scenery of the capital of thermal waters. This is the 13th edition of the event, bringing together running and nature enthusiasts in a friendly, active setting.

name: Mokra Gora Trail
description: Mokra Gora Trail is a new regional hiking trail that runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia. The trail is part of the Via Dinarica network and offers a unique opportunity for adventure tourism and exploration of the Balkans’ unspoiled nature. It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, with the aim of promoting cross-border tourism and preserving the region’s natural beauty. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions, which offer exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.
course_highlights: The trail runs across Mount Mokra Gora, connecting three countries: Montenegro, Kosovo* and Serbia
It is part of the Via Dinarica network, known for its unspoiled nature and mountain landscapes
Via Ferrata sections offer adventure opportunities for hikers
additional: The trail is part of the Via Dinarica cross-border project and was developed to promote sustainable tourism and improve infrastructure. No race price or registration details are listed, indicating that the focus is on the hiking trail rather than a competition. The contact organization is the Regional Cooperation Council, headquartered in Sarajevo. The project is linked to the development of regional hiking trails, including Via Ferrata, GPS mapping and the installation of signage, with the aim of promoting sustainable tourism and cooperation in the region.

name: Tour de Fruška
distance_verbose: 55 km, 35 km, Polumaraton, 15 km, 7 km, 1 km
description: Tour de Fruška brings together outdoor enthusiasts in Vrdnik, in the natural surroundings of Fruška Gora. The program includes various disciplines, including trail running and MTB/eMTB cycling, giving participants the chance to experience the mountain terrain both on foot and by bike. Everyone is welcome to combine sport, nature and time spent on Fruška Gora.
course_highlights: Trails and rides in the natural surroundings of Fruška Gora
Trail race through forest and mountain terrain
MTB and eMTB disciplines

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: The Devica–Ozren hiking trip, organized by PSK Pobeda, takes participants on a climb up Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost mountains in the Balkans. The route passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations dotted with numerous caves, including a climb to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, and finishes along a forest trail toward Ozren and Ripaljka Waterfall. The trip lasts one day, departing from Belgrade in the early morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a Planinarski savez Srbije membership booklet valid for 2026 and suitable hiking equipment.

name: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3
description: Serbia EPIC MIONICA #3 is an exciting series of races held in Mionica, offering a range of distances for runners of different levels. The races include mountain and cycling marathons, as well as shorter courses, all set in the beautiful natural surroundings of Stara Planina. This event attracts nature and sports enthusiasts, offering challenging and scenic routes. You are welcome to take part and enjoy the unique atmosphere and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A variety of courses from 7 km to 60 km
Mountain and cycling marathons on Stara Planina
Beautiful natural landscapes and challenging terrain

name: 6ο Vasiliki Lefkada
description: The 6th Vasiliki Lefkada Road & Mountain Races 2026 will take place on May 30–31 in Vasiliki, Lefkada. This two-day event features road races and mountain running, organized by the Lefkada Tourism Company and the Tourism and Culture Association of the wider area. Events include races for children on scooters, an exciting 3,500-meter aquathlon combining swimming and running, and the classic 13,000-meter road race, which starts at Porto Katsiki Beach. The main road race starts at 18:00, offering a unique sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting.

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in the village of Zhelyava, Sofia. This is a challenging race that attracts mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful landscapes and varied terrain in the Sofia area. The organizers provide professional organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking cross-country marathon (XCM) race held in the village of Zhelyava. The race offers three main routes of varying lengths and elevation gain, suitable for different categories of riders, including hobby riders and e-bikes. The routes pass through scenic and challenging terrain, including the famous Zhelyava Trail, which is popular with cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for intermediate and well-prepared cyclists.

name: Crosul Copiilor
location: Veneția de Jos, Brașov County, Romania

name: Senćanski polumaraton
description: The Senta Half Marathon is a half-marathon race held in Senta, on the main square. The race brings together running enthusiasts from the region and offers an opportunity for sports and friendly competition in a pleasant atmosphere. The course runs through the city center and surrounding areas, offering participants a unique experience and challenge.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the main square in Senta
Route through the city center and surrounding areas
Pleasant atmosphere and support from the local community

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: The Vuk Karadžić Trails is a 25 km loop race with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres. The course starts at Vuk’s memorial house and runs through the shade of the centuries-old Monastery Forests, past woodland streams and waterfalls to the 13th-century Tronoša Monastery. It then continues across Mala Tronoša and Lisina to Zajača, from where the Monastery Candles Trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin Konak ethno complex, before returning to Tršić and Vuk’s house, where the finish is located. This race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the region’s natural beauty and cultural and historical landmarks.

name: Kros Trka Carica
description: The Carica Cross-Country Race is a traditional outdoor race held in Mali Stapar, bringing together runners of all ages, from children to competitors over seventy. The main race is 6.4 km long, preceded by children’s races with around forty participants. The event celebrates the traditions of sport, friendship, and spending time outdoors, and the organizers invite everyone to take part and enjoy this sporting event. The race is a prelude to the Friendship Race held in Kula, continuing the tradition of sport and community.

name: 14ο Skiathos Trail Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Επί τόπου εγγραφές πληρώνουν κανονική τιμή

description: The Skiathos Trail Run is a 24 km mountain half marathon that crosses forests, monasteries, and coastal areas of Skiathos, starting and finishing at Bourtzi, in the Old Port. There are also 10 km and 5 km races through town, as well as Special Olympics and children’s races. The event offers a unique experience combining natural beauty, cultural heritage, and an athletic challenge for all ages and ability levels. On the Saturday before the race, there is a guided tour of the old town and a pasta party, while race day is full of activity and volunteer support.
course_highlights: A 24 km mountain course with three climbs and six aid stations
Passes historic landmarks such as the Castle and Kechria Monastery
Coastal sections and routes through town for the 10 km and 5 km races
additional: The children’s races and the Special Olympics race are free and untimed. Electronic timing is provided for the 24 km, 10 km, and 5 km races. Race registration is open on race day from 07:00 to 08:30 at Bourtzi. Medical coverage is provided, along with aid stations offering water, isotonic drinks, and snacks, and medals for all finishers. Discounts on ferry tickets and special accommodation rates are available for participants. The program includes a Special Olympics race and children’s races.

name: 5TH EVRYTANIA TRAIL RACES
distance_verbose: 85 km, 60 km, Μαραθώνιος, 20 km, 12 km, 6 km, 1 km
description: The organizers of the 5th Evrytania Trail Races invite you to run along the fir-covered trails of mountainous Evrytania, in one of Europe’s cleanest ecosystems. The races offer a unique opportunity to discover the magic of nature, cool off in the crystal-clear waters of the Krikellopotamos River, and enjoy the hospitality of traditional villages that serve as aid stations. The event includes races of different distances, suitable for beginner and experienced runners, with beautiful and challenging routes combining trails, dirt roads, and paved roads.

name: 2οι Ορεινοί Αγώνες Τρεξίματος Χαλκιόπουλοι Βάλτου
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιοπουλιτών Αθήνας – Πειραιά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The event is organized by the Chalkiopoulites Association of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit,” the Chalkiopoulo Cultural and Educational Association, the local Chalkiopoulo Community, and the Municipality of Amfilochia. The races feature two distances, 27 and 10 kilometers, crossing the beautiful mountain landscapes of Chalkiopoulo and Valtos and offering a unique trail-running experience.

name: 5ο Posidonia Running Event
description: The 5th Posidonia Running Event will take place in Piraeus, offering a 5-kilometer route through the city streets. The event is open to runners from around the world and combines sport with support for charitable causes, as proceeds will go to the Municipality of Piraeus and its partner charities. The start and finish will be at the Municipal Theatre of Piraeus, with the race starting at 9:00 a.m. The event is part of the international Posidonia 2026 shipping exhibition and promises a unique experience for participants.

name: 6ο Karya Olympus Trail
description: Karya Olympus Trail is a mountain running race held in Karya, offering a unique experience for runners who love nature and the challenge of the mountains. The race showcases the beauty of Mount Olympus and the surrounding area, combining demanding trails with breathtaking views. It is an event that attracts runners of all levels, with the aim of promoting sport and local tradition. The organizers are welcoming and support participants every step of the way.

name: 42ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Διστόμου
description: The 42nd Distomo Sacrifice Road Race is a memorial race held in Distomo, honoring the memory of the 1944 massacre. The 11.2-kilometer course starts at the historic site of Karakolithos and finishes at National Resistance Square. Participation is free, and the event includes a 1.1 km children’s race starting at the same time. The organizers provide transportation for runners, timing, medical coverage, and refreshments along the route and at the finish.

name: Porto Carras Athlos 2026 - Giant Run
location: Porto Carras Grand Resort, Neos Marmaras, Sithonia, Halkidiki, Greece
description: Porto Carras Athlos is a three-day celebration of sport, wellness, and gastronomy held at the iconic Porto Carras Grand Resort in Halkidiki. The event transforms the enchanting landscape of Sithonia into a lively destination for sporting activities such as coastal running races, open-water swimming, and beach volleyball tournaments, as well as wellness programs and experiences for the whole family. It offers a unique opportunity to combine sport with relaxation and cultural delights in an idyllic seaside setting.
course_highlights: Coastal running races with sea views
Open-water swimming in crystal-clear waters
Beach volleyball tournaments and wellness activities
additional: Porto Carras Athlos also includes Pilates, swimming activities for babies, and a curated wellness program. The event takes place over the three-day Holy Spirit weekend and combines sporting events with culinary and cultural experiences at Porto Carras Grand Resort. It includes a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, and a 1 km children's race. The event is hosted at Porto Carras Grand Resort, near Neos Marmaras.

name: Karya Olympus Trail
description: The Karya Olympus Trail 2026 offers a unique mountain-running experience in the idyllic Karya Valley, under the protection of Mount Olympus. The routes follow marked trails with different distances and elevation gains, suitable for runners of all levels. The event includes races of 25, 13 and 5 kilometers, as well as children’s races, with amenities such as electronic timing, commemorative medals and technical T-shirts. The races start early in the morning, while the awards ceremony takes place at the start-finish area. The region offers natural beauty and historical interest, making the race a complete sporting and cultural experience.

name: Titnata Trail
description: The Titnata Trail 13km is a short mountain running race held in Karya, Greece. The 13-kilometer course includes 760 meters of ascent, offering a challenging uphill run on a marked trail. The race starts at 08:50 and is limited to 200 runners. Finishers receive a commemorative technical T-shirt.

name: Αγώνας δρόμου ιστορικής μνήμης «Βασιλί – Δασόλοφος»
organizer: Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Βασιλί και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δασολόφου
description: The “Vasili–Dasolofos” Historical Remembrance Road Race is organized by the Vasili Cultural Association and the Dasolofos Cultural and Beautification Association in memory of the 40 Greeks executed in 1944. The race starts from the square in Vasili and passes through historic and scenic spots in the area, honoring the memory of the heroes and promoting unity and historical awareness. After the finish, a memorial service will be held at the monument to the fallen. The event combines sport with culture and history, inviting participants to send a message of remembrance and respect.

name: Karya Mini Trail
description: The Karya Mini Trail is part of the Karya Olympus Trail, held in Karya, an idyllic valley on Mount Olympus. The 5-kilometer course follows a marked trail with 285 meters of positive elevation gain, offering a beautiful mountain-running experience. The event also includes longer routes and children’s races, with amenities such as electronic timing, souvenirs, and refreshments. With its rich history and natural beauty, Karya offers a unique setting for runners and visitors.

name: MYTYHICAL ODYSSEY - ECHOES OF ARCADIA, GREECE
Mediaș Coffee Run
organizer: Asociația Binderbubi Run & Hike și The Bean Roasters Mediaș
description: Mediaș Coffee Run is a charity urban run that brings together runners, children, and families to support therapy and recovery for children with disabilities. Participants can choose between routes of approximately 10 km and 4–5 km, while younger participants have their own race of approximately 500 m. The event emphasizes community involvement and support for a local cause.
course_highlights: Urban route of approximately 10 km, with around 100 m of elevation gain
Espresso Run of approximately 4–5 km
Children’s race of approximately 500 m
additional: The event supports the Pruncul Isus Mediaș Recovery Center and the Sfântul Casian Mediaș Association. Participants under 18 need parental consent.

name: Crosul Copiilor Limanu
description: Crosul Copiilor Limanu is a running competition for children, organized by age and gender categories, with an open and friendly atmosphere. The event takes place in Limanu, on Căminului Street, with the start and finish in front of Limanu No. 1 Middle School. Participants receive race kits that include a finisher medal, a T-shirt, and access to hydration stations, promoting sport and health among children. It is a local tradition that brings together many children and families each year for a day full of energy and joy.
course_highlights: Course along Căminului Street in Limanu
Start and finish in front of Limanu No. 1 Middle School
Races by age and gender category, plus a Family Run
additional: The race kits include a finisher medal, a T-shirt, and access to hydration/refueling stations. Participants who exceed the time limit set for their category will be disqualified. The race schedule will be announced later by text message.

name: Crosul umanitar Matei și Mabel
location: Șanțurile Cetății Alba Carolina, Alba Iulia, Romania
description: The “MAI closer to Matei and Mabel!” charity run, organized by the Alba County Police Inspectorate, is a charitable event dedicated to raising funds for two children with special needs. The event takes place in the Alba Carolina Fortress Moats in Alba Iulia, on the occasion of International Children’s Day. This charity run promotes solidarity and community support for children who hope to take steps toward a better life.
course_highlights: Located in the Alba Carolina Fortress Moats, an iconic place in Alba Iulia
A charity event dedicated to supporting the children Matei and Mabel
Organized by the Alba County Police Inspectorate, with its second edition continuing the tradition
additional: The event is organized annually on the occasion of International Children’s Day and aims to raise funds for children with special needs. It is an initiative of the Alba County Police Inspectorate that involves the local community in supporting social causes.

name: Macin Mountain Fun ~ 2026
description: Măcin Mountain Fun is a mountain cycling and running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Măcin Mountains. The courses offer a range of difficulty levels, from technical and demanding routes for experienced cyclists to more accessible trails for amateurs. The event emphasizes safety, fair play, and fun, making it suitable for outdoor sports enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and athletic challenges. Registration is online, and the organizers provide a well-organized, friendly experience.

name: Humanitarna IT trka „Štafeta srcem”
description: The charity IT race “Relay with Heart” will take place at Niš Fortress. The event brings together the IT community and running enthusiasts in a charitable atmosphere, promoting solidarity and support through sport. The race is an opportunity to socialize, lead an active lifestyle, and contribute to the community in the beautiful setting of the fortress.

name: Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Νέας Σμύρνης
organizer: δήμος Νέας Σμύρνης και Περιφέρεια Αττικής
description: The Nea Smyrni Night Run 2026 is a 5-kilometer road race organized by the Municipality of Nea Smyrni in collaboration with the Attica Region and the Nea Smyrni Commercial Association, as part of World Environment Day. The race has an athletic, ecological, and recreational character, with the aim of promoting environmental protection and sustainable development. The course follows the axis of El. Venizelou Street, with the start and finish at 54 Omirou Street. A concert and party follow the race, while local businesses take part with special offers and discounts.

name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race offering a unique experience in the wild nature of Vitosha.
