The race includes three distances of varying difficulty and elevation gain, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the courses cross varied terrain, including an ascent of Cherni Vrah—the highest point on Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop trail-running culture in Bulgaria and encourage an active lifestyle.

name: Национален шампионат под 18 г.
description: The U18 National Championships in Stara Zagora is a prestigious athletics competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The event brings together young athletes under 18 who compete in various track events. It is part of the national calendar and provides an opportunity for young athletics talents to compete and develop.

name: XRun
description: X-Run is a running competition held in Oradea, organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association. The 21 km course offers a complete experience, with refreshment stations providing still water, isotonic drinks, cola, ice, fresh fruit, and energy bars. Participants receive a race pack containing a personalized technical T-shirt, a race number, and an electronic chip for timing. Medical assistance is provided along the course by ambulances and specialized staff. Race pack collection takes place between 16:00 and 20:00.
course_highlights: 21 km course in Oradea, Bihor County
Refreshment stations with drinks and energy snacks
Medical assistance along the course, with ambulances and specialized staff
additional: The race pack includes an official personalized technical T-shirt, a race number, and an electronic chip for timing. Medical assistance is provided by specially equipped ambulances and medical staff at key points along the course. Participants must present a signed declaration of responsibility and their identity card or passport.

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation gain, designed to test participants’ physical and mental limits. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, while careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can reconnect with nature and take on the challenge of an authentic endurance race.
course_highlights: Alpine routes with impressive panoramic views
Significant elevation gain for each distance
Marked routes and well-stocked aid stations
additional: The race kit includes a personalized technical shirt for the first 800 participants, timing with a disposable chip, aid stations along the route and at the start/finish, a finisher medal for those who finish within the time limits, and products provided by sponsors. There are time limits for each distance and an awards ceremony at 18:00. The routes include aid and support points, with categories and prizes for different distances. The event promotes an authentic mountain trail experience and participant safety.

name: AROBS X-Man Romania 2026
description: The AROBS X-Man Romania 2026 competition invites competitors from Romania and abroad, amateurs and professionals alike, to test their limits over the Long, Middle and Olympic distances. The event takes place in Oradea, a vibrant Art Nouveau city with a rich cultural and architectural history. Participants can enjoy a unique urban setting, with numerous tourist attractions and modern amenities. The organizers offer attractive prizes to reward each participant’s determination and passion.

name: Maraton Apuseni ~ 2026
description: Maraton Apuseni is an iconic mountain-running event held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, offering a variety of routes for all preferences and experience levels. Participants can choose between an ultramarathon, marathon, half-marathon, cross-country race, and family race, enjoying picturesque scenery, shaded trails, spectacular ridges, and traditional villages. The event celebrates 15 years of tradition and community and is organized by the Romanian Alpine Club, Cluj Branch, with a friendly, festive atmosphere. It is a unique opportunity to run in nature, test your limits, and connect with other mountain-running enthusiasts.

name: Măcin Mountain Fun
description: Măcin Mountain Fun is an event for mountain biking and running enthusiasts, held amid the natural beauty of the Greci area, Tulcea County. The courses offer technical challenges and spectacular scenery, and are suitable both for experienced competitors and for those looking to enjoy an active outdoor experience. The event promotes fair play and participant safety, offering a variety of courses, from easy to difficult and technical. It is an excellent opportunity to combine sport, nature, and socializing in a friendly setting.
course_highlights: The 54 km long course with 1,700 m of elevation gain is difficult and technical, with spectacular climbs and descents
The 32 km short course with 600 m of elevation gain has easy-to-moderate technical difficulty, featuring an approximately 6 km climb and a long 9 km descent
The 23 km half-marathon course is technical and difficult, while the 12 km cross-country course is easy to moderate and suited to runners accustomed to varied terrain
additional: Registration is confirmed after the fee is paid, within a maximum of 5 calendar days. Payment can be made by card, bank transfer, or at a BCR branch counter. Participants under 18 must have written consent from their parents and submit a liability waiver on race day. T-shirts come in fixed sizes and cannot be exchanged. The courses are available for download in .zip format.

name: Festivalul Sporturilor Iași
description: Iași Sports Festival is a sporting event for everyone, from beginners to advanced competitors, offering a variety of events such as trail running, mountain biking, orienteering, and road running. The event takes place on routes in the city of Iași and the surrounding areas, with starts and finishes at Hotel La Castel and the Palace of Culture. Participants can compete individually or in multiple events to receive discounts, and can take on the Multisport Trophy challenge, which includes four events over two days. The festival promotes physical activity for everyone, including families and people with special abilities, offering a complete and welcoming experience.
course_highlights: Varied routes in the city of Iași and surrounding areas, including trails through vineyards and Breazu Forest
Aid and hydration stations along the trail-running routes
Live electronic timing and cash prizes in the Open categories
additional: Start/finish at Hotel La Castel - Green View Salon (Saturday) and the Palace of Culture (Sunday). Participants must present their original identity card and sign a declaration of responsibility when collecting their race kit. The competition takes place regardless of weather conditions, except in extreme conditions. Timing is chip-free, and the standings are available live on the website during the race. There are Open categories with cash prizes and age categories detailed in the regulations. Time limits for events: 11 km trail run - 2 hours; 21 km half marathon - 3 hours.

name: MARATON APUSENI
description: Maraton Apuseni is a mountain running event offering varied courses for all fitness levels, set amid the picturesque landscapes of the Apuseni Mountains. Participants can choose from an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, cross-country race, and family events, running through dense forests, spectacular ridgelines, and traditional villages. The event is held annually at Buscat Resort, Cluj, and emphasizes an authentic nature experience with a festival atmosphere. The courses are carefully marked and equipped with aid stations, and each runner receives a participation kit with official gear and other benefits.
course_highlights: Courses through the dense forests and spectacular ridgelines of the Apuseni Mountains
Passing through the Scărița-Belioara Nature Reserve and the alpine area of Muntele Mare
Courses that include traditional villages and alpine meadows
additional: The participation kit includes official gear, a timing chip, a race bib, a finisher’s medal, access to aid stations and the afterparty, as well as energy drinks depending on the event. The ultramarathon has specific mandatory gear, and the courses are carefully marked and equipped with aid stations. There is a No Limits event dedicated to people with disabilities. The ultramarathon starts at 05:00, and cutoff times are set for checkpoints along the course.

name: ROMANAȚI Trail Run, editia a V-a ~ 6 iunie 2026
description: Romanați Trail Run is a vibrant trail-running race that transforms Caracal into the trail-running capital for a day. The event offers three challenging courses suitable for runners of all levels, with a friendly atmosphere and a community passionate about exercise. The event’s motto encourages competitors to run beyond their own limits and enjoy the course. The event is carefully organized, and participation also supports a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Three challenging courses for all levels
The half-marathon and 12 km race start in Constantin Poroineanu Park, near the 1848 Monument
The half-marathon course is approximately 22.9 km long
additional: Registration for the children’s race takes place on site on race day between 07:00 and 09:30 by completing a form provided by the organizer. The contribution must be paid by bank transfer within 3 business days of registration; failure to pay will result in cancellation of the registration. The half-marathon and 12 km race share a start in Constantin Poroineanu Park, near the 1848 Monument.

name: Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail
description: The Dušan Milošević Memorial Trail is a race held in honor of Serbia’s first Olympian, Dušan Milošević, and takes runners along the most beautiful trails of Rudnik. The race is dedicated to his courage and perseverance, and aims to honor his legacy and the Serbian spirit through running. Three courses are available: the fast, shorter Vihor course; the more challenging Rudnik course, with steep climbs and descents; and the non-competitive Domaćinska course for those who want to enjoy nature. The race is an opportunity to celebrate history, courage, and community.

name: Kup Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Cup 2026 is a traditional sports, competition and recreation event held on Fruška Gora. The races cover a range of trails, including the ultra-extreme marathon, ultra marathon, middle eastern marathon and beginner trails, with varying levels of difficulty and distance. The event brings together runners from Serbia and abroad, offering challenges on Fruška Gora’s old trails and a chance to enjoy nature and the spirit of sport. The organizers also provide transportation to the start and extensive support throughout the event.

name: Serbia EPIC VRNJAČKA BANJA #4
description: The UCI XCO race in Andrevlje is an exciting competition that brings together elite and junior riders in the men's and women's categories. Held in front of the Ceptor Hotel amid the beautiful surroundings of Andrevlje, it lasts four days and offers an outstanding atmosphere and intense competition. Riders can expect electronic timing, fully marked trails, and a comprehensive race pack with a T-shirt, medal, and refreshments on the course. This is an event that combines a passion for sport with the natural beauty of Serbia.

name: Tara Ultra Trail
description: Tara Ultra Trail is a running adventure in the heart of Tara National Park, held in Mitrovac. The race offers three distances: 12 km, 21 km, and 69 km, taking runners through the mountain’s most beautiful and appealing areas, including Banjska Stena and lesser-known places. The courses are designed for runners of different levels, from beginners to experienced trail runners. All races are ITRA-certified and count toward the ITRA National League. Alongside the race, an all-day outdoor festival for all ages and fitness levels is held in Mitrovac.
course_highlights: The courses pass through the most beautiful parts of Tara National Park, including Banjska Stena
The longest distance, 69 km, features 3,036 m of cumulative elevation gain and spectacular ridges and peaks
The 21 km course leads to Serbia’s best-known viewpoint, Banjska Stena, and the ridge of Aluška Mountain
additional: Time limits are 3 hours for TUT 12, 6 hours for TUT 21, and 17 hours for TUT 69. The start and finish are in Mitrovac. The organizer reserves the right to change the courses according to conditions on the ground. The children’s race for ages 4–12 is free and is part of the outdoor festival. A fee is charged for vehicles entering Tara National Park at the entrance gates, and there is no public transport to Mitrovac. An all-day outdoor festival is planned at the finish. A free children’s race for ages 4 to 12 will also be held. Participants under 18 may not run TUT 69; parental or guardian consent is required for the other distances, and participants under 14 must be accompanied by a parent.

name: Global Day Run
description: Global Day Run Patras 2026 is a friendly running event held in Agia, Patras, aiming to promote running as a way to improve physical and mental health. The event includes 8 km and 4 km races, as well as a 1 km children’s race, primarily for beginner runners and recreational athletes who want to exercise outdoors with friends. The race is part of the global celebration of running, encouraging families and friends to take part without competition. The start takes place in the afternoon on the beach of Agia.

name: 1ο Ultra Track 100km Athens
location: Dionysos Municipal Stadium (Angelos Sotiriou Stadium), Dionysos, Attica, Greece
description: The 1st Ultra Track 100km Athens is a charity ultradistance race held at the Municipal Stadium of Dionysos in Attica. The race is inspired by Alexandros Tzorvas, former goalkeeper for Panathinaikos and the Greek national team, and aims to introduce more runners to the world of ultradistance running. The event is supported by the Municipality of Dionysos and the ELIZA Society Against Child Abuse. It is a demanding 100-kilometer race with a 14-hour time limit, held over two days, Saturday and Sunday.
course_highlights: A 100-kilometer race at the stadium in Dionysos, Attica
A 14-hour time limit for the ultrarunners
Charitable event supported by the ELIZA Society Against Child Abuse
additional: The race takes place from Saturday evening to Sunday morning (21:15–11:15). There is also a 2-hour race (1st ELIZA) for runners who want to take part without pushing themselves too hard, for charity and with a 2-hour time limit (19:00–21:00).

name: Rhodo Rock
distance_verbose: 88 km, 60 km, Маратон, Полумаратон, 9 km, 2 km
description: Rhodo Rock is a two-day ultramarathon in the Rhodope Mountains, held near the beautiful town of Momchilgrad. The event offers five distances across two days: 88, 60, and 42 km on Saturday, and 21 and 9 km on Sunday. Participants follow varied routes through peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, making the race suitable for both professionals and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Rhodo Rock promises a unique atmosphere and an unforgettable experience amid the wild nature of the Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: A two-day race with varied routes through peaks and valleys
Crossing rivers and following forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Five distances from 9 to 88 km, suitable for different fitness levels
additional: All participants receive a finisher’s medal if they finish within the cutoff time, an original-design T-shirt, and gifts in the race pack. A mandatory medical examination is required before collecting the race pack. Medical teams are available during the event. Race timing and photography are provided.

name: Business Run Sofia
description: Business Run Sofia is the largest team-building event in Bulgaria, bringing together employees from different companies for a corporate relay race. Teams have 4 participants, each of whom runs 4 laps of 1.2 km, for a total of 4.8 km. In addition to the relay, there are also a Power Walk, CEO Dash, and Kids Run. Every participant receives insurance, a medal, and gifts. The event is a great opportunity to strengthen team bonds and enjoy active recreation with colleagues.

name: Tinca Cross
description: Tinca Cross is a running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Tinca Town Hall and the Local Council. The event includes 5 km and 10 km cross-country races, suitable for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The course starts at Tinca Community Stadium and follows a 2.5 km loop through the forest next to the stadium, finishing at the stadium. Participants under 18 need written consent from a parent or guardian. Cash prizes and diplomas are awarded to the top finishers.

name: Color Run Arilje
description: Color Run Arilje is a sports and recreational race that combines running and fun, with participants passing through color zones. The course runs through Arilje and along the Rzav River, and the event brings together participants from different parts of Serbia. Everyone is welcome to experience the town and its surroundings in a cheerful, active atmosphere.
course_highlights: Around seven kilometers through Arilje and alongside the Rzav River.
Cross three bridges and pass through color zones.
Varied terrain with climbs, descents, and a water crossing.

name: Village Trail
description: The race offers a blend of sport, nature, and adventure, with two courses winding through beautiful landscapes, including a viewpoint overlooking the Danube and Belgrade. The start and finish are at the Dunavska Terasa restaurant, and the event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. In addition to the race, an entertainment program is provided for children and families, while runners can look forward to support from volunteers and an after-run party.

name: 1ο Vlasti Wind Trail
description: Vlasti Wind Trail is a distinctive mountain running event held in the natural surroundings of Vlasti, Kozani. It combines the sporting experience with the promotion of harmonious coexistence between people and nature, emphasizing Renewable Energy Sources and sustainable development. The event is a celebration of sustainability and local cooperation, supporting the local community and highlighting the value of clean energy. The routes offer a unique experience through beautiful natural scenery, with respect for the environment and local tradition.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κουρούτας
description: The 2nd Kourouta Road Race 2026 invites runners to take on a route where the road meets the waves, offering unique views of the Aegean Sea. The event includes 10 km and 4,300 m races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race, with electronic timing and a commemorative medal for all finishers. Medical coverage is provided by the Red Cross, while traffic safety is ensured by the Amaliada Traffic Police and volunteers. The start and awards ceremony take place in Kourouta Central Square, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.

name: 2o Sykourio Trail
organizer: Δήμος Τεμπών και ο Σύλλογος Εμποροβιοτεχνών Συκουρίου
description: The 2nd Sykourio Trail is a mountain running race held in the Sykourio area of the Municipality of Tempi, on Mount Kissavos. It features three routes of varying difficulty and length, crossing trails, dirt roads, and paved roads for a comprehensive mountain running experience. The race is open to runners of all ages, with a special route for children within the settlement. The event provides electronic timing, food and water along the course, and refreshments at the finish.

name: 4ος Συκάρειος Δρόμος
description: The 4th Sykareios Run is a road race held in Kryoneri, Attica. It offers two distances, 15 km and 5.5 km, starting and finishing at the Kryoneri Municipal Unit Gate. The race is open to runners of various ages and offers commemorative medals to all finishers, as well as awards to the top male and female runners. The event emphasizes runner safety and support, with refreshment stations along the route.

name: 4ο Argithea Mountain Race
description: The 4th Argithea Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race held in the area of Petrito, Karditsa. It features several distances, including the 30 km Argithea Skyrace with 2,000 m of elevation gain, the 15 km Vlachogiannis race with 700 m of climbing, a 5 km family race, and a 1 km children’s race. There is also the 3.6 km Lakos Vertical, with 700 m of climbing, offering a unique experience on trails through a fir forest with views of the Agrafa peaks. The race attracts runners who love the mountains and a challenge, while also offering activities for the whole family.

name: 5ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Aqua Mare
description: The 5th Aqua Mare Road Race takes place in Megara, with the start and finish on Varea Beach, in front of the AQUA MARE beach bar. Participants can choose between two distances, 10 km and 5.3 km, running alongside the waves on a beautiful coastal route. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with free transportation and a commemorative T-shirt for runners. The race starts early in the morning, making for a day full of adrenaline and relaxation.

name: 6ο Raches Run
description: The 6th Raches Run - Agroinvest is a sporting event organized by the Raches Interactive Association ALOPI at Raches Beach in Phthiotis. It includes 10,000-meter and 5,000-meter races, as well as a 1,000-meter race for children, promoting sports and social solidarity. The race showcases the beauty and history of the area while strengthening participants’ connection with the village and local community.

name: Artemida Sunset Run
description: The Artemida Sunset Run is the first road race to be held in Artemida, offering 5 km and 10 km routes at sunset. The routes are pre-established and marked on public roads, with the start and finish at the Artemida Municipal Stadium. The event includes electronic timing, participant medals, an event T-shirt, and awards by age category. The race is open to runners aged 15 and over, with a total participation limit of 300 runners across both distances.

name: Kilkis Trail
description: Kilkis Trail is organized by the Kilkis Runners’ Health Association and offers a variety of races, including the main 20-kilometer trail race, a 4.8 km fun run, a 4x4.8 km relay, and a 1 km children’s race. The Kilkis Trail course follows trails and dirt roads around the city of Kilkis, with gentle slopes and technical sections, covering approximately 850 meters of elevation gain. The start and finish are at the Kilkis open-air cinema, offering runners a beautiful and challenging experience. The race is open to runners of all levels.

name: Лудогорски маратон
description: The Ludogorski Marathon takes place in the picturesque Pchelina area near Razgrad, in a protected natural area with varied terrain and beautiful woodland. The event offers running, cycling, duathlon, and triathlon disciplines. The routes are mostly forest trails and dirt roads, with a small amount of asphalt and gravel. The event is suited to nature lovers and adventure-sports enthusiasts, and provides aid stations, medical assistance, and a guarded transition area. It is organized by the Zелена стъпка (Green Step) club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is almost entirely in the forest, on unpaved forest roads and trails, with a small amount of gravel and asphalt.
The natural environment is well preserved and diverse, with the possibility of encountering wildlife.
The 25 km running course has 650 meters of elevation gain and four aid stations.
additional: The 2-kilometer children's run is free to enter, with registration on site. Checkpoints and aid stations are spaced approximately 5 kilometers apart. At the start/finish, there is a food and drink vendor, toilets, and medical assistance. The triathlon swim takes place in Pchelina Reservoir, with a rescue team on hand. Starts take place on the field with sports pitches in the Pchelina area. Finish times are limited for the different disciplines.

name: SepsiRun
description: SepsiRun is a running festival held in the city of Sfântu Gheorghe and its surroundings. Its goal is to become the largest running event in the area, attracting over 1,000 participants from across the country. The event features several races on urban and trail routes, suitable for all experience levels, with distances ranging from 5 km to 23 km. SepsiRun offers a complete running experience, combining nature and the city with varied routes and a welcoming atmosphere for runners.

name: Pedală în Bănie ~ 2026
distance_verbose: 43 km, 24 km, 14 km, 3000 metri, 1.53 km, 0.6 km
description: Pedală în Bănie is a longstanding sporting event in the Dolj region, dedicated to mountain biking and trail running enthusiasts. Held in the Palilula area of Craiova, the event offers routes inspired by the “JURASSIC” theme, with challenges that test participants’ strength, speed, and endurance. With a variety of races for all ages and ability levels, Pedală în Bănie promotes health, community spirit, and environmental protection, offering a complete experience of competition and adventure in nature. Its friendly atmosphere and thoughtful organization make it a celebration of sport and outdoor activity.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Tepe Jambore is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv, combining running, movement, and culture across the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural performances, including jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through landmark city locations, hills, paths, and green spaces, and are suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race, but an experience that brings the community together and supports causes for people facing social disadvantage.
course_highlights: Champions’ Jambore — 13 km with 450 meters of elevation gain, passing over all of Plovdiv’s hills
Laid-Back Jambore — 7 km with 250 meters of elevation gain
Kids’ Jambore — 1 km in Bunardzhik Park, on a safe route in a supervised environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops featuring theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, performers, and surprises. The start-finish area hosts a party with music and entertainment. Participants can volunteer with the Jambore Squad, helping support participants and the event organization. Corporate teams take part in a competition that celebrates team spirit and raises donations for the “Plovdiv112” volunteer formation. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km options; the event is part of Plovdiv’s 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: Wild Calls Madzharovo is an annual event combining cycling and trail running in the picturesque Eastern Rhodopes. It takes place in the town of Madzharovo, situated in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique natural landscapes and historical landmarks. The courses offer a range of distances and challenges, suitable for both recreational and elite athletes. Organized by the Dimitar Madzharov Cycling Club, the event aims to showcase the beauty of the region and bring sports enthusiasts together in a spirit of adventure and respect for nature.
course_highlights: Trail running with up to 900 m of elevation gain and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes through dense forests and old trails, passing close to a waterfall
Unique natural surroundings in a volcanic crater, near the Arda River and its impressive meanders
additional: Start and finish in the square in front of the Municipality in the town of Madzharovo. Services include chip timing, mountain rescue, emergency medical assistance, a delicious lunch in the festival area, and the option to camp in the Arda River canyon or at a campsite in the town park.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championship for under-14 competitors in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together more than 300 young athletes from across the country. Held at Hristo Botev Stadium, it gives the youngest talents an opportunity to compete in classic track and field events. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sports calendar and takes place alongside the international Nikola Valchanov Tournament. It is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
description: The Nikola Valchanov Athletics Tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at Aprilov Stadium. It features 17 events, including sprint races and shot put, for age groups ranging from under 14 to men and women. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATHLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and opens officially at 11:00.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Beyond the Bridge is a unique bike-and-run event in Lovech, combining a sporting challenge with an opportunity to explore the region’s nature and history. Participants pass through scenic and historic places such as the Devetashko Plateau, the Kakrina Inn, Hisarya Fortress, and the Covered Bridge, a symbol of the city. The event is suitable for anyone seeking adventure, a sporting experience, and the chance to support a charitable cause, with 20% of the fees going to the cause.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain featuring forest and country trails and asphalt (70–80% off-road, 20–30% asphalt)
Routes through historic and scenic places such as the Devetashko Plateau and Hisarya Fortress
The Covered Bridge—the emblem of Lovech, with a unique atmosphere and old-world charm
additional: Registration is available online through tracksport.live or on-site on certain days. During the final two weeks before the event, registration is subject to restrictions: no personalized race bib, and merchandise will be available on-site in the selected size. Signing a declaration is mandatory when collecting the race pack. 20% of the fees go to a charitable campaign.

name: Bloodfluencer Marathon
description: Bloodfluencer Marathon is an annual running event held to mark World Blood Donor Day, in the picturesque village of Dejani, at the foothills of the Făgăraș Mountains. The event promotes voluntary blood donation and a healthy lifestyle, bringing together a community dedicated to this cause. Participants can choose from several races, from the Family Run to the Marathon, in a remarkable natural setting. The organizer is the HEM Association, which supports the national program “N-avem SÂNGE?!”.
course_highlights: Routes in the picturesque area at the foothills of the Făgăraș Mountains
Several races: Family Run, Popular Race, Cross-Country, Half Marathon, Marathon
An event dedicated to promoting voluntary blood donation
additional: Organized minibus transport between Făgăraș and Dejani is available for participants on request. A camping area for approximately 30 tents is available, no more than 2 km from the Start/Finish, with advance reservation. Easy access by car and several accommodation options are available in the area. Tourist recommendations are available for visiting nearby attractions. For the 2027 edition, the registration page shows that registration is closed. Listed fees: Family Run and Popular Race 135 RON, Cross-Country 120 RON, Half Marathon 140 RON, and Marathon 160 RON.

name: Maratonul Nordului
description: The Northern Marathon is a sporting event that brings together nature and spirit in northern Romania, offering spectacular routes for runners of all levels. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, taking place amid the impressive natural landscapes of Botoșani and its surroundings. Participants can choose from several races, including marathon, trail, and MTB, enjoying a complete experience that combines sport with tourism and local culture.
course_highlights: Spectacular routes through northern Romania
A variety of races: marathon, trail, and MTB
Natural landscapes and authentic local communities
additional: Registrations validated by April 10 guarantee the official race T-shirt. After June 20, the technical T-shirt or personalized items in the race kit are not guaranteed. The organizer will decide whether race-day registrations will be allowed and will announce this in advance. Spectacular routes, outdoor event, community participation

name: Retezat Sky Race
description: Retezat SkyRace is a skyrunning race held in the spectacular landscape of Romania’s Retezat Mountains, offering runners a challenging experience on varied, technical mountain trails. The event combines the challenges of rugged terrain with the natural beauty of ridges, valleys, and alpine lakes, and is designed for mountain-running and adventure enthusiasts. Organized with careful attention to safety and respect for the environment, the race offers a passionate community and opportunities to connect with others and push personal limits. Participants can experience a true mountain adventure in the heart of the Retezat Mountains.

name: Maraton Maramureș
description: Maramureș Marathon is a mountain race set amid the picturesque landscapes of Baia Mare and its surroundings. The routes include a 13 km run and hike, a 21 km mountain half marathon, and a full 42 km marathon, each offering challenges and spectacular views. Participants will tackle sustained climbs, trails along the shore of the Firiza Reservoir, and areas with impressive panoramas of the local peaks. The event is suitable both for experienced mountain runners and for those seeking a trail-running experience in nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://maratonmaramures.ro/): 2027-06-12 — "12 iunie 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-19)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: 12 iunie 2027

name: Maratonul Sării
description: The Salt Marathon is a sporting event that combines running and mountain biking, set in the natural and historic landscape of Târgu Ocna, Bacău County. Participants can choose between 10 km and 21 km trail-running races, as well as a 30 km mountain-bike race, all starting and finishing in the Town Hall Square. A unique feature of the competition is a 7 km section through the underground galleries of the Târgu Ocna Salt Mine, offering an unusual experience and health benefits thanks to the ionized air. The event promotes an active lifestyle and responsible stewardship of nature, and includes plogging activities to clean up the routes.

name: Maraton Tarcău
location: Mănăstirea Tarcău, comuna Tarcău, jud. Neamţ
description: Tarcău Marathon is an annual competition held in the natural landscape of the Tarcău area in Neamț, offering marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races. The event emphasizes physical preparation and suitable equipment, ensuring a complete and safe sporting experience. Participants can collect their race kit the day before the competition and must follow the official race rules. Cutoff times are clearly set for each race, ensuring a competitive and well-organized event.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://maraton-tarcau.ro/): 2027-06-12 — "Maraton Tarcau 12 IUNIE 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-19)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Maraton Tarcau 12 IUNIE 2027

name: Atinge OMU
description: Atinge Omu is a mountain running race held in the first ten days of June, along the Peștera–Omu Peak route and back. The event offers runners an intense experience amid the spectacular scenery of the Bucegi Mountains, when the ridges are tinged red with rhododendron. At the finish, participants are rewarded with bulz grilled over embers and jintiță, in a friendly, traditional atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain route: Peștera–Omu Peak–Peștera
Spectacular views of rhododendron flowers on the ridges of the Bucegi Mountains
The race starts at the Peștera Cable Car
additional: The start area is at the Peștera Cable Car. At the finish, bulz grilled over embers and jintiță are served to all participants.

name: Semimaratonul Eroilor Invictus
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon, taking place on 12 June 2027 in Bistrița, is a sporting event dedicated to commemorating heroes who lost their lives in the service of the armed forces. The event promotes mass-participation sports and their physical and mental health benefits, and is open to both amateur athletes and elite runners. It is organized by the Invictus Volunteers Association – Bistrița Branch, in collaboration with local and national institutions, under the high patronage of Prince Radu. Participants can choose from several races, including a half marathon and a cross-country race, all held on carefully planned routes in the city of Bistrița.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is 21 km long, starting and finishing in Central Square in Bistrița
The event also includes a 5.2 km cross-country race, suitable for all ages and fitness levels
The courses are marked and secured for participants’ safety, while promoting community spirit and remembrance of the heroes
additional: Participants receive a race bib and timing chip. Custom Invictus T-shirts are available. The event is held under the high patronage of Prince Radu and involves numerous local partners and sponsors. Registrations are validated until 12 May 2027, and the organizer reserves the right to refuse participation. Registration involves choosing a race and making a donation. The INVICTUS T-shirt is collected with the race kit on the basis of the donation and will not be available for purchase on the day of the event.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://semimaratonuleroilor.ro/regulament/): 2027-06-12 — "Evenimentul are loc în orașul Bistrița, în data de 12 iunie 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-29)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Evenimentul are loc în orașul Bistrița, în data de 12 iunie 2027

name: Maraton Scaunul Domnului
location: Bistra Mureșului, Deda, Mureș County, Romania
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 km, Maraton, 25 km, Semimaraton, 15 km
description: Scaunul Domnului Marathon is a challenging mountain race held in the Scaunul Domnului Nature Reserve, offering 42 km, 21 km, and 10 km routes. Participants can discover spectacular volcanic landscapes and experience running on varied trails with significant elevation changes. The event is organized with a focus on runner safety, with well-placed checkpoints and hydration stations. The atmosphere is rounded out by an awards ceremony and post-race social activities.
course_highlights: 42 km route with 2,100 m of positive elevation gain
Spectacular views towards the Călimani Ridge and lookout areas with a risk of falling
Multiple checkpoints, hydration stations, and refreshment points along the route
additional: Race kits can be picked up on Friday, June 12, from 17:00 to 23:00 and Saturday, June 13, from 6:00 to 8:00 for the main races. Mandatory equipment checks take place before the start. Each race has time limits and intermediate checkpoints. Competitor parking is arranged in a designated area beside the Blidăreasa forest road, accessible from the Bistra Valley.

name: The Color Run Iași
description: The Color Run Iași is an untimed 5-kilometer race, known as the “Happiest 5k on the Planet,” celebrating health, joy, and originality through a colorful, high-energy experience. Participants run, dance, and enjoy a festive atmosphere, getting covered in vibrant powder at every kilometer. The event is open to all ages and promotes an active, fun lifestyle, culminating in a colorful post-race party. The Color Run is a celebration of community and movement, offering a memorable day for all participants.
course_highlights: Untimed 5 km race with colored powder at every kilometer
Festive atmosphere with music and a post-race party featuring a cloud of colored powder
Open to all ages, with no minimum or maximum age limit
additional: Children aged 0 to 6 can participate for free and receive a race bib, medal, and colored powder, but must be accompanied by an adult. The standard kit includes a T-shirt, race bib, temporary tattoos, bandana, medal, and colored powder. Participants with disabilities and their companions receive free access in accordance with the law. Registration is online, and the entry fee varies depending on the registration period. The event promotes respect for the environment and sportsmanship throughout the race.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is a nature running event held on trail routes in the Bistrița area, promoting health through movement, community, and truth. The event combines physical effort with a profound message about living life to the fullest in body, mind, and spirit. It is for those seeking more than a competition: an authentic experience that brings people together and points them toward Christ. The name Peniel means “place of meeting,” symbolizing a living connection with God and personal transformation. The routes offer a varied, runnable, and beautiful experience, suitable for both beginners and advanced runners.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route (21 km) has approximately 650 m of elevation gain, shares sections with the 10 km route, and includes a scenic loop in the Tărpiu area.
The 10 km route is fast, easy, and very runnable, with approximately 270 m of elevation gain, on a route rarely used for competitions.
The accessible 5 km route has two short climbs, including one through a fir forest, and is suitable for beginners and competitive runners.
additional: The event includes a Kids Cross race for children, promoting fun and exercise for the little ones. The official event T-shirt is provided to participants. Routes may undergo minor changes before the event, and the organizers promote a healthy, balanced lifestyle centered on community and faith.

name: The Color Run Timișoara
description: The Color Run Timișoara is an untimed 5-kilometer race, known as the “Happiest 5k on the Planet,” celebrating health, joy, and originality through a colorful, energetic experience. Participants run, dance, or walk along a course where they are showered with colored powder at every kilometer, then enjoy a vibrant party with music and fun activities. The event is open to all ages and promotes an active, positive lifestyle. It is a celebration of community and movement, offering a memorable day for everyone taking part.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km untimed course
Colored powder at every kilometer
Vibrant post-race party with music and activities
additional: Children aged 0–6 can participate for free and receive a race bib, medal, and colored powder, but no T-shirt. The race kit includes a T-shirt, race bib, temporary tattoos, bandana, medal, and colored powder. There is no official timing, and participants must wear their race bib visibly throughout the event. There is no bag storage area. Access to the event area is granted with the wristband received at the entrance. The medal and colored powder are given out on event day. Children aged 0–6 have free admission.

name: Stara Planina 2026
description: Stara Planina Skiing 2026 is a four-day winter program offering skiing, sledding, walks, and socializing amid the unspoiled nature of Stara Planina. Enjoy the thrills and beautiful scenery at the Babin Zub ski resort, with over 13 kilometers of groomed runs of varying difficulty, including a freeride run and an artificial snowmaking system. The program is for skiers and winter sports enthusiasts, with departures from Belgrade and Niš and accommodation at Ždrma Inn. If there is not enough snow, hiking tours are organized, making the event accessible to nature lovers and those seeking an active holiday.

name: Vidra Gradac Trail
description: Vidra Gradac Trail offers a unique running experience along the Gradac River, known for its unspoiled nature and crystal-clear water. The course winds through a canyon rich in wildlife and varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky riverbanks, and stream crossings. This race combines natural beauty and adventure, making it ideal for runners who want to experience trail running at its most scenic. It takes place in Valjevo, Serbia, and is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia.

name: 5ο Livadia Night Run
description: The 5th Livadia Night Run is a night race held in Livadeia, near the Erkinas springs in the Krya area. The event features three distances: a 10 km main race, a 5 km race, and a 1 km race for students, welcoming runners of all ages and abilities. The race starts at 20:00, and timing is provided by CHRONOLOG using electronic chips. It is organized by the Athletic Swimming Club of Livadeia in cooperation with the Municipality of Livadeia, offering a local sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting.

name: 5ο Olympic Day Run
description: The 5th Olympic Day Run in Ancient Olympia is a unique and official Olympic running event that honors Greece as the birthplace of the Olympic Games. The race brings together Olympians, Paralympians, and distinguished athletes, creating a large Olympic running team. The event includes 8,000 m, 4,000 m, and 1,500 m races, with routes passing through the archaeological site and the ancient stadium of Olympia, offering a unique sporting and cultural experience. The event is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Olympic Committee and other important organizations, with the aim of highlighting Olympic heritage.

name: 10ο Πέρασμα Του Αποστόλου Παύλου
organizer: Δημο Πυδνας Κολινδρου και Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δρομέων Ν. Πιερίας «ΥΓΕΣ»
description: The 10th Anniversary “The Passage of the Apostle Paul” Road Race is organized by the Holy Metropolis of Kitros, Katerini and Platamon, the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros, and the “ZEUS” Athletic and Cultural Runners’ Association of Pieria. The race is 10,000 meters long and follows a paved route through the villages of Methoni and Makrygialos. The start is at the Church of the Apostle Paul in Methoni’s central square, and the finish is at Ancient Pydna. It is a scenic route with gentle ascents and descents, marked along its entire length.

name: Triglav Skyrun
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain running race held in the wild, high-altitude area of Central Balkan National Park. The courses pass iconic mountain huts and nature reserves, with the Sky distance including an ascent of Mount Golyam Kademliya (2275.4 m). The race starts in the picturesque village of Tazha, which offers impressive views of the rocky massif. The event is suited to lovers of mountain running and nature who are looking for a challenge and adventure.
course_highlights: The Sky course passes three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka
Pass through Sokolna Reserve, with its pristine nature
Climb Mount Golyam Kademliya (2275.4 m) on the Full Triglav course
additional: Race packs are distributed in the village of Tazha from 15:00 to 18:00 on the day before the race and from 6:00 on race day. The awards ceremony takes place at 14:00, with prizes and singlets for the top finishers. Participants can order a designer Triglav Skyrun 2027 singlet during registration. Participants under 18 may enter only the BASE and SHORT distances, with a signed parental consent form. Volunteer opportunities are available to help with the organization and safety of the event.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Run Barefoot with a Smile is a unique event held in picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers the opportunity to run barefoot, combining sport and enjoyment amid nature. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running without shoes in beautiful, inspiring surroundings.

name: Crosul Supereroilor
description: The Superheroes Run is an energizing race that brings together thousands of participants in Cluj-Napoca as part of Sports Festival. The event promotes team spirit and fun, offering a unique sporting experience in the heart of the city. Participants can enjoy a vibrant atmosphere and challenges on routes suited to all ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Urban route in the Cluj Arena area
Event part of Sports Festival
Friendly, energizing atmosphere for all ages
additional: The 2025 edition took place at Cluj Arena, and half of the registration fee went to the Via Transilvanica project by the Tășuleasa Social Association.

name: SPORTS FESTIVAL Alergăm pentru Cluj!
description: Sports Festival is the largest multisport event in Romania, held in Cluj-Napoca. The festival combines sports competitions, introductory activities, demonstrations, concerts, and educational events, offering a unique sports and entertainment experience for all ages. Crosul Supereroilor, a 5 km and 10 km race, is an important part of the festival, motivating participants to run for a social cause in support of the Via Transilvanica community. The event brings together champions, supporters, and sports enthusiasts in a festive and welcoming setting.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.sportsfestival.com/crosul-supereroilor/): 2027-06-13 — "Supereroii se aliniază din nou la start, în 13 iunie 2027!" (was estimated 2027-06-20)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Supereroii se aliniază din nou la start, în 13 iunie 2027!

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event for amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy an outdoor ride or compete for a place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully prepared to protect the natural environment, and course markings will be kept to a minimum to respect the forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including children’s races and options for families with special discounts. In the event of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled to a backup date.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race that brings together runners of all ages and their families, including pets, to support free psychotherapy services. The event takes place in Herăstrău Park in Bucharest and offers accessible, dynamic courses suitable for amateurs, families, and people with disabilities. Participants receive superhero costumes and themed kits, and every kilometer run contributes to a noble cause. The atmosphere is full of energy, fun, and community solidarity.
course_highlights: Flat, fully marked urban courses suitable for runners of all levels
A special course accessible to people with disabilities
Pets are welcome, with dedicated areas for families and children
additional: Participants receive the official T-shirt, a superhero cape, themed accessories, a surprise bag, a race number, and a medal. Hydration stations, medical assistance, security, and secure baggage storage are provided. The event includes prizes for the top 3 finishers in the 7 km and 3 km races.

name: Sunrise Marathon
description: The Sunrise Marathon in Bačka Palanka supports the mission of the Sunrise Association, an organization that provides free summer day camps for children with cancer and their siblings. Runners are invited to join Team Sunrise and help bring joy and happiness back to children battling this disease through running and fundraising. By taking part in the race, participants have the opportunity to support unique programs and camps that bring smiles and hope to children around the world.

name: 8ο Γράμμος Mountain Run
description: The 8th Grammos Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race held in the beautiful Mastorochoria region, in the village of Plikati, Municipality of Konitsa. It features two routes, 21 km and 10 km, both starting and finishing in the village square. The 21 km route follows the ridge of the Grammos mountain range, with a total elevation difference of over 1,680 meters, offering a unique experience for runners with good fitness and mountain-running experience. The race starts at 10:00 a.m. for the 21 km and at 10:30 a.m. for the 10 km, with full support and amenities for participants.

name: 13ος Δρόμος Σέιχ Σου
description: The 13th Seich Sou Run is a trail-running race organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association. The routes include 10 km, 16 km, and a 3 km fun run through Thessaloniki’s Seich Sou peri-urban forest. The race aims to introduce citizens to the natural environment and promote exercise and forest conservation. The event is supported by O.M.A.K. Kalamaria and offers an opportunity for easy trail running in a natural and historic setting.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The XVI Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), with the aim of preserving, developing, and promoting Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, songs, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folklore performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.

name: Zlatitsa Run
description: Zlatitsa Run is a running event held in the town of Zlatitsa. The course offers a chance to take on a sporting challenge amid the area’s beautiful natural surroundings. The event is suitable for runners of different levels and aims to bring the community together around sport and an active lifestyle.

name: Roșia Montană Marathon
description: Roșia Montană Marathon is a sports, eco and socio-cultural event held in the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană, Alba County. The 13th edition in 2026 celebrates the area’s nature, history and cultural heritage, offering varied routes for runners of all levels. The event includes marathon, half-marathon, cross-country and children’s races, on routes combining mountain trails, local roads and sections of paved road. Along the way, participants can admire natural landscapes and historic architecture in a setting that promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Routes with elevation changes along mountain trails and local roads
A combination of mountain and road running
Natural landscapes and centuries-old architectural heritage
additional: The program also includes cultural and social activities, such as creative workshops and concerts. The routes are suitable for both mountain runners and road runners. The event features cultural and environmental activities, community projects and educational initiatives, offering an opportunity to support the area’s natural and cultural heritage.

name: Mediaș Summer Trails
description: Mediaș Summer Trails is an annual mountain-running event held in Mediaș, offering participants the opportunity to explore varied and scenic trails in nature. The event is organized by the Binderbubi Backyard Running community, which promotes a passion for running and authentic outdoor activity. The courses vary in difficulty and length, making them suitable for both experienced runners and families. Participants can discover beautiful scenery and enjoy a friendly, supportive atmosphere.
course_highlights: The 24 km course with +684 m elevation gain
The 12 km course with +348 m elevation gain
The 1.4 km Family Run course with +34 m elevation gain
additional: Participants can download GPX files for each course to track their run. There is a special challenge offering a free entry to the person who draws the longest possible route on the streets of Mediaș, subject to strict rules about the route and GPS validation. The group organizes weekly group runs, usually on Tuesdays and Thursdays, for all experience levels. The events have positive elevation gains of approximately 34 m (Family Run), 155 m (6.5 km), 348 m (12 km), and 684 m (24 km). The start is scheduled for 09:30.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both mountain runners and road runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Children’s Race, which follows age-group routes in the historic center of the village. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage.

name: Crosul Hoia
description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Cross-Country Run is a running race held in Cluj-Napoca, giving participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race takes place in June, swapping urban asphalt for nature and offering an outdoor running experience.

name: Urlea Super Vertical
description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme and innovative mountain race held in the Breaza area of the Făgăraș Mountains. It is Romania’s most challenging vertical race, covering a distance of 12 km with 1,833 m of elevation gain and reaching an altitude of 2,474 m. Its unique format includes an up-and-down relay, where one partner climbs and the other descends, offering an intense and spectacular experience. The race focuses on vertical adrenaline and mountain spectacle, and is a first for Romanian mountain running.
course_highlights: 12 km with 1,833 m of elevation gain, reaching an altitude of 2,474 m
UP + DOWN relay format, with one partner climbing and the other descending
Route along a forest road and logging road, through deciduous and coniferous forests, and across alpine pasture
additional: Payment is accepted exclusively by bank card, and registration is valid only after full payment. Participants receive a personalized race bib (those who register after 15 July receive a non-personalized bib). Engraved stone finisher medals and an HG superlight technical T-shirt are provided to the first 300 registrants. Aid and hydration stations along the route, a hot meal on the route, medical assistance, photo albums with selfie identification, parking for 360 cars, and Q&A sessions and themed workshops are provided.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: The Târnava Marathon is a trail running event held in Târnăveni, Mureș County, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon offers an outdoor experience surrounded by the natural landscapes of the Transylvania region. The start and finish take place on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare, and the competition includes several running routes for all ages and fitness levels. The event brings together a community of passionate athletes and supports environmental education and the benefits of running in nature.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare
A variety of trail running routes: half marathon 21 km, cross-country 10 km, cross-country 4 km, and Kids Trail Running
Natural landscapes in the Transylvania region, in Mureș County
additional: Race kits can be picked up the day before the event between 18:00 and 21:00 and on race day between 07:00 and 09:30. A fitness instructor leads a warm-up before the start. Races for children are organized by age group. After the competition, there is a Goulash Party, a concert, and the awards ceremony.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a traditional mountain running competition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain lovers from across the region. The event offers two races in an authentic mountain setting, with substantial elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The routes are marked and have hydration points, and the finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl, the event’s main partner. Participants receive a race kit with a race bib, a T-shirt (if registered by June 2), a medal, access to refreshment points, and medical assistance.
course_highlights: Cross route: 14 km with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain, featuring sustained climbs and technical descents
Half Marathon route: approx. 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain, for an extra challenge
Hydration points are set up along the routes (2 for the Cross, 4 for the Half Marathon)
additional: The start is at Podul Berdu, in the Ferneziu neighborhood, at the foot of Lake Firiza, accessible by bus no. 1. The race kit includes a chip-timed bib, a T-shirt (available only until June 2), a medal, access to refreshment points, and medical assistance. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl. The routes are marked with ribbons and arrows.

name: Ultramaraton Palić
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The race includes several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, starting and finishing at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathon runners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the race offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continually improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.

name: 9ο Koufalia Hill Run «Δήμητρα Ιορδανίδου»
description: The Koufalia Hill Run “Dimitra Iordanidou” is a distinctive event that combines the natural beauty of the Koufalia hills with an athletic challenge. It features 6- and 10-kilometer courses, mainly on dirt trails through a pine forest, with climbs and descents offering unique views of landmarks such as the Monastery of Gregory Palamas and Gavanas Cave. The event has a family-friendly character, with parallel activities for children and parents, and aims to promote sports and connection with nature in the local community. It honors the memory of Dimitra Iordanidou, who conceived the race and established it as an annual tradition.

name: Beyond Kerkini Running Experience
description: Beyond Kerkini Running Experience is a unique running event held at the Lithotopos Marina, next to Lake Kerkini. It offers routes combining varied landscapes and terrain, from flat paved roads to challenging mountain trails. Each route offers a distinctive view of the area’s natural beauty, with the chance to run among waterside rocks and through landscapes that change from sunrise to sunset. The event also includes free activities for families and children, making it a full-day sporting experience for everyone.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances for skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with impressive views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience in Bulgaria’s natural surroundings, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop approximately 5 km long with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose between three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
description: Organized by Veloclub Ilchov Bair, the event features disciplines such as cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on various courses and are required to follow safety and nature conservation rules. The race is suitable for enthusiasts of mountain biking and running in natural surroundings.

name: ISKRA Trail Kosmaj
description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Mount Kosmaj, giving participants the chance to enjoy dense forests and stunning views. The race is a great opportunity for a day out and socializing in the race village, located in the start and finish area. Three distances are available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages, with parental consent required for participants under 18. The organizer guarantees safety and a great atmosphere, and participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt if they register on time.

name: 3ο Panetoliko Mountain Trail Run
description: The 3rd Panetoliko Mountain Trail Run invites you to discover the wild, unexplored beauty of Mount Panetoliko through three spectacular routes. The races offer a unique mountain-running experience, with fir-covered slopes, waterfalls, alpine peaks, and scenic trails. The event welcomes both experienced runners and newcomers to the sport, offering electronic timing, refreshments, and transportation to and from the city of Agrinio. Experience the magic of the mountain and create unforgettable memories.

name: 3ο Galatsi Night Run
description: The 3rd Galatsi Night Run is a nighttime running event held in Galatsi, Athens, starting and finishing at the Galatsi Indoor Olympic Gymnasium – PALAIS. The 5 km course follows the city’s main road, Veikou Avenue. There is also a 1 km children’s race for primary school pupils within the PALAIS grounds. The event encourages citizens to take part in sport and physical exercise, with an emphasis on safety and an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: 5ο Orestis Run
description: The 5th ORESTIS Road Race in Orestiada is a sporting event that attracts runners and sports enthusiasts from the area. The race offers an opportunity to take part in an organized route through the city, promoting health and physical activity. The event is friendly and open to everyone, aiming to strengthen the local community and promote sport. It has become an important sporting occasion for the Orestiada area.

name: Go Florina – Run The City Experience
description: The Municipality of Florina and GoEvents are organizing the two-day GO FLORINA - RUN THE CITY running event, a sporting and cultural occasion that combines athletics with the beauty of the city of Florina. The races take place on June 20 and 21, starting and finishing at Georgiou Modi Square. Runners of all ages and abilities are invited to take part in routes through the city and along the Sakoulevas River, enjoying the area’s distinctive atmosphere. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 3 km night race, and a 1 km participation run for families and children.

name: 25ο «Στα Χνάρια του Απόστολου Παύλου»
description: The 25th “In the Footsteps of the Apostle Paul” Road Race and Power Walk is organized by the Municipality of Corinth and symbolically retraces the route followed by the Apostle Paul in the area. The race starts at the ancient port of Kechries and finishes in the central square of Ancient Corinth. The 11.4-kilometer route includes three support stations. It is a historic and cultural route that combines sport and tradition.

name: SNF Nostos Run
description: The SNF Nostos Run 2026 is a much-loved evening road race organized by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation, returning on June 23 to celebrate 30 years of the Foundation’s philanthropic work. The race includes 10 km and 6 km routes, as well as a 1 km route for Special Olympics athletes, starting at the Panathenaic Stadium and finishing at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center. The event emphasizes giving and solidarity: the Foundation will contribute three times the total amount raised through participation fees to support nonprofit organizations. Along the route, participants will enjoy music from percussion bands, with a DJ set at the finish. Timing is official, but the race is non-competitive.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodna Mountains, near Borșa, Maramureș. The event offers three distinct routes suited to different experience levels: the Puzdrelor route, the most difficult, for experienced runners; the Gărgălău route, a moderate challenge for well-prepared runners; and the Musceta route, a fast course with a large elevation drop. The race is part of the Carpathians Circuit and emphasizes the experience of running in nature amid spectacular mountain scenery. The organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to take part in an active weekend outdoors.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race starting and finishing in Sinaia Town Hall Square. The routes pass through scenic areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, giving runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain-running enthusiasts, with 10K and 21K races. Participants receive a race kit with a bib, timing chip, and medal, and the organizers provide free digital photo galleries.

name: Ultra Zărand History
location: Cetatea Șoimoș, Șoimoș, Lipova, Arad County, Romania
description: Ultra Zărand History is a mountain running competition held in the Șoimoș area, in the Zărand Mountains. The courses start and finish near Șoimoș Fortress and offer options for runners with different levels of experience, from shorter distances to an ultra trail.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Șoimoș Fortress.
Courses of 9 km, 23.5 km and 62 km.
Run along mountain trails in the Zărand Mountains.
additional: A race for children is also mentioned.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road-running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes, thousands of amateur runners, and children at the starting line. The festival combines competitive sport with the joy of movement and the city’s energy, offering a flat, fast course ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes races for children, open 5 km and 10 km races, and an elite race featuring top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with Mioveni City Hall and the city’s Cultural Center. The event brings together runners of all ages, from 3-year-old children to 78-year-old seniors, on varied 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes, as well as special races for the little ones. The atmosphere is vibrant, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations, and artistic performances, offering a day dedicated to health, community, and sporting fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania, and UHU Romania.

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
description: The Mioveni City Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus Romania, dedicated to promoting a spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded military personnel. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sporting competitions. Participants are encouraged to join in and support the values of honor and respect in a friendly and motivating setting.

name: Noćni maraton
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most popular races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is a 42 km marathon that requires dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings a special nighttime race atmosphere. There is also a mini marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich program on the course and after the race.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the chance to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are suited to all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy the natural beauty of Tornik, test their endurance and contribute to environmental protection through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.

name: 2ο Silk City Run
description: The 2nd Silk City Run in Soufli is a road race inviting amateur and experienced runners, families, and young people to enjoy a unique route through the city of silk. Running through the streets of Soufli is not just a race, but a journey toward a healthier, more balanced, and creative way of life. The Municipality of Soufli warmly welcomes all participants, offering an opportunity for renewal and energy.

name: 22ος Olympus Marathon
description: The Olympus Marathon is a unique 44-kilometer mountain race with a positive elevation gain of +3,350 meters, held on the mythical Mount Olympus. The route starts at the archaeological site of Dion and follows trails through forests, alpine meadows, and peaks, reaching Litochoro. The race honors the ancient tradition of pilgrims who climbed Mount Olympus to pay tribute to Zeus, offering runners a unique experience as they follow the traces of history on the mountain of the gods. It is a certified SKYRUNNING race and a challenge for experienced mountain runners.

name: Porto Heli Night Run
description: The Municipality of Ermionida and the Municipal Community of Porto Heli invite you to the major sporting celebration “Porto Heli Night Run.” The race is dedicated to the memory of Minoas Kyriakou and offers events for everyone, from an 11 km trail run and a 5 km night run to children’s races and a race for people with disabilities. Each participant will receive a commemorative T-shirt and medal, making for a unique sporting experience in beautiful Porto Heli.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings near Koprinka Reservoir, Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and an atmospheric experience.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a zero-waste race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful setting of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. The race brings together sports and nature enthusiasts, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging course through forested areas and mountain terrain. The Festival of a Healthy Spirit, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in the heart of Serbia.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different fitness levels, from a vertical climb to an ultra-long 62 km course with significant elevation gain. The routes pass through hidden and scenic parts of Tara, giving runners an unforgettable experience of nature and a challenge for body and mind. In addition to the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events take place at the finish, creating a unique atmosphere for participants and visitors alike.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
