organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The first Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships will be held in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition features four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, bringing together the best mountain runners in the Balkans. The courses are varied and challenging, with spectacular scenery and technical climbs, offering a true challenge and the chance to enjoy nature. The organizers are the Balkan Mountaineering Union, Mountaineering Association of Serbia, Tara Ultra Trail, and Tara Mountaineering Club. We invite all runners to join us and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.

name: Troyan Run
distance_verbose: 70 km, 69 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 6 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is a mountain race held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the work of Vasil Levski. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain-running enthusiasts. It is organized by the “Troyan in the Future” association, which works to promote the area’s historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sport. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.

name: Вършец ултра
description: Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for experienced ultrarunners, beginners, and children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. Participants can choose between the 48 km ultra distance and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. The race combines sport, nature, and an opportunity for an active getaway in the national resort of Varshets.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Sands is a unique running event held along Bulgaria’s longest beach, between Kamchia Resort Complex and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River, with rescue equipment and assistance facilities provided. The event offers two main distances—10 km and 21.1 km—as well as a 2.2 km children’s race. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 102 km, 58 km, 57 km, 45 km, 44 km, 36 km, 23 km, 6 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race held at Complex Cheile Grădiștei in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and Piatra Craiului. The event offers six individual race options, with distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature, in a friendly and well-organized setting. Registration is limited and takes place online.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
A range of distances from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: Registration is limited and can be completed online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by donations from participants, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation requires an online form; registration is limited, and wildcards may be available to recognized athletes.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the Călimănești-Căciulata spa resort. The event, organized by the Pegas Triathlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and humanitarian fundraising. Participants take on three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require experience and mountain skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race all runners are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery.

name: Siriu Open Water JOY ~ 2027
location: Barajul Siriu, Siriu, Buzău County, Romania

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, Bacău, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and along the ridges of the Nemira massif. Participants can choose between a half marathon and a cross-country race, both featuring significant elevation gain and well-marked routes. The event emphasizes the mountain experience and promotes active tourism and ecotourism in the area, amid beautiful, unspoiled nature. The event is praised for its clear markings, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through shady forests and alpine areas with unspoiled natural scenery
Approximately 25 km half marathon with 1,100 m of positive elevation gain
Approximately 14 km cross-country race with 700 m of positive elevation gain, including sections of asphalt and runnable forest road
additional: The routes are marked 90% with hiking trail markings, supplemented by plastic tape and signs where needed. Participants should have mountain experience and be prepared for difficult sections, including passages with fixed ropes. The start is in the Central Park of the Slănic Moldova resort. The organizers recommend booking accommodation early, as the resort has limited capacity during peak season.

name: 4ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Κακολύρι 1944
organizer: Δήμος Κύμης – Αλιβερίου και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Ταξιαρχών
description: The 4th “Kakolyri 1944” Memorial Run honors the victims of the 1944 massacre in the village of Taxiarches. It is organized by the Municipality of Kymi-Aliveri and the Taxiarches Cultural Association, with support from cultural associations and communities in the area. The event includes a 21 km half-marathon, a 5 km race, and a 1.2 km children’s race, with routes passing through historic villages and natural landscapes. The race offers electronic timing, commemorative medals and T-shirts, as well as full support with aid stations and medical coverage.

name: Coast To Coast Run
description: The Coast to Coast Run in Ierapetra, Crete, is a 21,100-meter half marathon that starts at Pachia Ammos Beach and finishes at Minos Square in Ierapetra, crossing the narrowest point of Crete amid beautiful natural scenery and the Ha Gorge. A 5,000-meter race and a 1,000-meter children’s race are also held in the town of Ierapetra. The event has a cultural and tourism focus, offering a unique experience that connects the northern and southern coasts of Eastern Crete. The organizers provide transportation for athletes and ensure the races are held safely.

name: Вършец рън
description: Varshets Run and Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a variety of distances suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners and children. The event takes place in the picturesque resort town of Varshets, with the start in front of the Medicus Hotel. The courses include a 48 km ultra distance, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, offering opportunities for participants of different levels. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform, and race packs are collected at the Varshets Municipality.

name: Maraton La Fetești
description: La Fetești Marathon is a trail running event in Moldova featuring three races: Cross (14 km), Half Marathon (23 km) and Marathon. The routes start at the “La Fetești” Tourism Promotion Center and pass through remarkable historical and natural sites, including Fetești Nature Reserve, Little Switzerland, the Trinca Canyon and La Castel Nature Reserve, with their labyrinths of caves and rocks. The event offers a running experience in nature, combining a sporting challenge with picturesque scenery and local cultural elements. The start is scheduled for the morning, and the races have significant elevation changes, making them suitable for runners with different levels of fitness.
course_highlights: Routes through Fetești Nature Reserve and Little Switzerland
Trinca Canyon and La Castel Nature Reserve, with labyrinths of caves and rocks
Elevation gains of between 300 m and 470 m D+ over the 14 km and 23 km distances
additional: The start is at the “La Fetești” Tourism Promotion Center. The Cross race has a 2-hour time limit. The race kit, timing and prizes are mentioned on the website, but no specific details are provided on the pages reviewed. The weekend also includes hikes, camping, a music festival and a local producers’ fair.

name: Treska Trail
description: Join an adventurous hiking tour with Kežman Mountain Houses to the summit of Treska on Kopaonik. This short 650-meter trail leads to an impressive peak at 1,622 meters above sea level, offering beautiful panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The trail is well marked and suitable for all guests. The ascent takes about 30 minutes, giving you the chance to enjoy nature and take photos. Organized tours are available to all accommodation guests, with transportation to the trailhead.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
distance_verbose: 5 km, 3000 metara, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km, 0.2 km
description: The Race Around Avala is a traditional event organized by the Serbian Masters Athletics Association. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Avala and brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels. It is an opportunity for sporting camaraderie and for promoting athletics among masters and recreational runners. The start and finish are at an attractive location, and the course offers both challenges and enjoyment of nature.

name: 8ο Skloupo Trail Run
description: The 8th Skloupo Trail Run is a trail race held in the picturesque village of Ampelochori (Skloupo), in the Municipality of North Tzoumerka. It features three routes: 13.5 km, 5 km, and a 1 km Kids Race, offering a unique experience through fir and conifer forests, with steep climbs and descents. The course combines dirt trails and paved sections, passing beautiful natural landscapes and historic sites in the village. The race is open to runners of all ages, with special care for younger participants.

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 series and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to challenging mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain course with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km course suitable for beginner and intermediate runners, through forests and rolling hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, challenging climb
additional: The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, and the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA series is conditional on holding a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The courses are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon 2026 is a unique trail event in western Serbia, bringing together lovers of nature, endurance, and extreme races. It takes place on July 10 and 11 in Prijepolje, with the start and finish at the Cultural Center Plaza. All the courses are new and do not repeat those from the previous edition, and the races are suited to different fitness levels and runner categories. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, promotional materials, and a finisher’s medal, while the organizers also provide support with accommodation and meals.

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The Under-20 National Championships, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that brings together Bulgaria’s best young athletes. It takes place at a stadium in Sofia and offers young athletes an opportunity to develop and showcase their talents in athletics. The competition is part of the BAF’s 2026 sports calendar and is held under the auspices of Bulgaria’s leading athletics organization, which has a long-standing tradition and international recognition.

name: TRI Legend Batak 2026
description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event held at Batak Reservoir, offering three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay. The race brings together a community of people who push their limits and value friendship and support. The Legend distance is a classic middle-distance triathlon with a 1.9 km swim, 90 km cycle, and 21 km run, while Turbo is shorter and more intense, suitable for beginners. The Relay option allows teams to compete, with each member completing a different discipline.
course_highlights: Legend: 1.9 km swim, 90 km cycle, 21 km run
Turbo: 0.9 km swim, 52 km cycle, 10 km run
Marked course with aid stations and legendary organization
additional: 120 places for the Legend distance, 60 places for Turbo, and 20 teams for Legend Relay. The race promotes community and shared victory. Participants receive a race pack and can enjoy an atmosphere of friendship and support.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event for both amateurs and experienced runners. It features five scenic courses suitable for all fitness levels: K13 Cross, K24 Half Marathon, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Marathon, and Family Run. All start at the base of the Clabucet ski slope.
course_highlights: 100% trail running routes through forests and mountain paths
Challenging climbs, including over 500 m of elevation gain over 4 km on K24
Spectacular views from Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cross, K24 Half Marathon, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Marathon, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clabucet ski slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape bearing the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cut-off times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can register in various race categories, and the event supports a social cause. Registration details and rules are available on the official website.

images.alt_text: Peisaj montan cu stânci și pădure, potecă de trail pentru alergare în Predeal Forest Run.

name: Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon was first organized by the Jadovnik Citizens’ Association on the mountain of the same name. The race aims to showcase the beauty and rich flora and fauna of Mount Jadovnik, which has so far been little known to the public. This ultramarathon offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the challenge and special appeal of running in unspoiled nature. The organizers aim to preserve and promote the mountain through sport and community.

name: Sova Night Trail
description: Sova Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Divčibare, known for its clean air and beautiful viewpoints. The race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy adventure tourism and the natural beauty of the area, with trails winding through forest scenery and mountain landscapes. The event brings together running and nature enthusiasts, offering an unforgettable experience beneath the starry sky.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the mountain trails of Divčibare
A night race with a distinctive atmosphere and lighting
Beautiful viewpoints and unspoiled nature along the route
additional: The race package includes a bib number, refreshments on the course, and a finisher’s medal. An accompanying program is planned after the race.

name: XL kmrun - Сеславци
description: XLkmrun is an organized, non-professional athletics race over middle and long distances, offering a challenge for runners of varying fitness levels. The event takes place in Sofia and is part of the 5KM RUN initiative, which promotes a healthy lifestyle through free but organized running. It is an opportunity for anyone interested to take part in a sporting atmosphere that supports diversity and community.

name: ALEARGĂ TU PENTRU EI by HOSPICE Casa Sperantei
distance_verbose: 20 km, 18 km, 10 km, 6 km, 4 km, 2 km, 0.9 km
description: “Run YOU for Them” is a running event organized by HOSPICE Casa Speranței in Brașov to support the organization’s work. Previous editions have featured races for different ability levels, from short races for children and beginners to distances of 20 km. The 2027 event is scheduled for July 11 in the Aleea Tiberiu Brediceanu area.
course_highlights: Located in the Aleea Tiberiu Brediceanu area of Brașov
Previous editions offered distances from 900 m to 20 km
Charity event organized by HOSPICE Casa Speranței
additional: Previous editions have included races of 900 m, 2 km, 4 km, 6 km, 10 km, 18 km, and 20 km.

name: 4ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Μυτιλήνης
description: The 4th Mytilene Night Run is a popular nighttime road race held in the city of Mytilene. The 5- and 10-kilometer routes cross the city, starting and finishing at Tsamakia, with much of the course running along pedestrian streets to minimize disruption to traffic. The race is organized by the Lesvos Runners Association in cooperation with the Municipality of Mytilene and other local organizations, offering a unique running experience under the night sky. High participation and a warm atmosphere characterize the race, which has become an established event on the island of Lesvos.

name: 15ος Faethon Skyrace
description: The 15th Faethon Skyrace “Apostolos Tsourekas” will take place in Kokkinoplos on Mount Olympus. This is a challenging mountain race offering two routes: the Faethon SkyRace, 23 km with +1,800 m of elevation gain on alpine terrain, and the Faethon Trail, 14 km with +400 m, passing through historic trails and lush forests. The event also includes the Faethonaki Run, a 1 km children’s race that gives children the chance to discover mountain running. The race starts from the central square of the village of Kokkinoplos, and the event embodies a vision rooted in love for Mount Olympus and mountain running.

name: 7ος Καραμάνειος Δρόμος Υγείας
description: The 7th Karamanios Health Run is a 3-kilometer race held in Drakeia, Pelion, in memory of Dr. Georgios Karamanis, who established the first mountain sanatorium in Greece in the early 1900s. The race has a charitable purpose and honors the doctor’s history and contribution to the area. Participants can register on race day from 18:00 at the starting point. After the race, an event follows featuring a documentary screening and poetry.
course_highlights: A 3-kilometer race in Drakeia, Pelion
Honoring Georgios Karamanis, founder of the first mountain sanatorium in Greece
A mountain setting with historical significance
additional: Registration is available on race day from 18:00 at the starting point.

name: Трявна ултра
distance_verbose: 100 km, 70 km, Маратон, 25 km, Полумаратон, 3000 метра
description: Tryavna Ultra is a mountain race offering varied courses through the heart of Tryavna and the Central Balkan Mountains. The event combines mountain running and cycling with a friendly, family atmosphere, and the routes return to town, where the square comes alive. Participants can choose from different distances and duathlons to suit a range of levels and preferences. Tryavna is known for its cobbled streets, historic architecture, and beautiful forest trails, making the event unique and appealing to mountain enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Courses through the heart of Tryavna, with cobbled streets and historic architecture
Routes in the Central Balkan Mountains, featuring forest trails and scenic natural views
A combination of mountain running and cycling, with duathlon options
additional: The event takes place from 16–18 July 2027, with multiple starts for the different distances and duathlons. It offers a family atmosphere and the option to take part in short and long courses, including the Decathlon 3 km Run. The routes are designed to return to the town centre, making logistics easier and creating a lively atmosphere.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Maraton Bate Toaca is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit. The event offers two main courses: the 18 km Cursa Dochia, with approximately 1,500 m of elevation gain, and the 31 km Cursa Bate Toaca, with approximately 2,700 m of elevation gain. The courses pass through spectacular scenery, including Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi, and Vf. Toaca, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 is a mountain running event organized by the Sport fără Limite Vâlcea Association, promoting the beauty of Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The event takes place in the village of Bărbătești, Vâlcea, and offers a variety of races for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from children’s races, cross-country races, and mountain courses of 11, 18, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular scenery and authentic mountain challenges.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
description: Burduf Challenge is a mountain running event held in Râu Sadului, Sibiu. The event features three races on scenic subalpine routes with significant elevation changes, for adults as well as children and teenagers. Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the entry fee, and after the race runners are invited to a brunch featuring local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the preservation of mountain cultural heritage in the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains area.

name: Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR)
description: The Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR) race is the largest mountain running event in Greece, offering a unique experience amid the natural beauty and culture of the Zagori region. With routes crossing stone bridges and villages and passing through the impressive Vikos Gorge, runners can test their endurance on challenging trails with significant elevation changes. ZMR features multiple routes, from a 5 km race for everyone to the two-day 93 km Challenge, catering to different levels of difficulty and experience. The event is welcoming and professional, with an emphasis on athlete safety and support.

name: XCO National Championship 2026 (ДЛШ и ХОБИ)
location: Knyazhevska Gora Park, Knyazhevo, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: The 2026 XCO National Championship in Knyazhevo is one of the most anticipated events on Bulgaria’s mountain biking calendar. The race features a dynamic XCO course with technical sections and fast descents, creating a true competitive atmosphere. The event is open to both competitors in the National Championship and recreational riders in the Hobby category. Registration is free. A valid UCI licence is required for the National Championship, and a temporary Hobby licence is required for the Hobby category.
course_highlights: Dynamic XCO course with technical sections
Fast descents
Competitive atmosphere amid nature in Knyazhevska Forest Park
additional: A valid racing UCI licence is required to compete in the National Championship, while a temporary Hobby licence is required for the Hobby category. Categories are planned for different ages and skill levels.

name: SZENT GELLERT CROSS
location: Kakastaréj Fogadó, Ditrău, Harghita County, Romania
description: Szent Gellért Cross is a mountain running competition held in Ditrău at Kakastaréj Fogadó, offering athletes of all ages an excellent opportunity to enjoy running in nature. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and gives participants the chance to discover the area’s natural and cultural beauty. The competition includes races for adults, children, and families, with varied courses and prizes for the top runners. The organizers provide amenities such as free camping spots and a welcoming environment for athletes.
course_highlights: Varied courses for adults, children, and families, with distances from 500 m to 45 km
The start and competition hub are at Kakastaréj Fogadó, surrounded by the nature of Ditrău
An opportunity to discover the natural landscapes and local attractions of the commune of Ditrău
additional: The start and race-pack pickup take place at Kakastaréj Fogadó. Free tent pitches are available. On-site registration is possible on competition days, but without an official T-shirt. There is a technical briefing and warm-up before the start. The start is at Kakastaréj Fogadó in Ditrău. A free camping spot is available.

name: 15ο Zagori Mountain Running
distance_verbose: 93 km, 60 km, 33 km, Ημιμαραθώνιος, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Zagori Mountain Running race is Greece’s largest mountain running event, offering a unique experience through the imposing landscapes of Zagori. The routes cross stone bridges, the Vikos Gorge, and the Tymfi mountain range, combining natural beauty with challenging terrain. With a range of route options from 5 km to 93 km, the race caters to all preferences and levels of runners. The event is welcoming and well organized, with an emphasis on safety and athlete support.

name: Ο Δρόμος του Αλατιού
description: The Road of Salt is a running event held in Messolonghi, offering 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m races. The event emphasizes accurate electronic timing and excellent organization, aiming to provide an unforgettable experience for runners from all over Greece. It combines sporting spirit with local tradition, attracting participants of all ages and abilities. The organizers ensure prompt publication of results and provide commemorative certificates of participation.

name: Up to Postăvaru
description: Up to Postăvaru is a multi-discipline sporting event held in Poiana Brașov, featuring trail running, MTB, downhill, and e-MTB events. The courses are designed to be accessible and welcoming, suitable for all experience levels, offering an active outdoor experience with beautiful views. The event promotes physical activity and the joy of cycling or running outdoors in a spectacular mountain setting. Participants can choose between uphill races, technical descents, or runs on trails and forest roads. The atmosphere combines community spirit with friendly competition, with prizes and activities for all ages.
course_highlights: An easy, welcoming MTB route through forests and along forest roads, with beautiful views
Downhill descent on the black trail in Postăvaru Bike Park, starting at Lacul Ruia
A 7 km trail-running route with 210 m of positive elevation gain, combining trails and forest roads
additional: Race numbers can be collected from the Race Office at OutdoorFun Bike Rental, in the car park towards Swissotel. The start and finish for running, MTB, and kids’ MTB are at the same location, while the e-MTB finish is at Yager Chalet. A valid UCI licence is mandatory for downhill. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or have a legal consent declaration. Pre-booked shuttles and transport options from nearby airports are available. The schedule may be subject to changes announced in advance. The event includes running, MTB, E-MTB, and events for children.

name: Boogie To The Van 8k fun run
description: Boogie To The Van is a fun 8 km race held in Brezoi, offering participants an enjoyable and accessible experience. The event is open to runners of all levels and promotes exercise and socializing in a relaxed setting. The course is designed to be accessible and enjoyable, ideal for those who want to enjoy running without competitive pressure.
course_highlights: 8 km course through Brezoi
Fun run accessible to all levels
Relaxed and friendly atmosphere

name: Балкан ултра
description: Balkan Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in the area around Pleven Hut, Apriltsi. The courses include technical sections with significant elevation gain and require good physical fitness and mountain experience. Participants can choose between two main distances—Sky and Ultra—each with a unique route through beautiful and demanding mountain terrain. The race offers impressive views and varied trails, including routes over peaks such as Botev and Mlechni Chal.

name: Магура Run
description: Magura RUN is a running event held near the village of Rabisha, Belogradchik, in northwestern Bulgaria. The event celebrates a love of movement and running, inviting all runners to take part regardless of their pace. The course offers a unique experience in nature, with the chance to run at both sunset and sunrise, combining sport with the beauty of the local landscape. The organizers, BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, put a great deal of effort and energy into creating an authentic and challenging event that may be the last of its kind because of changes in nature.
course_highlights: The course passes by Rabisha Lake and through the area around the village of Rabisha
The chance to run at sunset and sunrise
Held amid the scenic natural landscapes of northwestern Bulgaria
additional: The event is organized by BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, with an emphasis on authenticity and energy. Possible challenges in preparing for the event include finding workers to clear the course. The race takes place on July 27 and 28 near Rabisha Lake. No information is provided about start times, prices, or registration.

name: Национален шампионат под 23г.
description: The National U18 Championships is one of the largest competitions on the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar. The competition includes a variety of events, with the discus and hammer events held at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad. Traditionally, the championships bring together young athletes from across the country, giving them the opportunity to compete at a high level and showcase their talent. The event is organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.

name: ТОДОРКА ВЕРТИКАЛ 2026
description: Todorка Vertical is a classic speed ascent in the Pirin Mountains, organized by the AlPirinSki sports club. The race takes place on the steep Tomba and Todorka ski slopes in the Bansko area and offers a test of spirit, willpower, and love of the mountains. The event attracts both serious competitors and children taking part in the children’s course, creating an atmosphere of sportsmanship and positive emotions. The organizers aim to encourage moving uphill and create unforgettable memories for all participants.
course_highlights: Speed ascent on the steep Tomba and Todorka ski slopes
The course is one of the steepest in Bulgaria
Panoramic views of the Pirin Mountains
additional: More than 250 children also take part in the children’s course. The organizers provide race packs and prizes for the winners. The race takes place in a cheerful atmosphere, with the support of numerous partners and volunteers. A one-day insurance policy is included for the classic course; mountain rescue services, a medical team, timing, and photography are provided.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Ne revedem pe sâmbătă, 24 iulie 2027.

name: Get Muddy
description: Get Muddy is a charity obstacle race held along the banks of the Trinkbach stream in Sibiu. It combines fun with a good cause: supporting cancer patients through the Sus Inima Association. The 3-kilometer course features rough terrain, water, and obstacles, with the focus on participants helping one another rather than on athletic performance. The event is open to individual runners, teams, and children, offering an energetic experience full of solidarity and mud. Participants commit to raising funds to support the cause of cancer, and the atmosphere is one of community and mutual support.
course_highlights: A 3-kilometer course with rough terrain, water, and obstacles along the banks of the Trinkbach stream
The focus is on helping one another, not on running times
A charity race supporting cancer patients through the Sus Inima Association
additional: Children aged 7–13 may participate with the written consent of a parent or legal guardian, who must also be present at the event. The participation fee is non-refundable and is treated as a donation if a participant does not show up at the start. Taking part in the obstacles is optional, and the event is not a competitive athletic race. Each participant receives a personal fundraising page. Registration includes a personal fundraising page, and participants commit to raising at least 250 lei for the cause.

name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks
description: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB invites you to explore the wild heart of the Eastern Carpathians, one of Europe’s last authentic wilderness areas. With six races ranging from a fast 15 km run to a 114 km challenge, the routes cross rocky ridges, UNESCO-protected old-growth forests, medieval sheepfolds, and impressive natural landscapes such as Moara Dracului Gorge and Pietrele Doamnei. Expect steep climbs, technical trails, and authentic mountain conditions, with every kilometre offering a unique experience in the European wilderness.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: H2: SATURDAY - 24.07.27

name: Cer Night trail
description: Cer Night Trail is a night race held on Mount Cer, known for its beautiful natural scenery and challenging trails. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts who enjoy running through forests and mountain terrain beneath the starry sky. The event is part of the Cer Trail race series, which promotes community, perseverance, and a love of nature. Cer Night Trail gives runners the opportunity to experience the magic of night trail running in the unique setting of Mount Cer.
course_highlights: A night race through the forests and mountain terrain of Mount Cer
Challenging trails with natural obstacles and beautiful views
A sense of community and support among runners
additional: Cer Night Trail is part of the Cer Trail race series, which also includes Cer Winter Trail and Cer Ultra Trail. The race is a member of the UTMB and ITRA communities. The Instagram profile promotes the values of community, support, and runners’ strength, especially that of women. Photos and videos from previous races are available on the Instagram profile.

name: 10ο WAVE Running
description: The 10th WAVE Running returns in full force to the Keramoti–Avdira coastline, with Myrodato Beach in Xanthi as its main base. The anniversary event offers three routes of 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km through the unique natural environment of the Nestos Delta. Parallel activities highlight the event’s character and philosophy, including beach cleanups, an exhibition of local products, and musical performances, creating a complete celebration of sport, nature, and culture.

name: Ημεράσια
location: Church of the Transfiguration of the Savior, Kato Lousoi, Kalavryta, Greece
organizer: Πολιτιστικός & Εξωραϊστικός Σύλλογος Κάτω Λουσών «Ο Χελμός»
description: The Himerasia road race is an annual sporting event honoring the memory of Aristovoulos Petimezas, an Olympic champion at the Modern Olympic Games. Participants can run on a paved, mostly flat route through nature, alongside the slopes of the Aroania Mountains, starting from the Church of the Transfiguration of the Savior in the village of Kato Lousoi, Kalavryta. The race offers 5- and 10-kilometer routes, electronic timing, a commemorative T-shirt, a participation medal, and local products, creating a lovely festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: A paved, mostly flat route with a few uphill sections
A route alongside the slopes of the Aroania Mountains at an elevation of 1,070 meters
Start at the Church of the Transfiguration of the Savior in the village of Kato Lousoi
additional: Schedule: 17:30 Race office opens; 19:00 Start of the 5 km and 10 km races; 20:15 Start of the children's 500 m race; 20:30 Awards ceremony. The event also includes children's races of 500 and 1,000 meters.

name: 9ο Στα Χνάρια των Ηρώων
organizer: Δήμος Αλιάρτου-Θεσπιέων και Αθλητικός Σύλλογος Απόλλων Δυτικής Αττικής
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Heroes” ultramarathon covers 102 km from Thespies to Thermopylae. The route honors the Thespians who fell at the Battle of Thermopylae and connects two places of profound historical significance. Runners are invited to follow in the heroes’ footsteps on a demanding endurance course.
course_highlights: Start in Thespies and finish in Thermopylae.
A 102 km historic route connecting Boeotia with Thermopylae.
The route passes through the areas of Askri and Aliartos.
additional: Previous editions also offered relay options of 2×51 km and 4×25.5 km.

name: SEMIMARATON TARA DE PIATRĂ
description: The Țara de Piatră Half Marathon is a running race held in the Avram Iancu area, Câmpeni, Alba, Romania. Participants can choose from three races of different distances, running along routes through the Apuseni Mountains’ historic and natural landscapes, imbued with the spirit of their ancestors. The start is scheduled for 8:00, and transport to the starting line is provided by coach. Race kits can be picked up on Saturday and Sunday morning before the start. The event offers an authentic and energizing experience for runners of all levels.

name: 2ο Oinousses Run
description: The 2nd Oinousses Run is a unique event that combines running and cycling on the enchanting island of Oinousses. The 13 km running route passes the historic Monastery of the Annunciation and offers impressive views of Chios, while the 20 km cycling route makes a complete circuit of the island, with gentle climbs and fast descents. Participants enjoy a wonderful experience amid picturesque landscapes and coastal routes, with amenities including electronic timing, a medal, a commemorative T-shirt, and refreshment stations. The event is organized by Chios Cyclists and the Municipality of Oinousses, offering a friendly, summery sporting event.

name: Славееви Планини Ултра
distance_verbose: 55 km, 51 km, 33 km, 28 km, 16 km, 9 km
description: Slaveevi Planini Ultra 2026 is a trail running and mountain biking event held around the town of Dospat in the Rhodope Mountains. The event offers a range of distances from 9 to 56 km, with varying difficulty levels and up to 2,900 m of elevation gain. Participants can enjoy scenic forests, panoramic views, and fresh air, combining sport, adventure, and a love of the mountains. The start and finish are in the town center. The race is suitable for experienced runners and cyclists as well as enthusiasts looking for new challenges.
course_highlights: Distances from 9 to 56 km with up to 2,900 m of elevation gain
Route through scenic forests with panoramic views
Start and finish in the center of Dospat
additional: The race pack includes a medal, a souvenir featuring the event logo, timing, a race number, course marking, photo coverage, and aid stations. It does not include additional mandatory equipment.

name: Национален шампионат по шосейни бягания
description: The first national road running championship in Bulgaria will be held in Plovdiv. The race features distances of 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as starts for children and beginners. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and offers a prize fund of over 4,000 BGN. It is an important opportunity for amateur and professional runners to compete on attractive courses and prepare for European and world championships.

name: С ухание на малини и боровинки Run
description: With the scent of raspberries and blueberries, Run is an exciting trail running race held in northwestern Bulgaria, in the area around Midzhur Hut and Kopren Hut. Participants can choose from various courses with different difficulty levels and technical features, running amid breathtaking mountain views. The race offers adrenaline, new friendships, and a sense of accomplishment on every course. The organizers recommend wearing trail running shoes and remind participants that the race may be canceled in unfavorable weather conditions.

name: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare
description: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare is a mountain race offering challenging running and cycling courses in the Rhodope Mountains. The start and finish are at Olympic Square in the town of Chepelare, at an altitude of 1,062 m. The courses pass through Rhodope forests, mountain meadows, and panoramic trails, reaching a maximum elevation of 1,872 m. Participants can choose from three distances in each discipline, and the event is part of the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge.
course_highlights: The courses pass through Rhodope forests and mountain meadows
The highest point of the course is Mechi Chal Peak, at 1,872 m above sea level
Elevation change on the long course: +1,887 m of ascent and -1,885 m of descent
additional: The race pack includes a race bib with a timing chip, a special gift, magnesium, bottled water, and energy food. Every finisher receives a unique metal medal, and participants in both races in the series receive a special wooden medal display stand. Free parking is available at Vasil Dechev Secondary School. Payment can be made by bank transfer, EasyPay, ePay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

name: LATERAL Mures 24H ~ 2026
description: Lateral Mures 24H is an endurance sports event organized by the Mureș Runners Association, held in the heart of nature on the Cornești Plateau in Târgu Mureș. The competition includes 24-hour MTB and trail-running events, both individual and team, as well as a 12-hour running race and a one-lap 10.5 km race. The course is an approximately 10.5 km loop with 215 m of elevation gain, mostly through forest, clearly marked during the day and with reflective signs at night. The event promotes team spirit, endurance, and a passion for exercising in nature.

name: Tura Licuricilor ~ 2026
description: The 11th edition of Tura Licuricilor is a running event held in Franz Joseph Park in Timișoara, starting at 20:30. The event is part of the Alergotura series, which promotes running as a lifestyle and the local sports community. Participants can enjoy a pleasant outdoor run in an urban natural setting, ideal for runners of all levels. The organizers provide support and motivation for taking up running and encourage community involvement.

name: Mogoșa Everesting
organizer: Asociația Club Sportiv de Alergare Montană Maramureș
description: Mogoșa Everesting is a mountain running competition held at Lake Mogoșa, Maramureș, Romania. Participants can compete individually or in teams, completing laps on the mountain course to reach a total elevation gain equivalent to an Everesting. The event is organized by the Maramureș Mountain Running Sports Club Association and offers a challenging, community-oriented experience, with categories for juniors and teams. Entry fees are affordable, and registration is open until places are filled.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://mogosaeveresting.ro/): 2027-07-31 — "31 Iulie 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-07)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: 31 Iulie 2027

name: Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026
location: Restoran Na Vencu, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: The Night Challenge on Fruška Gora is a sports and recreational event for hikers, runners, and nature lovers. It takes place on three courses of varying lengths: Fan Hiking (7 km), Hobby Trail (11 km), and Sport Trail (19 km). The start is at 21:00 by the Na Vencu restaurant, and participants have a time limit of 4 hours and 15 minutes to complete the course, allowing even the slowest participants to finish successfully. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the nature of Fruška Gora at night.

name: 6. NIGHT CHALLENGE FRUŠKA GORA 2026
location: Spomenik Sloboda, Iriški venac, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: The 6th Night Challenge Fruška Gora 2026 is a night OCR race held in the unspoiled nature of Fruška Gora, starting at the Monument to Freedom, Iriški Venac. Competitors can choose between two courses, 7 km and 13 km, which wind through dense forest and natural obstacles, including unique water obstacles at Ledinačko Lake. The race combines adrenaline-pumping obstacles with beautiful scenery and concludes in a spirit of camaraderie and celebration at the end of the season. The event is part of the Invictus OCR League and is intended for everyone who wants to test their limits and enjoy sport and nature.

name: 4ο Nemea City Night Run
description: The 4th Nemea City Night Run is a night race held in the city of Nemea, Corinthia. The event offers a unique running experience through the city, combining sport with a nighttime atmosphere. The race attracts runners who want to enjoy a different route in a historic setting. The race announcement and details are expected to be released soon.

name: 13ο Ikaria Run
organizer: Εξωραϊστικός και Εκπολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Πλαγιωτών Ικαρίας
description: Ikaria Run is an established road race held every summer in the village of Plagia on Ikaria. It offers two distances, 5,000 m and 10,000 m, starting and finishing in the village square. The race is organized by the Plagiotes of Ikaria Beautification and Cultural Association and is a unique opportunity to enjoy the island’s beautiful scenery and traditional hospitality. The event takes care of participants’ safety and comfort while also promoting sports and local culture.
course_highlights: Circular route starting and finishing in Plagia Square
5,000 m and 10,000 m routes with elevation changes
Views of the Icarian Sea and the traditional village of Plagia
additional: The race takes place on the first Saturday of every August in the village of Plagia, Ikaria. Participants can receive a 30% discount on ferry tickets. The circular route includes elevation changes, offering runners a challenge. Participation requires signing a declaration accepting the race rules and taking personal responsibility. Water stations and manual timing are provided. Free transfers are available from the ports of Evdilos and Agios Kirykos.

name: 20ός Αγώνας Διάσχισης του Καλλίδρομου
description: The Kallidromo Crossing Race is a historic mountain race held in the area of Mendenitsa, Phthiotis. It is a challenging route across Mount Kallidromo, offering runners unique natural beauty and challenges. The race attracts runners who love mountain running and being in nature, while the organizers ensure a well-run and welcoming experience. The race starts in Mendenitsa’s central square, creating a warm atmosphere of community and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A mountain route with striking natural beauty
Crossing Mount Kallidromo with challenging climbs
Start and finish in Mendenitsa’s central square
additional: Previous editions also included a 1,700 m children’s race.

name: Balkaniada West
description: Balkaniada West is a mountain race that starts at 06:00. The event includes several distances of varying lengths and elevation gain, with routes passing through scenic mountain areas around Gorski Rai Hut. The event has a limited number of participants, and applications to participate require prior approval. The organizers provide transport, accommodation, and food, as well as branded clothing for those who finish within the time limit.

name: Айтос –Тополица DH 2026 - Квалификации
description: Aytos - Topolitsa DH 2026 - Qualifiers is a downhill race held under the rules of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation. Participants compete in different age categories, with the qualification determining the starting order for the final downhill run. The course is approximately 1790–1810 meters long, with 255 meters of elevation, and is suitable for different age groups. Cash and non-cash prizes are provided for the winners, and riders must wear mandatory protective equipment.
course_highlights: Children’s course (U13, U15), 1810 m long with 255 m of elevation
Course for U17, U19, Elite, Masters, Women, 1790 m long with 255 m of elevation
The course has the same starting point for all categories
additional: All riders must wear a back protector or body armor, and all riders under 18 must wear full body armor. A neck protector and elbow pads are recommended. Every rider will be checked at the start to ensure they have full protective equipment; riders without it will not be allowed onto the course. A valid license from the Bulgarian Cycling Federation is required to participate. Protective equipment is mandatory; riders under 18 must wear a back protector or full body armor.

name: ШОСЕЙНИ БЯГАНИЯ ПЛОВДИВ 2026 - 1 миля

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ранна регистрация до 31.12.2026 г., 23:59 ч. 1 миля 15 €

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Късна регистрация от 01.01.2027 г. до 02.03.2027 г., 23:59 ч. 1 миля 20 €

description: Road Races Plovdiv 2027 take place on March 6–7 at the Rowing Canal in Plovdiv. The event offers three distances—1 mile, 5 km, and 10 km—suitable for runners of different fitness levels. Organized by SC ACTIVE 2013, the race includes electronic timing, refreshment stations, and medical assistance along the course. Participants receive a unique medal and a chip-equipped race bib, and can enter a prize raffle. The race has a friendly atmosphere and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course is at the Rowing Canal in Plovdiv
Refreshment stations and a medical team along the course
Electronic chip timing and official results
additional: The race package includes a cash prize fund for the overall standings, a unique designer medal, a chip-equipped race bib, entry into a raffle with more than 32 prizes, gifts from partners, insurance, water and refreshments at the finish, an electronic certificate of completion, event photographers and host, as well as volunteers and the organizing team. The race package includes a finisher’s medal, electronic timing, insurance, refreshment stations, a medical team, and entry into a prize raffle. Race packages are distributed in the foyer of the Rowing Canal administration building.

name: 10α Παραποτάμια
description: The Pantavrechei Mountaineering Club is organizing the 10th consecutive edition of the Riverside Races in Prodromos, Evrytania. These mixed river-and-trail races offer two distances, 8 and 14 kilometers, starting at Dipotama Prousou and finishing in Prodromos square. The route includes sections through the water, trails with 350 meters of elevation gain, and two water stations. The event is co-organized with the Evrytania Regional Unit and the Municipality of Karpenisi and is held under the auspices of the SEGAS East Central Greece Association.

name: Parapotamia -Krikelopotamos o bregmenos dromos
description: The Parapotamia – Krikelopotamos, The Wet Road race is organized by the Panta Vrechei Greek Mountaineering Club in the South Evrytania region. This mountain race crosses rivers and trails, offering a unique experience in a natural setting rich in history and natural beauty. Founded in 2015, the club is active in the area and maintains trails and promotes mountain sports. Taking part in the race supports the continuation of the club’s activities and helps showcase the region.

name: 7ος Δρόμος Στείρι Οσιος – Λουκάς – Στείρι

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Η συμμετοχή στον αγώνα (των 5χλμ ή 10χλμ) είναι 5 ευρώ (με t-shirt 10 ευρώ) για την ενίσχυση του Εκπολιτιστικού Συλλόγου Στειρίου.

description: The Cultural Association of Steiri is organizing the 7th Steiri – Hosios Loukas Monastery – Steiri Race, a summer running event with an athletic and cultural character. The races start from the village’s central square, head to Hosios Loukas Monastery, and return to the square. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a 1,000-meter children’s race. The aim is to encourage participation by people of all ages, highlight the monastery’s historical significance, and showcase the area’s natural beauty. After the race, a buffet with sweets, juices, and local products is offered.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Steiri’s central square
Route to and from Hosios Loukas Monastery
The area’s natural beauty and historical significance
additional: Registration is completed online and is considered valid once payment has been deposited within 3 business days. Places are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

name: Adventure Skyrun 2027
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains, offering three challenging distances of varying difficulty and length. The courses pass through scenic natural landmarks such as Mount Malyovitsa, Mount Musala, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, a 25 km route with extreme climbs, and a 55 km ultramarathon connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race is suitable for beginners as well as experienced runners and mountaineers looking for a true skyrunning experience.
course_highlights: 12 km forest course through the ancient pine forests of Rila
25 km route climbing Mount Malyovitsa, with panoramic views of the Rila Lakes
55 km ultramarathon climbing Mount Musala and passing Ribni Ezera and Strashnoto Lake
additional: The cut-off time for the 55 km race is 14 hours (until 20:00), with the start at Hotel Rila, Borovets. The cut-off time for the 25 km race is 9 hours (until 18:00), with the start at the Malyovitsa Central Mountain School. Participants must bring their own water container, as bottles are not available at the aid stations. Valid mountain insurance is mandatory for the 25 km and 55 km distances. After the race, transport is organized for 55 km participants to Samokov and Borovets.

name: Retezat Mountain Run ~ 2026
description: Retezat Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat Mountains, with routes climbing to the summit of Mount Retezat. The event offers four races of varying difficulty and distance, from the 8.5 km Easy Run to a nearly 40 km Marathon with over 3,300 m of elevation gain. The routes cross wild landscapes, with aid stations in hard-to-reach areas, and the event is organized with the help of dedicated volunteers and mountain authorities. The event continues the tradition of the Retezat Marathon, with a new team and a long-term plan for continuity.

name: ALERG ÎN DUMBRAVĂ
description: Alerg în Dumbravă is a social, sporting, and charitable event that promotes outdoor running and a healthy lifestyle. It takes place in Homu Forest, north of the village of Glogoveanu, Dâmbovița County. The event features marathon, half-marathon, and cross-country races dedicated to the memory of local personalities, offering an outdoor experience on accessible trails and dirt roads. Recreational activities such as Latin dancing and a campfire add to the welcoming community atmosphere. Now in its seventh edition, the long-running event also supports an important social cause by helping Mia’s Children Association.

name: 44. Kanjiža Running & Swimming Festival
distance_verbose: 13 km, 10 km, 4 km, 3000 metara, 2.6 km, 1.4 km, 0.9 km, 0.57 km, 0.2 km
description: The running and swimming festival in Kanjiža brings competitors together on the banks of the Tisa, with a program that combines road running and open-water swimming. The swimming events take place at the beach, with disciplines for different ages and experience levels, from short distances to a 3,000-meter race. Welcome to a day of sports by the river, for competitors and fans of active recreation.
course_highlights: Swimming events take place at the beach on the banks of the Tisa.
The swimming program includes distances from 25 to 3,000 meters.
The festival also includes road running in Kanjiža.

name: 2ο Olympia Night Run «Run Under Zeus»
description: The 2nd Olympia Night Run “Run Under Zeus” is a nighttime road race held in the heart of Ancient Olympia, honoring the tradition of the first Olympic Games. The race takes place under the light of the full moon, bringing to life the myth of Hercules and Zeus and offering a unique running experience in a historic and mythical setting. The event is supported by the Greek National Tourism Organization and aims to combine sport with a message of life and culture.

name: 3ο Δρύοπες Run
location: Central Square, Ano Kalentini, Arta, Greece
description: The 3rd “Dryopes Run” is a 10-kilometer race that starts and finishes in the main square of Ano Kalentini, Arta. The route is paved and passes through beautiful natural landscapes, stone bridges, and fountains, offering runners an enjoyable experience. There is also an 800-meter children’s race for children up to 12 years old, which is participation-focused rather than competitive. The race is dedicated to the memory of Panagos Lambros, its inspiration and a founding member of the Arta Runners’ Association.
course_highlights: Paved 10 km route starting and finishing in the main square of Ano Kalentini
Passes stone bridges (Vratsista Bridge) and fountains
Scenic natural spots along the route
additional: The 800-meter children’s race is non-competitive, and registrations are accepted on-site on race day from 17:30 to 18:30. Race packs are distributed the previous day and on race morning at SPORTSHOUSE in Arta and at the race office in Ano Kalentini square. A dedicated clothing storage area is available for runners. The race has a 120-minute time limit from the start. A non-competitive 800 m children’s race for children up to 12 years old is included.

name: Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail
description: The Maratonul Nordului Teioasa Trail is a trail-running race held in northern Romania, offering participants an authentic experience amid spectacular scenery. The event promotes health, community, and adventure, bringing together passionate runners in a remarkable natural setting. The routes are designed to showcase the beauty of the area and the spirit of northern Romania.

name: Serbia EPIC STARA PLANINA #5
location: Hotel Stara Planina, Jabučko Ravnište, Stara Planina, Serbia
description: Serbia EPIC STARA PLANINA is a sporting event that brings runners together on the trails of Stara Planina mountain. The races are held as part of the Škoda Serbia Epic series and include trail races of different distances, with a time limit of 3 hours. The start and finish are at Hotel Stara Planina, and participants collect their race packets on site. This event promotes health, sport, and a family-friendly atmosphere in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: 15 km and 6 km courses
Start and finish at Hotel Stara Planina
The race time limit is 3 hours
additional: Race packets must be collected in person during the designated hours and are not mailed. Race packets can be collected the day before the race at Hotel Stara Planina and on race day at the start/finish. Race packets are collected at Hotel Stara Planina; they are not mailed. The time limit for the races is 3 hours.

name: Voio Race Series
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, well-being, environmental and social responsibility, with the involvement of volunteers and the active participation of the local community. Sport is presented as the most beautiful part of life, while taking part is considered a victory and finishing a triumph. The event welcomes everyone and encourages young people and children to take part in creative and enjoyable activities.

name: 11ος Δρόμος των Μουσών
location: Church of Saint Paraskevi, Ano Milia, Pieria, Greece
organizer: Εκπολιτιστικός – Εξωραϊστικός Σύλλογος Οικισμού Άνω Μηλιάς Πιερίας «Η Αγία Παρασκευή»
description: The 11th Mountain Running Race “THE ROAD OF THE MUSES” is organized in Ano Milia, Pieria, by the Cultural and Beautification Association of the Ano Milia Settlement “Agia Paraskevi,” in cooperation with the Pieria Runners’ Athletic Club “Zeus” and the Municipality of Katerini. The race features a 10,000-meter loop on mixed terrain, including paved roads, trails, and forest roads, starting and finishing in front of the Church of Agia Paraskevi. A 1,000-meter children’s race for primary school pupils is also held. The route offers natural beauty and varied elevations, with two water stations and three natural springs along the way.
course_highlights: Loop route with 1,500 meters of paved road
2,700 meters of prepared trails
5,800 meters of forest roads of exceptional natural beauty
additional: The start is at an elevation of 950 meters, and the route’s highest point reaches approximately 1,350 meters. There are two water stations and three natural springs along the route. Men and women over the age of 16 are eligible to participate in the 10,000-meter race. The children’s race is for primary school pupils, under the responsibility of their parents or guardians. The children’s race is 1,000 m, and participation is free.

name: Ο Δρόμος της Φτέργας
organizer: Οι αδελφοί Χουβαρδά και ο Σύλλογος των Απανταχού Φτεριανών
description: The Fterga Road is a mountain race held every August in Pterounda, Lesbos, the hometown of marathon runner Kostas Chouvardas. The event includes an 8-kilometer route on moderately challenging gravel terrain, as well as a children’s race. It is organized in collaboration with the Chouvardas brothers and the Association of Fterians Everywhere, offering a lovely trail-running experience in a picturesque setting.
course_highlights: An 8 km mountain route on moderately challenging gravel terrain
The village of Pterounda, Lesbos, hometown of marathon runner Kostas Chouvardas
A children’s race alongside the main event
additional: Registration is available on race day at the race office from 17:00 to 18:00.

name: Kallikrateia Coastal Run
description: The Kallikrateia Coastal Run is a coastal road race organized by the Federation of Settlements of Nea Propontida. The race offers 1-, 3- and 5-kilometer routes along Kallikrateia’s coastal road, starting in the town and finishing at Vergia Beach. The event is supported by SEGAS, the Regional Unit of Halkidiki, sponsors and volunteers, ensuring a safe and welcoming environment for runners of all ages. After the race, participants receive medals, certificates, T-shirts and caps, while awards are presented and refreshments and fruit are offered.
course_highlights: Coastal route along Kallikrateia’s coastal road
1-, 3- and 5-kilometer routes suitable for all ages
Starts in Kallikrateia and finishes at Vergia Beach
additional: All participants receive a medal, certificate, T-shirt and cap. Medical coverage is provided by an ambulance and a doctor, and police are present to ensure the race is safe. Fruit, juice and water are provided to runners after the finish. The event is approved by SEGAS.

name: Mesta Mastic Run
description: The Mesta Mastic Run is held in the traditional settlement of Mesta on Chios. The event combines running and walking, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy the area's unique natural and cultural setting. Its success depends on the active participation of volunteers and sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes through the traditional settlement of Mesta
Chios’ natural and cultural setting
An event combining running and walking
additional: The event relies on the support of volunteers and sponsors, without whom it could not succeed.

name: Ultra Race Romania
description: Ultra Race Romania is a unique long-distance running race covering 250 km over 6 stages, in a self-sufficient format, exploring the unspoiled wilderness, culture, and history of the Siriu area in Buzău. Participants will tackle a challenging route through the Carpathian Mountains, with legendary scenery and places steeped in local stories and mysteries. After the race, runners are invited to stay for two days to discover Romania’s traditions, cuisine, and famous tourist attractions, such as Peleș Castle and Bran Castle. The event focuses on the experience of a lifetime, lasting friendships, and the joy of being part of this extraordinary adventure.

name: 15ος Επικούριος Δρόμος «Ιάθημεν»
location: Temple of Apollo Epicurius, Mount Kotilio, Figaleia, Ilia, Greece
description: The Epicurean Road “Iathimen” is a running race in Figaleia, Elis, with a route connecting the Temple of Apollo Epicurius to the Ancient Fountain. The 14-kilometer course passes through Kotilio and the surrounding villages, combining the natural landscape with Figaleia’s long history. The race is dedicated to the ancient Olympic champions of Figaleia.
course_highlights: Start at the Temple of Apollo Epicurius on Mount Kotilio.
A 14-kilometer route to the Ancient Fountain in Figaleia.
Mostly downhill, with stretches of gentle uphill and level terrain.
additional: Three aid stations along the route will provide water and isotonic drinks.

name: Aidonochori Race
description: The Aidonochori Race mountain running event is organized by the Aidonochori Cultural Association, in cooperation with the Region of Thessaly and the Municipality of Sofades. The event includes three races: a 1 km children’s race, a 5 km race, and a 10 km race, with starts and finishes at the central square of the village of Aidonochori, Karditsa. The courses are mainly paved, with uphill and downhill sections, and are suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The event offers an enjoyable mountain-running experience in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Kids Race 1k: A downhill course that is 95% paved, ideal for children up to 12 years old
5k race: A course with 150 m of elevation gain, starting at the square and passing onto a forest dirt road
10k race: A course with 300 m of elevation gain and a 2-hour finishing time limit
additional: The start and finish for the longer races are at the central square of Aidonochori, while the children’s race starts and finishes at separate points in the central square. Finishing time limits: 1 hour for the 5 km race and 2 hours for the 10 km race. The co-organizers are the Region of Thessaly and the Municipality of Sofades.

name: Мусала Екстрийм
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Borovets, offering two distances: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain and 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain. The course passes peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains. The race combines technically difficult sections with fast descents and demands strength, speed, and skill. Alongside the individual races, there is a team race, as well as the option to take part in a duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: Musala Extreme
organizer: Клуб за изкуство и спорт "Дунавска" / Borosport
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race in Borovets, Bulgaria, covering 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain. The course passes over peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains. The race requires technical skills for navigating rocky and steep sections, combining strength, speed, and care. The shorter Yastrebets Trail Run, covering 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, is also held alongside it and is suitable for runners looking for an easier route. The organizers also offer a team race and a duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: THE COLOR RUN - MAMAIA BY NIGHT
description: The Color Run - Mamaia by Night is a colorful, energetic 5-kilometer race along a route in Mamaia, near the large parking area in front of the Rex Hotel. The event celebrates health, joy, and originality. Participants are showered with fluorescent powder at every kilometer, and the fun continues with a cloud of colored powder at the finish. The race is untimed, focusing on a joyful experience and a festival atmosphere with music and interactive activities. Suitable for all ages, including young children, it promises a memorable evening of running and outdoor fun.

name: Cupa LEEVA Run
description: LEEVA Run Cup is an official running competition on a 32 km route through the Transylvanian landscape, offering both individual and relay races, as well as a 1.5 km race for children. The event is part of the LEEVA Transylvanian Games festival, which brings together sport, health, and community in a setting inspired by the energy of Transylvania, at Corvin Castle in Hunedoara. The three-day festival brings families, athletes, and local communities together to promote an active, healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: 32 km route through the Transylvanian landscape
Individual and relay races
1.5 km Kids Run
additional: The event is part of a three-day festival that also includes other sports competitions, relaxation areas with food offerings, and spaces dedicated to health and well-being, with assessments and activities promoting a healthy lifestyle. The Kids Run is 1.5 km long.

name: Fuga lotrilor
location: Summer Camp Festival, Brezoi, Vâlcea County, Romania
organizer: Asociația „Împreună pentru Spitalul Orășenesc Brezoi”, în parteneriat cu Asociația Mentor Rock
description: Fuga Lotrilor is a charitable mountain and road running event organized by the Association Împreună pentru Spitalul Orășenesc Brezoi in partnership with the Mentor Rock Association and other local organizations. The event takes place as part of Summer Camp Festival Brezoi and aims to support local health and community, turning every kilometer run into tangible support. Participants enjoy a memorable experience amid the beauty of the Lotru Valley, in a setting dedicated to solidarity, nature, and athletic achievement. Several race distances are available, suitable for all fitness levels.
course_highlights: 6 km cross-country course with 58 m of elevation gain, estimated time: 45 minutes
13 km cross-country course with 142 m of elevation gain, estimated time: 90 minutes
12 km mountain cross-country course with 330 m of elevation gain, estimated time: 120 minutes
additional: The event takes place on 15–16 August 2027, with the start and finish at Summer Camp Festival Brezoi, Vâlcea County. The program includes race-kit pickup, a technical briefing, warm-up, and awards ceremony. Races are organized for adults, as well as a KIDS RUN. The official rules require participants to sign a declaration of responsibility when collecting their race kit. The organizers may change the schedule depending on conditions on the day of the event. Funds raised from registration fees support the charitable projects of the Association “Împreună pentru Spitalul Orășenesc Brezoi”.

name: Bobija Trail
description: Bobija Trail is a mountain trail race on Bobija, near Tornik, for runners who want to experience forest trails and a climb through the natural landscapes of western Serbia. Previous editions offered several distances, including 9, 15, and 26 km, giving runners of different experience levels a choice. The routes cross challenging mountain terrain, and the race is organized by West Serbia Trails.
course_highlights: Mountain forest trails on Bobija
15 km route with around 650 m of total elevation gain
Several race distances, including 9 and 26 km
additional: Previous editions had the race base at the elementary school in a village on Bobija.

name: XL kmrun - с. Кътина
description: XL Kătina is a mountain running event in the XLkmrun series, held near the village of Kătina, Sofia. The race offers three distances of varying lengths, suitable for different levels of fitness. The routes pass along natural trails and cart roads, offering a challenge amid beautiful scenery. The event is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park races in Sofia and other cities.

name: Хисаря рън
description: Hisarya Run is an annual race that attracts runners of different ages and abilities. The course starts and finishes at the modern Krepost Stadium and passes the preserved Roman fortress wall and two beautiful parks in Hisarya. The event offers two main distances: 7.85 km for more experienced runners and 1.6 km, suitable for children and teenagers. The event is part of RUN BULGARIA and combines sport with the region’s cultural and historical landmarks.

name: Βαλτινές Διαδρομές
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιποπουλιωτών Αθήνας – Πειραϊά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The “Valtines Routes” road races are being held for the fourth consecutive year alongside the Inachos River, in Neos Chalkiopoulo, Valtos, Aetolia-Acarnania. The Association of Chalkiopoulo Residents of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit” invites you to take part in a celebration of culture and sport, held as part of the cultural events from August 10 to 17. The races include three routes, with electronic timing and support from volunteers and the local community.

name: 7ο Λάνθι Run
organizer: Τομέας Αθλητισμού του Δήμου Πύργου, Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Λανθίου και Τοπική Κοινότητα Λανθίου
description: Lanthy Run is an annual running event held in Lanthi, Ilia. It is a non-competitive, non-profit event that promotes sports and social participation. The event welcomes runners of all levels in a friendly, relaxed environment.
course_highlights: The event takes place in the Community of Lanthi.
A previous edition also included a walk to the Holy Monastery of Panagia Kremasti and back.
The event is non-competitive, with an emphasis on participation rather than performance.
additional: The event has been held with the support of the Municipality of Pyrgos.

name: Αγώνας Δρόμου Δυρράχι – Ρεκίτσα
location: Ιερά Μονή Αγίου Γεωργίου Ρεκίτσας, Αρκαδία, Greece
organizer: Αδελφότητα Δυρραχιτών Αττικής και Δήμος Μεγαλόπολης
description: The Dyrrachi–Rekitsa Road Race is an annual race held in Arcadia in memory of and in honor of the hero Papaflessas. The 9-kilometer course starts at Litharou Square in Dyrrachi and finishes at the Holy Monastery of Saint George of Rekitsa. The race combines history, nature, and tradition, offering participants a unique experience. After the finish, a local national celebration follows, with a doxology, wreath-laying, and awards. Dyrrachi is a place deeply rooted in history and nature, with a rich cultural identity and traditions.
course_highlights: A 9-kilometer route from Litharou Square in Dyrrachi to the Holy Monastery of Saint George of Rekitsa
Sections through historic and natural landscapes on the slopes of the northern Taygetus
Finish at a historic religious site, with celebratory events
additional: Registration takes place earlier at the start area in Litharou Square. After the race, a local national celebration follows, with a doxology, wreath-laying, and awards for athletes. The race honors the hero Papaflessas and is part of Dyrrachi’s established events. A doxology, wreath-laying, and awards have taken place at the finish.

name: 16ος Γαβαθώνιος
organizer: Σύλλογος Απανταχού Αντισσαίων «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Θεολόγος»
description: The 16th Gavathonios is a 9-kilometer road race held in Antissa, Lesvos, organized by the Athens Association of Antissa Residents, “Saint John the Theologian.” The race is a landmark event for sports and culture in Western Lesvos, inspired by the local dialect, which expresses the energy and joy of running. The race starts in the afternoon at 18:30, offering an enjoyable running experience in a friendly local setting. Entry has a symbolic fee, and registration is completed by bank transfer.
course_highlights: A 9-kilometer road race in Antissa, Lesvos
Organized by the Athens Association of Antissa Residents, “Saint John the Theologian”
Starts at 18:30, celebrating sports and culture
additional: Registration is completed by bank transfer to the organizer’s account, following the instructions on the registration form. For information, call 6955 806454 or 22530 56255.

name: 8ος Αλύζιος Αγώνας Δρόμου Βάρνακα – Μύτικα
description: The Alyzios Road Race connects Varnakas with Mytikas, inviting runners and young participants to a local sporting event. The program includes a 5 km race and a separate 1 km race for children or beginners.
course_highlights: Route between Varnakas and Mytikas
5 km race
Short 1 km distance

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra 2026
description: Persenk Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon offering a unique experience in the natural surroundings of the Rhodope Mountains. The courses pass over panoramic ridges, soft coniferous trails, lakes and rock formations, combining challenge and beauty. The race takes place in the Pamporovo resort, known for its natural beauty and comfort. Hotel Perelik is the event’s official partner and host, providing amenities and recovery facilities for participants. The organizers have many years of experience and create a “from friends to friends” atmosphere for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Panoramic ridges and soft coniferous trails
Natural landmarks such as lakes and rock formations
High positive elevation gain of up to 4,550 m on the 100 km distance
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Pamporovo Congress Centre from 19 to 22 August. Mandatory equipment includes a mobile phone, at least 500 ml of water, a whistle, a bell, a survival blanket, a hat, gloves, long trousers and a waterproof jacket with a hydrostatic head of at least 10,000 mm. Hotel Perelik offers premium accommodation and a spa centre for recovery. The race is held on a semi-self-sufficient basis, with aid stations along the course.
