Electronic timing and live results are provided. The festival programme also includes the 25 km Pamporovo Sky Race and the 20 km Sport Box Trail Run.

name: GLS NIGHT CROS CHALLENGE Start la muzeul în aer liber din Dumbrava Sibiului
description: GLS Night Cross Challenge is a night running race with a 10-year tradition in Sibiu, held in Dumbrava Sibiului. The event offers a unique outdoor running experience on specially prepared trails, surrounded by nature, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. Participants can enjoy a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, ideal for amateurs and athletes of all levels. The organizers emphasize pushing personal limits and the joy of running together as a community.

name: GLS Night Cross Challenge ~ 2026
description: Night Cross Challenge powered by GLS is Romania’s most beautiful night cross-country race, reaching its 12th edition in 2026. The event takes place at the Dumbrava Sibiului Open-Air Museum, offering participants a unique running experience on marked routes after dark. Races are available for adults over distances of 4.5 km and 9 km, as well as children over distances of 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,300 m. The competition is open to all age groups from 5 to 75 years, with prizes for the winners of the open category in the 9 km race.

name: 12ος Αγώνας Δρόμου «Κοσμάς ο Αιτωλός»
location: Central Square of Thermo, Thermo, Aetolia-Acarnania, Greece
description: The 12th “Kosmas the Aetolian” Road Race is held in Thermo, Aetolia-Acarnania, and features races for adults and children. Starting from Thermo’s Central Square, the course passes historical and archaeological sites in the area, offering a unique experience for runners of all ages. The event includes a 10.2 km race for adults, a 5.1 km race for adults and children over 13, and a 1 km children’s race for children up to 12 years old. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with the start and finish at the central square, where the awards ceremony also takes place.
course_highlights: 10.2 km course starting from Thermo’s Central Square
Passes the new archaeological museum and the archaeological site of Thermo
Routes for adults and children, with different distances
additional: Start times: 18:45 for the 1 km children’s race, 19:00 for the 10.2 km race, and 19:05 for the 5.1 km race. The finish and awards ceremony are at Thermo’s Central Square. Race numbers and timing chips will be handed out at the square from 17:00. All races start from Thermo’s Central Square. Electronic timing and race numbers with chips are provided.

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra
description: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra is one of Bulgaria’s leading trail running races, held every summer in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains. The event brings together runners from around the world, who can enjoy the unique spirit, culture, and natural beauty of this ancient mountain region. The 50-kilometer course passes through some of the wildest and most beautiful parts of the mountains, including the Wonderful Bridges, the Chimneys, and Tsirikova Church, offering a challenge and unforgettable views.

name: Велокръг Кнежа - 2026
description: Knezha Cycling Circuit is an amateur cycling event organized by the Municipality of Knezha, with the aim of promoting cycling and a healthy lifestyle. The race is held in a criterium format, with three laps on a fast course with little elevation gain and opportunities for sprinting. The start is in front of the municipal building in Knezha. Participation is open to all physically fit cyclists with the necessary skills. The race emphasizes safety and requires participants to sign an informed consent declaration.
course_highlights: Fast criterium course with three laps
Relatively little total elevation gain
Opportunities for sprinting
additional: Race packs are distributed from 08:00 at Akhtirka Park, opposite the entrance to the municipal building. Every participant must wear a helmet, attach the race number with its RFID chip to the bicycle’s seat post, and wear a clearly visible race number on the back of their jersey. Participants aged 12 to 18 must submit a declaration signed by a parent or guardian. For safety, a police patrol will escort riders through the city streets. A helmet and a race number with an RFID chip are mandatory. Motor traffic on the course will not be stopped.

name: 2X2 Race
location: Lacul Bâlea, Transfăgărășan, Sibiu County, Romania
description: 2X2 Race is an extremely technical and challenging mountain ultramarathon, held entirely above 2,000 m in the Făgăraș Mountains, Romania. The main 45 km course, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, passes over Romania’s two highest peaks, Moldoveanu and Negoiu. Two other races, X1 Race (26 km, 2,400 m elevation gain) and X2 Race (18 km, 1,900 m elevation gain), are also highly technical and intense, and intended for runners with mountain experience. Participation is limited and subject to experience requirements to ensure competitors’ safety given the high physical and mental demands.

name: Via Transilvanica Maraton
description: Via Transilvanica Marathon 2026 is a sporting event that celebrates Romania’s nature and unique heritage, held along the Via Transilvanica route. The marathon offers a challenge of 39.3 km with an elevation gain of 1,292 m, crossing forest roads, villages, and panoramic landscapes. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere, with well-organized checkpoints and hydration stations, as well as activities for children. The event is organized by the Țășuleasa Social Association, which promotes volunteering and respect for nature.

name: CROS DONATON
location: Muzeul Etnografic al Transilvaniei, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania

name: Tara Extreme Skymarathon – 5. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: Tara Extreme Skymarathon is a challenging mountain running race held on the beautiful and demanding trails of Tara National Park. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series and brings together competitors who want to test their physical and mental limits on demanding terrain with significant elevation gain. The start and finish are in Mitrovac, the traditional location for this event. During the race, participants can enjoy spectacular views and Tara’s wild natural scenery.
course_highlights: Trails with significant elevation gain of up to 3150 meters
The beautiful, wild nature of Tara National Park
Three different courses: SkyTrail (10 km), SkyRace (24 km), SkyMarathon (44 km)
additional: The race takes place in Mitrovac, with the start and finish at the same location. There are three courses with different distances and elevation gains: SkyTrail (10 km, 700D+), SkyRace (24 km, 1700D+), SkyMarathon (44 km, 3150D+). The race is known for its difficulty and for testing competitors’ limits. The organizers thank the competitors, volunteers, and sponsors for their support.

name: Tara Extreme Skychallange
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Extreme SkyChallenge is a unique skyrunning race held in the heart of Tara National Park, starting and finishing at the Mountain Lodge in Rastište. The race features three different courses that are technically demanding and physically challenging, intended for experienced mountain runners. Sports and recreational activities for all ages are also organized as part of the event, making it appealing to a wider audience. The courses are certified according to ISF, ITRA and UTMB standards, and the race is part of the PSS National Mountain Running Series.

name: 7ο Lepanto Evening Run
location: Old Beach of Nafpaktos, Nafpaktos, Greece
organizer: Δήμος Ναυπακτίας και Σύλλογος Δρομέων LepantoRunners
description: The 7th Lepanto Evening Run is a running event held in the beautiful coastal area of Nafpaktos. It features two open races of 9.5 km and 5.2 km, on routes that are entirely paved and run beside the sea, along Psani and Paleopanagia beaches. The event honors the memory of young runner Anastasia Geka with a children’s race and welcomes runners of all levels, encouraging participation and the joy of exercise. It is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultramarathons.
course_highlights: 9.5 km and 5.2 km routes along Psani and Paleopanagia beaches
Entirely paved routes with no elevation gain
Start and finish in front of Nafpaktos’s old beach
additional: The children’s race honors the memory of young runner Anastasia Geka. Part of the proceeds go to support the Flóga association, which supports children with neoplastic diseases. The paved routes are flat. The start is near Nafpaktos’s old beach, and the finish is at the lower end of the harbor, in front of the statue of Anemogiannis.

name: Земен рън
description: “Zemen Run” is an athletics event in Zemen, with distances for different abilities—from a short run for children and beginners to a longer challenge. The main distance combines road and mountain running and takes participants through the beautiful area around the town. The start and finish are in the center of Zemen, and the event is part of the Run Bulgaria series.
course_highlights: The main course is about 15 km and combines road and mountain sections.
The route passes between Zemen Monastery and Peshtera Monastery.
There are also shorter distances of about 5 km and 1 km.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Χίου
description: The 14th Chios Half Marathon is organized by the Chios Health Athletes Association in cooperation with the Municipality and the Chios Regional Unit. The race and accompanying sports and cultural events will take place in the traditional settlement of Kampos on Chios. Alongside the half marathon, there will also be 1.5 km (children’s), 5 km, and 10.5 km races, as well as races for people with disabilities. This celebration of sport and culture invites runners of all ages and abilities to take part.

name: Στη Σκιά του Κριάκουρα
description: The “In the Shadow of Kriakouras” mountain running race is being held for the 12th year in Theodoriana, Arta, offering two challenging courses of 10 and 23 kilometers. The routes pass through fir forests, rivers, and trails of exceptional natural beauty and difficulty, revealing the secrets of the Tzoumerka mountains. The race is dedicated to the person who inspired the first event in 2014 and serves as a qualifying race for participation in major mountain marathons. The start and finish are in Theodoriana’s central square, with all races starting at 10:00 a.m.

name: Αγώνας Δρόμου και Τιμής Μεγαλόπολης
organizer: Δήμος Μεγαλόπολης, ΓΕΝΟΠ/ΔΕΗ, Σύνδεσμος Συνταξιούχων ΔΕΗ Μεγαλόπολης και Εργατικό Κέντρο Αρκαδίας
description: The Megalopoli Race of Remembrance and Honor is an annual running event held in honor of the 33 workers who lost their lives at PPC workplaces in Megalopoli. The 12-kilometer course starts at Heroes of the Polytechnic Square and passes historic and notable landmarks around the city. The race gives runners an opportunity to honor their memory and take part in an important local sporting event. The race starts in the afternoon, creating a welcoming atmosphere of participation and respect.
course_highlights: A 12-kilometer route through central streets of Megalopoli
Passes Heroes of the Polytechnic Square and the Ancient Theater
A route honoring the memory of PPC workers
additional: Registration is available online through the provided link or at the Megalopoli PPC Retirees Association offices (65 Papaioannou Street, Megalopoli), Monday to Friday, 09:00–13:00. Participation is listed for runners aged 18 and over.

name: Underdogs
description: Underdogs - The Backyard Ultra is a unique endurance race set in the beautiful landscape of Brebu, Dâmbovița County, Romania. Participants run repeated 6.8 km loops, with a start every hour, until only one competitor remains in the race. This competition tests runners’ physical and mental limits, offering an intense, community-focused experience where every step is a challenge and a story of resilience. Founded on Lazarus Lake’s concept, the race brings together ultra-running enthusiasts in an adventurous setting built on mutual support.

name: Adventure Sky Run
location: Borovets, Samokov Municipality, Sofia Province, Bulgaria
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, offering three distances of varying difficulty and length. The courses pass through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, 25 km of ski trails, and a challenging 55 km run connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race offers stunning natural scenery and an opportunity to push beyond your limits.

name: Kom Epic Half Ultra Берковица
description: Kom Epic Half Ultra Berkovitsa is a mountain race in the Western Balkan Mountains and part of the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series. The race starts at Yordan Radichkov Square in Berkovitsa, at an elevation of 405 m, and the courses climb to Kom Peak (2,016 m), offering impressive views of the Danubian Plain, Rila, and the Rhodope Mountains. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for trail running and mountain biking. The event also includes a children’s race and a wide range of activities for children after the race.

name: OSLEA RUN
location: Camping Valea Iarului, Câmpușel, Hunedoara County, Romania
description: Oslea Run is a mountain-running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, in the area of the Oslea, Paltina and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs, where Retezat National Park meets Domogled - Valea Cernei. The event offers four daytime races on varied and challenging mountain routes, continuing a tradition that began in 2011. Participants can enjoy a complete experience, including a technical T-shirt, finisher medal, support points along the course and at the finish, as well as social activities and wine tastings. The competition is organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului and takes place at Camping Valea Iarului, Câmpușel, Hunedoara.
course_highlights: Mountain routes through Retezat National Park and Domogled - Valea Cernei
Four races covering distances of 8.5 km, 15 km, 26 km and 41 km
Support points and individual timing with online rankings
additional: Limited-edition technical T-shirt and finisher medal for participants who finish within the time limit. Access to a Corcova Roy & Dâmboviceanu wine tasting and a traditional dinner on Saturday evening. Discounted camping at Camping Valea Iarului for competitors. UTMB and ITRA points for the Paltina and Scorota races. An ambulance will be present in the start/finish area. Technical briefing and outdoor film screening before the race. Sound system and MC at the event. Access to workshops and a social space on Saturday evening. The Paltina and Scorota races were listed as offering ITRA and UTMB points.

name: Oslea Run ~ 2026
description: Oslea Run is a mountain running competition held in the Retezat and Vâlcan Mountains, around the Oslea, Paltina, and Piatra Iorgovanului massifs, organized by Clubul Alpin Valea Jiului. The event continues the area's tradition of mountain running, offering four daytime races that showcase spectacular routes amid nature, where Retezat and Domogled-Valea Cernei National Parks meet. Participants enjoy an authentic outdoor experience, with prizes, race kits, and related activities such as tastings and socializing.

name: SCORILO SKY RACE
location: Pine Hill, Poiana Mărului, Caraș-Severin, Romania
distance_verbose: 45 km, 44 km, 26 km, 12 km, 8 km, 4 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Muntele Mic Semimaraton 26 km +1100 m 160 RON

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Crosul La Mesteceni 12 km +576 m 140 RON

description: Scorilo Sky Race is an international mountain running event held at Pine Hill, Poiana Mărului, offering a variety of races for runners of all levels. The routes include the 45 km Țarcu Marathon, with over 2600 m of elevation gain, the Muntele Mic Half Marathon, the La Mesteceni Cross-Country Race, as well as races for children and families. The event is recognized by international associations such as ITRA and UTMB, ensuring high standards for participants. It has a community- and tradition-oriented atmosphere, with attractive prizes and a local story connected to the area’s landscapes and legends.
course_highlights: The Țarcu Marathon route features sustained climbs through forest and alpine terrain with spectacular scenery
Strategically located refreshment and control points, including at the route’s highest peaks
Varied routes, from technical mountain races to short races for children and families
additional: Race kits can be picked up in the Start/Finish area at Pine Hill cabin from 08:30 on race day. Each race has time limits (cutoffs), and participants who exceed them are stopped. The event provides official T-shirts and medals for participants. An active community of volunteers supports the event at key points along the route. The routes combine marked trails and forest roads, with short stretches of asphalt. The event also includes a 4 km race for children and a Family Run.

name: Coffee Run & Wine
description: Coffee Run & Wine is a special run organized in the Medwine vineyards in Mediaș, offering participants a unique experience of running in nature, combined with socializing and supporting a worthy cause. The event takes place on August 29, starting at 9:30, and includes routes suitable for all ages, from children to adults. Participants can enjoy the lively scenery and friendly atmosphere of the Binderbubi Backyard Running community, which promotes authentic movement and a passion for running.
course_highlights: Routes through the Medwine vineyards, with natural scenery and a relaxing atmosphere
A variety of routes: 5 km Wine Run, 2.25 km Coffee Run, and 650 m Kids Run
The start is at Via Medwine, offering an authentic experience in the heart of the vineyard
additional: Registration is in person at Bean Roasters Centru (Strada Petőfi Sándor 2) or The Wine Corner (Strada Johannes Honterus 40). Children under 10 can participate free of charge, but must be registered. Participants are required to complete a liability waiver. The event supports the participation of Mediaș teams in Autism 24H.

name: Aventura în Vrancea Sălbatică
location: Putna-Vrancea Natural Park, Vrancea County, Romania
organizer: RNP Romsilva – Administrația Parcului Natural Putna-Vrancea
description: Aventura în Vrancea Sălbatică is a mountain adventure competition that tests teams’ physical and mental abilities, endurance, and navigation skills. The routes are unmarked and pass through varied areas, from settlements and alpine meadows to forested areas and rugged terrain, offering an authentic experience in the wild nature of Putna Vrancea Natural Park. Participants must have strong navigation skills and mountain experience. The route is not prescribed, and teams choose their own way between checkpoints. The event promotes respect for nature and participant safety, and is organized as part of the Putna Vrancea Park, a Wild and Accessible Park for the Future project.
course_highlights: Unmarked routes through wild mountain areas and varied terrain
Teams are free to choose their routes between checkpoints
Water-resistant paper maps provided 12 hours before the start
additional: Race maps are handed out during the mandatory technical briefing, 12 hours before the start. Participants must manage their free time and route as they see fit. Accommodation and camping at the base camp are not provided. Mandatory equipment is detailed in the regulations. Short-race teams consist of 2 people, regardless of gender. The short race starts at 08:00, and the time limit is 10 hours. Participants compete in teams, which must pass through the checkpoints in the established order and stay within 100 m of one another. The race time is recorded when all team members cross the finish line simultaneously.

name: Iskra Avala Night Trail
description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race held on Mount Avala. The start is at 20:30 in front of the Avala Tower, and runners will enjoy the unique atmosphere of a night-time adventure, with headlamps required. In addition to the race, a race village with food, drinks and music will be set up in the start and finish area. The race is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top finishers in the men’s and women’s categories at both distances.

name: Dunavske Čarolije 2026
description: Dunavske Čarolije is a unique event in Čortanovci combining running, cycling, orienteering, water jumping, hiking, films, music, and volleyball. This festival of sport and entertainment brings together participants of all ages and offers a variety of activities on the banks of the Danube. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with a rich program running throughout the day. Everyone is invited to join and enjoy the charms of the Danube and the sporting challenges.

name: Black Yard Ultra
description: BLACK YARD Ultra by Mamali Festival is a challenging ultra trail race that starts and finishes at the Mamali Festival Base Camp, at an elevation of approximately 1,454 meters. It includes a Last Runner Standing ultra race, a 12-kilometer race, and a 1-kilometer children’s race. The 12-kilometer loop has 514 meters of elevation gain, mostly on trails and dirt roads, and the ultra requires experience, as each lap becomes increasingly demanding with less time to complete it. The Base Camp offers camping facilities, showers, food, and a festival atmosphere, creating a unique experience for participants.

name: MAMALI BLACKYARD ULTRA
description: Runners are invited to complete consecutive laps of the same course. A 12-kilometer trail race is also held for those looking for a quick mountain experience. There is also an untimed 1-kilometer children’s race, ideal for families. The event offers a fully organized Base Camp with free camping, coffee, refreshments, and a festival atmosphere throughout the race.

name: 2ο Salona Run
organizer: Διγενής Αλωνίων ΑΜΠΣ και Κοινότητα Αλωνίων
description: Salona Run is a road race in Alonia, Pieria, featuring a main 10-kilometer race and a children’s race. The event invites participants to discover the area’s beauty and the village’s Pontian hospitality through a sporting celebration of the place and its residents.
course_highlights: The 10-kilometer course is entirely on paved roads.
Start and finish at Alonia square.
Includes a 500-meter children’s race.

name: 8ο Syrrako Trail & Priza Vertical
description: The 8th Syrrako Trail Run is held in Syrrako, Ioannina, and features two races: the mountain race Syrrako Trail Run Classic and the demanding vertical ascent race Priza Vertical. Priza Vertical is an uphill route of 4.280 kilometers with 890 meters of elevation gain on technical terrain. The event offers a unique mountain-running experience in a beautiful natural setting, with steep slopes and technical challenges. My Adventure, with years of experience and respect for the environment, is the event’s main organizer.
course_highlights: Uphill route of 4.280 km with 890 meters of elevation gain (Priza Vertical)
Technical terrain with steep slopes
Mountain scenery in Syrrako, Ioannina
additional: Priza Vertical takes place on the Saturday before the main Syrrako Trail Run Classic race, which is held on Sunday. The event is organized in collaboration with the Municipality of North Tzoumerka, the Ioannina Runners’ Association, the Syrrako Tourism Businesses, and the Syrrako Mountaineering Club.

name: Φανούριος Δρόμος
location: Courtyard of the Church of Saint Nicholas, Anatoliko, Delta Municipality, Greece
organizer: Ενορία Ιερού Ναού Αγίου Νικολάου Ανατολικού
description: The Fanourios Run is a special athletic and spiritual event that combines running with tradition and faith. It takes place in the courtyard of the Holy Church of Saint Nicholas in Anatoliko, in the Municipality of Delta. Participants are invited to complete a symbolic route, choosing between two distances, with hydration stations along the way. The event has a distinctive character: each runner receives a piece of a mosaic depicting Saint Fanourios and places it at the finish, helping to complete the image as a mark of honor and devotion.
course_highlights: Two routes: 6 km and 12 km
Three hydration stations along the route
At the finish, participants symbolically place a piece of the mosaic depicting Saint Fanourios
additional: The race starts with the ringing of the bell. Traditional fanouropita is offered at the finish. Electronic timing is provided by Timing for Sports. The top three men and women in each distance receive awards. All participants receive a commemorative medal. Recent editions have included electronic timing, hydration stations, and a commemorative medal for participants.

name: VITOSHA RUN
location: National Palace of Culture, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: Vitosha Run is an annual mountain-running race in Sofia, organized by the Marathon Association. The course is an uphill route measuring 17.3 km with 1,734 m of elevation gain. It starts at the National Palace of Culture in central Sofia and finishes at Cherni Vrah, the highest peak in the Vitosha Mountains. The race is open to participants aged 15 to 75, with categories for men, women, youth up to 20 years old, and veterans over 45.
course_highlights: Uphill mountain course with 1,734 m of elevation gain
Start at the National Palace of Culture in Sofia
Finish at Cherni Vrah, the highest peak in the Vitosha Mountains

name: Бели Искър рън
organizer: RUN BULGARIA, община Самоков и Българска федерация лека атлетика
description: “Beli Iskar Run” is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and brings runners together in the village of Beli Iskar. Participants can choose between 16 km and 5 km distances, while children and recreational runners can take part in a mass 2 km start. The start and finish are at the village stadium, and the race is part of the sports and cultural program of the Moon Festival.
course_highlights: Choose between 16 km, 5 km, and a mass 2 km distance.
Start and finish at the stadium in the village of Beli Iskar.
The 2 km distance is suitable for children and recreational runners.

name: Vrancea Montană Run
description: Vrancea Montană Run is a mountain running event held in the Vrancea Mountains, in the commune of Păulești, offering an authentic experience in nature for runners of all levels. The race features two main events: an 11 km cross-country race with approximately 350 m of elevation gain and a 21 km half marathon with 550 m of elevation gain. Both take place on varied, unpaved routes combining forest roads, trails, and rugged terrain. The event is organized by the Vrancea Montană Association with support from Păulești City Hall, and promotes respect for the wilderness and fair play among competitors. Participants also contribute to a worthy cause by supporting wildlife rehabilitation in Romania.

name: Maratonul Olteniei
description: Maratonul Olteniei is a multi-sport event featuring running, MTB, and Hyathlon Sprint, held in Zăvoi Park in Râmnicu Vâlcea. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of being together, emphasizing the connections between participants and their shared motivation. It is a celebration of sport and nature, with a strong tradition and a dedicated community. Participants enjoy varied courses and a friendly atmosphere that encourages performance and socializing.

name: Avala noćna trail 2026
description: Iskra Avala Night Trail is a night trail race held on the plateau in front of the Avala Tower in Belgrade. The race starts at 20:30 and offers a unique nighttime experience on Mount Avala, with a race village for entertainment before, during, and after the race. Participants can choose between two distances, 6 km and 10 km, and a headlamp is required. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the top male and female finishers in both distances.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Αλληλεγγύης Ι.Ν. Αγίου Χαραλάμπους
Șopa Forest Race ~ 2027
location: Șopa Forest, Șelimbăr, Sibiu County, Romania

name: BELMEKEN SKY QUEST
description: BELMEKEN SKY QUEST is a high-altitude race offering a unique challenge in the rugged, open terrain of the Rila Mountains. The race takes place above 2,000 meters and combines sport, adventure, and a love of the mountains. Participants run with almost no course markings and no aid stations, requiring good preparation and self-sufficiency. There are two distances: 34 km with 2,200 m of positive elevation gain and 13 km with 600 m of positive elevation gain, each with a technical, scenic route. This is not just a race, but an encounter with altitude, wind, and your own limits.
course_highlights: High-altitude course above 2,000 meters
Technical course along ridgelines and through open alpine areas (34 km)
Dynamic route with panoramic views (13 km)
additional: The race has almost no course markings and no aid stations, requiring participants to be self-sufficient. Water will be provided only if necessary, if some water sources are dry. The race is almost entirely self-supported: there are no aid stations, and markings are sparse and placed only at mandatory locations.

name: Благотворителен турнир по уличен фитнес TroyanRun 2026
description: The TroyanRun 2026 charity street fitness tournament takes place at the outdoor fitness area of Chavdar Stadium in Troyan. Organized by the Troyan v Badeshteto Association with the support of Troyan Municipality and Dr. Georgi Stoev - Schwartz Multiprofile Hospital for Active Treatment, the tournament combines athletic competition with a charitable cause. The event promotes physical activity and community involvement, with proceeds used to renovate the fitness equipment and support the local hospital. Free preventive check-ups are also offered to help raise health awareness.
course_highlights: Takes place at the outdoor fitness area of Chavdar Stadium
Features various fitness disciplines using the outdoor equipment
Renovated fitness equipment installed at the event venue
additional: Alongside the sports program, free preventive check-ups are offered by urologic oncologist Dr. Milen Tsvetkov to those who register in advance. Proceeds from the tournament are used to renovate the outdoor fitness equipment and make a donation to the local hospital. The tournament is dedicated to a campaign against urinary tract cancer. Free preventive check-ups are planned alongside the tournament for people who register in advance.

name: CugiRace
location: Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, Jud. Alba
description: CugiRace is a mountain running competition held in Poiana cu Goruni, Cugir, offering events for all fitness levels: an ultramarathon, half marathon, 10 km cross-country race, and children’s race. The courses are varied, with significant elevation changes, offering a challenging and scenic experience in the Cugir Mountains. The event promotes outdoor exercise and a healthy lifestyle, welcoming both experienced runners and those looking to make the transition to ultramarathons. The atmosphere is friendly, supported by careful organization and dedicated volunteers.

name: StruguRUN
description: StruguRUN is a unique running competition set among the vineyards and historic scenery of Odobești, Vrancea. The event offers three races for all levels: the Half Marathon, the Cross-Country Race, and the Popular Race, each following spectacular routes through vineyards and forests and along the Milcov River. Participants can enjoy an authentic experience that combines sport with nature and local traditions in a friendly, energizing atmosphere.

name: Σκυταλοδρομία Λέσβου
description: The Lesvos Relay is organized by the Lesvos Runners Association, founded in 2017 by people passionate about running. The race offers runners a chance to meet, run together, and enjoy the running community on the island of Lesvos. The event promotes physical activity without strict requirements, focusing on a shared love of running and on strengthening the local running culture.

name: 7ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Δρόμου Γουμένισσας «Τρέχω Για Μένα»
Teteven's Peaks
description: Teteven's Peaks offers an adventure for every mountain running and hiking enthusiast in the beautiful surroundings of the Teteven Balkan. The event features several distances: a challenging 27 km trail, a vertical climb, an easy 6 km route, and a guided mountain walk. Participants will enjoy fresh air, scenic views, and well-organized aid stations. The event is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and families, with medals, T-shirts, and personalized bibs with timing chips provided.

name: Via Pontica
description: The cross-border Via Pontica Marathon takes place annually and offers a unique running experience through Bulgaria and Romania. Participants run along a scenic route past Lake Durankulak, the northern Bulgarian beaches, and the Romanian coastal settlements of Vama Veche and 2 Mai, crossing the border without stopping. The event includes distances of 28 km, 16 km, and a 2 km children’s race, with the finish on the beach near the village of Krapets. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.

name: Екиден маратон
description: The Sofia Team Marathon is a relay race held at Vasil Levski National Stadium. The event promotes road relay running and commemorates 140 years since the Unification of the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia. Teams cover a total of 42.195 km, divided into six legs of different lengths, with color-coded bib numbers. The race is organized by the Sport for All Sofia in Europe Sports Club and the Bulgarian Sport for All Federation, with the aim of determining the national relay running champions.

name: Sighișoara 10K
organizer: Asociația Părinților din „Clubul Sportiv Școlar” Sighișoara
description: Sighișoara 10K is a running race offering a unique experience through the heart of the medieval citadel of Sighișoara, combining sport with the discovery of the city’s historical treasures. The event includes 10K and 5K races, a children’s race, and an Up Stairs challenge, and is open to all age groups and fitness levels. Participants can enjoy a vibrant, energetic course, with cash prizes and a raffle for all runners. The race is held in memory of Dr. Stelian Larga, a cardiologist and citizen actively involved in the city’s sporting and cultural life.

name: CIUCAȘ X3 Scriem povestea. Împreună clădim tradiție.
organizer: Clubul de Turism și Alpinism Ciucaș Ploiești
description: Ciucaș X3 is a mountain running event organized by the Ciucaș Ploiești Tourism and Mountaineering Club, promoting outdoor activity and mountain sports. A range of races, from a short vertical race to an ultramarathon, take place in the Ciucaș Mountains, offering challenges for amateurs, professionals, and children. The event has a history spanning more than 16 editions and supports the sustainable development of the local community. Participants can experience spectacular mountain scenery and varied routes in a friendly atmosphere with professional organization.

name: Vlasina 2026
description: The Vlasina Triathlon of Self-Transcendence is a traditional race held at the beautiful Vlasina Lake near Vladičin Han. Participants can choose from the Olympic, Sprint, Super Sprint, Super Kid, and Mini Kid triathlons, tailored to different ages and competition levels. The race is known for its atmosphere of self-transcendence and the support provided by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which promotes sport and spirituality. Each competitor receives a race number, a certificate, and a finisher’s medal.

name: Δρόμος Μάχης Μαραθώνα
description: The Battle of Marathon Road Race is a historic race organized by the Telmissos Marathon Runners Club. The race honors the memory of the Battle of Marathon and offers a unique running experience on a route of historical and natural beauty. Telmissos actively supports the race and invites runners of all levels to take part and run together in Marathon. The event includes accompanying races and group registrations, strengthening the spirit of community and sporting tradition.

name: Ορειβατικός Μαραθώνιος Ολύμπου
description: The Olympus Mountaineering Marathon is a historic race organized by the Thessaloniki Mountaineering Club. It is a demanding route across Mount Olympus, offering participants unique natural beauty and challenges. The event includes 5, 15, and 42-kilometer routes, catering to different levels of difficulty and experience. The organizers emphasize athlete safety and support, with aid stations along the course.

name: Voio Race Series
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations across the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, well-being, and social cohesion, with volunteers and the active participation of the local community. Sport is presented as a wonderful part of life, while taking part is considered a victory and finishing a triumph. The event is open to people over 15 and encourages young people and children to participate with their parents’ consent.

name: European Masters Off Road Championships
description: The 2026 European Masters Off-Road Running Championships in Râșnov bring together masters athletes from across Europe to compete in the heart of the Carpathian Mountains. The event takes place in the historic town of Râșnov, offering a technical trail-running course combined with Transylvania’s rich cultural heritage. This competition is a unique opportunity for masters athletes to test their skills on challenging and scenic terrain.

name: Пирин ултра
distance_verbose: 160 km, 68 km, 38 km, 33 km, 17 km, 2 km
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers a range of distances suitable for both experienced ultramarathoners and enthusiasts who want to enjoy the mountain’s unique nature and challenges. The routes follow scenic trails with impressive views and technical sections that require good preparation and skill. The event combines a sporting challenge with an opportunity to discover the beauty of Pirin.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in Pirin National Park, including technical sections
Routes with impressive panoramic views and a variety of trails
Passage through key checkpoints and aid stations
additional: For the 38 km and 68 km distances, you must have 2 ITRA points from at least one race before registering. For the 160 km distance, 4 ITRA points are required. Registration includes a medical examination and a check of the mandatory equipment. The drop bag must be handed in on registration day and is transported to the Mandrata checkpoint, which the course passes twice.

name: Arad Half Marathon
organizer: Asociația City Guide, prin platforma Arad Run
description: Arad Half Marathon is an urban running event held in Mihai Eminescu Park in Arad, offering a variety of races for runners of all levels. The event includes an individual half marathon and relay, races for adults and children, a nighttime charity run, and family races, creating a friendly, community atmosphere. Participants can experience urban running in an active and dynamic setting, with courses suited to both performance and accessible movement. A distinctive feature is the Punem Rădăcini Race, a nighttime charity run supporting a local tree-planting project.
course_highlights: Urban courses starting and finishing in Mihai Eminescu Park
An approximately 22.5 km half marathon and relay over the same distance
A 3 km nighttime charity run as part of the Punem Rădăcini project
additional: The event includes races for children and families, with prizes, medals, and participant kits. Relay handoffs take place in areas designated by the organizer. The half marathon has a 3-hour time limit. After the nighttime charity run, participants can suggest names for the trees planted as part of the Punem Rădăcini project. The Kids Run and Family Race are free. The entry fee for the Punem Rădăcini Race is donated in full to the project of the same name.

name: 20ό Hercules Series
description: The 20th Hercules Series is a series of mountain races held in Ypati, Phthiotis, offering routes of varying distances that cross the most iconic trails of Mount Oiti. The races feature demanding routes with natural beauty, historic sites, and picturesque villages, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with nature. The event is open to runners of all levels and offers a unique mountain-running experience in a magnificent setting.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: The Oiti Ultra Trail (OUT 100K) is a demanding 101.7-kilometer ultramarathon on Mount Oiti, with 5,265 meters of elevation gain. The route combines natural and historic trails, passing through mountain villages, dense forests, and Oiti’s highest peak. It offers a unique experience that pushes the limits of body and mind. The race connects sport with nature and history, making it a challenge for mountain-running enthusiasts.

name: Woodrocks Trail Run
description: Woodrocks Trail Run is a mountain running event held in the village of Petriș, offering three storybook courses for runners of all levels. The 6 km Green Course is ideal for beginners, with shady trails and gentle hills. The 15 km Blue Course offers an exhilarating experience with moderate climbs, while the 35 km Pink Course is a thrilling adventure with 1,600 metres of elevation gain over rugged terrain and scenic ridgelines. The event celebrates the joy of running in nature and supports environmental education through the EcoStuff Romania Association.

name: Maratonul Dragomirnei
description: The Dragomirna Marathon is an annual competition held in the Dragomirna Beech Forest Nature Reserve in Suceava. It offers a unique running experience in nature, combining scenic landscapes with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization. The event includes several races, from a full marathon to a half marathon and a cross-country race, catering to both experienced and amateur runners. Participants receive race kits and prizes, while the organizers promote an active community committed to supporting sport and the environment.

name: AIUD GREEN RUN by DP World
organizer: DP World, Primăria și Consiliul Local Aiud, Asociația Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesület
description: Aiud Green Run by DP World is a sporting event that promotes a healthy, eco-friendly lifestyle, giving participants the opportunity to run scenic routes surrounded by nature and authentic Transylvanian landscapes. The event includes a 21 km half marathon, an 8 km race, and a 2 km family run, suitable for all experience levels. The routes are designed to challenge and inspire runners while offering a friendly atmosphere and a memorable experience in the municipality of Aiud. The start is near Aiud Fortress, and the event is organized in partnership with Aiud City Hall and the Dr. Brendus Gyula Egyesulet Association.

name: ORADEA RUN FEST
description: Oradea Run Fest returns for its second edition on September 12 in Piața Unirii, Oradea. The event promises an experience full of energy, movement and good cheer, bringing together people passionate about sport, health and community. The organizers are preparing a spectacular edition with surprises and special moments for participants.

name: RUNNING FESTIVAL CSIKSZEREDA
description: Running Festival Csíkszereda is a running event that combines the urban beauty of Miercurea Ciuc with the natural scenery of the surrounding area. The routes pass through historic and picturesque places such as Márton Áron High School, Mikó Fortress, and the Șumuleu Ciuc area, offering spectacular views of Șumuleu Mare Mountain. The festival features a variety of races, from the marathon and half marathon to children’s and family races, all accompanied by cultural and social activities. It is more than a race—it is a community experience with live music, a pasta party, and other recreational activities.
course_highlights: Routes through urban and natural areas, with views of Șumuleu Mare Mountain
Passing historic landmarks such as Márton Áron High School and Mikó Fortress
Trail-running paths in the Șumuleu area and at the mountaintop altar
additional: The event includes a 10 km night trail race starting at 19:30 on the preceding day, multiple races for all ages, a post-race pasta party, live music along the route, cultural and recreational activities, including visits to the Székely Museum of Ciuc and relaxation at Csíki Csobbanó. The program includes 5 km and 10 km races, a half marathon, marathon, marathon relay, night trail, children’s race, and family race. The festival also offers activities such as a pasta party and live bands along the route.

name: Festivalul Sporturilor Greenfield
location: Greenfield Plaza, Greenfield Băneasa, Bucharest, Romania
description: The Greenfield Sports Festival is an outdoor multisport event held in Greenfield Băneasa. Greenfield editions bring together trail running, mountain biking and orienteering events, alongside activities for children and families. Participants can choose from recreational and competitive events during a weekend dedicated to exercise and spending time in nature.
course_highlights: The running routes pass through Băneasa Forest and include distances of 5 km, 11 km and 21 km.
The MTB events take place on forest trails and singletrack, with Family and E-Bike options.
Greenfield Plaza is the start and finish point for events described in previous editions.
additional: Previous editions have also included swimming, orienteering and children’s races; the programme may include activities for the whole family.

name: Heritage Run
location: Fortified Church of Biertan, Biertan, Sibiu County, Romania
organizer: Fundația Biserici Fortificate, Primăria Biertan, Anii Drumeției, Asociația Clubul Sportiv Montan Sibiu și Asociația My Transylvania
description: Heritage Run is a charity trail-running event that combines the joy of exercising in nature with support for valuable historic monuments. The routes range from 7 to 22 km and pass by four fortified churches, including the fortified church in Biertan, which is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Participants contribute directly to the restoration of these sites through their entry fee, which includes a donation to the Fortified Churches Foundation. The event offers a unique trail-running experience on country roads and marked paths, amid authentic Transylvanian landscapes.
course_highlights: Routes of 7 to 22 km passing by four fortified churches, including Biertan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Varied terrain on country roads and narrow paths marked by Via Transilvanica and the Transylvanian Hills
Elevation gains ranging from +30 m to +625 m, with hydration stations every 5 km
additional: Race bib pickup takes place between 06:30 and 08:30. The technical briefing is at 08:45. Brunch for participants is served in the courtyard of the fortified church between 10:30 and 11:45, and the awards ceremony begins at 12:00. Parking is available in Biertan Central Square, approximately 200 m from the start. The entry fee for adult races includes a donation of 5 EUR to the Fortified Churches Foundation.

name: Run&Care
description: Run&Care is a charity race associated with Rompetrol and KMG International, bringing employees and runners together to support social causes. The event has supported children with serious illnesses and families in need. Participants can turn running into an act of solidarity.

name: Bukovački maraton 2026
description: The Bukovac Marathon – Long Course is a challenging mountain race held on Fruška Gora, starting and finishing in Bukovac. The course is 47.8 km long, with 1,350 metres of ascent and 1,350 metres of descent. It is well maintained and marked with red-and-white hiking blazes, and passes significant sites including the Novo Hopovo, Staro Hopovo, Grgeteg, Krušedol and Velika Remeta monasteries, as well as Branko’s Grave and monument. The race is intended for experienced hikers and runners who want to experience the natural surroundings and cultural heritage of Fruška Gora.

name: 8ο Acheloos Run
description: The 8th Acheloos Run is organized by the Oiniades Running Team in Neochori, Messolonghi, and includes road races on public roads for all ages. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas beside the Acheloos River, with flat terrain and historic sites, offering a unique running experience. The finish is near the sea, where runners can enjoy local products and music at a beach party. The event is supported by volunteers and safety agencies to ensure participants’ safety.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: The Oiti Ultra Trail is a challenging 101.7-kilometer ultramarathon held on Mount Oiti, combining natural beauty, history, and endurance. The route includes trails through dense forests, mountain settlements, and the highest peak of Oiti, offering runners a unique experience. The race is part of the events organized by the Fthiotida Runners Club TRACHINA and is classified as UTMB 100K with 4 ITRA points. The event connects sport with the region’s nature and history.

name: Serifos Sunset Race
description: The routes include 5 km and 10 km road races starting and finishing at Vagia Beach, as well as 750 m, 1,500 m and 3,000 m swimming races in Livadi Bay. The event offers a unique sunset running experience, ideal for runners and swimmers of all levels. It also provides an opportunity to visit beautiful Serifos and enjoy local activities and hospitality.

name: Syros Trail Challenge
description: Syros Trail Challenge 2026 is a running race held in Ermoupoli, Syros, featuring 3 km and 10 km routes. The routes pass through paved alleyways, stairs, trails, and stone-paved paths, offering a unique experience in an urban and natural setting. The race is open to men and women over 18, with age categories for the 10 km race, and includes a commemorative T-shirt and medal for all participants. The start and finish are at Miaouli Square in Ermoupoli, and the maximum time allowed to complete the races is 2 hours and 30 minutes.

name: 1ο Prostate Cancer Race «Τρέχουμε για την Πρόληψη»
11ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Μνήμης για τη Μικρασιατική Καταστροφή «Από τον Ασκάνιο στον Ερασίνο»
Бургас Рън
description: Burgas Run is the first running festival in Bulgaria, bringing together recreational and professional runners across various distances in the beautiful city of Burgas. The event offers a variety of courses suitable for all ages and fitness levels, combining sport, fun, and a sense of community. Participants can enjoy a well-organized race supported by volunteers and partners who ensure an excellent experience.

name: Чудобой 2026
description: Chudoboy is a team adventure race combining sporting disciplines with creative and intellectual challenges in nature in the village of Asparuhovo, Varna. The race offers three categories with different technical difficulty levels and course lengths—Elite, Hobby, and Ailyak—suitable for varying levels of fitness. Teams consist of two people, at least one of whom must be an adult. The race is aimed at adventure enthusiasts looking for both a competitive and adventurous spirit.

name: Râșnov Medieval Run  ~ 2026
location: centrul orașului Râșnov, Râșnov, Brașov County, Romania
description: Râșnov Medieval Run is a running race held in the center of Râșnov, combining medieval spirit with a passion for running. The event offers participants a unique experience, with clear participation requirements, including presenting a medical certificate and wearing the race bib throughout the race. The start is scheduled for the morning, and the organizers provide facilities such as timing, first aid, and a dedicated start and finish area. It is a competition suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a special atmosphere and the picturesque scenery of Râșnov.
course_highlights: Route through the center of Râșnov
Unique medieval atmosphere
Timing and first-aid facilities provided
additional: Participants must bring an identity document when collecting their race kit. They must present a medical certificate or accept responsibility for their physical fitness. The race bib must be worn on the front of the shirt throughout the race, from start to finish. Participants must present identification and a medical certificate, and wear their race bib visibly. Registration is online, with on-site registration also possible while places remain.

name: Rombat Trail Run
description: Rombat Trail Run is a mountain running race that invites over 600 nature lovers to take part in the spectacular natural landscape of the Ghinzii and Codrișor forests. The event offers an authentic trail-running experience, combining athletic challenge with the beauty of the surrounding environment. Organized by Runners Club, this competition is for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and test their limits in a friendly, professional setting.

name: Zăvoi Trail Comana
description: Zăvoi Trail Comana is a sporting event for trail running and mountain biking enthusiasts, held in the heart of Comana Natural Park, a protected area with impressive biodiversity. The event is organized by the Plogging for Romania Association, which promotes sport and environmental protection through plogging activities. The routes offer an authentic nature-exploration experience, combining sporting challenges with awareness of the importance of protecting the local ecosystem. Participants can choose between mountain bike and trail running races, each featuring spectacular and accessible routes.

name: Baia Mare Half Marathon
organizer: Maramureș Runners, Rotary Club Baia Mare
description: The Baia Mare Half Marathon is an annual sporting event that brings together runners from across the country to celebrate movement, community, and an active lifestyle. The main race is the 21 km half marathon, held on an urban course consisting of 6 loops of 3.5 km each, for participants over the age of 15. The event also includes relay races, a 7 km cross-country race, a 3 km fun run, children’s races, and a special AutiSmile race dedicated to people with autism. The organizers emphasize health, community, and environmental protection, planting trees for every kilometer run.

name: 8ο Νάουσα Βέρμιο Trail
organizer: Α.Σ. Νάουσα Βέρμιο Trail και Δήμος Νάουσας
description: The Naousa Vermio Trail offers a unique mountain-running experience on Mount Vermio and in the city of Naousa. It features routes of varying distances, including the challenging 6 Peaks race (44 km, with 3,000 meters of elevation gain), the Amazonios (24.4 km), the Ververa (10 km), and the fun Alsos Fun & Run (6 km). The routes cross beautiful natural landscapes, peaks, and trails, offering a challenge for runners of all levels. The welcoming event supports participants with aid stations and course markings.

name: Patmos ChoRun
description: Includes 21-kilometer (half marathon) and 5-kilometer races, as well as a 1,000-meter children’s race and power walking. The races start at central locations in Chora, offering a beautiful running experience on the island’s public roads. The event is organized by the Patmos Gymnastics Club “Stadion” in cooperation with the Municipality of Patmos and the South Aegean Region, under the auspices of the Dodecanese Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS Dodecanese).

name: Hercules Series
description: The Hercules Series is a mountain running race series held in Ypati and Mount Oiti. It includes four unique routes of varying distances and difficulty, as well as a children’s race in Loutra Ypatis. The routes feature steep climbs and natural beauty, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with the mountains. The event is open to everyone and is organized by the Fthiotida Runners’ Association TRACHINA.

name: Шосеен пробег „Карнобат”
description: The Karnobat Road Race is a traditional athletics competition organized by Atlet Club (Karnobat) and Karnobat Municipality. The event includes various distances for men, women, and junior athletes, with the course passing through Third of March Central Square in Karnobat. It attracts athletes from different age groups and offers an opportunity for sports competition and the promotion of athletics in the region.

name: Șiria Vertical Loop
description: Șiria Vertical Loop 2h is a short-duration mountain running competition for both amateurs and professionals, promoting the tourist heritage of Arad County, especially Șiria Fortress. The race follows a vertical-race course, with a 2.5 km loop and approximately 240 m of elevation gain per loop. The race lasts 2 hours. Participants must complete at least one full loop to be considered finishers. The race is known for its difficulty and the mental challenge it involves. The event is part of the A.T.I.A. Trail Trilogy and is included in the ITRA National League.

name: Gușterița Trail Run
description: Gușterița Trail Run (GTR) is a mountain running race held in Gușterița Forest in Sibiu, offering accessible and varied routes for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. The routes cross a rich natural area, with dirt trails and spruce forests, offering an authentic trail-running experience close to the city. The event promotes both competition and community, bringing together mountain running enthusiasts in a spectacular natural setting. GTR is an ideal opportunity to push your limits and enjoy nature in the company of other runners.

name: Mogoșa Race
description: Mogoșa Race is an annual mountain running competition held in September, starting at Domeniul Mogoșa in Baia Sprie, Maramureș. The event offers a variety of courses, from 4 km for all participants, to an accessible and engaging 11 km route, and a 21 km half marathon for experienced runners, featuring demanding climbs and technical descents. The race promotes an active lifestyle and the discovery of the natural beauty of the Mogoșa area in a vibrant, community atmosphere. It is organized by the Baia Mare în Mișcare Association, which supports physical activity and health in the community.

name: OMU MARATHON by Transilvania 100
description: OMU Marathon by Transilvania 100 is a challenging mountain race held in the Bucegi Mountains, finishing at the iconic Bran Castle. The main marathon covers 41 km with nearly 3,000 meters of elevation gain, traversing windswept plateaus, dark forests, and ancient trails up to Vf Omu at 2,505 meters. The event also features two shorter races, SCARA Skyrace (24 km, 1,800 m climb) and POARTA Cross (11 km, 420 m climb), all offering breathtaking Transylvanian scenery and professional support from the experienced Transylvania 100 team. The race takes place in early October, promising a memorable late-summer mountain adventure.

name: Crosul Memoriei 5K
location: Calea Partizanilor, Mărgău, Cluj County, Romania
organizer: Asociația Clubul Monarhiștilor Clujeni și Asociația Hai Afară
description: The Memory Cross is an approximately 5 km mountain run along the Partisans’ Trail in the commune of Mărgău, in the Apuseni Mountains. It is Romania’s first memorial-themed trail, dedicated to the memory of the anti-communist resistance group “Teodor Șușman.” The event is part of Apuseni – Memorial Celebrations and offers a sporting and cultural experience, with special guests and a varied programme including themed hikes, exhibitions, and music around a campfire. The race starts at around 11:30.
course_highlights: An approximately 5 km mountain route along the Partisans’ Trail
Romania’s first memorial-themed trail
The Apuseni Mountains area, with panoramic viewpoints and historical features
additional: The event is part of a broader programme that includes a themed hike, the premiere of a documentary film, comic-book, painting, and icon exhibitions, discussions, and an evening of music around a campfire. Registration for the 2026 edition was online at my-run.ro, with two options: Standard Participation and Kit + Raffle.

name: Delicium Run Fest
location: Ferma Delicium, Borșa, Cluj County, Romania
description: Delicium RUN Fest is a running event held at Delicium Farm in Borșa, Cluj County, celebrating movement, family, and community in a unique natural setting. The routes pass through the farm’s raspberry and blackberry plantations, offering an accessible and enjoyable experience for all ages, including adult races and parent-child relays. The event focuses on the joy of movement and spending time together, rather than performance or long distances. After the race, participants can enjoy local products and relax in the farm’s specially designated areas.
course_highlights: Route through the raspberry and blackberry plantations at Delicium Farm
Short, accessible route of approximately 1.6 km within the farm
Parent-child relays for a family and team experience
additional: All participants receive medals. After the race, there are relaxation areas with hammocks, fresh fruit, the option to buy local products from the farm shop, and a restaurant where participants can have a meal. The event showcases the farm’s local products and offers a setting suited to family participation.

name: Radmilovac Trail
description: Radmilovac Trail is a unique race held in the green natural oasis of Radmilovac, not far from Belgrade. The race takes runners through orchards, vineyards, and fishponds, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant atmosphere. In addition to the standard 5 km and 10 km races, there is a special academic category for PhDs and doctoral candidates, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle. The event is organized by the Faculty of Agriculture in Zemun and AGRIF runners, and is known for its generous race pack and prizes for the top competitors.

name: Soko Čovka trail
description: Soko Čovka Trail is a mountain race held in Lazarevac, Županjac. It is organized by the VIS Mountaineering Club and gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty of central Serbia on challenging trails. The race brings together nature and sports enthusiasts, offering a unique atmosphere and a well-organized event.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the natural surroundings of Lazarevac and Županjac
Mountain terrain with challenging climbs and descents
Views of central Serbia and the surrounding landscapes

name: 1ος Διεθνής Ημιμαραθώνιος «Νικηταράς»
location: εκκίνηση: Άνω Δολιανά –  τερματισμός: Τρίπολη Αρκαδίας
description: The 1st International “Nikitaras 2026” Half Marathon is an outdoor road race held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli, as part of a three-day event in honor of Yiannis Kouros. The race starts in Ano Doliana and finishes in Tripoli, offering a unique experience for runners wishing to take part in an international half marathon. The event emphasizes safety and course quality, with a limited number of participants to ensure better organization and protect runners’ health.

name: 20ός Γύρος Λίμνης Ιωαννίνων
description: The Ioannina Lake Run is a flat, paved 30-kilometer race that passes through the area around Lake Pamvotida, offering a unique experience amid a landscape of natural beauty. It is suitable both for runners taking on this distance for the first time and for those aiming for strong performances. The start and finish are at Mavili Square in Ioannina, with runners setting off in waves from 8:15 a.m. The event has a long tradition and attracts thousands of runners each year, creating a three-day running festival with races for all ages and ability levels.

name: 57-ми шосеен пробег „Колю Фичето”
description: The 57th Kolyo Ficheto Road Race in Dryanovo is a traditional competition that brings together running enthusiasts from the region. The event takes place in the town’s picturesque surroundings, offering an opportunity for physical activity and socializing amid the natural scenery and historic landmarks of the area. The race is part of Dryanovo Municipality’s sports calendar and is organized with the support of the local administration.
course_highlights: Races over 300 m, 800 m, and 2,000 m.
Competition categories for different age groups.
Held on the roads of Dryanovo.

name: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026
description: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026 invites you to immerse yourself in the magic of the Elena Balkan mountains with three challenging distances: 12 km for beginners and speed enthusiasts, with panoramic views; 21 km on a balanced course combining technical sections and impressive scenery; and 33 km, combining the dynamism of the 12 km route with the technical challenge of the 21 km route. The event takes place in the town of Elena and promises autumn colors, fresh air, and unforgettable experiences for all participants. Registration is mandatory for everyone over 18, while younger participants have special participation terms.

name: XL kmrun - Кремиковци
description: XL kmrun - Kremikovtsi is an organized 5 km run held in Sofia. The event is part of the 5kmrun series, which takes place in several Bulgarian cities and is aimed at runners of all ages and ability levels. The start is at 9:00, and participation is free, making the event accessible and appealing to a wide range of runners. 5kmrun offers a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy regular outdoor exercise.
course_highlights: 5 km road run
Held in Kremikovtsi, Sofia
Start at 9:00
additional: Participation is free. The event takes place weekly in several cities across Bulgaria. Special initiatives include 5kmrun FEST and children’s runs. It offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Oradea City Running Day
description: Oradea City Running Day is an annual sporting event featuring half-marathon and relay races, 10.5 km and 5 km runs, as well as a children’s run. The urban courses start and finish in Ferdinand Square, crossing bridges and scenic areas along the Criș River. The event is open to both recreational and competitive runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and opportunities to socialize and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can collect their race kits the day before or on race day. The event is organized by the Xterra Sport Bihor Sports Club Association.
course_highlights: Urban course starting and finishing in Ferdinand Square, Oradea
Four laps for the half-marathon and two laps for the 10.5 km run
Passing under the Decebal and Carol I bridges and running along the Criș River
additional: Race kits can be collected in Ferdinand Square, next to Regina Maria Theatre, on Saturday from 16:30 to 20:00 and Sunday from 7:30 to 9:30. The children’s run starts at 13:00 and is for children up to 12 years old; it is non-competitive, with no awards at the finish. Half-marathon relay teams consist of four runners, each running one 5.2 km lap. Entry fees are paid online through the EuPlătesc system, and registration is not available on race day. Children’s races are also organized.

name: Crosul Companiilor
description: The Crosul Companiilor powered by Emerson is the largest team-building event in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together employees from various companies for a race through the city streets. The event promotes team spirit and health through sport, offering participants an enjoyable and dynamic experience. The course is designed to be accessible and motivating, encouraging people to take part in teams and support their colleagues. The organizers, Runners Club, provide a friendly and professional atmosphere, with official partners and dedicated support.

name: TRAIL LA CABANĂ
location: Rezervorul de apă, Slobozia, Ciurea, Iași County, Romania
organizer: Asociația Cultural-Umanitară „Fiii Satelor”, împreună cu Primăria Comunei Ciurea și Asociația G.A.L. „Colinele Iașilor”
description: Trail La Cabană is a running event in the forests of Slobozia, Ciurea commune, Iași, offering four races for all levels: a 21 km half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 3 km popular run, and a children’s race. The event starts and finishes at the Slobozia Water Reservoir and emphasizes exercise, nature, and community. The marked courses include trails, forest roads, and clearings, near a Natura 2000 protected area. Participants benefit from electronic timing, hydration points, and cash prizes for the main races.
course_highlights: Forest courses featuring trails, forest roads, and clearings
The half marathon passes Izvorul Sloboziei, Poiana cu Cetate, Poiana cu Schit, Cabana Bârnova, and Canton Dobrovăț
Hydration and refreshment points along the course
additional: Race kits are collected before the start and include a race number, the official T-shirt (if selected during registration), and information about the course and hydration points. Cash prizes are awarded to first- and second-place finishers in the half marathon and cross-country race, while the popular run and children’s race award medals and diplomas. Time limits are 3h30 for the half marathon, 2h for the cross-country race, and 1h for the popular run. For the off-road courses, shoes with good grip and gear suited to the terrain and weather are recommended.

name: Brăila Bridge Half Marathon
description: Brăila Bridge Half Marathon is an annual event that brings together thousands of runners along the Danube waterfront, offering a unique running experience across and alongside the Danube. With three main events—the 21 km half marathon, the 8.5 km race, and the 5 km race—plus races for children and families, the event is suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The course is spectacular, featuring the bridge over the Danube and views of the river, while the post-race atmosphere is enlivened by music and the joy of the community. The organizers emphasize participation and charitable causes, making this race a celebration of sport and solidarity.
course_highlights: A straight, open course along the Danube waterfront, ideal for personal records
Crossing the Brăila Bridge with views of the river
A vibrant post-race atmosphere with music and gatherings in the city
additional: The starts are scheduled as follows: the half marathon and the 8.5 km race begin at 9:00 from the Brăila Bridge Maintenance and Coordination Center, the 5 km race begins at 9:30 from Independence Square, and the children's races and Family Fun Run start separately later. Race kits can be collected in the days before the event at Brăila Mall and in the start/finish area. Registration for competitive races is not available on race day. Special races are available for children aged 6 to 14 and for families, promoting a day of running for everyone. Children's races and the Family Fun Run are available, along with charitable options.

name: HoneyRun
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 3000 metri, 1.2 km, 0.8 km, 0.2 km, 0.1 km
description: HoneyRun is a sporting event held in Lugoj, dedicated to promoting an active and healthy lifestyle. All races take place at Stadionul Tineretului, with events for children and adults and a range of distances suited to all ages and fitness levels. The event is free, with a limited number of places, and is supported by Honeywell Technologies. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to spend quality time outdoors with family and friends.
course_highlights: All races take place at Stadionul Tineretului in Lugoj
Distances range from 200 m for children to 10,000 m for adults
The courses consist of multiple laps of the stadium, with a set number of laps for each distance
additional: The event is free, with a limited total of 500 places or 100 places per race. Race kits can be collected at Piața Iosif Constantin Drăgan and Stadionul Tineretului. The schedule includes kit distribution in the days leading up to the event and on race day. Races start at 09:00, with events for children and adults, including a FunRun 4 x 100 m relay. Each person may register for only one race, except for the FunRun Relay; places are limited.

name: Semimaraton Brăila
description: The Brăila Half Marathon is an annual race held along the riverfront and in Monument Park in Brăila, offering participants an enjoyable and accessible running experience. The event promotes solidarity by supporting local charitable causes, and runners can turn every kilometer into an act of support for the community. The course is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners, providing an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of Brăila in a friendly, sporty setting.

name: 10. Zrenjaninski polumaraton
description: The Zrenjanin Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Zrenjanin since 2016 and is known as one of the best-organized half marathons in Serbia. The course is 21.1 km long, flat and circular, and passes through the city’s most beautiful areas, including the 4. jul and Ruža Šulman neighborhoods, with the start in front of City Hall. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers 7 km and 14 km races, Nordic walking, and a 3 x 7 km relay, welcoming runners of different abilities and ages. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community, and runners become part of the story of a city known for its big heart and generous hosts.

name: 1ος Διεθνής Διπλός Μαραθώνιος Δρόμος “Γιάννης Κούρος 2026”
organizer: Γιάννης Κούρος – Πέρα από τα όρια
description: The 1st International Double Marathon «Yiannis Kouros 2026» is a demanding ultramarathon of approximately 455 kilometers, starting and finishing in Tripoli. The race runs over varied terrain, mainly old paved roads with hills, as well as dirt roads and trails. Runners are encouraged to bring headlamps for the night course. The race has a completion time limit of 84 hours, and participation is by invitation, with strict performance criteria. The race is part of a three-day celebration honoring Yiannis Kouros and is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli.

name: 3ο Dadia Trail Run
description: The 3rd Dadia Trail Run is a mountain race held in the Dadia Forest, in Soufli, Evros, every September since 2024. The race is organized to help restore the natural environment and promote sports for all, inspired by the message that hope can rise again from the ashes. The event is supported by the Authentic Athens Marathon Runners’ Group «ORAMA» and the Honorary Chief of the Hellenic Army General Staff, retired General Charalambos Lalousis, who has a special connection to the area. The race invites everyone to take an active part in the effort to restore the forest and life.

name: 9ο Lesvos Trail
description: The 9th Lesvos Trail is a mountain running event held in Lepetymnos, Lesvos, offering 15 km, 6 km, and 1 km routes. The routes cross the Lepetymnos mountain range and pass through agricultural and livestock-farming areas, combining natural beauty with local character. The event is supported by the Molyvos Tourism Board and has been moved to an autumn date due to restrictions in the area. The race is ideal for runners seeking a mountain-running experience in a warm yet beautiful setting.

name: 10ο Lailias Mountain Running
description: The 10th Lailias Mountain Running race takes place at the Lailias Ski Center near Serres. It is a mountain running event with two routes, 6Km and 21Km, offering runners the chance to enjoy the natural pine forest and the unexplored trails of Lailias. The race welcomes both beginners and more experienced runners, with positive elevation gains of 200m and 1350m respectively, offering a unique mountain running experience in a stunning setting.

name: Run Greece Trikala
description: Run Greece Trikala 2026 is a running event offering 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a power walking event and races for children and families. The event emphasizes runner safety and support, with support stations and medical coverage. Participation is open to everyone, with special rates for students in group registrations. Runners who complete the 10 km race receive a medal and a certificate of participation. The event offers an opportunity for physical activity and community participation in the city of Trikala.

name: CURSA IMPOSIBILĂ
description: The Impossible Race is a unique virtual event in which participants reach the finish line one hour before the time they started. It is not a competitive race, but a personal and collective challenge held throughout 2026. Participants can choose from multiple sports and routes, including running, walking, cycling, rollerblading, swimming, and water sports, with a range of distances, some even thousands of kilometers long. The event emphasizes community spirit and supporting causes, and awards a finisher medal to everyone who completes the challenge.

name: Thessaloniki Stage Run
description: The Thessaloniki Stage Run is a multi-stage race in the peri-urban Seich Sou Forest in Thessaloniki, designed for runners of all levels. It consists of three race stages: a 15 km night race, a challenging 40 km race, and a fast 25 km race, offering a comprehensive trail-running experience. The event encourages participants to run all three stages to fully enjoy the journey through the forest. The race combines natural beauty, challenge, and atmosphere, with the city lights as a backdrop.

name: K3 ULTRA – GOLD BORDER RACE
description: K3 ULTRA - GOLD BORDER RACE is the first ultramarathon to cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains in Bulgaria. The race takes place in late September, when nature is at its most picturesque and colorful. Participants can enjoy professionally organized routes with minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails, and special support along the course. The event is a UTMB qualifier and awards points toward the ITRA ranking. All finishers receive a medal and a special race pack with a T-shirt and gifts.

name: K3 Ultra 2026
organizer: Клуб за спорт и туризъм К3 Ултра
description: K3 ULTRA is one of the largest ultramarathons in Bulgaria, held in the picturesque Rhodope Mountains. The race offers five different courses of varying distances and elevation gains, all qualifying for the UTMB Index and earning points for the ITRA Ranking. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, race number and gifts, and the courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides medical assistance, aid stations with food and drinks, and professional race photography, creating an unforgettable experience in the magical Rhodope Mountains.

name: Поморие Рън / Pomorie Run
description: Pomorie Run is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and offers an attractive 10.25 km long-distance race and a 2023-meter short distance for beginners. The course follows the beach along the Black Sea and returns on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake, combining sea views with natural beauty. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and newcomers, and children’s athletics activities for young talents take place before the race. Pomorie Run is a traditional event that attracts national champions and members of Bulgaria’s national team.

name: Pavlikeni Run
description: Pavlikeni Run is a charity run organized by Absolut + Supermarkets in the city of Pavlikeni. The race offers two distances—3.5 km and 7 km—suitable for runners of different levels. The start is at 09:30 on September 25, 2027, at 16 Stefan Karadzha Street, Pavlikeni. The event combines sporting spirit with support for a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Two distances—3.5 km and 7 km
Start at the Absolut + Supermarket in Pavlikeni
