The event is charitable in nature
additional: The start for all distances is at 09:30. The organizer is Gergana Georgieva. The event takes place on September 25, 2027, in the city of Pavlikeni. A child may run the distance together with a parent.

name: Чудобой сити 2026
location: Kovshak Cheshma, Aladzha Monastery area, Varna, Bulgaria
price_range: 20 € за възрастни / 15 € за деца под 14 г.
description: Chudoboy City 2026 is an urban competition featuring several stages with different sports disciplines, including mountain biking, archery, climbing, kayaking, logic challenges, and compass orienteering. The competition takes place in the area of Aladzha Monastery, Kovshak Cheshma, Varna, and is part of the European Week of Sport program. Participants compete in teams, with both speed and skills across the different stages being evaluated. The event is organized by SC Chudnite Skali and VK Ustrem, with support from Varna Municipality and the Decathlon store.
course_highlights: Mountain biking stage, with the team time based on the second rider
Archery for points based on the shots
Rowing in tandem kayaks at Karantinata Beach
additional: Technical briefing at 9:30 a.m. in the meadow at Kovshak Cheshma; awards ceremony at 7:00 p.m. in the climbing gym at the former Yuri Gagarin swimming complex; the competition is part of the European Week of Sport program in Varna Municipality. The kayak stage takes place at Karantinata Beach, while archery and climbing are held in the climbing gym at the former Yuri Gagarin swimming complex.

name: Semimaraton Porolissum
organizer: ASOCIATIA CLUBUL SPORTIV TODO RUN ZALĂU
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is an annual mountain race held in the heart of history, in the area around the Porolissum Roman Camp in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The event offers three distinct races: the 23 km Half Marathon, the 12 km Salamander Race, and the 1.6 km Fortifications Tour, welcoming runners of all levels. The routes combine the challenge of mountain running with spectacular scenery and historical features, making them ideal for nature and history enthusiasts. The organizers provide a complete experience, with hydration stations, timing, and an awards ceremony.

name: ASCOTID Trail Race
organizer: ASCOTID (Asociația Copiilor și Tinerilor Diabetici - Mureș)
description: ASCOTID Trail Race is an annual off-road running competition held in the Cornești Plateau area of Târgu Mureș. The event promotes physical activity for all age groups and was initiated by the Association of Children and Young People with Diabetes Mureș (ASCOTID). The routes include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to the elevation changes. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere, with a focus on social and health goals.

name: „Alerg Pentru Tine” Trail Run
description: Alerg Pentru Tine Trail Run is a charity sporting event held in the picturesque forests of Bucovina, near Sucevița. The event supports palliative care patients at Sf. Luca Sucevița and Sf. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava hospitals, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of those going through difficult times. Participants can choose from three moderately difficult races, suitable for both experienced and less experienced runners, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The courses offer spectacular views of the Sucevița Valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.

name: ALBA IULIA CITY RACE Aleargă în cealaltă capitală!
description: Alba Iulia City Race is a major athletic event held in the heart of the Alba Carolina Citadel, giving participants the opportunity to run through a remarkable historic setting. The competition includes several races, from a half marathon and a 10 km cross-country race to fun runs and children’s races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a community of runners. The event is a running festival, combining a passion for sport with exploration and recognition of local values. The organizers emphasize a complete experience, with personalized race kits, hydration stations, electronic timing, and attractive prizes.

name: POROLISSUM TRAIL
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is a mountain running event held in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The main 23 km course offers a spectacular experience, starting and finishing at the heart of history, the Porolissum Roman Fort. The event also includes 12 km and 1.6 km races, for both advanced runners and enthusiasts of nature and history. The organizers offer a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, with race kits available for pickup in the days leading up to the event and on race day.

name: TRASCĂU TRAIL RUN
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: marathon, half marathon, and cross-country, set amid the scenic landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. Participants will explore the natural beauty of the Trascău Mountains on routes featuring challenging climbs, forests, gorges, and spectacular viewpoints. The event focuses on the experience of running in nature, with courses that combine physical challenge, storybook scenery, and local heritage. The organizers provide hydration and aid stations, medals for those who finish within the time limit, and prizes for the top competitors.

name: RUN FOR LIFE
location: Pădurea Vlădiceasca, Dumbrava Vlăsiei, Snagov, Romania
description: Run for Life is a charity running event supporting the construction of the Life Call Maternal Center, a safe space for mothers and children in crisis situations. The event takes place in Vlădiceasca Forest, Dumbrava Vlăsiei, offering races for all ages and experience levels. Participants can choose from several distances, run in nature, and contribute to a worthy cause. Every kilometer run turns hope into concrete support for those in need.
course_highlights: Routes through the spectacular natural scenery of the Vlăsiei Forests
Events for all ages and experience levels
Charity event supporting the construction of the Life Call Maternal Center
additional: Each participant receives a technical T-shirt with a special-edition design, a handmade heart-shaped medal, a race number, chip timing, and surprises from partners.

name: Župska vinska trka 2026
description: The Župa Wine Run is a unique sporting and wine event held in the beautiful landscape of Župa, a renowned wine region in central Serbia. The race brings together wine and sports enthusiasts on a course that passes vineyards, mountains, and cultural and historical landmarks such as the medieval town of Koznik. Participants enjoy tastings at aid stations and receive an official T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, and other souvenirs. The event promotes the region’s rich traditions and natural beauty. The race starts at 12:00, and race packs can be collected until 11:00.

name: 44ο Σπάρταθλον
description: The Spartathlon is a historic and exceptionally challenging ultramarathon held from Athens to Sparta, retracing the footsteps of the ancient runner Pheidippides. The course covers approximately 246 kilometers over varied terrain, from flat sections to steep climbs and descents, with elevation changes of up to 1,200 meters. The race starts at 07:00 in the morning and lasts up to 36 hours, with strict time limits at the checkpoints. It is intended for experienced, well-prepared runners who meet specific performance standards in previous ultradistance races.

name: Международен шосеен пробег "Бягане на свободния дух Русе - Гюргево"
description: The international road race “Run for the Free Spirit Ruse–Giurgiu” is an annual event that brings together runners from Bulgaria and Romania for a race along the scenic route between the two cities. The race promotes sportsmanship and friendship between neighboring communities, offering a unique experience on the course. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with international participation and support.

name: Crosul Arenelor
description: Arenelor Cross is a unique running event that will take place on Bucharest’s best-known and most beautiful streets. A fast race with no U-turns, where you can enjoy the city without the usual daily traffic.

images.alt_text: Grup de alergători care fac exerciții de încălzire pe un teren sportiv la lumina soarelui.

name: Buzău 21k
description: Buzău 21k is the first half marathon in Buzău County, organized by the Buzău Community Foundation. The event brings the local community together to promote exercise, health, and charity, offering a vibrant running experience in the heart of the city. The route starts at Buzău Athletics Stadium, crosses Crâng Park, and continues along the city’s main boulevards and streets, creating an atmosphere full of energy and joy. Buzău 21k is more than a sporting competition—it is a call for movement and community involvement.

name: Rajac 2026
description: Kosidba on Rajac is a traditional event held since 1892, on the first Sunday after Petrovdan. It brings together mowers dressed in traditional peasant costumes, who compete in hand-mowing grass on prepared plots. In addition to the competition, the program includes an exhibition of mowing tools, folk performances, and cultural and artistic activities, creating a unique atmosphere and preserving folk traditions.

name: Ainos Mountain Marathon
description: The Ainos Mountain Marathon is a demanding mountain marathon held on Mount Ainos in Kefalonia. The 40.5-kilometer course crosses mountainous terrain on technical trails, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 meters, offering panoramic views of the surrounding islands and the mountains of Central Greece and the Peloponnese. There are also a half marathon of 23.5 km and an 11.1 km trail race, starting from the village of Pyrgi. The event provides bus transportation for athletes, free post-race food, and special offers on ferry tickets and accommodation.

name: Run Greece Alexandroupoli
description: Run Greece Alexandroupoli 2026 is a friendly road race offering 10 km and 5 km routes, children’s races, and a Family Run for the whole family. The event prioritizes safety and medical coverage, with volunteers and medical support along the course. Participation is open to everyone, with special rates for students in group registrations. The race is an opportunity for physical activity and community participation in the beautiful city of Alexandroupoli.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου «Στις γειτονιές των Μικρασιατών Προσφύγων»
Държавно военно първенство по функционален фитнес 2026
description: The 2026 National Military Functional Fitness Championship is a dynamic and exciting competition held at Artillery Park in Stara Zagora. The competition is divided into two modules. The first includes exercises on a stationary bike and an ergometer, as well as a lap of the park. The second is strength-based and includes jumping over obstacles, push-ups, carrying weights, pulling, and flipping tires. The competition is open to men and women and offers challenges that test both participants’ endurance and strength.
course_highlights: First module featuring exercises on a stationary bike and an ergometer
A lap of the entire Artillery Park
Second, strength-based module featuring obstacle jumps, push-ups, carrying weights, and tire flips
additional: The format includes two modules with different physical challenges, combining cardio and strength exercises. The event is part of a broader public program featuring military demonstrations and equipment displays.

name: Турнир ”Лекоатлетите на Добруджа”
description: The “Athletes of Dobrudzha” tournament takes place in the city of Dobrich and brings together athletes from the region for track and field competitions. The event is organized by the Municipality of Dobrich and aims to promote sport and a healthy lifestyle among the local community. The tournament is held at the renovated “Dobrotitsa” athletics hall, which offers excellent conditions for training and competitions.
course_highlights: Competitions at the renovated “Dobrotitsa” athletics hall
Participation of athletes from the Dobrudzha region
Promotion of track and field and the spirit of sport

name: Balkaniada
description: Balkaniada 2026 is a mountain skyrunning race held in the heart of Central Balkan National Park, near the city of Karlovo. The race offers challenging courses with impressive natural views and varied terrain, suitable for mountain runners and outdoor sports enthusiasts. After successfully hosting the 2025 Masters Skyrunning World Championships, Balkaniada is establishing itself as one of the leading mountain races in the Balkans. Participants can choose from several distances with varying lengths and elevation gain, offering a unique experience amid the wilderness.

name: Шосеен пробег „Варна”
description: The Varna Road Race is a traditional competition held in Varna’s Sea Garden, attracting some of the best runners in Bulgaria. The race includes various distances suitable for men, women, and young people, offering athletes from different age groups and clubs the opportunity to compete. The event is part of the sports calendar and promotes athletics in the region.

name: НАЦИОНАЛЕН УНИВЕРСИТЕТСКИ ШАМПИОНАТ ПО ЛЕКОАТЛЕТИЧЕСКИ КРОС – 2026
description: The National University Cross-Country Championships is a competition that aims to promote student sports within the academic community and crown the national university champions in cross-country running. The event is part of the sports calendar of the Association for University Sports “Akademik” and takes place in Studentski Park in Sofia. The championships offer men and women the opportunity to compete over different distances, fostering a spirit of sporting competition and community among students.
course_highlights: Men’s distance: 5 km
Women’s distance: 3 km
The course is in Studentski Park in Sofia

name: "UNIRUN" Благоевград 2026
description: UNIRUN Blagoevgrad 2026 is a race offering a challenge for everyone—from beginners to experienced athletes. The course is entirely on roads and passes through the heart of Blagoevgrad, with crowd support at every kilometer. The race includes three formats: 5 km, 10 km, and a special Time Attack event for the fastest runners. After the finish, participants can enjoy the UNIFEST festival area with games, a career zone, and healthy ideas. Part of the proceeds go to the “Pirin Without Fires” cause, supporting local forestry services.
course_highlights: An entirely road-based course through the center of Blagoevgrad
Crowd support at every kilometer
Three formats: 5 km, 10 km, and Time Attack
additional: 30% of ticket prices are donated toward purchasing firefighting equipment for forestry services. A VIP package with race entry and a limited-edition T-shirt is available. The event includes UNIFEST with games, activities, and a career zone. Part of the entry fee goes toward firefighting equipment for the Southwestern State Enterprise.

name: ВОАЯЖ - благотворителен Крос срещу Рака
description: The Voyage Charity Run in Plovdiv brings together participants of all ages and fitness levels in support of cancer prevention. The course passes interactive hydration stations and an art promenade featuring inspiring messages about health and prevention. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and after the finish, a large charity Thracian horo is held with FS “Paldin.” The event is organized by the Stop Cancer Association, with the mission of promoting a healthy lifestyle and solidarity in the fight against cancer.
course_highlights: Interactive hydration stations along the course
An art promenade with messages about health and prevention at the start, the little bridge, and the finish
A large charity Thracian horo with FS “Paldin” after the finish
additional: On-site registration is available on the day of the event from 10:00 to 11:30. Participants receive a race pack with a bib, a personal cause, a T-shirt, a cap, a bandana, and other items. Before the start, there is a morning warm-up with favorite athletes, performers, Era Ballet, and BG Be Active. On-site registration and race-pack collection are available. Participants receive a medal; volunteers and donors can also support the cause.

name: Mârzești Trail Run 2026
location: Pădurea Mârzești, Breazu, Iași County, Romania

name: Vâlcea Forest Run 2026
location: Strada Muzeului 3, Bujoreni, Vâlcea County, Romania

name: 140 BPM - 25 aprilie 2026
description: 140 BPM is a running race held in King Michael I Park (Herăstrău) in Bucharest. The event offers routes adapted for all ages, including races for children and adults, over distances of 3 km and 6 km. The routes are designed to be accessible and enjoyable, following the park’s paths and offering a recreational and competitive outdoor experience. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and facilities dedicated to runners.

name: Crosul Regina Maria
description: Queen Maria Cross is a running event held in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together the local running community for a competition full of energy and sportsmanship. The course starts near the Horia Demian Sports Hall and offers participants an enjoyable experience in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere. The event is supported by official sponsors and partners, helping ensure smooth operations and amenities for runners. It is an excellent opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running outdoors and connect with other enthusiasts.

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing is a unique endurance race within Zalău Ultra Trail that tests participants’ physical and mental limits. The format involves repeatedly running a course of approximately 6.7 km, with a start at the top of every hour; participants who do not finish the lap in time are eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains, making it an extreme challenge of endurance, willpower, and strategy. The event takes place in Poienița Aghireș and is part of the ZUT series, which promotes connection between athletes, the community, and nature.
course_highlights: Approximately 6.7 km course run in successive loops
Starts at the top of every hour, with a time limit of 59 minutes and 30 seconds per loop
Elimination format continues until only one runner remains
additional: Participants must complete each lap in under an hour to continue in the race. The race is extremely demanding, eliminating anyone who is late or withdraws. The organizer recommends careful preparation and strict adherence to the rules for safety and fair play.

name: Veverița Night Run
description: Veverița Night Run is a nighttime mountain running race in Bucovina, held in Vatra Dornei, with two medium-difficulty races over 12 km and 22 km. The routes are mainly on mountain trails, with sections through forest and open meadows, starting and finishing at the base of the Veverița ski slope and reaching Diecilor Peak. The event provides hydration and food stations, as well as medical assistance from the Vatra Dornei Mountain Rescue team. Participants should be prepared for mountain running and bring the equipment needed for nighttime and mountain conditions.
course_highlights: 12 km route with 95% mountain trail and 5% paved road
22 km route entirely on mountain trails, with 1161 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the base of the Veverița ski slope, with the highest point at Diecilor Peak (1301 m)
additional: Children can register on-site. Participants must have a headlamp with charged and spare batteries, a mobile phone with a charged battery, their race number visible throughout the race, and suitable equipment for adverse weather conditions. Medical assistance is provided by Vatra Dornei Mountain Rescue; no ambulance will be stationed at the start/finish.

name: Harvest Run
description: Harvest Run is a sporting event that promotes running as a way to support health, solidarity, and community. In Vladimirescu, Arad, participants of all ages are invited to take part in a range of races, from the half-marathon to children’s races, in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere. The event supports social causes and encourages an active lifestyle, bringing together runners of all levels to support the local community.
course_highlights: Varied routes: half-marathon 21 km, sprint 10 km, super sport 5 km, family race 1 km, and children’s races
An event for all ages, from children to adults and seniors
A community atmosphere and support for local social causes
additional: The community meets every Tuesday at 18:00 for group training, on a route from Sala Polivalentă Arad to Stadionul Gloria. The event includes the “MAI DEPARTE” project, dedicated to beginners and those who want to adopt a healthy lifestyle. Minimum ages for the races: 18 for the half-marathon, 14 for the sprint, 12 for super sport, no age limit for the family race, and special races for children aged 6 to 12.

name: Serbia Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Serbia Backyard Ultra is an ultrarace with no finish line, held in Pančevo. Runners complete a 6,706-meter loop every hour, aiming to run as many loops as they can while finishing each one within the hour. The last runner to finish a loop wins, and the race is more of a mental challenge than a competition against others. Every personal best is celebrated, and the race is an opportunity to test consistency, perseverance, and mental strength.
course_highlights: A 6,706-meter loop
Each loop must be completed within one hour
A race with no preset distance or finish line
additional: The race venue is Šajka, Kej Radoja Dakića, Pančevo. Runners who cover the longest distance can ring the “record bell” and celebrate their personal best. Registration for the race is closed.

name: Noć na Jezeru 2026
description: Night by the Lake is the third race in the Subotica Friendship League, held at the Great Terrace in Palić. The event features several distances suited to different ages and running levels, including children’s races and 5 km and 10 km races. It brings together runners from the region in a welcoming atmosphere and offers an opportunity to socialize and compete.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km courses
Children’s races of 1 km and 0.3 km
Held at the Great Terrace in Palić
additional: The program includes a raffle, a food truck, and a dance workshop.

name: 27ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου Νεάπολης Αγρινίου
description: The 27th Neapoli Agrinio Popular Road Race is a traditional running event held in the beautiful area of Neapoli, Aetolia-Acarnania. The race covers a distance of approximately 10 kilometers and offers an enjoyable course for runners of all levels. The welcoming event aims to promote sports and the local community. Participants can expect a well-organized event focused on athlete safety and support.

name: MakrakomiBackyardUltra
description: Makrakomi Backyard Ultra is a demanding ultradistance Backyard Ultra race held in the beautiful area of Makrakomi, West Phthiotis. Participants are challenged to run a 6,706-meter loop every hour, with a new start for the remaining athletes, until one winner remains. The race promotes sport, culture, and environmental protection, offering a unique experience in a natural and sensitive environment. The start and finish are at Makrakomi’s central square, with the race starting at 09:00 in the morning.

name: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv
description: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv is a corporate relay race and team-building event held at the LIEBHERR factory in Plovdiv. The race features teams of four, with each participant running 4 km by completing two laps of the flat 2 km course. It is the largest corporate run in southern Bulgaria, combining sport, fun, and charity. The event has been held in Plovdiv since 2017 and attracts companies from across the country.

name: Неофит Рилски маратон и колоездене 2026
description: Neofit Rilski Marathon and Cycling 2026 offers a unique adventure, with courses that pass through Bulgaria’s beautiful countryside from the village of Neofit Rilski to Ovech Fortress. The races include running and cycling at various distances, starting and finishing at Historical Park. Participants will face challenges with varying elevation gain and time limits, suitable for different fitness levels. A children’s run with treats is planned for kids. The event is suitable for sports and nature enthusiasts seeking a serious challenge and adventure.

name: Бягане за животните 2026
location: Ezeroto Ariana, Borisova Gradina, Sofia, Bulgaria
organizer: КАЖИ (Кампании и активизъм за животните в индустрията)
description: Running for the Animals 2026 is a charity event held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia, starting and finishing by Ariana Lake. The race is 5 km long and open to all ages, including four-legged participants. Its goal is to support the campaigns of the organization KAZhI to reduce and end animal suffering and exploitation. Participation is free, and everyone can make a donation at their discretion. The event takes place near World Animal Day and carries the motto “The Wide Circle of Love.”
course_highlights: The 5 km course is in Borisova Gradina, around Ariana Lake
Suitable for all ages, with pets also welcome to participate
The event takes place outdoors in a natural urban setting
additional: Registration is free and takes place at the event venue on the day, from 9:30 to 10:45. After the run, there will be an awards ceremony and an introduction to KAZhI’s campaigns. The photography exhibition “The Wide Circle of Love” by Mariana Nordgren can be viewed throughout the day until around 15:00. There are no age restrictions. The funds raised support KAZhI’s campaigns and work.

name: НАЦИОНАЛЕН УНИВЕРСИТЕТСКИ ШАМПИОНАТ ПО ПЛАНИНСКО БЯГАНЕ 2026
location: Vitoshko Lale ski slope, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: The 2026 National University Mountain Running Championship takes place in Sofia on the Vitoshko Lale trail. The competition features two distances—2 km for women and 4.2 km for men—offering students an opportunity to compete in sport. The event is organized by the Association for Student Sport and takes place.
course_highlights: 2 km distance for women
4.2 km distance for men
Vitoshko Lale trail in Sofia

name: Въстаниците на Стара Загора 2026
location: Park "Branitelite na Stara Zagora", Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
description: The Defenders of Stara Zagora 2026 is a sporting event held in the Defenders of Stara Zagora Park. The competition features various running and cycling distances suitable for participants of different age groups, including children. Organized by CC Beroe, the event offers an opportunity to take part in active sport and competition in a pleasant natural setting.
course_highlights: Running and cycling distances in the Defenders of Stara Zagora Park
A range of age categories for children and young people
Competition stages and conditions adapted to participants’ ages
additional: The competition includes numerous age categories for children and young people, with separate running and cycling distances. The organizer is CC Beroe; contact: +359888747071. The event takes place in the Defenders of Stara Zagora Park. The competition supports the cleaning and restoration of trails in Bulgarian Volunteer Corps Park.

name: Бягай с нас - спаси живот 2026 Благотворителен крос в подкрепа борбата с рака
description: The charity run “Run with Us – Save a Life!” in Troyan is a city event supporting the fight against breast cancer. It offers two distances—3 km and 5 km—with the start and finish at Vazrazhdane Square. Each participant receives a themed souvenir T-shirt, and the accompanying program includes an information campaign and preventive examinations. The funds raised are used to purchase medical equipment for the local hospital. The event is organized by the “Troyan in the Future” association with the support of Troyan Municipality.
course_highlights: A fully urban run with 3 km and 5 km distances
Start and finish at Vazrazhdane Square in Troyan
Supporting the fight against breast cancer and the purchase of medical equipment
additional: Preventive examinations begin at 10:00 at Troyan Multiprofile Hospital for Active Treatment. The accompanying program includes an information campaign on breast cancer prevention and early detection. The race pack includes a themed souvenir T-shirt. The initiative is linked to free preventive examinations and an information campaign at Troyan Multiprofile Hospital for Active Treatment.

name: Brașov Running Festival
distance_verbose: 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 metri, 1.2 km, 0.8 km
description: Brașov Running Festival is a top road-running event that brings thousands of runners to Brașov, from amateurs to elite athletes, in an atmosphere full of energy, music, and fun. The festival includes a variety of races, from a 5 km race for beginners and races for children to tRUNsylvania 10K, the only road race in Romania certified with a World Athletics Elite Label. The event takes place on the streets of Brașov’s Tractorul district and offers a complete experience with cheering zones, live performances, and TV broadcasts. It is a celebration of running that combines athletic performance with the joy of community.

name: MARZESTI TRAIL RUN ALEARGĂ, FII PARTE DIN NATURĂ!
description: Mârzeşti Trail Run is an annual cross-country running competition held in the Breazu area, in Rediu commune, Iași County, with the start and finish in front of the forestry ranger station in Mârzeşti Forest. The varied courses include wooded areas, meadows, forest roads and agricultural roads, offering a unique running experience in nature, with flat sections, descents and climbs. The event promotes outdoor sports and supports local social causes, providing an opportunity for running enthusiasts to enjoy themselves and meet. The half-marathon distance and the other races are suitable for different levels of training, and the event includes hydration points and course marshals.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running competition held in Timișoara that promotes a healthy lifestyle and the freedom to discover yourself through movement. The event offers races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 200 meters to a full 42 km marathon. The UVT Liberty Marathon community is dedicated to supporting and motivating participants to reach their potential and enjoy running in a friendly, energetic setting. The courses are designed to challenge and inspire, and the atmosphere is supportive and free-spirited.

name: 1ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Σαλαμίνα «Ahepa Run»
description: The 1st Salamina Half Marathon “Ahepa Run” is a new series of road races combining Greece’s history, culture, and sport. The routes pass through ancient paths and natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience that honors the country’s rich cultural heritage. The event is open to runners of all levels and promotes health, well-being, and social connection. Alongside the half marathon, 5-kilometer and 1-kilometer races for children are also held, as well as races for people with disabilities.

name: 4ο Γόμφοι Trail
description: The 4th Gomfoi Trail semi-mountain race, “Along the Trails of Our Ancestors,” will take place in the Gomfoi area of Trikala. This unique event features two semi-mountain routes starting and finishing in Gomfoi’s central square. The courses follow trails, forest roads, and country roads in the foothills of Mount Itamos and across the Thessalian Plain. The race aims to showcase the area’s natural beauty and historical heritage, while promoting sports tourism and fair play.

name: 5ο Armeno Gate Trail Race
description: The 5th Armeno Gate Trail Race is a mountain race held in the Karystos area of Evia. It is a local event supported by the Armeno Gate Trail Organizing Committee, with Ultra Effort Coaching and Chalkida Sports Academy as co-organizers. The race offers an authentic trail-running experience, ideal for runners seeking routes in a natural setting. The event is supported by the Municipality of Karystos and the Regional Unit of Evia. October weather is usually cool and favorable for races.

name: Kastoria Lake – City Trail
description: The Kastoria Lake - City Trail race offers a unique mountain running experience around Lake Kastoria, combining natural beauty with urban scenery. Participants enjoy routes that cross trails with stunning views of the lake and the city’s historic center. The race is ideal for runners looking for a challenge in a picturesque setting, with varied terrain and elevation. The organizers ensure a safe and friendly atmosphere, welcoming runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Routes around Lake Kastoria with panoramic views
Mountain running trails through natural and urban scenery
Passages through the city’s historic center

name: Spetses Mini Marathon
description: The Spetses Mini Marathon is Greece’s largest multi-sport event, held on the beautiful island of Spetses. It includes running and swimming races for all ages and levels, with a participation medal for everyone and awards by age category. The courses offer unique experiences with refreshment stations and beautiful scenery, while the organizers prioritize athletes’ comfort and safety. The event attracts runners and swimmers from around the world, offering a celebration of sport and culture.

name: Run Greece Piraeus
description: Run Greece Piraeus 2026 offers a unique road-running experience in the heart of Piraeus, with routes suitable for runners of all levels. It includes 10 km and 5 km races, a power walking event, a children’s race, and a family run. The event is welcoming to everyone, promoting sports and social participation in a beautiful urban setting. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with electronic timing and support throughout the race.

name: IRAKLEIOS ATHLOS
description: The IRAKLIOS ATHLOS is a mountain running race held on Mount Erymanthos, in the Micha-Tsapournia area of the Municipality of Erymanthos, Achaia. It features three routes: 21 km, 9 km, and a 2 km children’s race, with varied terrain including fir forest, an alpine zone, and forest dirt roads. The race combines athletic challenge with experiencing nature and environmental awareness, promoting the protection of the Erymanthos ecosystem. The organizers provide electronic timing, medical coverage, refreshments, medals, and technical T-shirts for participants in the longer routes.

name: Xeskouriazo Trail
description: The ΞεΣκουριάΖω mountain running race has been organized since 2013 by the Women’s Association of Megali Panagia on Mount Kakavos in Halkidiki. Dedicated to environmental protection and opposition to gold-copper mining, the race promotes trail running and showcases the area’s natural beauty. The routes start and finish at Chorostasi Square in Megali Panagia and offer a unique experience in mountainous terrain with significant elevation gain. The race welcomes athletes from all over Greece and aims to keep the mountains alive and protected.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Αλμυρού «Δίδυμες Μετεωρίτικες Λίμνες Ζερέλια»
Γύρος Λιμνοθάλασσας Αιτωλικού
organizer: Αθλητικός και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δρομέων Αιτωλικού
description: The Aitoliko Lagoon Round is an established road race held every September and organized by the Aitoliko Runners’ Athletic and Cultural Association. The race takes place in the beautiful town of Aitoliko, known as Greece’s Little Venice. Its route circles the lagoon, offering unique natural beauty and a memorable sporting experience. Around 500 athletes and high-level runners from across Greece take part in the sporting events, along with many children running shorter routes. The event combines sport and culture, with activities held at Aitoliko’s East Beach, creating a celebration for participants and spectators alike.

name: Нови Пазар Рън / Novi Pazar Run
organizer: Българска федерация по лека атлетика, КЛА „Нови пазар“ и община Нови пазар
description: “Novi Pazar Run” is a road race in Novi Pazar, part of the Run Bulgaria series. Previous editions have offered distances of 6.5 and 13 km, as well as a short run for children and beginners. The race combines a sporting challenge with a route between Novi Pazar and historic Pliska.
course_highlights: The 13 km long-distance route connects the center of Novi Pazar with Pliska and back.
The 6.5 km course follows the same route, turning around at 3.25 km.
The 1 km short run is suitable for children and beginners.
additional: The race is the final event in the Run Bulgaria series and is associated with the Novi Pazar holiday.

name: B2Run Aθens
description: B2Run Athens 2026 is a corporate 5-kilometer running event held at the iconic Olympic Stadium of OAKA. More than 2,000 runners from various industries take part wearing their company colors, fostering team spirit and collaboration among colleagues. After the race, a lively after-run party follows, featuring live music, a DJ, food, and an awards ceremony, making B2Run a unique sports and entertainment experience for the corporate world.

name: A³ Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
organizer: ККТ „Сърнена гора“, ТД „Сърнена гора“, Вело клуб „Зарата“ и Община Стара Загора
description: A³ Ultra Trail Run & XCM Cycling is an iconic race that brings together Bulgaria’s top mountain runners and cyclists. It takes place in Ayazmoto Park in Stara Zagora and offers a range of courses of varying difficulty, suitable for beginners and professionals alike. The event combines technical routes, beautiful scenery, and an adrenaline-filled experience in the heart of the Sarnena Sredna Gora. Participants can choose from several running and cycling distances, with all courses professionally marked and secured.
course_highlights: Courses of varying difficulty from 6 km to 40 km, suitable for beginners and elite athletes
Panoramic views and varied terrain in the Sarnena Sredna Gora
Professionally marked routes with volunteers at key junctions
additional: The start and finish are at a central meadow in Ayazmoto Park, at GPS coordinates 42.438023, 25.617366. The schedule includes a technical briefing and mass start for cyclists at 08:55, followed by staggered starts for runners at 09:30. The awards ceremony and event closing are at 16:00. Disciplines include mountain running and mountain biking (XCM and E-Bike). Electronic timing with chips is provided.

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Marathon is a mountain running event held in the Cerna Valley, Băile Herculane, organized by Alternative Timișoara Sports Club. The race includes Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) events on mountain trails that cross the Cerna Mountains and connect the area's 39 hamlets. This outdoor competition showcases the region's natural beauty and the challenges of mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains
Connecting 39 hamlets in the Cerna Valley area
Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) events

name: Pedale’n Codru ~ 2026
location: DJ572, Băile Lipova, Lipova, Arad County, Romania

name: TulbuRun la Asconi Winery 2027
location: Asconi Winery, Puhoi, Ialoveni District, Moldova

name: Trka za život
description: The Race for Life is a charity event in Niš dedicated to supporting women with cancer. It aims to raise awareness of early detection and empower patients. Participants express solidarity and hope through moving together and taking part in educational activities at the finish. The event brings individuals, families, and organizations together in a spirit of community and compassion, combining sport, education, and charitable engagement in an inspiring day.
course_highlights: Start at Niš Fortress, with positive energy and a sense of community
Inspiring messages and educational materials at the checkpoints
A finish area with advice on prevention and support
additional: Each participant starts the race with a symbolic hug of support. The event concludes with a group ceremony and fundraising to help people affected by cancer. At the finish, an educational corner offers advice from doctors, psychologists, and radiologists. The race is a charity initiative by the Budite uz nas association, which provides ongoing support to women with cancer. Participation raises funds for support activities for people affected by cancer, healthcare institutions, and the purchase of equipment and supplements.

name: Ορεινός Αγώνας Δρόμου «Περιβάλλον και Ενοπλες Δυνάμεις»
Bucharest Marathon
description: The Raiffeisen Bank Bucharest Marathon is an iconic sporting event held annually in Bucharest, offering races for runners of all levels. The courses include the full 42 km marathon, the 21 km half marathon, the 10 km race, the popular race, and the 4x relay, all starting in Constitution Square. The event is known for its vibrant atmosphere, community support, and involvement in charitable causes. Participants can experience an urban course that passes major landmarks in the capital, with hydration and support stations along the way.
