name: Αγώνας Δρόμου Φερών Εβρου «Μινωτάκης»
description: The Feres, Evros “Minotakis” Road Race is organized by the Dromeas Thrace club, which promotes traditional and mass-participation sports, with an emphasis on health, well-being, and recreation. The race is an important sporting event for the local community of Feres, aiming to involve people of all ages and fitness levels. The club also offers activities such as hiking and triathlon, supporting the running movement in the region. The event is founded on values such as cooperation, innovation, and volunteerism.

name: 2ο Naxos Run Race For The Cure
Petrovaradin Fortress NIGHT trail Serbia EPIC 2026
location: Petrovaradin Fortress, Petrovaradin, Novi Sad, Serbia
description: Petrovaradin Fortress NIGHT trail Serbia EPIC is a night race held at Petrovaradin Fortress, known for its historical significance and unique atmosphere. The race offers electronic timing, a fully marked course, and a chip-equipped race bib. Participants receive an official race T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, refreshments at the finish, medical assistance, and other benefits. After the race, a party and concert are held, creating a great sporting and entertainment atmosphere. This race is part of the Serbia EPIC series and is a challenge for all trail-running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Night race at Petrovaradin Fortress
Fully marked course and GPS track for navigation
Refreshment zone at the finish and medical assistance during the race

name: Маратон "Хайдушки Пътеки"
location: Природен парк Сините камъни, Сливен, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: Маратон, 41.5 km, 41 km, 21.6 km, Полумаратон, 13 km, 12 km
organizer: КЛУБ СТОТЕ ВОЙВОДИ - ФОНДАЦИЯ СТАРИЯ БРЯСТ
description: The Haidushki Pateki Marathon is a unique race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park in the Balkan Mountains. The course passes through a historic rocky massif with alpine terrain, fortified with 14 ancient and medieval fortresses that outlaws used as refuges. The route follows ancient trails used by the outlaws and offers an opportunity to enjoy the area’s nature and history. The race takes place in the last week of October, bringing varied weather conditions and a different level of difficulty each year.

name: Rebel Trails Marathon Reverse
location: Sinite Kamani Nature Park, Sliven, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб Стоте войводи – Фондация Стария бряст
description: The “Haidushki Pateki” Marathon is a unique event held in the historic area of Sinite Kamani Nature Park, part of the Balkan Mountains. The course crosses an alpine rocky massif fortified with 14 ancient and medieval fortresses, which were used by hajduks as refuges. The route follows ancient paths used by the hajduks and aims to promote the historic fortresses. The marathon takes place in late October, bringing different weather conditions and levels of difficulty each year.
course_highlights: The course passes through 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
Alpine terrain with bare rocky peaks, ridges, and steep slopes
The route follows ancient hajduk paths that still exist today
additional: The event is organized by Club Stote Voyvodi - Old Elm Foundation. The marathon takes place in Sinite Kamani Nature Park, in the eastern part of the Balkan Mountains. There are several distances: 42K marathon, 21K half marathon, 13K quarter marathon, 10K, and a children's run. The course varies in difficulty and takes place in changeable weather conditions in late October.

name: Azuga Trail Race
description: Azuga Trail Race powered by JYSK is an annual mountain running event held in the town of Azuga and the Baiului Mountains, Romania. The event offers passionate runners a unique experience across four spectacular routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, and an atmosphere filled with adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people who share your passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains
Routes in the Baiului Mountains, with aid stations offering water, energy drinks, and fruit
Different start locations for the main races and children’s races, including special routes with gondola transport
additional: The race kit includes a personalized bib, personalized products, individual chip timing, aid stations with water and fruit, finisher medals, cash and sports equipment prizes, surprise prize draws, ITRA/UTMB points where applicable, and an official photo and video album. Gondola transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. Awards ceremony at 17:00, SuperParty on Saturday evening with DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation gain, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

name: Făget Tour
description: Făget Tour GlobalLogic is a running race organized by Runners Club in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run in nature during one of the most beautiful times of the year. The event includes two main races: a 7 km cross-country race and a 22 km half marathon, held on scenic routes in the Făget area. This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, now in its 15th edition, and promises an enjoyable and challenging experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 7 km cross-country route in nature
22 km half marathon with scenic views
Routes marked and supported by Runners Club Cluj-Napoca
additional: The routes are marked, and a GPX file is available for the half marathon. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The race has official partners and supporters. The event also includes other trail races and related activities, offering an opportunity to discover the area's natural beauty and take part in a community sporting event.

name: Armenopolis Ultra Running 2026
location: Parcul Mare, Strada Parcului, Gherla, Romania

name: ALERGAREA DE SAMBATA - CALARASI
description: The “Saturday Run” Half Marathon in Călărași is a landmark sporting event for the local community, offering races for all ages and fitness levels. The event takes place in Călărași Central Park and includes several events, from short races for children and adults to the half marathon. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere and facilities such as water and refreshment stations, as well as personal belongings storage. It is a competition that encourages personal achievement and community spirit.
course_highlights: Varied routes: 3 km, 5 km, and 10.5 km in Călărași Central Park
Water and isotonic drink stations along the route and at the start/finish
Open to all ages, with races for children and a corporate race
additional: Participants receive a bag for storing personal belongings. Registration is available online and by bank transfer. Participants must submit a declaration of responsibility. The corporate race will take place only if there are at least 10 teams. At the finish, runners receive snacks and water.

name: SEMIMARATONUL CRAIOVEI
description: The Craiova Half Marathon is an annual running and fundraising event for community causes, organized by the Romanian Association of Young People with Initiative (A.R.T.I.) in collaboration with SightRunning.ro. The event includes timed half-marathon, 14 km and 7 km races, as well as untimed races and activities for all ages and categories, including people with disabilities and pets. The course is urban, starting and finishing at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade in Craiova, and consists of 7 km loops with an elevation gain of 58 m. Participants support charitable projects in education, health and social inclusion.
course_highlights: Urban course starting and finishing at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade
7 km loops: 3 for the half marathon, 2 for the 14 km race and 1 for the 7 km race
Hydration stations and medical assistance along the course
additional: Race kits can be collected at Electroputere Mall in the days before the event and on event day at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade. The event includes special races for wheelchair users and adaptive sports, as well as untimed races and related activities. Safety measures include law enforcement, volunteers and an ambulance with a doctor along the course.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori
description: The Autumn Mountain Marathon on Fruška Gora is a traditional sports and recreation event that brings runners together on challenging trails through the beautiful nature of Fruška Gora. The races cover various distances, from ultra-extreme to beginner trails, and are suited to different fitness levels. The event takes place in Popovica near Sremska Kamenica and offers a unique combination of challenge and enjoyment of nature. The organizers also provide transport to the start, as well as extensive support during the race.

name: 14ος Νυχτερινός Ημιμαραθώνιος Θεσσαλονίκης
description: The 14th Thessaloniki International Night Half Marathon is a unique sporting event that combines athletics with the city’s nighttime party. Participants can enjoy a half-marathon course, as well as 10,000m, 5,000m, and 1-mile races, with full support and amenities. The event offers commemorative T-shirts, medals, electronic timing, and energy support, creating a welcoming and lively atmosphere for all runners. It also promotes social responsibility and culture, strengthening the Thessaloniki community.

name: One Step Together Run 2026 – 5 χλμ. Αγώνας Δρόμου
One Step Together Run 2026 – 1.500 μ. Διαδρομή Συμπερίληψης
Black Sea Trail
description: Black Sea Trail is a mountain running event held in the Varna region of Bulgaria, with three different distances suitable for runners of various levels. The courses offer a variety of terrain and beautiful views of the Black Sea, combining challenging climbs and descents. The event is a great opportunity for nature lovers and mountain runners to enjoy sport and the outdoors together.

name: Emine ultra
description: Emine Ultra is a mountain running event that combines the beauty of the mountains and the sea in the Elenite area. The race offers four distances—4K, 12K, 28K, and 50K—suitable for runners of different levels. The course follows scenic natural trails and offers a unique experience in nature. The event is part of the international Kom–Emine route and attracts runners seeking challenge and inspiration.

name: Povlen Trail
description: Povlen Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects the mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia through unique trail races. This race gives runners the opportunity to explore unspoiled nature and enjoy the challenges of mountain trails. West Serbia Trails promotes a blend of sport, nature, and community, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants.

name: Kamenica trejl 2026
description: Kamenica Trail 2026 is the first race in the South Trail Series, taking place on October 18, 2026, at the Dabilo recreation area near Niš. The race offers two courses: a long course of 20.7 km with 810 meters of elevation gain and a short course of 5.6 km with 240 meters of elevation gain. Both start and finish at the same location. The routes follow forest trails, gravel roads, and a stretch of asphalt, offering a challenge and beautiful scenery. The event is organized by the Running and Mountaineering Association “Running club Niš.” Participants can expect good organization, refreshments, and prizes.

name: 10ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αρτας
organizer: Δήμος Αρταίων, ΕΑΣ ΣΕΓΑΣ Ηπείρου, Σύλλογος Δρομέων Άρτας
description: The 10th Arta Half Marathon, “The Road of the Bridge,” is a race held in the city of Arta, known for its rich history and important historical monuments. The half-marathon course passes the city’s most iconic landmarks, including the famous Bridge of Arta, offering runners a unique experience. The race is certified by the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS) and also includes city races and children’s races. The start and finish are at central locations in the city, enhancing the local character and festival atmosphere.

name: 1ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Τιμής και Μνήμης Ανδρών Ηρωικού Τάγματος Εθελοντών Κρητών
34-ти Мемориал „Митето”
description: The “Dimitar Varbanov - Miteto” race in the town of Koynare is a traditional athletics event with a history spanning more than 30 years. It includes half marathons, road races, and track meets. In recent years, a race walking competition has also been held, attracting athletes from cities across Bulgaria. The organizers, the Spartak - Koynare Athletics Club, provide professional organization and competitions for all ages. The event is known for featuring Bulgaria’s top runners and race walkers.

name: Надбягване в Източни Родопи
description: The Eastern Rhodopes Race is the first ultrarunning event in one of the most biodiverse regions in Bulgaria and Europe, steeped in the mystique of its centuries-old history. The courses pass through wild, little-known areas, including megalithic monuments and unique natural phenomena, and feature challenging technical descents and climbs. The race is suitable for experienced runners as well as beginners who want to enjoy nature and an adventurous experience. The organizers provide course marking, medals, timing, photographers, and support along the route, including for pets.
course_highlights: Courses pass by megalithic monuments such as Kovil and natural phenomena such as Sheitan Dere
Wild, little-known terrain with no marked hiking trails
Technical descents and climbs with moderate elevation gain
additional: Participants may bring a pet; water and treats are provided at aid stations. Reusable cups or bottles are recommended to reduce plastic use. Course marking, medals, timing, photographers, isotonic drinks, water, fruit, and food are provided. The courses have no officially marked hiking trails, making them suitable for adventurers.

name: Национален шампионат по крос кънтри
description: The National Cross Country Championships in Koynare is a prestigious event that brings together athletes from across Bulgaria for competitive races in a natural and challenging setting. The event offers young and experienced runners alike the opportunity to compete on varied terrain suited to cross country. The organizers provide professional timing and live results, ensuring accurate and transparent rankings. The event is part of the Race Timing BG calendar, which offers modern registration and timing services.
course_highlights: Natural obstacles and varied terrain
Suitable for all age groups and fitness levels
Professional timing using RFID technology
additional: Online registration with personalized emails and a real-time participant list. Certified timing equipment and live results, optimized for mobile devices and computers.

name: Скоростното изкачване на Копитото
organizer: Екипът на Скоростното изкачване на Копитото
description: The Kopitoto Speed Climb is an annual race that challenges participants to climb the trail from Shisharka Bar to the summit of Kopitoto in Vitosha. The event is dedicated to great mountaineering achievements and embodies the spirit of challenge and personal accomplishment. The route has 662 metres of elevation gain and is clearly marked. Every finisher receives a medal and a certificate. The race combines sporting spirit with inspiration and respect for nature and mountaineering tradition.
course_highlights: Start at Shisharka Bar in the Knyazhevo district
Route with 662 metres of elevation gain
Finish at the summit of Kopitoto on a marked trail
additional: Race packets can be collected at 5 Yantra Street, floor 1, apartment 5, from 08:30 to 19:30 on the day before the race. On race day, the race office opens at 08:00 in the start arena area. The start is open between 09:00 and 12:00, with unclaimed race numbers released to those interested at 11:30. Every participant must pass through the start arch to register their chip. The awards ceremony takes place between 12:30 and 13:00 in the courtyard of the Kopitoto tower. If a participant withdraws, they must call the phone numbers provided so that they are not searched for at the finish. The race is dedicated to the memory of Boyan Petrov. Categories are available for men, women, amateurs and veterans; finishers receive a medal and a certificate.

name: Стани Юнак 2026
description: Stani Yunak is a unique obstacle race that brings together active people and athletes from different disciplines. Participants can choose between three courses of varying length and difficulty: Sprint 3 km, Balance 5 km, and Hyper 8 km. Each features a variety of obstacles that require strength, endurance, coordination, and strategic thinking. The race is suitable for beginners and advanced participants alike, offering controlled difficulty and support at every obstacle. After the finish, every participant receives a medal as a symbol of courage and determination, while music, beer, and barbecue add to the atmosphere. Hotel Avenue in Burgas offers accommodation and relaxation facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Three courses of varying lengths: 3 km, 5 km, and 8 km
A variety of obstacles requiring strength, endurance, and technique
Controlled difficulty, with supervision and instructions at every obstacle
additional: The race offers suitable levels for both beginners and advanced participants. Someone is present at every obstacle to monitor safety. Free trial training sessions are organized to help participants find the right group for their level. After the race, enjoy a festival atmosphere with music, beer, and barbecue. Hotel Avenue offers rooms and apartments, along with a restaurant, gym, and parking. A children's category, “Little Yunak,” with 10 obstacles is also planned. Finishers receive a medal.

name: Viking Challenge Trail
location: Planinarski dom Jedinstvo, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: Viking Challenge is a race held on Fruška Gora, with courses of varying distances suited to all ages and running levels. Participants can choose from courses ranging from 1 km to 22 km, which are well marked and offer a challenging and exciting adventure in nature. The race is carefully organized, with electronic timing, refreshments at checkpoints, and a post-race meal, all contributing to a pleasant atmosphere and the safety of all participants. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the support of volunteers and spectators.
course_highlights: Courses of 1 km, 7 km, 15 km, and 22 km on Fruška Gora
Well-marked courses with electronic timing
Refreshments, a post-race meal, and medical assistance available
additional: Starts are in groups according to registration dates, with no possibility of changing groups; participants receive a medal and a race T-shirt; race photos are available; water, juice, and energy drinks are provided at checkpoints; medical assistance is available in case of injury.

name: Ovčar 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held in the spectacular Ovčar-Kablar Gorge, starting and finishing in Ovčar Banja. The race is 22.4 km long, with a cumulative elevation gain of 1,600 metres. It includes technically challenging sections, with Kablar’s two summits as distinctive course landmarks. Participants can enjoy varied terrain, including fast forest sections and rocky stretches, as well as beautiful views of the West Morava River and the surrounding mountains. The event is part of the national skyrunning series and awards ITRA points. It is organised by the “Kablar” Mountaineering Society of Čačak under the patronage of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia.
course_highlights: 22.4 km long with 1,600 m of cumulative elevation gain
Technically challenging sections, with rocks as the dominant feature
Views of the West Morava River and surrounding mountains from Kablar’s two summits
additional: The race awards 1 ITRA point and counts toward the Mountaineering Association of Serbia (PSS) national skyrunning series. The start and finish are at the Nature Centre in Ovčar Banja. The course is certified and open to participants with a valid medical examination or a competition licence.

name: ABO Pharma XL Щафета 4 х 3 х 2.5
description: ABO Pharma XL Relay is a team running event in Sofia, where four participants complete a relay distance of 3 × 2.5 km. Gather friends, colleagues, or teammates and take part in a dynamic race that combines running with team spirit.
course_highlights: A team of four runners
Relay distance of 3 × 2.5 km
Held in the area of Vrana Palace in Sofia

name: Morning Run
location: Детска площадка „Слончето“, Борисова градина, София, Bulgaria
description: Morning Run is an annual cross-country race in Borisova Garden, Sofia, held since 2012 on the last Sunday of October. The course is a 5-kilometre loop, suitable for runners of all levels. The event also offers 10 km and 20 km options, as well as a children’s run with athletics games and a warm-up. Every finisher receives a medal, and the awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. The organisers provide a bag drop, medical assistance and aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: The course is a 5-kilometre loop in Borisova Garden
An aid station with water, electrolyte drinks and fruit shortly after the start
Start positions based on speed for better organisation and safety
additional: Start times are 9:00 for 5 km, 9:05 for 10 km and 9:10 for 20 km. The Kids Run for children starts at 12:00, with 40 minutes of warm-up and athletics exercises. A bag drop is provided, with volunteers tagging bags. Medical services are available at the start, and an ambulance is stationed in front of the CSKA stadium. Portable toilets are located 50 metres before the start. The start area is at the “Elephant” playground. Electronic timing is provided, and registration is free for participants aged 55+.

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event for both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts in Otelec and finishes in Piața Victoriei, offering a unique experience through the story of Eugeniu de Savoya’s arrival. The half marathon and shorter races offer varied routes through the city’s squares, parks, and historic neighborhoods, showcasing local beauty and heritage. The event also includes associated activities such as workshops, a Pasta Party, and a special anniversary race, “106 pentru POLI.”
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, in Otelec, and finishes in Piața Victoriei
The half marathon combines the squares and parks of the Fabric neighborhood along the banks of the Bega
The shorter races pass through the parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric neighborhood
additional: Race packs are distributed at the UPT Rectorate in Piața Victoriei. The marathon starts with a bus departure at 06:30 from Piața Victoriei to Otelec. Energy products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. Participants can choose from several race categories, as well as workshops and a pasta party.

name: 1ος Συμμετοχικός Αγώνας Δρόμου στο Παραποτάμιο Πάρκο Άρτας
myathlete AMA Training 2026 - Προπόνηση #3 στη Διαδρομή του Αυθεντικού Μαραθωνίου - 20 χλμ
Trka na 10 kilometara 2026
location: Večna vatra, Park prijateljstva, Beograd, Serbia

name: Imittos Epic
description: The Imittos Epic is a demanding mountain race aimed at experienced trail runners. The course features technical, rocky terrain, strict time limits, and cutoff points. It starts in the area of Agios Georgios Koutalas and includes uphill and downhill trails, passages by monasteries, and technical sections with exposed areas. The course reaches an elevation of 960 meters and offers a demanding but exciting mountain-running experience.
course_highlights: Technical, rocky terrain with exposed sections where a fall can have serious consequences
Passes by Kaisariani Monastery and Asteriou Monastery
Fast downhill trails and a technical rocky section on the “Karavi” trail
additional: Participants will be timed with a chip at multiple points along the course. There are cutoff times at specific checkpoints for the Epic race. Race bibs and chips are distributed on scheduled days before the race in Vyronas. Runners must bring their own bottle or cup, as there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations. Passage times are broadcast live over the Internet. Awards take place immediately after the winners finish.

name: Beiuș Running Day
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering races for all ages and experience levels, held in the town of Beiuș. The courses include a free children’s race, a 2 km race for beginners and families, a 10 km race for amateur and semi-professional runners, and a 21.1 km half marathon for experienced runners. The event takes place in Mihai Eminescu Park and on the streets of Beiuș, with safe, well-marked courses that offer an enjoyable and competitive experience. Participants receive prizes, medals, and surprises, while the children’s races are organized with special safety and supervision measures.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths and paved streets in Beiuș
A completely safe children’s race on a flat course closed to vehicle traffic
Prizes and medals for all age groups and distances
additional: The Children’s Race starts at 11:30 and is organized by age categories for children aged 4 to 13, on a completely safe course closed to vehicle traffic. Children participate for free, and parents or guardians must be present throughout the race. The adult races start at 11:00 in Mihai Eminescu Park. Prizes are available for podium finishers, and all participants who complete the race receive medals.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a running event offering a variety of routes around the Hațeg Royal Fortress, combining natural scenery with historical features. Participants can choose between the marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, and family run. All races follow well-marked, technical routes with climbs and descents that challenge both beginners and advanced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, friendly atmosphere, and attractive prizes. Participants are advised to be fit and have suitable sports gear to fully enjoy the experience.
course_highlights: Well-marked, clean routes with technical climbs and descents through hills and forest
Passage through the Hațeg Royal Fortress and natural areas such as Lunca de Jos and the Subcetate meadow
A range of races: marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, and family run
additional: On-site registration is not available, except for the Kids and Family categories, which are limited to 100 places. Participants must have suitable sports gear, and mandatory equipment may be checked at the start and along the route. There is a dedicated race for people with special abilities, “Și eu POT!”.

name: Gledić Ultra trejl 2026
description: Gledić Ultra Trail is a mountain race held in the heart of Serbia, in the Gledić Mountains, offering runners a unique opportunity to experience unspoiled nature across forests, meadows, and mountain ridges. The race offers three courses of different distances and difficulty levels: Lane (12 km), Srna (22 km), and Jelen (ultra, 58 km). All are well-marked and pass through beautiful natural landscapes. This event is not just a race, but also a gathering of people who share a passion for nature and adventure, with a generous race package and support along the course. The start is planned, with time limits suited to the course distances.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through the forests, meadows, and ridges of the Gledić Mountains
Three courses of different distances: 12 km, 22 km, and 58 km, with significant elevation gain
Beautiful viewpoints and authentic natural landscapes
additional: The race package includes a T-shirt with the race logo, a medal, a chip-equipped race bib, aid stations, professional photos, sponsor gifts, and lunch for participants. The courses are marked and secured. The time limit for the longest course is 12 hours, and for the middle-distance course, 6 hours.

name: South Olympus Forest Trail
description: The South Olympus Forest Trail 54 km race starts from the village square in Palios Panteleimonas, Pieria, and traverses trails with gentle slopes and impressive views. The route includes uphill and downhill sections, with a total ascent of approximately 2,000 metres, passing through natural landscapes such as Lake Kati and the village of Palia Pori. There are several aid stations and strict equipment requirements due to the season. The race offers a challenging yet enchanting experience on forest trails and in the mountainous landscapes of Olympus.
course_highlights: 930 m ascent in the first 8.5 km, with views of Lake Kati
Route with approximately +2,000 m of total elevation gain
Views of the Thessalian Plain, the peaks of Olympus, and the Aegean Sea
additional: Mandatory equipment due to the season. Aid stations at kilometres 9, 17, 28, 36, and 46. Cut-off points at 17 km (3:30 hours) and 36 km (8:30 hours). The event also includes 10-kilometre routes, and takes place in October 2026. Detailed information is available about registration and the required equipment.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of the city of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, turning every kilometer into a symbol of an active, healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic, unifying sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: An urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
A community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail run in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest. It started in 2018 and has grown to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run, suitable for runners of all levels. The race focuses on the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, and is organized by a team passionate about running. Participants can join group training sessions at different paces, led by coaches, to prepare for race day.
course_highlights: A 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
A range of races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Training sessions organized in groups at different paces
additional: Training sessions are organized in groups at different paces and led by coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with Asociația Magic and Asociația Zi de Bine. The event includes several race categories, route details and participant instructions, as well as support for social causes.

name: 9ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου Περιστερίου – Peristeri Run 2026 - 10,2χλμ
Ετοιμαζόμαστε για Μαραθώνιο - Open Marathon Run ΚΠΙΣΝ 2026 - 8 χλμ
location: Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center (ΚΠΙΣΝ), Kallithea, Attica, Greece

name: 5ο Zografou City Run - Γιάννης Ζώρζος 2026 - 9,6 ΧΛΜ
7ος Ορεινός Αγώνας «Λίμνη Νευρόπολη 2026» - Ημιμαραθώνιος NMR 21 χλμ
11ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου Παναγία Μερέντα
description: The Panagia Merenta Popular Road Race is a traditional event held in Markopoulo, Attica. It is organized by the Parish of the Holy Metropolitan Church of St. John in Markopoulo and offers an opportunity to take part in a popular road race with a friendly, local character. The race is a celebration for runners and the local community, promoting exercise and social participation. The event has a long tradition and is an important occasion for the area.

name: Τρέχω για τον Κορινό
description: The “I Run for Korinos” race is an established sporting event held in Korinos, Katerini. It is an event full of positive energy and smiles, attracting runners and spectators from the area. The race promotes physical activity and community participation, offering an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Първа Пушка Trail 2026
description: Pърва Пушка Trail is a mountain race in Koprivshtitsa that combines sport, nature, and history. The race offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gain, passing through scenic forest trails and open ridges, and reaching Mount Bogdan—the highest point in Sredna Gora. Participants can enjoy the mountain’s autumn beauty and magnificent views of the Rhodope and Balkan Mountains. The event captures the spirit of the April Uprising and Koprivshtitsa’s patriotic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through scenic forest trails and open ridges
Climb to Mount Bogdan (1,604 m), the highest point in Sredna Gora
Cobblestone streets and the historic atmosphere of Koprivshtitsa
additional: The start is at 20th April Square in central Koprivshtitsa. Two distances (25 km and 35 km) are part of the international UTMB Index network and award ITRA points. The 10 km course has a cut-off time of 5 hours and 30 minutes, while the 35 km course has a cut-off time of 6 hours and 30 minutes. In poor weather conditions, the 10 km course may be reversed. The entry includes a race pack with materials and gifts, chip timing, insurance, and medical assistance.

name: LAST RIDE VITOSHA 2026
location: Vitoshko Lale ski run, Vitosha Mountain, Sofia, Bulgaria
description: LAST RIDE VITOSHA 2026 is an open mountain biking event and national university championship marking the end of the active MTB season on Vitosha. Organized by the Academic Association for University Sports (AUS), the event brings together mountain biking enthusiasts and competitors, including MTB and E-bike categories. The course crosses varied mountain terrain with climbs, descents and technical sections typical of XC cycling, in the area of the Vitoshko Lale ski run. The event also supports volunteer trail care on Vitosha, encouraging participants to help protect nature.
course_highlights: Varied mountain terrain with climbs and descents
Technical sections typical of XC mountain biking
The course passes through the Universiada 83 cross-country ski trail
additional: Registration is mandatory and must be completed online; payment is made on site. Every participant must start with a roadworthy mountain bike and a helmet. The event has separate classifications for MTB men, MTB women and E-bike. The program includes a briefing, a 10:00 start, an awards ceremony and a presentation of a volunteer initiative. E-bike participants have a separate start and classification.

name: ISTRITA XSCAPE
description: IstritaXscape is a mountain running event organized by the Legendary Sports Sports Club Association, held on the hills, trails, and forest roads around Istrița Hill and the Sărata-Monteoru resort. The routes offer a unique experience, combining nature with the area’s millennia-old history, including Dacian, Roman, and prehistoric traces. Three races are available: Fun Run, Half Marathon, and Marathon, each featuring spectacular scenery and mountain challenges. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere and amenities such as refreshment stations and individual timing.
course_highlights: Routes across the hills and trails around Istrița and Sărata-Monteoru
Scenic views of the Monteoru resort and the city of Buzău
Ascents and descents on forest roads and marked trails
additional: Participants receive a race pack with a race number, individual timing, a finisher’s medal, refreshment stations and on-course support, isotonic drinks at the start/finish, results and an electronic certificate, as well as photo and video materials.

name: The Cactus Run
description: The Cactus Run is one of the major classics in the Bulgarian RunBG Trail Series, held in the village of German, Sofia. The course offers varied terrain and scenic views, making it suitable for mountain-running and nature enthusiasts. The event is part of the seasonal series and attracts runners of different ages and fitness levels. Organized by Trail Series, it offers a well-organized event with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail route in the village of German with varied terrain
Scenic natural views and mountain landscapes
Part of the established RunBG Trail Series
additional: The event takes place on Sunday from 11:00 to 15:00. The organizer is Trail Series. The location is the village of German, Sofia. No specific prices or different distances have been published for the upcoming edition at this time.

name: Misionis Trail
location: Младост Hut, Parka area, Targovishte, Bulgaria
description: Misionis Trail is a mountain race in the area of the town of Targovishte, starting and finishing near Mladost Hut, close to the historic Misionis Fortress. The race offers courses of varying distances and elevation gain, suitable for runners of different levels, including a children’s course. The course is clearly marked with white tape bearing the race logo, and there are aid stations with food and drinks along the routes. The organizers recommend trail running shoes and navigation devices for added safety.
course_highlights: Courses of 6 km (300 m+), 11.2 km (600 m+) and 28.6 km (1300 m+), with rocky terrain and gradients of up to 25%
Start and finish near Mladost Hut, close to Misionis Fortress
Aid stations with water, food and drinks; no plastic cups
additional: The race uses a contactless electronic timing system, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Overnight stays at Mladost Hut are available to participants. There are age categories and prizes for the top finishers, including for the 45+ groups and company teams in the 6 km Business Run. Participants must wear their race bib visibly at all times to avoid disqualification. Finishers receive a medal, and times are recorded electronically. Trail and mountain running shoes are suitable for the rocky courses.

name: BUCHAREST 21K
description: Bucharest 21k is a running race that invites you to discover Romania’s capital in a unique way: by running. The course is flat, fast, and ideal for setting personal records, passing through green parks and combining old architecture with the city’s modern energy. The event is suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs, offering a vibrant, dynamic atmosphere in the heart of Bucharest. It’s the perfect opportunity to explore a lively European city that remains undiscovered by the masses.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course, ideal for personal records
Green parks along the course
A unique blend of old architecture and modern energy
additional: The event is part of the YOLO Events series, which promotes an active, healthy lifestyle. Participants can support charitable causes through personal fundraising pages. The atmosphere is energizing, and the event is open to both elite runners and amateurs. The course includes hydration stations every 5 km and the energetic atmosphere characteristic of Romania’s capital.

name: 43ος Αυθεντικός Μαραθώνιος
description: The 43rd Authentic Athens Marathon is a historic and iconic road race that follows the classic route from Marathon to the Panathenaic Stadium. It offers a unique experience for runners of all levels, with accompanying 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km night race, and a 1,200 m children’s race. The event includes parallel activities such as the allwyn Marathon EXPO and Authentic Talks, which promote the values of sport and social responsibility. The Athens Marathon is a landmark event for runners worldwide, combining history, culture, and sport.
course_highlights: Classic Marathon–Athens route, finishing at the Panathenaic Stadium
Accompanying 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km night race, and a 1,200 m children’s race
A route of historical and cultural interest through the city of Athens
additional: The Marathon starts in waves (blocks 1–10). The clothing bag can only be handed in at the allwyn Marathon EXPO at the Faliro Indoor Hall. The official Athens Marathon App provides updates. Recovery and support services are available to runners after the finish. Social responsibility and volunteer events are also held.

name: Бягай с усмивка
description: The charity run “Run with a Smile” takes place in the city of Vratsa and supports children with facial anomalies. The event includes several distances—short, medium, and long—with routes passing through scenic spots in the Vratsa Balkan. Participants gather at Hristo Botev Square and run with a smile in support of the cause. The event is a tradition and attracts an increasing number of local runners and volunteers.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Vratsa Balkan, with beautiful scenery and shade along the trails
A loop route with a view of Vratsa’s landmark, Vratsata
An opportunity to support the event and refresh yourself along the route, with panoramic views
additional: All distances start together at Hristo Botev Square in Vratsa. The short-distance route has 60 m of elevation gain and is marked with a GPS track available for download. It includes a climb toward the Vestitel Hut and a scenic trail running parallel to the Leva River. In a previous edition, distances of 5, 11, and 21 km were offered, as well as a children’s course of around 600 m.

name: Балкански шампионат по крос кънтри
location: Koynare, Cherven Bryag Municipality, Pleven Province, Bulgaria
description: The Balkan Cross Country Championships are held in Koynare, Bulgaria, and bring together amateur and professional long-distance runners. The course is excellently prepared and offers an exciting experience for participants and spectators. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar and has a tradition in the region.
course_highlights: Excellently prepared course in Koynare
Suitable for long-distance and cross-country running
Balkan Championships with international participation
additional: The competition is held annually and is included in the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar. The course is suitable for cross-country and long-distance races. The organizer is the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.

name: Emenski Canyon Run
location: Emen Village, Veliko Tarnovo Province, Bulgaria
description: Emenski Canyon Run is a trail race held near the village of Emen, Veliko Tarnovo Province. The race offers three distances with varying lengths and elevation gains, suitable for runners of different levels. Participants can enjoy marked courses with aid stations and professional timekeeping. The event includes a medal and souvenir for all finishers, creating a friendly and motivating atmosphere for nature and running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Trail courses of 8 km (380 m elevation gain), 16 km (600 m elevation gain), and 24 km (850 m elevation gain)
Marked routes with aid stations along the course
Professional timekeeping and race bibs for all participants
additional: Registration and race-pack collection from 08:00 to 11:00. Technical briefings before the start of each distance. Participants under 18 must provide a declaration from a parent or guardian.

name: КАРАЙ, БЯГАЙ, ВДЪХНОВЯВАЙ
description: Ride, Run, Inspire is an event that brings together cycling and trail-running enthusiasts amid the beauty of the Balkan Mountains. The route runs from Buhovo to Mount Goten and offers options for both adults, with a distance of 22 km, and children, with a distance of 3 km. The event promotes an active lifestyle, shared experiences, and care for nature, combining sport with a social cause. The organizers invite participants to bring friends and family for a day of movement and fresh air.
course_highlights: Route from Buhovo to Mount Goten
Trail running and cycling amid the natural beauty of the Balkan Mountains
Two routes: 22 km for adults and 3 km for children
additional: The event is part of DRYVIA’s initiatives, which bring people together around social causes through sport and activities. The organizers provide course markings, hydration, and a medical professional along the route. The event promotes nature conservation and responsible behavior among participants. The start is at 11:00. The charitable cause supports the families of Border Police employees and the construction of a monument in their honor.

description: The Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic is a running race organized in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run along the cool trails of Hoia Forest. The event includes several races, with distances of 15 km, 7 km and 3 km, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race takes place in Central Park and its surroundings, offering a natural and challenging setting.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and the family race
Event held in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
additional: The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. Prizes are available for participants, and registration packages include T-shirts and other benefits.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Cross-Country Race is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the 1987 workers’ revolt at the Roman Truck Factory. The 5 km route follows the path taken by the demonstrators at the time, offering participants a symbolic and meaningful experience. The event also includes children’s races, with distances adapted to age groups. Participation is free, and the atmosphere is one of gratitude and freedom.
course_highlights: A 5 km route following the path of the 1987 Brașov Revolt
The start is inside the SC Roman industrial park, near the former Section 440
Children’s races ranging from 250 m to 1.2 km, depending on age
additional: Race kits can be picked up on Friday, 13 November, between 15:30 and 20:00 at the Sport Guru Brașov store. A warm-up and stretching session is led by WePlay. The time limit for the 5 km race is 60 minutes. The awards ceremony and raffle take place after the races.

name: 2ος Δρόμος Υγείας «Αγιος Δημήτριος – Στα Μονοπάτια των Ορυζώνων»
7ο Foloi Trail Run 2026 «Το Φαράγγι των Κενταύρων»
2ος Αγώνας Run for Poland – Bieg Niepodległości 2026
10ος Αυθεντικός Φειδιππίδειος
description: The 10th International Authentic Pheidippides Run is a commemorative 485.3-kilometer ultramarathon that revives the historic feat of the ancient messenger Pheidippides, faithfully following the ancient Athens–Sparta–Athens route. The event honors Greek history and the sporting ideal, offering a unique test of endurance with high standards of sportsmanship and fair competition. The course passes significant historical sites and requires exceptional physical fitness and mental stamina. The event is supported by official organizations and provides comprehensive medical coverage and GPS tracking.
course_highlights: 485.3 km route following the ancient Athens–Sparta–Athens course
Climb up Mount Artemisio (1,227 m), including 4 km on an unpaved road
Passes historical sites such as Ancient Corinth, Ancient Nemea, and the Sparta Stadium with the statue of Leonidas
additional: The event provides GPS tracking with an SOS button, comprehensive medical coverage from the National Center for Emergency Care (EKAB) and the Hellenic Red Cross, an operational plan that includes notifying hospitals along the route, and secure storage for athletes’ personal belongings.

name: XL kmrun - Бонсови поляни
description: XL kmrun – Bonsovi Polyani is a November race in the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the Lyulin Mountain area and the iconic Bonsovi Polyani locality on the outskirts of Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—short, medium, and long—allowing runners with different levels of preparation and ambitions to take part. The event is part of a series of races offering varied courses and running conditions in the natural surroundings of Sofia.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Lyulin Mountain area and the Bonsovi Polyani locality
A choice of three distances—short, medium, and long
A natural, iconic location on the outskirts of Sofia
additional: The race will take place in a natural setting with mountainous terrain; registration details and fees have not been specified. The date is November 22, 2026.

name: Маратон Бургас
price_range: от 10 до 50 EUR в зависимост от избраната дистанцията и периода
description:
Burgas Marathon 2026 awaits you on November 15 for an unforgettable run!

Whether you’re chasing a new personal best, preparing for your first half marathon, or simply want to share the excitement of sport with your family and friends, Burgas Marathon offers a distance for everyone.

Choose your challenge:

42.195 km Marathon | 21.097 km Half Marathon | 10.5 km | 5 km |
1 km Decathlon Fun Run – for children, families, and everyone who wants to be part of the running celebration

The course runs along the sea and past iconic locations in Burgas, combining a fast route, beautiful views, and an incredible atmosphere. Participants from Bulgaria and abroad, dozens of volunteers, music, support along the course, and that unforgettable feeling when you cross the finish line await you.

Choose your distance, register, and become part of the event that brings people together through sport, movement, and a love of an active lifestyle.

Burgas Marathon – Run with the pulse of Burgas!

name: 4o Γίδι των Μεθάνων
description: The 4th Methana Goat is a mountain race organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Troizinia–Methana, with the participation of the Argolis Hellenic Rescue Team. It is a challenging course offering unique mountain-running experiences in a volcanic landscape of great natural beauty. The race is a celebration for lovers of the mountains and adventure, attracting runners seeking a challenge and a connection with nature. The organizers emphasize the safety and support of participants throughout the race.
course_highlights: The volcanic landscape of Methana
Routes with steep climbs and natural beauty
Extensive views of the sea and mountains
additional: The race includes 28 km and 12 km routes, with elevation gains of up to +1720 m and +680 m, respectively, and offers cultural and entertainment events. The area is known for its thermal baths and unique natural landscape.

description: The 1st Nafpaktos Half Marathon “Ahepa Run” is a new road race that combines sport with Greece’s cultural heritage. The race routes pass through historic paths and natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience for all runners. The event also includes a 1 km race for children and a 5 km race for amateur runners and people with disabilities, promoting social connection and sustainable tourism. Participants receive full support, electronic timing, and commemorative gifts.
course_highlights: Routes through ancient paths and natural landscapes
5 hydration stations with water and energy drinks
Electronic timing and medical support throughout
additional: Participant amenities: race bib, backpack, commemorative T-shirt, finisher’s medal, electronic certificate, medical support, bag-drop and changing facilities, athlete transportation, 5 hydration stations, electronic timing, and refreshments along the course and at the finish. The event includes a half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 1 km children’s race, with impressive routes through natural and historic landscapes. Participation promotes health and the area’s cultural identity.

name: Gidi of Methana
description: The Methana GOAT is an annual mountain running race held in autumn on the volcanic peninsula of Methana. It offers courses of 28 km with 1,720 m of elevation gain, 12 km with 680 m, and 5 km with 120 m, attracting athletes seeking a challenge across rugged volcanic terrain. The race stands out for its constantly changing scenery, views of the sea from high points, and warm hospitality. The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race.
course_highlights: Volcanic terrain with steep climbs
Frequent views of the sea from high mountain passes
Beautiful landscapes with changing natural surroundings
additional: Courses: 28 km (+1,720 m), 12 km (+680 m), and 5 km (+120 m). The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race. Trail race through volcanic landscapes in Methana, Greece; registration via the official website; scheduled for November 22–23, 2025.

name: 9ο Olympic Day Run
location: Umbrellas sculpture, Megalou Alexandrou Avenue, Thessaloniki, Greece
organizer: Ελληνική Ολυμπιακή Επιτροπή, Διεθνής Ολυμπιακή Ακαδημία, Ολυμπιακό Μουσείο, Δήμοι Θεσσαλονίκης και Καλαμαριάς, Σύλλογος Ελλήνων Ολυμπιονικών και Διεθνές Κέντρο Ολυμπισμού «ΟΛΥΜΠΙΑ»
description: The 9th Olympic Day Run in Thessaloniki is the country’s only official Olympic road race. It brings the Olympic spirit to the city and draws Olympians and distinguished athletes. The route starts on Megalou Alexandrou Avenue, near the “Umbrellas” sculpture, and runs through central streets, offering a distinctive sporting experience with high standards of safety and aesthetics. The event promotes Greece as the birthplace of the Olympic Games and is a celebration of sport, culture, and education.
course_highlights: Start on Megalou Alexandrou Avenue, near the “Umbrellas” sculpture
The route passes through central streets of Thessaloniki, including Maria Kallas Street, Kaf. Rossidou Street, Them. Sofouli Street, and Nikis Avenue
The route returns and passes the White Tower, an iconic landmark of the city
additional: The race is part of the largest Olympic running team, with Olympians and Paralympians taking part. The event emphasizes safety and high standards of aesthetics in its sporting and cultural activities. Contact telephone: +30 2310 968531. School participation is free.

description: Giona Mountain Race is a new mountain running event showcasing Giona, Amfissa, and the area’s natural wealth. It takes place on November 21 and 22, 2026, and offers courses for athletes of every level, from beginners to experienced runners. The event combines challenge, exploration, and unique views in a two-day celebration of action and respect for the environment. The courses include mountain trails, historic cobbled paths, and views of Parnassus and Phocis.
course_highlights: Giona Trail 28 km with +1,550 m elevation gain, challenging for experienced athletes
Panagiorema Trail 12 km with +550 m elevation gain, featuring fast trails and excellent views
Amfissa City Trail 5 km with +100 m elevation gain, a fast and accessible route through the city
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Kehagia Square in Amfissa on Saturday, November 21, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00, and on Sunday, November 22, 2026, from 07:00 to 08:15. Aid stations: 4 for the 28K, 2 for the 12K, and 1 for the 5K. Mandatory equipment may be specified depending on weather conditions. Outside assistance is prohibited except at official points. Free Run For All and Kids Race activities are also included. The 28, 12, and 5 km races are open to participants aged 18 and over.

name: Lailias Wolves Races
description: Lailias Wolves Races is an endurance running, uphill racing, and cycling event held at Lailias, Serres, on November 21–22, 2026. It features four routes: the long continuous climb, Lailias Ultra Vertical; the short and challenging Lailias Mini Vertical; the fast and accessible forest route, The Wolves Run; and a new open cycling challenge, Lailias Bike Vertical. The event offers a unique experience in a natural setting, with an intense sporting atmosphere and participation opportunities for all runners and cyclists.
course_highlights: A long, continuous climb from Serres to Lailias
A short, steep, and challenging climb on the course
A fast and accessible forest route for everyone
additional: Registration is completed through a form on the website, and the entry fee is paid by bank transfer to an account belonging to M.G.S. Panserraikos. T-shirt size is required only for the Lailias Ultra Vertical and Lailias Bike Vertical routes. Race results are posted on separate pages after the event. The program also includes Lailias Bike Vertical Bike, an open cycling challenge.

name: Ορεινοί Αγώνες Νυμφαίας
location: Tourist Pavilion of Nymfaia, Komotini, Greece
description: The Nymfaia Mountain Races are a challenging mountain running event held in the Nymfaia area of Komotini. The 40-kilometer course offers a unique experience through natural landscapes, with significant elevation changes and varied terrain. The race is organized by the Rodopi Runners club and is an important sporting event for mountain running enthusiasts in the area. The organizers provide refreshments and ensure participants’ safety, offering a complete experience.
course_highlights: A 40-kilometer course with significant elevation changes
Natural landscapes and varied terrain
Refreshments along the course
additional: The race provides refreshments for runners during the course. The organizers emphasize proper hydration and preventing dehydration, providing participants with relevant guidance.
